Sing, dance, and have fun together: Lips: Deutsche Partyknaller is far more than "just" a karaoke game. On one hand, many songs are accompanied by their original music videos; on the other, the two motion-sensitive wireless microphones (sold separately for this version) ensure that Xbox 360 singers have to deliver a sizzling live performance to get the high score. Keiichi Yano, the Japanese developer who has already programmed several highly successful music games, was able to bring all his ideas to life with "Lips."

Lips: Deutsche Partyknaller is far more than just a karaoke game and is available as a standalone version as well as in a bundle with 2 motion-sensitive wireless mics.

Your Avatar joins the game: Lips: Deutsche Partyknaller allows for the integration of Xbox LIVE Avatars, which boosts the fun factor. Furthermore, this game is one of the first titles to allow players to unlock exclusive accessories for their Avatars.

Name: Fahrschule easy 2009/2010: Sicher durch  die theoretische Prüfung
Overview:
Over 1.3 million student drivers in Germany study for their driver's license exam every year.

This new console software now helps all beginners study for the theoretical driving test with a lot more fun. The highlight is that this doesn't strictly have to be done on a PC, because cramming at a computer can be pretty boring. That’s why study sessions are being moved to the living room or your own bedroom—comfortably on the sofa with your console. The program is very easy to operate via the DVD function using the gamepad and Xbox, displayed large and clear on your TV or screen.

Features:
Driving School Easy 2009/2010 prepares you safely, quickly, successfully, and with more fun for the theoretical driving test! It contains all official questions that can be used in the actual theory exam.

By selecting the Reading, Practice, or Exam mode, you determine your own learning pace and progress.

You can run a real exam simulation at any time and then intensively review the questions you answered incorrectly.

Reading Mode: Practice by reading.

Practice Mode: Answer the questions. Every wrong answer is corrected immediately.

Exam Mode: A random generator selects the exam questions, providing detailed results at the end of the test.

Everything is coordinated so you can immediately see where you are confident and what still needs to be practiced.

Simply insert the DVD into the console and you can learn, answer questions, practice, and test yourself easily and comfortably using the controller. With instant results!

Name: Fighting Edition: Includes 3 Games
Overview:
Fighting Edition is a compilation of three fighting games:
Tekken 6
Tekken Tag Tournament 2
Soul Calibur V

Name: PDC World Championship Darts
Overview:
Compete against the greatest PDC Champions in the toughest console championship of the year

4 Game Modes: Exhibition, Custom Tournament, Career, and Party Games.

Three difficulty levels/throwing mechanisms: Amateur, Professional, and Master.

The detailed Career Mode is based on the 7 most significant tournaments of the PDC calendar.

Online Multiplayer – compete in friendly and ranked matches.

You can step into the shoes of 16 PDC pros or compete against them, plus commentary from the TV "Voice of Darts" Sid Waddell and top referee Bruce Spendley.

Computer opponents play according to the pros' real average scores and playing styles.

47 Achievements ranging from "163 Bogey-Checkout" to "9 Dart-Finish".

Name: Ride
Overview:
Ride is a motorcycle racing simulation that aims to recreate a realistic racing experience without any arcade elements. At the start the player designs a character and gets to choose between three bikes from the slowest category (under 700 CC). The main game modes are World Tour, Quick Mode (quick races and time trials) and Online. Most of the content is unlocked through the World Tour. By participating in different events, 'reputation' is earned to buy new bikes and accessories. Bikes can be fully customized based on the appearance, brakes and suspensions, engine, transmission and wheels. Every main category is further split up in different components. For the engine for instance the player can determine the air filter, cylinder head porting, electronic control unit, exhaust and oil type. Components and bikes come from licensed manufacturers, both historic and modern. The general statistics for bikes are acceleration, braking power, handling and top speed.

The world tour events consists of leagues such as naked bikes (middleweight and heavyweight groups), supersports, historic superbikes, modern superbikes, pro circuit, premium events (extremely limited bikes) and open races. Most of them only become available after acquiring the right type of bike. There are about 100 bikes in total, with displacements ranging from 250 to 1,299 cc and manufactured between 1987 and 2015. Each league is further split up in multiple groups of events. Racing events include single races, championships, drag races, endurance, head-to-head, time attack, track day (overtake a number of riders) on circuits inspired by real ones (GP tracks) and more general, open terrain races (city, country etc.). The Team Race game mode requires a team mate as the results of both riders combined determines the final standing. The team mate is a character that can be chosen, but is also possible to download the rider profile and appearance of a friend.

The game contains three simulation levels: Semi Pro, Standard and Pro. They influence the handling of the bike and sometimes lock guides at higher levels. Physics elements include auto brakes, joint brakes, an anti wheelie option, tuck-in, different settings for following the ideal trajectory (shown through coloured arrows on the track to show the best line and recommended speed), the type of transmission and influence over TCS (traction). The game also takes into account how the track evolves over multiple laps with rubbered in black marks that offer better grip. At lower levels it is possible to use multiple rewinds, allowing the player to rewind time after a mistake. Before each race the settings of the bike can be adjusted, based on the suspension (preload, spring stiffness, compression damping, rebound damping), handlebars and gears. While racing the player controls acceleration and braking (front and rear brake), shifting gears, steering, shifting weight, adjusting TCS and tuck-in. There are different camera options and it is possible to look to the sides or behind to keep an eye on the other racers.

Multiplayer includes split-screen for two players, single races for up to twelve players and championships with multiple races in succession.

Name: Avatar Cannon
Overview: It's Safari time! Take you Avatar out into the wild and take on the world.

Name: Bloodbath
Overview: Get ready to compete in the most brutal sport of the moment. In the Dog Eat Dog tournament, you should avail yourself of your ruthless fighting skills and crush your enemies if you want to make your way to victory. Fight alone or with friends, compete in multiple stages and game modes, and improve your favorite fighter. BloodBath takes fighting games to a new dimension!

Name: Zero Gravity Y3030
Overview: The Year is 3030 and you are a glorified futuristic forklift driver, in space. It's a perilous job, with low safety standards and ridiculously high risk but the money is good and training is optional. You've just landed a contract and your boss doesn't hold you in high regard; your not even sure if your Lifter is air tight. The decent of your life, is really up to you. A huge 3D space simulation.

Name: One on One Basketball
Overview: Get ready for some new one on one action! This is the second game from the one and only 1on1 series on Xbox LIVE Indie Games. Play against many teams in championship. Increase your skills with experience you have earned to get prepared for harder matches and ofcourse: your friends!

Name: Oneonone Soccer
Overview: Pure 1 vs. 1 soccer action. Play against 10 teams in Championship. Become the best by increasing your skills with experience you have earned. Compete with your friends in multiplayer.

Name: 2 in 1 Trivia All-Stars
Overview: Are YOU a GENIUS? Experience a world of exotic trivia! Play with classic to present questions in this thrilling interactive challenge. Get rewarded on every correct answer, and score more than your friends to win. Here's your chance to prove once and for all, how smart you really are!

Name: Hitman HD Pack
Overview:
The Hitman HD Pack (also known as the Hitman HD Trilogy) for Xbox 360 is a high-definition remastered collection that compiles three foundational games from the franchise into a single package. 
Included Titles & Storylines
The collection spans over 40 missions, covering Agent 47's career from 2002 to 2006. 

Hitman 2: Silent Assassin: Agent 47 attempts to retire to a monastery but is lured back into the life of an assassin by a Russian crime boss after his mentor, Father Vittorio, is kidnapped.

Hitman: Contracts: While wounded and hallucinating in a hotel room, Agent 47 relives past missions. This title serves as a partial reimagining of the original PC-only Hitman: Codename 47.

Hitman: Blood Money: Agent 47 goes up against a rival organization known as "The Franchise." This title is widely considered a series highlight for its open-ended sandbox levels and refined mechanics.

Name: SpongeBob SquarePants and the Nicktoons Gravjet Racing
2 Jawsome
Overview: 2 JAWSOME - The hunter becomes the hunted. Help save swimmers and catch Sharks in beaches around the Map.

Name: 2D House of Terror
Overview: 2D House of Terror is a Party Game which provides an enjoyable 4 Player experience. You and your friends can compete in random mode or witness the bewitching storyline whilst taking on great challenges. Young Billy O'Tale inherits a bunch of old things from his deceased great uncle Willsworth, among them a mysterious treasure map! Together with his friends he sets off to start the adventure!

Name: 2D Math Panic!
Overview: Solve equations and catch the falling guys with the correct answers! Lose a life if you miss correct answers, lose points if you grab the wrong answer!

Name: 2D World Creator
Overview: Let your imagination run wild with 2D World Creator. Use themed blocks sets, including medieval and futuristic, to create your own world. Place wiring to create circuits and manipulate objects with electricity. You can even wire two futuristic transporters together to travel instantaneously between them. A world of creation sits in your hands waiting for you to shape it to your will.

Name: Twin Ghost
Overview:
Twin Ghost tells the tale of two ghosts on their way to heaven. That is until they get separated en route and must now be reunited.

During gameplay, the player takes control of both ghosts using both of the thumbsticks, one thumbstick controlling one of the ghosts each, and must use the ghosts to collect all of the hearts in the game field then get both ghosts through the exit of the level together. The player must also keep an eye on both of the ghosts as they drift about when not being moved and can potentially drift into a 'reaper block' which causes the player to fail the level.

Name: 3 Days of Nurse Fanny
Overview: Can you survive just three days until treatment! Don’t get to excited or lose your sanity!

Name: 3D Infinity
Overview: 3D Infinity is an on-rails space shooter that features real 3D graphics. The player controls a ship that can fire a normal shot as well as lock-on missiles, and must shoot enemies and avoid obstacles while flying along a pre-programmed path. The ship can move freely around the screen, but will always move forward, and can also perform a barrel roll in either direction to avoid obstacles. When the ship is hit, it loses shield energy, and if the energy is depleted, the ship will explode and the game is over. The game offers three difficulty levels, and two different 3D graphics methods in addition to the standard display mode.

Name: 3D Pixel Art Studio
Overview: 3D Pixel Art Studio lets you create anything you can imagine. Design layer by layer in 2D or work directly in 3D. Save up to 10 scenes each with its own unique palette.

Name: 4-in-1 Cardgame Collection
Overview: Welcome to 4-in-1 Card-game Collection, brought to you by Reaper Gaming Studios. This package contains 4 variants of single-player solitaire, each challenging and addictive in it's own way. Featuring demon, super demon, calculation, and one foundation, and fun for all! Also features global scoreboards and unlockable awardments.

Name: 4-tet Music Maker
Overview: Anyone can make music with 4-tet Music Maker. Game provides samples to start from or you can make create your own masterpiece from scratch. On screen help makes it easy to get started. Fun for kids of all ages. No musical skill or knowledge required.

Name: 4.5 Trillion Puzzle
Overview: Inspired by the puzzles of the early 80s, the 4.5 Trillion Puzzle defies you to arrange colored balls into columns. With three difficulty levels and the ability to save your puzzle in progress, test your intellect to the limit.

Name: 3D Stereo Studio
Overview: 3D Stereo Studio is an interactive studio to examine a large collection of stunning 3D anaglyph models. By watching the models with red/blue glasses, the objects become real and jump out of your screen!

Name: 3D-struction
Overview: Eye-popping 3D visuals on your 3DTV or with colored glasses! The classic brick-breaking game explodes into a new dimension as you bounce balls down 35 levels of 3D blocks, alone or with a friend. Clear the field quickly using 1, 2, or 4 thumbs, and create point Combos to get maximum Stars! Variable-Depth 3D modes including 3D-TV and Anaglyph - running in Smooth 1080p.

Name: 4P Ping-Pong
Overview: No matter how old you are, this game is fun for everyone! Challenge out up to 3 of your friends or play against the computer.

Name: The 4th Wall
Overview: The mechanics of The 4th Wall are relatively simple: The player walks around in a confined area until the trigger which leads to the next scene is found. The size of the areas are, depending on the scene, between small (the end can be seen while standing on the opposite side) and middle-sized (about a minute to cross). On the way, the player encounters a number of events with horror elements. For example, in one scene the player stumbles around in the dark while being observed by eyeballs.

Name: 5 Minutes RPG
Overview: Want to fight? Want some teamwork? You've only got 5 minutes? Try this game! Also contains skills, equipement, boss, random dungeons... Still here? I have a secret for you, you can play more than 5 minutes if you finish several dungeons, but don't tell anyone.

Name: 8-bit Girlfriend
Overview:
8-bit Girlfriend offers something lacking in most old school RPGs: The ability to date the no name characters the heroes come across in their journey through the lands. Pick between four different girls (Princess, Elf, Thief and Item Shop Girl) and try to chat them up in order to secure a date for Sir Knight, the game's main protagonist.

Gameplay consists of picking the appropriate answer to conversational pieces offered up by the girls (usually 2-4 options). A favorsome reply results in the player moving on to the next part of the conversation, while giving the wrong answer results in instant failure, a broken heart and absolutely no chance of a date.

Name: 7 Quests of the Hero
Overview:
A one player action adventure with comedy elements! - Seven maidens have been kidnapped and held prisoner by an evil sorcerer... Your mission is to locate and rescue them back to the safety of the castle and then keep them amused for the duration of their stay!

Hours of gameplay

Buy special items from the shop to help your quest

Buy gifts for the maidens to make them happy!

Release your inner hero!

Name: 7Strains: The Infectious
Overview:
A virus has taken over the landscape and has begun converting everyone into one of seven different strains of virus. It is up to the player to take them on, using only rocks. This is to be taken literally: the player only controls a cursor which is used to pick up rocks and throw them at the blobs which are floating around. Every killed blob results in an increased score.

As well as the single player campaign, there is also a challenge mode available with four different difficulty levels (Easy, Intermediate, Hard and Insane) that offer an array of different challenges including 'High Score Challenges', 'No Aiming', 'Purple Invasion' and 'Mind Games'. 7strains also offers cooperative gameplay for up to four persons in offline play.

Name: 8 Ball Champion
Overview:
8 Ball Pool Champion is a recreation of the American 8 ball pool game, in which two players or two teams of players attempts to pot his/hers.their set of balls into 6 pockets around the edge of the pool table the first. However, Instead of focusing on realistic physics simulation, 8 Ball Pool Champion instead features a more arcade style of play. By utilizing the 'Cheat-O-Laser, the player can pull off shoots that rebounds of several bumpers in a bouncy, kinetic way.

Players can play against an A.I opponent, or play with up to three other friends in a local offline game.

Name: 8-Bit Defense
Overview: 8-Bit Defense pits you against some of the galaxies nastiest aliens as they try to make claim and take over your home town.

Name: 7 Gunfighters
Overview: 7 Gunfighters is a Wild West first-person shooter in which the player takes on the role of a bounty hunter who is going after a band of seven outlaws who all think they are the best shot's in the Old West. A bounty has been placed on all of their heads. There are seven levels in total, one for each outlaw. The player starts each level by choosing and outlaw, and then fights his way through the henchmen in order to apprehend the boss and collect the reward. Levels are small and simple in design. The player can move around freely and shoot the bandits that pop up from behind objects and structures. The weapon needs to be reloaded regularly and the difficulty level can be adjusted. There are no pick-ups and there is but a single weapon.

Name: 8 Ball
Overview: 8 BALL is a 3D casual pool game focusing on 8-ball gameplay with high quality visual appearance and wide range of customization. Player is given a stylish pool table with sizes customizable among 6 foot, 7 foot, 8 foot and 9 foot. The bed color is available in 6 colors. The game also offers yellow/red balls with options to apply national flags to them.

Name: 8 Ball Champion Live
Overview: Classic 8 Ball pool, with Live multiplayer up to 4 players. Featuring multi rebound Cheat-O-Laser for insane trickshots!

Name: 8BitsRetroZSurvivals
Overview: 8BitsRetroZSurvivals is an addictive retro 3D styled game where you have to survive against the attacks of zombies. Try to survive on 3 unique maps - Headquarters, Sewers and Village

Name: 9 Ball Champion
Overview: Classic 9 Ball pool, with 4 player party mode, and cooperative play against the computer. Featuring multi rebound Cheat-O-Laser for insane trick shots!

Name: 9 Ball Champion Live
Overview: Classic 9 Ball pool, with Live multiplayer up to 4 players. Featuring multi rebound Cheat-O-Laser for insane trick shots!

Name: 10 Amazingly Awful Games Volume 2
Overview: Oh no! Back despite popular demand for it not to be, here is 10 Amazingly Awful Games Volume 2 : Featuring Zombies, Platforms, Shooters and more. 10 Games for the price of 1. We take no responsibility for any anguish and torment that may come from playing, enjoy!

Name: 10 Amazingly Awful Games
Overview:
10 Amazingly Awful Games is a compilation of 10 different games in different genres. They are:

All Your Beans Are Belong To Us: In this game the player takes the role of Billy the Blob who loves to eat beans and will do anything to do so. The other blobs don't want him to do so and will do anything to stop him. The game is somewhat similar to Pac-Man where the Billy has to navigate a single screen labyrinth eating all the beans while avoiding getting hit by the other blobs. To aid him Billy can release bean gas to slow down his adversaries.

Desert Race: This is a simple top down racing game with check points. The player has to make it to the next check point before the time runs out while avoiding traffic. Passing a check point or shooting cars along the way will add extra bonus time.

ETMD - Earth Defence: Earth is being invaded by aliens and it's up to the player to stop them! Aliens keep hovering down towards Earth while firing projectiles. The player controls a space ship with which he/she needs to take down the aliens before they reach Earth at the bottom of the screen. When Earth's defenses hit 0%, it's game over! This game supports up to 4 players.

Fishy Fishy: This is a side scrolling game in which the player controls a hungry fish. The goal is to keep eating all the smaller fishes to constantly refill the ever draining health meter. This has to be done while avoiding big fishes and other obstacles such as toxic waste barrels.

Greedy Worm: All the worms in the mud pile are hungry for cupcakes! In this Snake variant there are two modes of gameplay. If played single player, the task is to survive as long as possible while eating lots of cupcakes and gaining length, while avoiding the other snakes. If played in multiplayer, the goal is to eat the most cupcakes while trapping the other worms for extra points.

Hungry Hungry Toilets: What do toilets eat when they are hungry? Oranges fall down from the sky and by dashing and jumping the players have to have their toilet eat more oranges than the others. It's also possible to jump off of other toilets to gain extra height while at the same time stunning them. The toilet which devoured the most oranges when the timer hits zero wins.

Jet Pack Jack: Jack must go into the evil caves of planet Zog and retrieve the stolen cargo. To his aid he has his jet pack and a laser gun. The player controls Jack as he makes his way through the single screen caverns using his jet pack for propulsion and his laser gun to dispose of enemies (which will constantly respawn), while trying to get the cargo boxes to the teleporter. As the levels progress, the amount of cargo which needs to be collected increases.

Lame Invaders: Lame Invaders have decided to take over Earth, and it's up to the player to use his/her starship to take out as many of the intergalactic idiots as possible before they can finalize their plans. The game is a side scrolling shoot 'em up where the player has to take down endless waves of enemies in space while gathering bonuses.

Poor Man's Video Poker: This game is a simple video poker machine simulation where each bet is 1 credit. The player gets dealt a hand and can choose to hold cards for a second hand. If the second hand is good enough, credits get paid out to the player.

Revenge of the Blocks: Blocks have been abused by balls and bats for far too long and are out to seek revenge! Stop them before they get a change to exact revenge on you. This game plays like a mix between Breakout and Space Invaders. The player controls a paddle at the bottom of the screen with which a ball needs to be bounced up along the screen to break the blocks lurking at the top. The difference here, however is that the blocks aren't docile blocks. They keep slowly going down while firing at the paddle. Sometimes blocks will dive down on the paddle as well. The paddle on the other hand, has an automatically increasing amount of balls to use against the block uprising.

Name: 10 Seconds or Less
Overview: 10 Seconds or Less tasks the player with finding various targets on several pictures that include owls, flowers and doors within 10 seconds. Points are awarded for finding the target accurately and the amount of time that elapses in your attempt to find it.

Name: 15 Puzzle
Overview: 15 Puzzle is a simple slider puzzle game which features five different puzzles, each with it's own difficulty ranging from easy to expert mode. All the puzzles have a tropical and beach theme.

Name: 20 Games To Play With Your Mates
Overview: 20 Games is a collection of games made for you and your mates. From zombie slaying to turn based strategy there are a great variety of games for local multiplayer and single player.

Name: 21 Ball Snooker Champion
Overview: Classic UK Snooker, with 4 player party mode, and cooperative play against the computer. Featuring multi rebound Cheat-O-Laser for insane trick shots!

Name: 21 Ball Snooker Live
Overview: Classic UK Snooker, with Live multiplayer up to 4 players. Featuring multi rebound Cheat-O-Laser for insane trickshots!

Name: 27 Ball Funky Pool
Overview: Discover Funky Pool : the pool game with 27 disco balls! Enjoy your pool games with 4-player party mode, and cooperative play against the computer. Featuring multi rebound Cheat-O-Laser for insane trickshots

Name: 37 Days to Die
Overview: In order to save her mother, sexy Kim Brooks must fight off hordes of bad-ass aliens in a televised event known as Annihilator. So put on your space boots and shoot aliens in the face!

Name: 48 Chambers
Overview: 48 Chambers is a simple, yet challenging 2d game about movement and timing. Race against the clock for the high score as you collect orbs, dodge bullets and blades, and attempt to reach each chamber's exit in one piece. Defeat 48 increasingly difficult and treacherous levels to become the master of the 48 Chambers!

Name: 60 Seconds to Park
Overview: Race against time to find the last available parking space in an ever expanding parking lot. Skid around corners and optimize your route to beat the clock and progress to the next round.

Name: 360 Mega App Pack HD
Overview: 360 Mega App Pack HD features a number of fun and useful applications. In Rumble Lounge you can choose from one of our relaxing preset massages or try a custom massage session. Other applications include Ultra Clock, Omega Calculator, and more. Also included are Super Button Mashing Bros (an 8-bit button mashing classic), Arrow Panic (a multiplayer action strategy game), and Memory Masters.

Name: 360 Mega Pack HD Remix
Overview: A collection of titles such as Super Button Mashing Bros, Ultra Clock, TwinStick Shooter, Omega Calculator, Masters of Memory, Rumble Lounge, Arrow Panic, Fortuitous Fortune Cookie, Fantastic Flashlight, Ping, and Gravity Dash. Gravity Dash is a fast paced platformer in which you must intelligently manipulate gravity. Includes a campaign as well as a full-feature level editor.

Name: 360 Lines
Overview: Avoid filling the board by forming lines of five or more balls of the same color in this addictive game! Try to get the highest score with combo bonus! It can also be played with shapes instead of colored balls. Includes many backgrounds to customize the game.

Name: 360 Video Poker
Overview: Experience the thrills of video poker and dare to risk it all on the Hi-Lo mini game.

Name: 1337 Ship Deathmatch
Overview: 1337 Ship Deathmatch is a simple space shooter game which focuses on multiplayer combat. The player takes control of one of the four ships and the goal is simple. Destroy the others to rack up the points and win the game. The ship has an energy meter for the weapon, so if you shoot too much you need to recharge for a while to get the firing rate back up. There are also two type of warp drives which makes the ship appear in a different location on the screen as well as a shield that absorbs some of the damage when used. The player has the option of either playing against human players or up to four bots, which are set to learn from the player's style of play and adapt to it to increase the difficulty over time.

Name: 2010: A New Threat
Overview: Against the backdrop of deep space, a fiery flower blossoms... and fades. More appear; then they, too, are gone. Around you, the world is painted with the colors of war. Can you survive? With 8 game modes and 8 weapons, A New Threat is full of fun, fast action! Fly against your friends as each vies to become king of the skies, or band together to protect mankind! How long can you survive?!

Name: 2012 Athletics Tournament
Overview: Compete against the world in classic track and field games including sprinting, hurdles, long jump, swimming, ninja darts and throwing. Rapid tournaments will have you racking up hundreds of medals in no time.

Name: 2048: Xbox 360 Edition
Overview: The latest mobile gaming craze arrives on Xbox 360! As addictive as ever, and complete with online scoreboards. Based on 2048 by Gabriele Cirulli.

Name: 2060 Cyber Racer
Overview: 2060 Cyber Racer is a racing game set in a cyberspace-like environment complete with the Matrix-like imagery of black and green digits covering the landscape. Choose between two cars with different characteristics, pick a colour and set out on one of the three tracks available to get the best lap time possible. The high scores are saved in the game for future bragging rights.

Name: 2176 Supernova Storm
Overview:
2176 Supernova Storm is a top-down space combat game that pits the player up against an invading army of cyborgs. The player takes the role of a space fighter pilot and must use the canons of his space ship to shoot down cyborgs. Power ups can be obtained from some of the cyborg ships that are shot down.

As well as a single player campaign, players can group together cooperatively to take on the single player campaign together with one other friend offline or three others online, or go head to head in multiplayer games with up to seven others locally or via Xbox Live.
2468 is a game where you move tiles in any direction and try to combine matching tiles to create new tiles.

Name: Aah Little Atlantis
Overview:
Aah Little Atlantis is a puzzle strategy game where the goal is to sink Atlantis while showing pity on its inhabitants. The player needs to rescue as many Atlanteans as possible from the sinking kingdom while at the same being part of the destruction.

Each island will stay above water for a specific number of turns, and it is up to the player to save as many Atlanteans as possible by guiding them to high ground with the divine tools at his/her disposal. These are:

Floods - By placing these in close proximity to an Atlantean, he will flee one square in the opposite direction.
Meteors - These are the highest ground available, and they need to be placed in such a way that the Atlanteans stand on them when the island finally sinks.
Trees - If an Atlantean stands on a square with a tree the same round as the ground below sinks, it turns into a raft and automatically saves the person on it.
Boats - They move around the map and can save up to 4 Atlanteans at the same time.
There is a water level meter on one side of the screen which indicates when a specific type of land will vanish beneath the waves. Any Atlanteans standing on that specific land the round it sinks, will drown.

In each stage there is a set score they player has to reach to get medals and finish the stage. The different types of Atlanteans are worth different points, so sometimes the "lesser" inhabitants have to be sacrificed in order to save, for example, a king.

There are 15 islands to sink, all with varying conditions and difficulty.

The game was originally developed for the 48 Hour Games Dev Competition, but was later fixed up and polished and released for the Xbox 360. One month later the Flash version was done and uploaded to Aah Games' site.

Name: Aaron's Ping-Pong
Overview:
Aaron's Ping-Pong is a indie game version of Pong, with virtually identical gameplay. The game area is entirely black, and has two paddles on the left and right, with a ball going between the two and it is up to the player to prevent the ball from getting past his paddle whilst directing it past the AI controlled paddle on the opposite side.

A two player mode is also supported to allow a second player to take control of the opposing paddle for a head to head game on the same Xbox 360.

Name: Aardbloxx
Overview: AardBloxX is a 3D puzzle game designed to exercise your mind. Blocks are sent at you which must be fit into flat planes at an increasing pace. You will have a blast playing this game, and it will help keep you mentally sharp and improve your spatial awareness! With two modes for both new and advanced players, it allows you to tweak gameplay to your liking for the best puzzle experience.

Name: A-Maze!-ING
Overview: Run your way out of a treacherous volcano maze in this arcade style adventure! Challenging and rewarding gameplay awaits those with the skills to master this incredible game!

Name: A.I.R. Play
Overview:
In the future, football is played by advanced robots using a plasma football that gradually get hooter over the course of a game and will eventually explode. The aim of the game, to score as many goals as possible is unchanged, but instead of there being eleven players on the pitch, there are only four, two on each team, one goalkeeper and one outfield player. It is up to the player to guide one of these futuristic teams to the 'AirPlay Tournament' using the players choice of 14 robotic players.

For multiplayer games, there is support for local 2 player head to head games on a single Xbox 360 with a choice of seven arenas to choose from.

Name: Aah, Halloween Pie!
Overview:
Ahh Halloween pie!

Originally released on Xbox Live Indie Games on the Xbox 360 in December 2012

In this short but sweet 2D sideways scrolling platform game can you collect all of the pumpkins for the witch?

A short sideways scrolling platform game with a Halloween flavour!

Unique ingeniousfun art style

Random elements so game is different every time you play.

Name: Aah! Who's that Character?!?
Overview: Want to be hailed the master of all media? Why not take the greatest trivia challenge ever! This isn’t exclusively for film buffs, couch potatoes, bookworms and cartoon freaks, but for everyone. Refresh your memory and get asked who played who, who said what and who did what. Show off what you got in this exciting game that will make you and your friends scream “Aah! Who’s that Character?!?”

Name: Aah Impossible Rescue
Overview: Aah Impossible Rescue tasks the player with guiding three kittens who are stranded in a river across twelve levels to safety, whilst controlling all three at the same time. As the three kittens go downstream, the player must use the A, X and Y keys, which correspond to one of the kittens, to move them up and down in their respective streams. If any of the three kittens hit an obstacle however, all three of them are returned to the last checkpoint.

Name: Aagh!
Overview: Aagh! is a two dimensional side-scrolling racer that tasks the player with guiding a small metallic ball through a narrow black corridor that sharply shifts direction at various gradients. The player has to last as long as possible without crashing into the various coloured walls of each level.

Name: Gravity
Overview: Take control of one of the most powerful forces in the universe. Gravity! Control and bend it to your every whim in this mind bending platformer. Four game modes and Online score boards.

Name: Abaddon
Overview:
Abaddon is a tower defence game set in space that gives the player control of the capital ship Abaddon, which is severely damaged, and in need of new and improved weaponry before it is over run. To provide assistance, Abaddon has a small fighter circling around her to provide support. The game will pit the player up against waves of enemy ships that range from small, lightly armed fighters to other big, heavily armed capital ships. During the course of the game, the player will be able to pick up ship and weapon upgrades for both the Abaddon and her support fighter that include both offensive and defensive upgrades. After successfully completing each mission, the player will awarded with power orbs that can be used to further modify and optimize the Abaddon and her fighter escort.

Abaddon also includes co operative support for two person offline or eight person via Xbox Live.

Name: Abaddon: Retribution
Overview:
The sequel to the Xbox Live Indie game Abaddon, Abaddon: Retribution puts the player in the role of Tara Cole, a fighter pilot who has been assigned to pilot the support fighter of the spaceship Abaddon from the first game.

The gameplay is largely the same unaltered tower defence gameplay from the first game, in which the player, as the previously mentioned Tara Cole, must engage enemy fighters in order to help protect the Abaddon, who's weapons are damaged beyond repair and must be replaced by various weapon systems that can be brought by using Green Matter, which is obtained by defeating enemies. This Green Matter can also be used to repair the Abaddon's weapons. The more it its Repaired and upgraded, new weapons will become avaliable for use on the Abaddon.

Abaddon: Retribution also features the same co-op mode, as featured in the first game, as well as support for competitive play for eight people on four Xbox 360 consoles.

Name: Aban Hawkins & 1000 Spikes
Overview: Aban Hawkins & the 1000 Spikes is a self-described "hardest extremest craziest platform action puzzle adventure", which is a surprisingly accurate description. Controlling the Indiana Jones-esque (or perhaps Spelunky-ish) explorer Aban Hawkins, the player must navigate trap-filled labyrinths to reach the key hidden within, which can be used to open the door to the next stage. The game prides itself on its difficulty, and each stage contains an almost absurd amount of traps. The game gives Aban 1000 lives, and he's going to need every last one of them.

Name: ABC Fun
Overview:
ABC Fun is an educational game which is meant to teach young children ABC in a fun and interactive way.

The player controls his/her avatar and walks along the alphabet (displayed as kid's blocks). Every time the player stops, the letter is read out loud and an example of an item or animal is displayed (such as A is for Ant). The avatar can also use special effects such as a burst of stars or fire and flames on the blocks to make them spin and more. The avatar animates randomly between all sorts of movement types, such as swimming, laughing and running, all to stimulate the young participants.

Name: Abduction Action!
Overview: As a UFO pilot in training, you have been tasked with the overwhelming mission of invading Earth, terrorizing the locals, and returning home in one piece. Use your tractor beam to abduct helpless Earthlings and defeat aggressive foes. It will take all your skills, wits, and intellect to prove your alien worth and triumph over humanity.

Name: Abduction Action! +
Overview: As a UFO pilot in training, you have been tasked with the overwhelming mission of invading Earth, terrorizing the locals, and returning home in one piece. Use your tractor beam to abduct helpless Earthlings and defeat aggressive foes. It will take all your skills, wits, and intellect to prove your alien worth and triumph over humanity.

Name: About to Blow Up!
Overview: 'Small Time Records' is in BIG TIME trouble! Can you stop Mr. Sleez? 'About to BLOW UP' is a hilariously insane hip-hop cartoon adventure jam-packed with crazy characters and mind melting puzzles! Classic point and click action! Hand drawn 2D animation! Huge cast of zany cartoon characters! Old school Hip Hop soundtrack! Laugh out loud dialog and slap stick humor!

Name: Abronium Tournament
Overview: Join the Abronium cyber world for a hot thrilling tournament competition. Gather friends/family and build your own cool tournament using 35 different maps from 10 different game modes (EG: Race, CTF, Soccer, Chase & Fetch). With up to 16 players in a local game you’ll have the perfect party booster. Play one-to-one or gather up in teams to see who will score the most or get knocked out.

Name: Absolute Firepower
Overview: Give freedom to Kaalamarii Islands. Defeat the oppressive army.

Name: Absorb
Overview: The gameplay of Absorb revolves around a blob that has to change colour in order to destroy enemies and absorb them in order to make the player's blob stronger. At the end of each level there is a boss battle. The absorbing process is based on four colours (blue absorbs yellow, green absorbs blue, red absorbs green, and yellow absorbs red).

Name: Academy Trivia
Overview: Academy Trivia is a trivia game with more than 4,000 questions that cover eight subjects. It also has a more challenging Academy Mode. The gameplay starts with a 3D wheel being spun that has all the categories on them to decide the topic for the questions. Players then compete against one another to see who can answer the most questions accurately. The game supports up to four players locally and there are also bonus rounds.

Name: Absolute Defense
Overview: A Two player tower defense. The zombies are smart targeting the closest, most populated villages first. Keep the zombies away or they will eat the the villages and grow in numbers, kill them to continue on. Play with a friend =). infinite mode. 30 something levels. Can you protect them all?

Name: Abstacked
Overview: Abstacked is a Tetris variant where the player needs to clear stars. Pieces drop down in pairs, can be rotated, and fill up columns. A star is cleared when it ends up in-between two identical shapes. When a game starts, the stars are already present. If the player fails to clear enough star pieces before they reach the top of the playing field, the game is over. There are two game modes (Story and Infinity) and five difficulty levels.

Name: Ace of Dynamites
Overview: The gems from the kingdom of the Round Happy Faces people have been stolen by their enemies. They're now scattered in the lands of the Death's Heads tribe, and guarded 24/7. Since explosives are the only weapon that can be used against the Death's Heads, you've been chosen to go to hostile territory and get as many gems back as possible, for your Round Happy Face's nickname is Ace of Dynamites.

Name: Abzolium
Overview: The award winning multiplayer battle arena game Abzolium is finally coming to the Xbox 360! Fight with up to 4 players in an action-packed arena where the environment is more than just a dormant background. Create your own ability build that suits you or your team so you'll come out victorious in the upcoming rounds where kill-count is all that matters.

Name: Ace Gals Tennis
Overview:
Ace Gals Tennis is a tennis game comparable to Wii Sports Tennis. The player controls their avatar, who will automatically run towards the ball, but must correctly time the swing of the racket in order to hit the ball. When hitting or serving, the player can also control the general direction of the ball. Poor timing will result in a low-power hit that may go out-of-bounds, while flawless timing will result in "amazing" shots that will go where they're supposed to with good power. "Amazing" shots can be chained together, allowing for more powerful shots.

The player's stats are dictated by the "trainer" they choose. There are six trainers to choose (with two more unlockable), all of them young women. The game offers several difficulty modes and court types, and there are both exhibition and tournament matches available. There are also a number of "trophies" that are unlocked when certain in-game criteria are met, much like the achievements found in other games.

Name: Absolute War
Overview: Aliens, Humans, and Robots collide! Play one of the pre-loaded game maps, or create your own mayhem using the Level Editor. Choose your faction and complete wave-by-wave of increasingly difficult enemy personnel. Manage your personnel by making the most out of points received by purchasing ammo, upgrades, special abilities, and vehicles. Make use of cover and towers to win the War of Absolution.

Name: Action Arcade Wrestling
Overview:
Action Arcade Wrestling is as the title suggests a arcade style wrestling game that allows the player to customize his wrestler by adjusting the size, outfit and hair, with the colour of the outfits and hair being adjustable. Players can also assign various moves to their wrestler.

To fight bouts, the player can choose from one out of a total of ten arenas, all of which are also customisable by the player. The game modes on offer include Tag Team, Rumble, Championship and Tag Championship.

Action Arcade Wrestling also supports multiplayer for up to four people on a single console for one on one bouts, or tag team games.

Name: Acid Rain
Overview: Acid Rain puts the player in the role of a hiker hiking near a volcano coincidentally just as it explodes, causing acid rain to start falling in the surrounding area. It is now up to the player to locate the twenty survivors of the eruption by using binoculars and rescuing them whilst diving in and out of cover in order to avoid the acid rain as well as other hazards such as volcanic boulders and lava. The player will also encounter wild animals that will attempt to hinder progress, but can be warded off by using the characters flashlight.

Name: Acid Drift: Solar
Overview: Mine, trade, and fight your way to riches in this open-ended space adventure!

Name: Acid Rain Heroes
Overview: Acid Rain Heroes is the same game as the XBLA Indie game Acid Rain This version of the game adds a new multiplayer mode with 6 co-op missions.

Name: Action Arcade Wrestling 2
Overview: The sequel to the best-selling XBLI game, AAW2 is a 2.5D retro arcade game. Hundreds of moves, multiple match types, create wrestlers & arenas, up to 10 wrestlers in the ring at once, classic control scheme and so much more.

Name: Ace on Steroids
Overview: Ace on Steroids sets you in the seat of Ace, a young pilot in charge of protecting Earth from incoming asteroids. While fully playable, the goal of Ace on Steroids is to serve as a purpose to learn how to make games using Microsoft XNA, the SynapseGaming SunBurn engine and the Indiefreaks Game Framework. Visit http://indiefreaks.com to learn more.

Name: Aceball
Overview:
Aceball is a pong variant that puts the player in control of a paddle on one side of the screen, and a computer controlled paddle on the other side of the screen with a small ball bouncing between them, and it is up to the player to prevent the ball from getting past his paddle whilst trying to get it past the players opponent. At various points throughout the game, the player will have multiple balls to contend with, but will also have shaped paddles to help get balls past the opposing paddle.

Aceball also features local multiplayer support for competitive as well as co operative games.

Name: Acupwnture
Overview: Acupwnture is a puzzle based board game similar to Tetris based on the movements of the Wu Xing in which the player has to form groups of blocks based on the elements to create bombs that release Qi energy, which in turn the player earns points for collecting. They need to earn a certain amount of points from the elements to progress through each of the games 50 levels.

Name: Jawsome
Overview: Jawsome is a game featuring a shark on a search for food. The player can choose from several different sharks to play as before entering a level. Levels are 3D environments which are explored from a behind view perspective. A certain number of food items must be collected in order to complete each of the game's five levels.

Name: Adamant Ants
Overview: Command and protect a loyal and blindly obedient army of ants. With a variety of special ability upgrades, you must dig, fly, shoot and explode your way to victory as you attempt to rescue the queen ant who has been kidnapped by the evil worm and bird alliance. An addicting game of action and strategy for all ages!

Name: Adamant Ants 2
Overview: What happens when you take lemmings, add some worms, throw in some birds (that are angry), then pit them against an army of ants? you get Adamant Ants! Excavate, climb, fly and explode your way to rescue the ant queen from the diabolical bird and worm army in PART 2 of the series! With hours of fun and stimulating gameplay, fully destructible terrain, and loads of ant ability upgrades!

Name: Adventurer Pets HD
Overview:
There once was a notorious gambler named Johnny Five Aces, who hid a treasure somewhere. There is a map to this treasure, but it has been split into six pieces, and only one who has all six pieces can find the treasure. Enter the Adventurer Pets, four anthropomorphic pets who all want the treasure for themselves, and will do whatever they can to collect all the pieces of the map.

Adventurer Pets is a multiplayer battle platform game. Up to four players battle on each stage, using items like bombs and shields to kill opponents or protect themselves, with the goal of having the most treasure at the end of the game. There is also a single-player adventure mode where the player must collect the treasure on each stage with a limited number of lives, and a time-attack mode where the player has infinite lives but dying will incur a time penalty.

Name: Adventures in Text
Overview: Explore the world of Aeski, try to escape a locked room or be accepted to the School for Gifted Demons in Adventures in Text, three short multiple choice text adventures. Play with friends by co-operating and agreeing your answers. Fail to agree and the game decides your path! Also includes three quizzes.

Name: Adventures of Captain Becky
Overview:
Adventures of Captain Becky is a puzzle platform game starring the titular female pirate captain. The goal of each stage is to reach the goal as quickly as possible, collecting as much gold as possible, and without dying. Becky can double-jump as well as attack with a mace, which will destroy many but not all hazards and enemies. One hit will kill her, though she can collect a special pink outfit that gives her an extra hit.

There are four difficulties with eight stages each, along with a tutorial. There is also a "gallery mode" where the player can watch Becky dance around in any of the unlocked outfits, as well as an edit mode which provides numerous options for modifying Becky's physique to the player's liking.

Name: Adventures of Sid
Overview: Adventures Of Sid is a 2D side scrolling platformer that puts the player in the role of Sid the tomato. Armed with a flamethrower and some TNT, the player must guide Sid through 16 levels in search of treasure. However, hindering Sid are obstacles as well as crazed wildlife that keep the player from his goal. As well as uncovering treasure, fresh ammo for the flamethrower and new explosives will need to be found sooner or later.

Name: Adventures of Rocaman
Overview: Enjoy a classic platform game! Through 8 worlds of the prehistoric, battle against dinosaurs and take on dangerous roads with our friend Rocaman.

Name: Adrift
Overview:
Adrift is a modern day pirate game that puts the player in the role of a nameless Somali pirate operating in the Gulf of Aden who is aiming to move up the pirate ranks by looting and pillaging other ships.

The player controls the ship of said nameless pirate and must navigate through the Gulf of Aden looking for ships to raid. To aid this, the players boat is armed with weaponry to take on other ships. Also at the players use is several smaller boats to board and capture ships. It is also possible to form alliances with other pirates to make it easier to capture loot.

There is also a co-op mode available for up to four players for offline games.

Name: Adventures of Sid: XMAS Special
Overview: Adventures Of Sid XMAS Special is a Christmas themed remake of the XBLA Indie game Adventures Of Sid. As with the original game, the player (once again in the role of Sid the Tomato) must blast through obstacles and wildlife using Sid's trusty flamethrower in search of treasure. As this is Christmas themed, obstacles come in the form of Christmas related items such as Christmas crackers and Reindeer's.

Name: Add Some Light
Overview: Add some light to your life by letting your screen fill the room with beautiful colors of your choice! This special light app has a variety of modes suitable for different occasions. E.G: Heart - For romantic dinners. Stroboscope-For crazy parties. Clock-As a nice digital/analog clock. Flowers-As color changing art. It also has classic RGB etc.. Customize the modes by using special meters.

Name: The Adhara War
Overview:
The Adhara War is a turn-based strategy game with action combat. It is set in the Clamshell Expanse where the Neoterrans, the descendants of humanity, settled. After finding old ruins on the planet Adhara, they managed to build space gates - which caused them to meet the Hegemony, an alliance of multiple alien races. The Hegemony claims ownership over Adhara which eventually leads to a declaration of war. Now the fate of Adhara lies in the hands of the Guards, basically an AI network taking command over the war effort, who fight against the Hegemony.

On the strategy map (a 5x7 grid), both factions move in turns. The overall goal is wiping out the different faction completely. To do so, the player requires resources which are earned by assimilate planets which produce a certain number of resources each turn. Those are not only used to build additional ships in the homebase, but also platforms on any owned grid: jammers (disable special abilities of enemy vessels during combat) and shipyards (used to repair and build ships). Additionally refineries double the resource production of a planet. Each ship can move a certain number of grids each turn and capturing a planet only means to occupy the grid for one turn.

When two hostile ships meet, action combat begins. The goal is is to eliminate the opposing ship by shooting the primary/secondary weapons as well as using abilities. The equipment changes from ship to ship, for example the destroyer has a standard energy weapon, a secondary seeker missile and a shield which absorbs energy damage. To move a ship forward, the player needs to hold one gamepad stick in the same direction as the ship faces; rotating the stick (also available during movement) also rotates the ship. Only a few Hegemony ships can aim independently from the movement direction with the second stick. In this phase it also becomes important on which grid combat takes place: anomalies have properties (e.g. less energy damage) which affect both ships.

Besides the ship abilities, there are also other differences between the two factions. Most importantly, the Hegemony has a space gate as main base and random reinforcements come through it. It can only be destroyed by constructing and using a special ship (basically a bomb). The skirmish game mode allows to set up an action match without the strategy part.

Name: Aeternum
Overview:
Ellica is a Demonic Magic Studies student at one of the most prestigious schools in the realm, Aeternum Academy. But her schoolwork has to take a back seat one day when she discovers her best friend Macy is missing!
Help Ellica brave the crazed groundskeeper, an overzealous hall monitor and waves upon waves of wayward flying cats in the adventure of a lifetime… or maybe just the adventure of this week.

Name: After Dusk
Overview: Long range communications aboard the 'Century Research Station' have abruptly stopped shortly after a distress signal was sent out. With military forces spread far and few in-between, a freelance vessel has been contracted to investigate and report on the problem. Little do the intrepid travelers know, something dire lurks in the dark of Century Station...

Name: Agent MOO: Maximum Overdeath
Overview: Agent MOO: Maximum Overdeath is a 2D deathmatch game featuring weapons such as rockets, guns, and the trusty sack of oranges. If that doesn't suit your fancy, climb in a car to get some vehicular homicide kills! Features original soundtrack by I KILL PXLS.

Name: Aesop's Garden
Overview:
Aesop's Garden is a puzzle game in which the player must guide Aesop round his garden moving blocks and activating switches whilst avoiding traps.

After his prize winning garden is destroyed by his rival Alistair August in an attempt to keep him from winning another gardening competition, Aesop must now re-build his garden in time for a big gardening competition. The player takes control of Aesop and must go through his garden digging up every weed through each level.

Name: Ahoy Pirates
Overview:
Ahoy Pirates is a naval strategy party game that places the player in control of a pirate ship in search of treasure. Players must navigate their ship around the game field collecting as much treasure as they can find within the time limit.

Ahoy Pirates can also be played between four different players on a single Xbox 360 console for multiplayer games.

Name: Aimeroids
Overview:
Aimeroids is a space based shooter game similar in concept to the game Asteroids. Gameplay involves the players spaceship flying around an asteroid field blowing up asteroids without getting hit around the head by one. The player will also have passing alien ships to contend with by blowing them up as well.

There are two game modes available, the first is called "Retro", and is the basic shot the rock version with no strings attached. The second is called "Powerplay", which is largely the same as Retro, only now the player has access to power ups that can aid them such as shield upgrades and improvements to the players weapons.

Name: Air Combat: Desert Aces
Overview: Take to the skies over North Africa in a P-47 Thunderbolt to defend against the German Luftwaffe. Attempt to break past their fighters and destroy their base while your squadron provides cover. Your armament includes wing mounted .50 cal machine guns and the option to equip a variety of rockets and heavy bombs.

Name: Air Legends
Overview:
Air Legends is a WWII aerial dogfighting game. The player takes control of one of ten planes available and take on planes in a top down perspective and take on multiple enemies.

Air Legends also supports two player offline play, both has head to head and co operative multiplayer support.

Name: Air Forte
Overview:
Air Forte is an educational flight game that tasks the player with answering questions based on mathematics, geography and vocabulary by using the players plane to shoot them. Points are awarded based on how well the player does.

Up to four players can engage in competitive play on a single console.

Name: Aircraft RC
Overview: Aircraft RC is a simulator of radio-controlled airplane models.Aircrafts are equipped with retractable landing gear. The game display shows the throttle, aircraft speed, and radio control signal. There are three aircraft available.

Name: Airport Anarchy
Overview: Airport Anarchy is a game where you must complete flights while managing the flow of aircraft to and from the airport. In arcade mode you earn more points the quicker you deal with aircraft, while Endless mode won't finish until there's a crash!

Name: Air War
Overview: Experience air to air combat against AI controlled enemies, only to get jumped by human players at any moment. Manage your power supply mid battle... shields? lasers? engines? Upgrade your ship and show off your moves to friends. Supports up to 8 players at once. Music by Bensound.com

Name: Akujin
Overview:
Akujin is a top down space shooter similar to the XBLA game Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved, in which the player is given control of a fighter and must fight of waves of enemies. The weapons of the players fighter craft are based on various properties such as gravity and electricity. These are only effective against certain enemies.

Also featured in Akujin is a two player offline co operative mode.

Name: Airport Anarchy: The Lost Runways
Overview: Airport Anarchy - The Lost Runways is a game where you must complete flights while managing the flow of aircraft to and from the airport. In arcade mode you earn more points the quicker you deal with aircraft, while Endless mode won't finish until there's a crash!

Name: Ajare & Watch
Overview: Play Ajare & Watch, the most powerful and expensive LCD Game on the market... $50,000. Multi Screen x10, RPG and ninjas.

Name: Akimbo Paddles!
Overview: Akimbo Paddles! is a dual wield paddle game in which the player must either keep a series of balls afloat using two paddles, or attempt to pair up other pairs of balls, often within a time limit. The paddles are controlled by the two analog control sticks. There are 24 levels of gameplay in total, with the difficulty going up from level to level.

Name: Alawishus Pixel
Overview: Alawishus Pixel is a retro-style puzzle platform game. A nameless young man in a hoodie has wandered into a cave, and the only way out is forward. The only way out of each room is to push a block onto a yellow switch, which will open a door leading to the next room. Many rooms contain hazards like ogres, bats, and lava, and one touch will kill the hero. Many rooms also contain signs left by a previous traveler, offering hints, instructions, and sometimes insane rambling. The player has infinite lives, and can reset the stage if it becomes unsolvable. The game features 40 puzzles to solve, and allows the player to return to any previously-visited stage through the options menu.

Name: Alien Hideout
Overview: You are Agent Alan Gingerspicy/Alana Gingerspicy in search of aliens in Antarctica. Explore the alien bases and eliminate aliens from the Earth. Choose either task oriented "Adventure" mode or hardcore "Wipeout" mode. Upgrade to cool weapons in this kill'em all mission.

Name: Alien Hunter
Overview: Alien Hunter is a first-person shooter (FPS) in which the player's character has been abducted by aliens and the player must now escape from them. Unfortunately, since the abduction took place, the teleporter needed for the players escape has broken down and the player must go on a hunt for these parts whilst dealing with the aliens that are attempting to subdue him.

Name: Alien Overkill
Overview: Alien OverKILL. Clear the space ships of alien monsters in this first person 3D alien horror shooter.

Name: Alderman
Overview:
Alderman is a medieval jousting game that puts the player in the role of the titular hero. With the king away from the kingdom, Count Wharfdale decides to stage a takeover of the kingdom. It is now up to the player to take on the count's minions atop of his horse and joust his way to victory.

Gameplay involves guiding your horse mounted hero across the level, taking out enemies using the trusty lance.

Name: Alien Jelly
Overview:
Alien Jelly is a 3D puzzle game. It uses a mechanic of flipping the world around to solve puzzles and get your avatars to the exit point. The player controls multiple Alien Jelly characters that come in a variety of four colors, which each play a roll in some of the puzzles. The game also supports up to 4 players local co-op.

The additional puzzle mechanics include portals, pushing crates, stacking Alien Jellies to create stairways, color changing blocks that only allows a character of the same color to be on it, hologram blocks that can be turned on and off to create pathways. The game includes hazard elements such as spike pits, crushing blocks, lasers and robots that shoot lasers.

The game sports a level editor crafted for consoles. All the levels in the game were built in the same editor that ships with the game. The players can also share these levels with friends through the Xbox Live Gold service.

Name: Alien Pyramid Challenge!
Overview:
Alien Pyramid Challenge! is a puzzle-based platformer that has the players alien character trapped in an ancient Egyptian pyramid with only a Egyptian mummy for company.

In order to escape from the pyramid, the player must rearrange limestone blocks to allow escape, but to get to them, the player must move from platform to platform by jumping and using springs to get through each level. If the player gets stuck, the sarcastic mummy will be on hand to offer advice on how to escape.

Name: Alchemist
Overview:
Alchemist is a puzzle game similar to Bejeweled. In Alchemist, two players attempt to form rows of three or more runes of the same colour to remove them from the board and score points during a preset amount of time. Whichever player has the highest score at the end of the time limit, the player who has scored the most points is the winner. If the player forms a row of colours with a specific series of symbols on them, they will score additional points and potentially remove entire rows or columns from the playboard.

As well as being able to play against an A.I opponent, players can also play up against a human player on a local multiplayer game.

Name: Alchemy God
Overview: You can create the universe! Starting with nothing but the four basic earthly elements, you can mix and match them to create newer, more advanced ones! With over 80 unique elements, Alchemy God is sure to engross you in the world you create.

Name: Alexander Learning Series: Match with Wally
Overview: Water Bear Interactive LLC presents Match with Wally for the X-Box 360. Match with Wally allows the child to match Upper and Lower case letters, Star blocks with Number Blocks, Shapes and colors with their name block. The software uses randomization to reduce patterns and encourage learning. Match with Wally is part of the Alexander Learning Series.

Name: Alien Siege
Overview: Defend your planet from the incoming enemy missiles, flying saucers and asteroids using your AMS rockets and Proton blaster . With support for 1-2 players, upgradable weapons, four different stunning worlds and three difficulty settings

Name: Alien Super Mega Blaster
Overview: Alien Super Mega Blaster a classic retro shooter with a twist. Kill the aliens and avoid the fallout. Maximize your score with mega cascading death to the alien scrum. Over 100 hand crafted levels of blasting fun... how far can you go? All proceeds from this game will be donated to Action Duchenne.

Name: Aliens vs Romans
Overview: The real reason Rome burned! Go back in time and fight for the empire against the Alien threat. Take up the enemies weapons and beat them back!

Name: Aliens vs. Aliens
Overview: In a distant galaxy, an alien race is at war with itself. Take command of a squad of alien 'tracker' units in an attempt to thwart the plan to invade earth, in this turn-based game of strategic warfare. With multiple weapons and dozens of unit and weapon upgrades, do you have what it takes to defeat a foe with vastly superior numbers?!

Name: Aliens Go Boom
Overview: Aliens Go Boom is a side scrolling shooter in which aliens have invaded earth. The player takes control of a fighter plane and must shoot through multiple levels taking out alien turrets in order to score as many points as possible.

Name: All Fives Dominos
Overview: All fives game of Dominos with all the correct rules of play.

Name: All Your Creeps
Overview: Defend the homeland against the capitalist pigs, or siege the communist headquarters to prevent their victory on earth and in space. Play with up to 4 players in this fast-paced tower defense game.

Name: Allure
Overview: Shmup action with different ships, customizable weapons, armors and shields. Choose your ship and upgrade your weapons as you play. Battle through 9 levels and fight intense boss battles. Adapt your ship to the levels you play or just plow through the enemies using skill alone.

Name: Allied Assault Squadron
Overview: In Allied Assault Squadron (AAS), the player experiences aerial combat as a member of an elite World War II fighter pilot team. AAS is a top down 2D aerial shooter in which the player controls one of six World War II era fighter planes, on a mission to clear the grounds and skies of enemies.

Name: Alpha Morph
Overview: Alpha Morph! Collect energy from your defeated enemies to power and upgrade ship systems. Morph into powerful new forms to complete each stage.

Name: All Out of Bubblegum
Overview: Fortify your defenses and take up arms against the zombie horde. Up to 4 players can build structures, place turrets, choose from an assortment of weapons, and then watch the giblets fly.

Name: All the Bad Parts
Overview: All the Bad Parts is an Action Adventure that features hand to hand combat, weapons, a shifting plot line, and multiple endings. The story begins in a classroom. While trying to survive school, Corbin starts to notice that time is starting to speed up, and everything isn’t as it appears. He then has to make sense of the shifting world around him, fight waves of enemies, and make key decisions.

Name: Allegory
Overview: Allegory tasks the player with protecting a small cube known the 'the follower' as it travels along a series of lines of varying length and direction. Only two lines will be on screen at one time, the line the follower is on and the next line, with additional lines appearing when the follower end of the current line it is on. The player protects the follower by guiding a second, larger cube to deflect incoming missiles that are being drawn towards the follower. Points are awarded based on how many the player deflects away from the follower. The player has limited use power ups called 'Slowdowns' available for use, which slows the game play down and gives the player extra time to reach the incoming missiles.

Name: Amazing 8bit Ball
Overview: Amazing 8bit Ball utilizes the processing power of your Xbox to think really hard about stuff you ask it.

Name: (Almost) Total Mayhem
Overview: (Almost) Total Mayhem is a 2D team-based action platformer that pits two teams against each other in an attempt to destroy the other's base, which comes in the form of medieval forts. In addition teams of knights in armor must also protect their own base from attacks. Also hindering the player's progress is that there is only a single bomb on the map. The graphics come in hand-drawn form on lined A4 paper, and look like someone has doodled them. There is a two player co-operative game mode available for use on a single Xbox 360 console for 2-player split-screen games.

Name: Along Came A Spider
Overview: Along Came A Spider is a 2D platformer that puts the player in control of a spider who must jump from various moving and stationary platforms that come in various colours. On white platforms the spider can be walk, climb and swing, purple ones cannot be climbed, and orange ones move other platforms along. Meanwhile the spider attempts to get home and catch the three flies that are on each level, to unlock new environments. The spider can also swing from the platforms using its webbing to catch the flies, and webbing can also be used to bridge two platforms. There are twenty levels and four special boss levels, during which the spider gains new swinging abilities. Near to some platforms are glowing white orbs that act as checkpoints and require close proximity in order to activate. At the end of each level there is a spider's web that must be entered in order to complete the level.

Name: Alpha Blasters
Overview: Alpha Blasters is a single-screen arena shooter similar to Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved. The player is put in control of several possible ships and must fight one of several themed enemies, including different currencies, space rocks and logos. The game includes a two-player head-to-head competitive mode.

Name: Alpha Squad
Overview: In the not so distant future, Earth is ruled by a military dictatorship known as The Alliance. They have put bounties on the heads of Clint, Jin, Lynx and Lackey, four mercenaries more commonly known as Alpha Squad. The player takes control of one member of Alpha Squad using a top-down perspective. He needs to fight different enemies whilst attempting to find out who in The Alliance has put a price on their heads and why. The game features a four-player co-operative mode for two to four people on a single Xbox 360 in split-screen, or over Xbox Live.

Name: Alphabet Sub
Overview: Pilot a toy submarine around the ocean collecting letter and number bubbles! Over 60 levels that concentrate on the alphabet and numbers, with short levels that are meant to be easy, while the longer levels offer more of a challenge. More games in the series coming soon!

Name: Altar of Gems
Overview: A fast pace gems building game with exciting attack / defense strategy. Exciting versus mode supports 1~4 players. Challenging adventure mode provides various of goals to challenge. With cooperative arcade mode, impact the high score board with your friends!

Name: Amass & Collapse
Overview: AAC is a falling block match three puzzle game with grid rotation added into the mix. The player has control over the falling blocks rotation and can shift the order of the colored blocks. With each rotation of the grid your combo grows.

Name: Amazing Facts
Overview: Enjoy the beautiful HD graphics and music while being astonished at over 500 amazing and incredible facts. You can even send them to your friends!

Name: Alpha Chimp: Episode One: The Jungle
Overview: Alpha Chimp casts the player as a chimp as he battles his way through several environments, fighting human poachers, logging company employees, space aliens and other chimps, which will ultimately lead to a fight with the alpha male of the chimp's tribe. There is also a Battle Mode included, which allows players to select a single type of enemy to fight in any of the arenas featured in the story mode.

Name: Alpha Ship
Overview: A new exciting and fun way to learn the letters of the English language! Hear their sounds and enjoy the fun experience of learning!

Name: Amazing Princess Sarah
Overview:
The King has been kidnapped by a fiendish demon! Only the (Amazing) Princess Sarah has the courage, and the upper body strength, to fight through the 5 demon castles to rescue him.

In Amazing Princess Sarah the player will travel through each of the five castles, completing platforming challenges before facing off against a screen-filling boss at the end of the castle. The castle interiors are broken up with checkpoints, and luckily for Sarah she has an endless supply of lives to spend as she dies repeatedly inside the castles. To defend herself Sarah has a very weak sword attack, but her main method of attack is picking up furniture or defeated enemies and hurling them at her foes. Launched enemy corpses also have additional attack properties, such as bombardiers exploding or archers flinging out a wave of arrows. Enemies defeated in quick succession are worth bonus XP, and Sarah gains HP and attack power she she levels up.

Each time the game is beaten new princesses are unlocked with different gameplay properties, like Vampire Princess Sarah or Drunk Princess Sarah.

Name: Ambient Water
Overview: Do you love water? Do you need it to live? Yaystuff quenches your thirst...to relax. When you're done putting the pedal to the metal, saving the world and blowing stuff up - load up Ambient Water. Relax and recharge. Maybe even take a nap. Come back fresh and frosty.

Name: The Amazing Rumbling Hypno Disc
Overview: Take a journey into your minds eye! Introducing the amazing rumbling hypno disc!!! Play your own soundtracks or messages in the background and use the added rumble feature to relax your cares away.

Name: Ambient Travels
Overview: Summertime may be almost over, but that doesn't mean the vacation has to be! With Ambient Travels you can travel the world from the comfort of your couch. You can visit Ireland, Hawaii, Egypt, and more! Just relax and let the ambient sounds soothe you.

Name: Aminal: The Christmas Game
Overview: Aminal: The Christmas Game is a 2D side-scrolling platformer that puts the player in control of a member of a fictitious band called Aminal. Players need to complete seven levels and collect as many bells as possible, before delivering them to the post box at the end of each level. The player is awarded points based on the time taken and the amount of bells obtained. If the player obtains bells fast enough, a combo bonus is provided. Whilst you are collecting bells, you will have to avoid hazards in the form of men on camels as well as snowmen with chainsaws.

Name: Amoeba Generator
Overview: Amoeba Generator is a game where the player takes control of an amoeba and guides it through its life cycle as it evolves in seven different stages. Each of those is a different type of game, including a shooter level, turret defense level and a level in which the player must tether genetic material in order to absorb it.

Name: Ambiance
Overview: A neat and simple screen saver style app for your Xbox 360. Lots of color and glowiness. Features music from Deceased Superior Technician.

Name: The American Hot Dog Race
Overview: In The American Hot Dog Race the player participates in a hot dog eating contest. To eat, the player needs to bash the displayed button as fast as possible. This button changes over the course of the match. When the time is over, the contestant with the most points wins. Additionally to the single-player mode against nine opponents with increasing difficulty, there is also a multiplayer mode and a time trial available.

Name: Amazing Wizard
Overview: Amazing Wizard is a Magic Game. Make your XBOX magically answer any questions. English Only. NOTE: CHATPAD REQUIRED. (Similar to 'Peter Answers' / 'Wizard 666')

Name: Anger Management 4
Overview:
Anger Management 4 is the follow-up to Anger Management 2, as there was no Anger Management 3.

Anger Management 4 is a Breakout variant. Players move a paddle left and right at the bottom of the screen and try to keep bouncing a ball to break and remove blocks from the top of the screen. The game makes the claim that the computer will mess with the player thus driving the player to anger.

The game has six difficultly level options.

Name: Blow
Overview:
Blow is a puzzle game in which the player must guide bubbles to the exit. This is accomplished by placing fans on the screen (they need to in proximity to a surface) which then carry the bubbles forward. The distance depends on a few variables: the angle of the fan (can be freely changed), at which position the bubbles enter the fan (from the back increases the distance), the fan speed (three available) and the bubble heat. In each level, the player has only a certain amount of gold available which restricts the number of fans (faster ones cost more) which can be placed. In most levels, the bubbles must travel through one or multiple blossoms before the exit is unlocked.

Before placing a fan, the game gives a preview how the bubbles will travel. However, there is no penalty for wrong placement because a fan can always be removed with a full gold refund. There are 70 levels and the option to randomly generate new ones.

Name: Ancient Trader
Overview:
Ancient Trader is a sea faring trading game in which you sail your ship into unknown waters in search of trade opportunities and compete with other traders to see who can turn the best profit. During the players travels, they will also have to fight off a variety of sea monsters and search for hidden treasures for that little extra money. Fights play out in a turn-based combat screen: every opponent has openly displayed and differently colored cards with varying attack figures; one color also gives an additional attack bonus. Every turn the combatants choose one card and the one with the higher value wins.

Players can also play against up to four other people to see who can accumulate the most wealth and treasure.

Name: Anger Management
Overview: This game will make you mad. The computer will mess with you. DEAL WITH IT!

Name: Angle of Attack
