There are four types of paintball guns with different attributes, and in addition to the online play for up to 16 players, there is also a training mode where the player has a limited amount of time to shoot targets strewn about the map.

Name: Avatar Penalty Kick
Overview: Replay the world cup matches with Avatar Penalty Kick! Will you be the best scorer?

Name: Avatar Pinball
Overview: Ragdoll physics meets classic pinball gameplay in a giant pinball machine where your Avatar is the ball!

Name: Avatar Penalty Shootout
Overview: Take part in a tense penalty shootout with your avatar. Compete against AI or take on a friend and see if you can become the penalty shootout master! Quick fire fun for all the family.

Name: Avatar Physics: Running
Overview:
Running is hard! Can you reach the finish line?

Features avatar ragdoll physics.

Name: Avatar Planking
Overview:
Ready for extreme planking? You’ll plank in places you’ve never dreamed of! Plank inside a taco, on a cat’s stomach, or even on Mars!

Over 60 crazy locations, famous landmarks, and beautiful vistas await your avatar in Avatar Planking! Don’t forget to make a silly face for the camera!

Name: Avatar Pro Wrestling
Overview: A wresting game... with avatars!

Name: Avatar Pumpkin Smash
Overview: Get your Avatar into the autumn spirit and have a smashing good time too! Ghoulishly throw pumpkins at other Avatars to score the most points within the time limit. Play in teams or everyone for themselves. Each map can be played during the day or at night if you dare. You are even treated to power ups. Play against computer controlled fiends or play online against friends or enemies.

Name: Avatar Quest
Overview: An adventurer lost on a mysterious island faces the dangers of a runic quest. Every game is different! Lots of replay value with 186 random levels. Test your mental agility while the time is running out!

Name: Avatar Punch
Overview: Compete with your avatar to manage to be the best boxer of all times across his 4 game modes or fight against a friend!

Name: Avatar Puzzle Pop
Overview:
Avatar Puzzle Pop is a frantic and fun action puzzler. Connect two groups of blocks of the same colour to remove them from the play field. Combo blocks together for big points.

Avatar support for fun gameplay feedback. Multiple game modes, clear the line, disarm the bombs, shoot some dice and play a friend in 2 player mode.

Name: Avatar QuizCall
Overview: Think you are the genius of the household? Put your Avatar on the stage and your quiz knowledge to the test with up to three other contestants. Will you be the laughing stock, or win the adulation of the crowd? With over 1000 questions and online high score tables we will soon find out who is the smartest cookie in the jar. Big Button controllers are compatible with Avatar QuizCall.

Name: Avatar Racedrome
Overview: Take your avatar for a rollercoaster drive at the Racedrome! Battle it out on 16 twisty tracks with fierce computer opponents, or online over Xbox LIVE. Includes a rewind feature so you can retry those risky maneuvers.

Name: Avatar QuizCall: Xmas Edition
Overview: The hit game Avatar Quizcall is back to brighten up your holiday season, step up to the stage and take part in the ultimate holiday quiz. With one to four players, global highscore tables and region specific questions. It's not a party unless it's a Avatar Quizcall party, let's see who is the smartest cookie in the jar.

Name: Avatar Random Chat
Overview:
Avatar Random Chat is the first Xbox service that pairs Xbox Live Enabled strangers from around the world together for voice-based conversations. At any point, either user may leave the current chat by initiating another random connection. It's like a chat roulette on your Xbox!

To use this service you must buy this app and have an Xbox Live Gold subscription and a Mic or Headset.

Name: Avatar Ragdolls
Overview: Everybody loves ragdolls. Throw your funny avatar rag-doll higher and higher. Play alone or with up to 4 friends. See your avatar fall, rebounce and climb up to the victory.

Name: Avatar Running 2
Overview: "Avatar Running 2" is a multiplayer action platformer that offers a multiplayer Score Attack Mode, single player Time Attack Mode, P2P Time Attack rankings, Course design support, and P2P sharing of courses. In Time Attack mode, the ghost of the fastest record is displayed.

Name: Avatar Runner
Overview:
Enjoy a leisurely stroll along the beach or sprint through a nightmare world in Avatar Runner. With a unique scoring system, collecting items builds up your combo. These points are only earned when you bank so if you make a mistake - all your combo is lost.

Run to your own music library with a custom run and compete against friends through tournaments.

Name: Avatar Rumble
Overview: Grab a friend (or three!) and do battle with your Avatars on soaring planes, city rooftops and more!

Name: Avatar Rumble 2
Overview:
Avatar Rumble is back and better than ever!

Wield hammers, swords and raw ki energy as you battle across a variety of stages inspired by a selection of Xbox Live Indies!

Name: Avatar Run!
Overview: Run as fast as you can to grab the gold! Enjoy playing with up to 4 other players in this button mashing competition featuring your avatar. Share you score online and see who's best. Beat the 100m world record! Double it with the 200m record or master the 400m !!

Name: Avatar Running
Overview: It is four person fighting type action game corresponding to online. It corresponds to the course design and the course sharing.

Name: Avatar Scent Wars
Overview: The opposing team smells awful so it is time to change their scent. Choose to be fresh and clean with the Spicers or stinky and stenchy with the Skunkers. Use your scent bombs, rockets and nukes to battle through 10 stages while leveling up your team. Also, scent weapons have healing powers if teammates start to smell rank.

Name: Avatar Shatter
Overview: Join your friends in a Co-op arcade game that features avatars and blast through waves of enemies across several worlds.

Name: Avatar Slam Dunk
Overview: Slam Dunk fun for your avatars! Featuring slam dunks and free throw contests with local multiplayer support.

Name: Avatar QuizCall: Africa 2010 Edition
Overview: QuizCall-Africa 2010 has a plethora of new features including computer opponents to test you to the max. Gather round and show us who is the smartest cookie in the jar, with a mix of general knowledge/sports and football questions. Africa 2010 the perfect addition to any World Cup party. See you on the high score table! (Big Button compatible) It's not a party unless it's a QuizCall party!

Name: Avatar Showdown
Overview: A great conflict awaits you and your Avatar. Challenge yourself and your friends in this purest test of skill. Includes online play and the Official JForce Seal of Quality.

Name: Avatar Snake
Overview: Snake Game, with Avatars!

Name: Avatar Rockets
Overview: Avatar Rockets is one of the few xbox 360 indie games that has full xbox live and Avatar support. Compete against your friends in 3 exciting multiplayer modes or take on the world with the global scoreboard in the single player game. Design your own space shuttle in the Rocket Paint feature and take your Avatar to the stars and beyond.

Name: Avatar Typing: Horde Invasion
Overview:
Stop an onslaught of angry Avatars by...typing? Logical enough! Can you type the sentences you're given before the enemies cross your path?

Featuring 8 enemy types and 2 modes of play, the action is sure to last. With over 1,500+ sentences to type and the ability to create your own, you're almost guaranteed to develop a fun case of carpal tunnel!

Chatpad or Keyboard required.

Name: Avatar Tennis
Overview: Game, Set & Match! Experience the most spectacular matches with Avatar Tennis! Train your skills, unlock over 50 rackets and get to the top rankings in the complete Career Mode, and take part in exciting local games of up to 4 players.

Name: Avatar Tower
Overview: Your Avatar is stuck in a burning tower! Flee from the fire by jumping the platforms. Make combos and collect stars to gain higher scores. Try to break your own highscore!

Name: Avatar Trials: Ninja Uprising
Overview:
Unleash your Inner Ninja! Avatar Trials: Ninja Uprising is a third person platforming game. Using parkour and free running movement, use your Avatar to navigate three challenging levels influenced by Assassin's Creed and Ninja Warrior.

You've never seen Avatars like this before - Master your skills to become a true ninja!

Name: Avatar Snowboarding
Overview:
Hit the slopes with your avatar. Enjoy breathtaking 3D HDR scenery, awesome 3D physics, hundreds of millions of levels, and more!

Snowboard alone or with a friend split-screen style. You have but one goal - make it to the bottom of the mountain.

Oh, and don't worry about calling for a pick-up. You are equipped with an infinite rocket booster should you need a push. Use with caution!!

Name: Avatar Squadron
Overview:
Avatar Squadron is a 2.5D side scrolling, comic styled, co-op shmup! Featuring non-stop airborne action where you will pilot Beano the biplane on a perilous adventure to rescue the land from the dastardly Dr Weevil and his infernal flying machines!

Packed full of excellent gameplay and some genuinely funny humour! Twelve levels, DropIn/DropOut multiplayer, fearsome boss fights and crazy weapons!

Name: Avatar Stealth
Overview:
Randomly generated stealth action!

Crawl, sneak and run past robot guards in a-near infinite number of levels! Customize the game and level generation in Custom Mode!

Name: Avatar Street Basketball
Overview: Shoot hoops with your avatar to be the best scorer across the world in four different game modes and five difficulty levels. Many stages in the whole world are waiting for you.

Name: Avatar Trivia Party 2
Overview: The hit online trivia game is back and better than ever! A more hectic board game and more challenging questions will put your intelligence and luck (or your Avatar's!) to the test!

Name: Avatar Surfing Challenge
Overview: 3D Surfing Action! Take your Avatar out onto the waves, win The Cup and be the Raddist Avatar on the Planet

Name: Avatar Survival Games
Overview:
Battle against other players in the multiplayer online Survival Games!

Scramble to grab weapons and supplies then fight for survival to become the victor!

Name: Avatar Takedown
Overview: Use portable tracers to mark Avatars for capture!

Name: Avatar Snowball Fight
Overview: Bring your very own Avatar into a holiday winter wonderland. Compete online with up to 16 other players in a full-on snowball battle!! Unlock cool new abilities and use them to secure your place on the global high score list. In full HD 1080P!

Name: Avatar Street Basketball 2
Overview:
Shoot hoops with your avatar to be the best scorer in the world!

Six courts and six different game modes are waiting for you in the first "basketball" game with zombies on it!

Name: Avatar Superstar
Overview: Be the star of the show, with your own music, in Avatar Superstar! Use your Microphone or Kinect to sing to your favorite songs, and see how you measure up to your favorite artists. Sound like a real pro with SuperTune automatic tuning technology. Are you the next Avatar Superstar?

Name: Avatar Thunder Cars
Overview: A race against combustible to travel as long as you can evading obstacles, mines, walls , flying in crazy ramps, boosting to crazy speeds of dizziness while you change between planets to gain more points.

Name: Avatar Trials 2: Ninja Redemption
Overview:
The sequel to the XBLIG top 250 best selling all time game Avatar Trials is back and better than ever!

Avatar Trials Ninja Redemption is a third person platforming game. Parkour and free run through 5 epic levels, learn platforming skills, and become a ninja master!

Name: Trivia Party Online
Overview: Test your trivia knowledge with a fully-featured online board game! Can you roll the dice and conquer the board before anyone else? With hundreds of questions and online matches over Xbox LIVE, you'd better smarten up!

Name: Avatar Workout
Overview: A new trainer is in town and avatars are invited for an intense workout session. Can your avatar keep pace with her or do you have a lazy couch potato on your hands? Compete with a friend's avatar or against an AI player.

Name: AvatarBall Hajiki
Overview:
AvatarBall is a multiplayer ball-playing action game. Control the AvatarBall and aim to hit your rivals and get over 100,000 points! Hit them with a smash after hitting them to earn a massive score.

Your score is calculated as ball-play points * survival points, so it's best to survive, but running away won't increase your score! Hitting them with a ball gives you an advantage, so corner them against the wall and trap them!

Name: Avatar Wasteland
Overview: The ultimate survival training exercise. Explore and fight in a large open world with up to 15 of your friends. This last man standing paintball battle features 5 weapons and a large urban wasteland with a variety of tactical locations.

Name: Avatar Warfare!
Overview:
Join 15 of your friends as you take your avatar into the intense online paintball battle of Avatar Warfare.

Customize your character as you progress though levels, climb the online scoreboards and unlock new weapons, perks and tag-streaks.

If you like Call of Duty Modern Warfare COD you will love Avatar Warfare.

Name: Avatar Warriors
Overview: Warriors beware! You will need all your strength and ability. First, learn everything you need in the training mode. Next, crush your rivals in 4 different arenas. Fight!

Name: Avatar Wave: Snowball Fight
Overview: Snowball+Avatars+LIVE Multiplay+Winter Classical Songs+Falling Snow+Flashing Lights+Powerups+ YOU = Exciting Snowball Fight! Start your fight now in Arcade, LIVE Multiplay, Versus and Survival game mode! Don't forget to check out the customizable screensaver and the secret mode! Get more points to enter the ranking tables and unlock new items!

Name: Avatar Without a Chute
Overview:
Feel the freedom and weightlessness of free falling without those unruly consequences of reaching the ground.

Collect points as you race your friends to the bottom!

Look out below!

Name: Avatar Fortress
Overview: A battlefield against others avatares in this fantastic First person shooter,12 players on line, Unlocks all weapons to get an advantage ,Compete online with a global high score list, and have fun with friends.

Name: Avatar Zombie Massager Extreme
Overview:
After minutes of studying XBLIG Memes, we have created The Ultimate Super XBLIG Game-App Thing! You know this is a surefire hit, because it has ZOMBIES! Yes, Zombies, the one constant known to launch any title, however stupid, to the top of the charts.

But wait! There's More! We even have AVATARS!

Name: Avatar... Fly!
Overview: "Avatar... Fly!" also gives you the chance to play in stereo 3D with the standard cyan-red glasses. This addictive game is the first step of the Ninja Fever team in the stereo 3D area, while keeps doing hard work to provide the user with all stereo visualization standards.

Name: Avatar's Rock
Overview:
ROCK NOW BELONGS TO THE AVATAR!

This is AVATAR'S ROCK! 4 PLAYER Co-op! 4 unique instruments! Lead, Bass, Rhythm Guitar and Drums!

AVATAR'S ROCK is compatible with popular Xbox 360 musical controllers.

Name: Avatar's Rock Paper Scissors
Overview: Classic game of rock paper scissors with avatars. Play against the computer or a friend.

Name: Avatar Word Wave
Overview: Get ready for family fun! Develop both sides of your brain, combining action skating and real time word spelling. Challenge friends and family and see who can earn all the awards and rack up the best career statistics. Each game you play earns ribbons and experience points. Experience will level up your Avatar and bring on a more challenging AI and faster reaction times to your commands.

Name: Avatars Don't Bleed
Overview: Use your avatar to beat 30 levels of extreme platforming with double jumps, spinning saws, spikes, sliding and canons.

Name: Avatarmageddon
Overview: Protect the mysterious artifacts from waves of suspiciously cubic invaders in this fast paced third person shooter that includes avatar support.

Name: AvatarFever: Capture the Spice
Overview: A fresh new capture the flag game, featuring multiplayer gameplay and online high scores. Compete online with your avatar and try to beat other players to be the freshest player over the world.

Name: Avatars in Grave Danger
Overview:
Zombified Avatars are on the loose, and they're hungry - for fun!

Defeat wave after wave of quirky zombies in this light-hearted wave defense game. Blast away 5 types of enemies using an upgradeable arsenal. Slow down time. Unlock over 50 Awards. Share your high scores and challenge your friends.

Will you triumph over all 20 waves? (Hint: Probably not!)

Name: Avatars on the Edge
Overview:
Come on! Grab your board and challenge gravity!

Jump from the roof of the buildings performing crazy stunts. Surpass yourself on twelve timetrials or challenge your friends online. Feel the wind on your face and laugh at danger to get your name to the top of the scoreboards.

Name: Avatars Skate: Old Spice Championship
Overview: Race your avatar around the icy tracks of Matterhorn and the warm beaches of Fiji. Attribute system gives seven areas to increase abilities, each affecting performance around the track. Increase your attributes by collecting Old Spice boosters, slow down the competition with multiple ammo types, and cross the finish line the Old Spice Champion!

Name: Avatars, Ghosts'n Zombies
Overview: Earth is again in serious danger. From the deapest space an asteroid full of ectoplasm has arrived. As "the chosen" your mission is to destroy the ectoplasmic menace and return earth to tranquility once again. Proof yourself trhough 57 levels in 7 different locations and save humanity from his terrible future fighting with your ray power, plasma power, flamepower and your brain.

Name: Avatars vs Zombies
Overview: Everyone hates zombies! Blast 'em to smithereens!

Name: Avatarzilla
Overview: Demolish the city or fight against your friends. Sandbox Fighting or Total destruction!

Name: Avatour
Overview: AVATOUR - Liberty Update. Tour the Statue of Liberty with Your Avatar. Use 4D Power to pass thru solid objects. Use anti-gravity power to travel up or down. Also, Drive a Taxi, Helicopter, Jet or Ferry Boat. GAMES.ARCHOR.COM

Name: Avatour: Vegas
Overview: AVATOUR - VEGAS Edition. Take a Tour of Vegas. Use 4D Power to go thru Objects, and use AntiGravity Power to Fly. Also, Drive a Car, Boat, Helicopter, Jet or Walk with Your Avatar. GAMES.ARCHOR.COM

Name: Axeh
Overview:
Dominate the board with the card!

AXEH is a new style game that is board game with flavor of card game. Read the next move of the opponent., and make full use the card to neutralize enemy castle!

You can play with various of AI to grow your skills at solo-mode. Of course, also supports online matches of XBOXLIVE!

Name: Awesome Pirates
Overview:
The Spanish Main is full of merchant ships carrying the spoils of the New World but, beware, other pirates are also on the prowl and the Spanish navy won’t tolerate their vessels falling prey to the rogues of the sea.

Captain your ship, fire its cannons, unleash powerful voodoo spells, deploy strategic munitions and make rival pirates walk the plank as you plunder a bustling Spanish trade route.

Name: Azubi's Pool of Bethesda
Overview: A game based on the biblical story about the events by the Pool of Bethesda. You have to uncover the hidden angels to obtain healing for your patients. There are three arch angels and twenty one ordinary angels distributed at random in the pool waiting to be revealed. Choose your patients wisely as you go angel hunting!

Name: Avoider
Overview: Don't let them get you!

Name: Awesome Tank
Overview: Take control of a lone tank, and shoot your way to victory against impossible odds! Features addictive gameplay, Global Scoreboards, Awardments, local and LIVE multiplayer, and endless replayability!

Name: AXBY
Overview: Please switch the attribute and destroy a lot of target. Let's put out the Hi SCORE by your TECHNIQUE!

Name: B-A-Maze'd
Overview:
B-A-Maze'd is a very fun and ingenious 3D maze based game in which you move the maze not the character in order to reach the heart of the character's favourite girl!!!.

The game lets the players use powerups to attack other players or ease their way in the maze.

Name: Avatour: Hide & Seek:  Mission: Miami
Overview: AVATOUR - Hide & Seek - Miami Mission. Go to Miami to Play Hide & Seek with NPC Avatars and Complete Missions. Find Avatars to UnLock more of the Map. Use 4D Power to go thru Objects to look for others, use AntiGravity Power to Fly up to others, also go underground. Use a Car, Boat, Helicopter, Jet or Walk with Your Avatar. GAMES.ARCHOR.COM

Name: Maze Game
Overview: Make your way through 20 mazes to rescue the princess from the evil brontosaurus. Collect coins along the way to purchase power-ups and suits.

Name: Baby Maker Extreme
Overview: Baby Maker Extreme is a game that simulates the miracle of childbirth... to the extreme! Time breathing with the triggers, then mash the B button to push, and the baby is launched from his mother and into the world, down the hall of the hospital. The player must control the bouncing baby boy by diving into glowing objects or boosting out of danger, with the goal being to keep the baby flying as far as possible. The top scores are recorded and replays can be shared with friends, and the player can even use their Xbox Avatar instead of the generic baby.

Name: Backyard Battles
Overview: Hey Kids! Your backyard has been taken over. What can you do about it? Are you brave enough to suit up and battle it out with the pests that have control of your space, or are you doomed to stay inside your house forever?

Name: Baby Soothing Machine
Overview:
Soothe your baby to sleep with this mobile and white noise player. This game is perfect for those late night feedings, when you need your infant to relax, so you can catch some zzzz's.

Dad created, baby approved!

Name: B.U.T.T.O.N
Overview: B.U.T.T.O.N. is a physical party game for 2-8 players. Race to your controller through physical space, and do whatever it takes to win (or to avoid losing). Act like a monkey, jump up and down, wrestle over the controllers, strip off some clothing, cheat your competitors, and above all, expect the unexpected. Brutally unfair tactics are, after all, totally OK now!

Name: Orbitroid
Overview: Try this frantic space shooter with eight action packed levels! Fight against tons of enemy hordes and four huge bosses. Destroy the Planetoid before it kills you using two upgradable weapons. Hit the Target to transform yourself into a invincible starship fighter. You can collect bonus to rise up your score to the stars or to charge Giga Bombs or again to extend time level.

Name: Baby Maker Extreme 2
Overview: Baby Maker Extreme 2 features gameplay similar to that of its predecessor. The player must time the breathing of a woman in labor before mashing a button to launch the woman's newborn baby as far as possible for maximum points. From there, the player controls the baby and must ensure that it keeps moving by bouncing off glowing objects and avoiding hazards. The player may also play as their Xbox avatar instead of the default baby. The game records the player's top scores and features numerous items for the avatar to wear which can be unlocked after completing certain challenges.

Name: Baby Mammoth's Journey to Mars
Overview: Help the baby mammoth escape the end of the world! Outrun the avalanche, duck under hungry vultures, and bash through trees in this epic fight against extinction!

Name: Baccarat
Overview:
Get the number one casino game of chance, Baccarat. All player moves are determined by the luck of the cards the player is dealt.

Baccarat is a very popular game among high rollers. Upgrade to the full game to access the VIP room.

Name: B&B Fatfree
Overview:
Online CO-OP Survival Game with Epic Boss battles, Mini-Boss battles, while fighting up to 300 zombie pigs.

Unlock and equip an assortment of weapons and pickups to defend yourself against waves of undead zombies.

Can you survive 50+ Days and Nights of blood and carnage?

Name: Bleed
Overview:
Wryn is a girl with purple hair and a big dream: she wants to be the ultimate videogame heroine. She also happens to have a large arsenal of weapons, so she starts a journey to take down the Greatest Heroes of All Time and claim the title for herself.

Bleed is a fast 2D side-scrolling action game with traditional gameplay elements such as running, jumping, shooting and avoiding enemies and other obstacles. The game consists of seven levels and has four difficulty settings. Besides the "normal" game mode there is also an arcade mode (just one life), a challenge mode (battle three bosses at once), and a local two-player co-op mode. There are also three unlockable characters.

Name: Switch!
Overview:
Intense Puzzle Action!

Match blocks, save orphans, earn points, fall in love, fire lasers and nukes, fall out of love and endure colors like "Cornflower Blue" and "Burnt Sienna"! Wow!

Love exclamation points (or unicorns)? You'll love this game!

Name: Bacto
Overview:
Bacto is a Eat'Em Up game where the player as a white cell will clean the area from bacterial infection by eating and killing nasty bacterias.

There are powerups in help for attacks and health. Each level will get more infected and be aware of highly lethal antibiotics.

The high score list is shared global with Xbox Live Gold.

Name: Bad Atom Episode 1
Overview: Bad Atom is a 3D Sci-Fi shooter where David Malcolm, a well respected pilot, takes on the responsibility to help create an experimental intergalactic weapon.

Name: Bad Golf
Overview:
Don't let the name fool you! "Bad Golf" is a fun, physics-based 2D golf game.

Play a relaxing round by yourself, or a frantic golf race with up to four players!

Name: Bacterio
Overview: Bacterio is 3D action puzzle game. You should avoid fallen blocks, eat and separate for making the road to the goal. Survive!

Name: Bad Bunny
Overview:
Come for the missiles, stay for the lasers.

Help Bad Bunny defend his humble hole from an onslaught of fascist good bunnies. Spoiler alert, you will eventually fail but its the effort that counts.

Name: Bad Caterpillar
Overview:
Partake in a 2D retro action the likes of which hasn’t been seen since the collapse of the arcades decades ago. Experience intense non-stop action as you fight off space insect hordes, collect weapons and power-ups, and battle for high score bragging rights against the entire world. And you know, save mankind from extinction at the hands of caterpillars, scorpions, spiders, and a slew of other ill-tempered giant killer insects.

"Bad Caterpillar is the game you deserve, but also the one you need."
- Commissioner Gordman

Name: Bailout!
Overview: When the rich get poor they get a Bailout! Collect as much money as possible as it falls from the sky while avoiding suicidal stockbrokers. Don't forget to kick the homeless before they steal your free government money and use it for medical treatment. Get a job, hippies!

Name: Balate: The Last Kingdom
Overview: Help the king of BALATE Sir Bradimir, and his court wizard Nerdin, to defend their country by the wrath of ferocious legions of orcs coming for their life. Be ready to fight the orcs by throwing 'Balates' to them, to make them fall down to the ground.

Name: Ball Guy
Overview:
Help navigate Ball Guy through the perilous dangers of inter-dimensional time travel, or something like that.

Defeat the Evil Ball and save Pinky, or maybe everything isn't what it seems. Try to collect the hourglasses in all the stages within the given amount of boosts and enjoy some fun facts along the way.

Name: Bail!
Overview: Strap on your snow pants and get ready for the best sled ride of your life. Six high speed hills and satisfying unlockable features make this an adrenaline spiked adventure for gamers of any skill degree. Tour the beautiful mountains of Colorado at breakneck speeds alone or in two player mode while you enjoy hours of gaming fun and don't be afraid to...BAIL!

Name: Ball Lightning
Overview:
Easy to learn, challenging to master, Ball Lightning is the first title in the "simple.fun" campaign series.

Test your reflexes and your wits across seven increasingly difficult levels in this arcade-style platformer from Amalgamation Softworks.

Collect power-ups, avoid traps and other obstacles, rescue your wizard, and escape the dungeon!

Name: Ball Track Builder
Overview:
Build a track in realtime and let the ball hits the barrel.

45 levels. 5 game mode.

A very new game type.

Name: Balloon Blocks
Overview:
Balloon Blocks is an inviting, easy to play and hard to master Match-3 game that uses soft body physics that give it a unique feel and intuitive game play.

The game has 3 game play modes and 3 difficulty levels as well as a custom game mode that gives the player over 100 different combination of options.

Name: Ballochet
Overview:
Ballochet pits you against girders and beams within intriguing cityscapes, and expects you to hit a target. You'll also need to negotiate crates that are in the way.

There are 25 screens, each of which gives you five different balls with which you can attempt to hit the target. There's a time limit, so you need take careful aim.

This may be the most addictive game that you have ever played.

Name: Balloon Guard
Overview: The Balloon Princess needs your help. An evil lord has exiled her from the Balloon Kingdom and has sent the sinister Balloon Agents to stop her return. Help her avoid Balloon Agents and return her safely to the Balloon Kingdom! Balloon Guard is a platformer with a twist. While conquering various platforming challenges, you must also bounce the Balloon Princess along while keeping her safe.

Name: Ballochet 3
Overview:
This game pits you against stunning cityscapes. Can you navigate the beams to hit the target?

49 levels give you hours and hours of riveting play time. Winning the game is easy. Just aim and fire. But the simplicity is deceiving as every level has to be mastered in its own way.

Have fun!

Name: Balls+Blocks
Overview: Addictive but fun maze game where you have to complete the level and control the ball to push and bounce to your target.

Name: Balls and Walls
Overview:
Those pesky balls have escaped! Oh no! What could we do? All you have are an unlimited supply of walls. Hmmm, Maybe you could trap the balls with the walls?

Includes 2 distinct game modes, HighScores, and Unlimited content through procedural level generation in both game modes.

Name: Ballern2D
Overview:
Expect spectacular battles in the most beautiful place in the entire universe!

In a hitherto unprecedented monotonous scenery and the unique one-level system, you must shoot at everything that moves.

Name: Balloon Boy
Overview: A young boy has run away from his parents. Well not run away so much as fly away in a balloon. Guide the boy safely through the dangerous skies and away from his troubles. Compete against the world with global high scores. Only you can boost TV news ratings!

Name: Ball Wing
Overview: If you got what it takes then take what you got and throw yourself in to the wild intense world of Ball Wing. Bounce your balls on enemies and try to survive so you can get the highest highscore in this intense puzzle shooter that will challenge both your reflexes and your intellect.

Name: Ballbuster
Overview:
After a wonderful theatre performance, balloons start falling from the ceiling.

Pop as many balloons as possible in the given time.

Name: The Ballet of Light & Shadow
Overview: In the burning light of a rainbow, fight the evil forces of shadows. Test your skills in four worlds of unique gameplay. Play in a dangerous ballet, detonate gears of shadows, avoid monstrous clouds and fight an epic war to liberate the rainbow from its foes.

Name: Pillar
Overview:
Pillar is a collection of minigames, where each game represents a different type of personality we find in people. Each personality is expressed entirely through the gameplay mechanics, without cutscenes or dialogue. All too often, we try to change people who are different than us, especially if they're polar opposites. We like to debate and tell them they're wrong and we're right... but what if there's a purpose for both extremes?

A Little Bit More About Pillar:
* A collection of minigames, each representing different personality traits (introversion, extroversion etc.) through gameplay mechanics. * Different people, different gameplay; each part of the game will challenge you in a unique way. * Explore an intimate snowy town, beautifully hand-painted with attention to every detail. * A distinct soundtrack, composed hand in hand with the game's design, by the game's designer, to ensure a cohesive experience.

Name: Barnstormer
Overview: Retrieve your coins from the farm, but be careful as the farmer has sent out his helicopters to try and stop you claiming back the coins that are rightfully yours. Make sure you storm the barns to get all the coins you can. Includes global Hi-Score table

Name: Bamdizzle
Overview: In a world where colored balls constantly fly at you, a paddle is the only answer. Take control of your destiny in this exciting 4 player ball blocking extravaganza. Feast your eyes on the 8 different paddle color options. Feast your ears on the 5 sound effects. And seriously feast your brain on the seemingly limitless game modes you can create with complete control over the game's rules.

Name: Banana Split
Overview: Banana Split is a 2D Puzzle/Platformer set in the exciting world of BREAKFAST! You play as Ben Ana, a banana with a top hat and a mission. That mission is to stop the unhealthy breakfast foods from turning breakfast into a bad meal. Ben will jump on heads and solve puzzles through five different zones across more than 50 levels in his quest to save his fruity buddies and rescue the princess.

Name: Barf and Beer
Overview: Chug your beer as fast as you can! Drink too much without burping and you'll puke, wasting valuable drinking time! Punch your opponents while they're burping to make THEM puke! Test your drinking skills against up to three other human or computer players at five difficulty levels!

Name: Basketball Machine
Overview: Basketball Machine is a virtual recreation of a foosball-style arcade basketball game. The court has a number of holes, and the player can launch the ball from a hole by clicking on it when the ball is resting in it. There are single- and two-player versus modes, as well as a single-player time attack mode where the goal is get as many points as possible within one minute.

Name: Bat-L-Blocks
Overview: Up to 4 players compete in a classic falling block style game, only this time players interact with each other by completing lines containing attack blocks. 20 unique attack blocks can change the game in an instant.

Name: Dance! Zombies Dance!
Overview: The zombie apocalypse? This may be it. This might be your only training. Don't go down without a fight!

Name: Basketball Trick Shot
Overview: Basketball Trick Shot is a physics based game. The goal is simple... put the ball in the basket. Challenge yourself with the 20 pre-built levels or create your own levels for timeless fun!

Name: Battle Ball
Overview: A twist on the tried and true classic. Blast your opponent in an attempt to get the ball past him. Battle the computer or a friend in two player mode. Or try the survival mode and try to beat your best score. Play at five unique locations. All programming and art by Jordan Hample.

Name: Battle Beat
Overview: Can you keep the beat and crush your foes? Using instrument-based controllers, Battle Beat combines the action of rhythm games with strategic elements to create a unique gameplay experience. Choose your squads and duke it out over the fate of your nondescript post-apocalyptic home world, fighting off massive hordes of aliens!

Name: Battle Cubes
Overview:
Battle Cubes is a fast paced, action packed, multiplayer first person shooter that combines the best features from classic and modern games.

Play on Xbox Live with 16 of your friends or 31 via System Link! Have a second player drop in at any point and play with up to 2 players split screen.

You can customize your cuboid with hats!

Includes CO-OP and Competitive game modes!

Name: Battle Bubbles (Four Corners)
Overview: Battle Bubbles (Four Corners) is set on a single-screen board with hexagonal fields. Each of the up to four players tries to seize as many fields as possible. This is accomplished by moving the controlled bubble over the screen, collecting floating blocks and place them into a free field which is adjacent to an already occupied field (each player starts the match with one). Then a timer starts and when it is expired, the field becomes fixed - but during this time, the block can be snatched away by another player. In addition to regular blocks, there are also special blocks which have positive or negative effects when placed, e.g. fast or slow speed. As soon as a block is picked up, the bubble becomes solid and can collide with other player bubbles. Each match ends after a certain time and the player with the most points wins. Points are rewarded for placing and stealing blocks, but having a block stolen results in a point subtraction.

Name: Battle Sub
Overview:
Never played a good submarine game? Ever thought 2D shooters are boring? They don't have to be! Battle Sub combines colourful artwork and compelling gameplay to create a unique experience in underwater combat.

Quests are the corner stone of this game, propelling the player forward in the story line as they help defend each ocean against the empire.

Name: Battle Tanks
Overview:
Battle Tanks is a top-down action game with tanks. The tank is controlled with the standard dual-stick style (one stick controls movement and the other aim) and, in addition to the regular shot with unlimited ammo, can also drop mines behind. However, just as ricochet bullets, they can also be harmful to the player's tank. When two bullets meet, they cancel each other out. Picking up spawning power-ups give permanent or temporary upgrades, e.g. invisibility, higher speed, rockets or a flame thrower.

All maps are basically single-screen arena maps. During the single-player campaign, 50 levels have to be solved by killing all opposition. In later levels not only the AI opponents and the time limit of two minutes may cause problems, but also environmental obstacles, e.g. conveyor belts, mud which slows down movement or crushing walls.

In multiplayer, up to four players can engage in deathmatch, team deathmatch or capture the flag matches. Optionally destroyed tanks can be turned into turrets so players can throw a few bombs while they are out. The multiplayer modes can also be played against bots.

Name: Battle for Demon City
Overview:
The city has been taken by an army of demons! You are its only hope, as all other law enforcing units, even from nearby regions, were neutralized during the attack while you were out of town, attending a disciplinary hearing.

Your mission is to go in, vanquish the invading army, punish those responsible for such riot, restore the peace and order in the city... and then return to your hearing.

Name: Battle Havoc
Overview: Battle Havoc is a fast paced multi-player action game with a unique twist on real-time artillery combat. Take to the air with rechargeable jets unleashing the power of over 20 different weapons and upgrades. Play Deathmatch or Elimination modes against 8 players over LIVE, System Link, or a single Xbox. Earn coveted Gold Medals as you race against the clock in 13 single-player time challenges.

Name: Battle High: San Bruno
Overview: At San Bruno High School, a vicious gang known as "The Rivals" reigns supreme, terrorizing and oppressing their peers undetected and unpunished. Choose from 8 students as they battle for justice or greed in this fast-paced 2D fighter.

Name: Battle-SX
Overview: 1-4 Player Multi-Platform 2-D Fighting greatness! Think of this as Battle-X featuring better backgrounds, remixed music and new moves for all characters. Multiple levels of difficulty are also available. Counters, block breakers, and Super Combos are some of the new features that make Battle-SX an action pack slugfest.

Name: Battle High 2
Overview: The sequel to Battle High: Elemental Revolt, this thrilling fighter introduces 5 new characters, new music and stages, new challenges, and awesome voice-acting! Play as one of 12 fierce students (and one secretive faculty member) as they face-off in the tough halls of San Bruno High for the Elementally Advanced and discover the secret behind the mysterious illness stripping students of their powers!

Name: Beer Pong 2
Overview: Beer Pong 2 introduces trickshot levels that allow you to collect caps and purchase upgrades. Upgrades include Ball variations, gravity controls, spin controls, ball paths and more that can all be used in Classic play. Using the new Minimap feature, you can now view the entire field to better aim your shot!

Name: Beach Bubbles: Chapter 2
Overview: Collect all bubbles!

Name: Beach Bubbles: Chapter 3
Overview: Collect all bubbles!

Name: Bed Time Nursery Rhymes
Overview: Bed Time Nursery Rhymes for your children.

Name: BattleWorms
Overview: Battleships? Phaw! Instead of trying to sink your opponent's ships, try to squish his or her worms? A fun twist on this classic board game. Squish all the worms in your opponent's garden before he can squish all of yours. Happy stomping!

Name: Beer Pong
Overview: Play Beer Pong with your friends! Either test your skill against a computer, or play with up to 4 players in a two on two match. Cup and drink counter will keep track of how many shots you've sinked as well as how many drinks you've had. Trickshot lets you test your skills against different style cups like a champagne glass or shot glass!

Name: BattleShip Arcade
Overview:
4 different modes to battle with friends. Sink, loot and beat them to see who is the real pirate!

BattleShip Arcade is for playing with friends and family up to 4 on the same screen!

Name: Beware of the Penguins
Overview: A first person shooter challenge game. Take turns to see who can kill the most penguins before the penguins kill you.

Name: Beat Blox
Overview: BeatBlox is a music-oriented action-puzzle game where you scramble to match blocks to the beat of a wide variety of music. Are you ready?

Name: BattleSweeper
Overview:
BattleSweeper is a straight Minesweeper variant. There is a grid and each time the player clicks on a field, the game either ends (a hidden bomb was found) or a number is revealed. This number shows how many bombs are found in the direct vicinity. Using those hints, the player has to work out where the bombs are hidden. Flags are used to mark the bomb spots. The game successfully ends when all fields without bombs are revealed.

This variant features three competitive multiplayer modes: Gems (the players needs to find as many hidden gems as possible), Survive (every player has three lives and no flags) and Zones (the goal is to uncover the largest area).

Name: Battlepaths
Overview:
Battlepaths is a loot-centric and addictive 2D-RPG featuring neat monster hacking, an excellent loot system and a huge variety of character development. Learn skills, use powerfull potions, and hunt down the Chaos Overlord. The battle begins in Babatula, the first of three big realms to explore.

Battlepaths offers a sophisticated drop system that generates countless different items along with more than 50 unique items. The character customization allows you to create a unique hero with its own strengths and weaknesses. You can build a heavy, damage dealing tank, a deadly ninja that utilizes high speed and agility to attack his victims from out of nowhere, a true master of mind who crushes his foes with powerful combinations of special abilities, or something in between.

You can choose to play in different realms that each have their own landscape and their own set of creatures. The many superior items you will find can be exchanged between different characters, one of which will eventually become the first powerful enough to face the Chaos Overlord.

Name: Beat Hazard Ultra
Overview:
Beat Hazard Ultra is a release of the game that was previously available for the Xbox 360 as an indie title and then on PC. It is a twin-stick shooter where the player controls a space ship in a single screen arena with randomly generated enemies and power-ups based on the music that is playing. Music is provided in-game but can also consist of custom tracks stored by the user on the device or hard disk. For the Android version it is also possible to play along an internet radio station.

As a whole, the game largely incorporates the content and features of the original Beat Hazard game along with the Beat Hazard: Ultra add-on, in a single game. The add-on for instance introduced head-to-head and cooperative multiplayer games (PS3, not for the mobile versions), also with the Boss Rush, Chill Out and Survival game modes. All versions come with perks that can be unlocked in-game and achievements/trophies. For the mobile versions there are two ways to control the game: either as a one-stick mode for beginners or a twin-stick mode or advanced players. The game also includes a music visualizer without gameplay.

Name: Beach Paddle
Overview: Can you be the Beach Paddle champion?

Name: Beach Bubbles: Chapter 1
Overview: Beach Bubbles is a simple action game where the player must maneuver a cute girl around the field collecting bubbles while avoiding bouncing around the open space. Collect all the bubbles on the stage without getting hit, and part of an illustration of a girl in a bikini is unlocked -- clear all the stages, and the full illustration is shown. There are a total of nine girls to see, with six stages for each.

Name: Befuddled Bears
Overview:
The bears are befuddled! Help these batty bears blast their way through challenges in this puzzle, arcade-shooter.

Follow the bears' escapades in story mode, and play with - or against - three friends in local multi-player. Along the way, unlock a bunch of bears and weapons, each with unique strategies to master. Did we mention cookies would be involved?

The bears need you - don't let them down!

Name: Being
Overview:
The evil Zargon has captured Being's friends and the magical star pieces. Somehow this will enable him to rule the galaxy, so Being has to stop him.

Being is a traditional side-scrolling platformer. The player character can move horizontally, jump on platforms, collect coins as well as keys. The latter are required to open same-colored doors. Enemies can't be defeated and have to be avoided, otherwise one of the three hearts of life energy is removed. At the end of a level waits one of Being's friends and a star piece to collect.

Name: Beep Brrp Bing Bang Bosh
Overview:
bbbbb is the ungodly rhythm game child of running platformers, Rock Band and gravity flipping.

Each lane controls an instrument, each button controls a character in a lane. Flip characters avoiding the spikes and keep the music going. And every so often there’s the wheel of fortune: characters are moved into new positions. There’s only a few seconds to get ready for the next onslaught.

Name: Bible Navigator X: HCSB
Overview: Bible Navigator X: HCSB is the first application on the XBOX 360 that allows the user to read the entire Bible from their 360. Featuring easy navigation, bookmarks, and search tools, Bible Naviagtor X presents the HCSB translation in a great way to read scripture. Various settings allow you to customize the reading experience with different themes, font sizes, and a scalable viewing area.

Name: Beer Screensaver
Overview: This screensaver looks like a glass of ice cold beer. Put it up at a party for the perfect atmosphere.

Name: Bible Trivia
Overview: Test your knowledge of the Bible with hundreds of trivia questions from the Old Testament and the New Testament. Easy and hard levels to choose from. Bonus mini-games are awarded after every round of 25 questions. Great for Bible study or family entertainment.

Name: Bid Whist
Overview: Bid Whist, this is a form of Rummy and had been played in Urban areas for quite some time. Tournament play makes this a must have for your game collection!

Name: Bible Trivia Avatar Edition
Overview: Welcome to Bible Trivia - Avatar Edition, where you and your friends can test your knowledge of Biblical truths from the comfort of our living room. So grab a controller, get comfy, and let's get going.

Name: The Escapists
Overview:
The Escapists is a single-player strategy and simulation game set in a series of prisons with increasing levels of security. The player takes the role of an inmate with the ultimate goal of escaping confinement. Each prison follows a strict daily routine that includes roll calls, meals, exercise, and job assignments. While appearing to conform to this schedule, the player must secretly gather resources, plan escape routes, and avoid suspicion from guards and fellow inmates. Progression through the game requires successfully escaping each prison, with later facilities featuring tighter security and more complex layouts.

Gameplay combines sandbox planning with role-playing elements. The inmate can work official prison jobs, such as laundry or kitchen duty, to earn money, and can also take on favors from other prisoners. These requests may involve delivering contraband, starting fights, or causing distractions, rewarding the player with cash or useful items. Money can then be used to buy tools, crafting ingredients, or contraband from other inmates. Crafting allows the creation of essential escape equipment such as shovels, wire cutters, disguises, and weapons.

Stealth and timing are central mechanics. Guards respond to suspicious behavior, contraband checks, and raised heat levels if the player breaks prison rules. Combat can occur with both inmates and guards, using improvised melee weapons or fists, but excessive violence can lead to lockdowns and solitary confinement. If caught, the player risks losing contraband or progress toward escape.

Escapes can be executed in multiple ways depending on the prison’s design, including tunneling beneath walls, cutting through fences, disguising oneself as a guard, or inciting riots as cover. Each facility encourages experimentation with different approaches, making no two escapes identical.

On some platforms, The Escapists also includes the ability to create and share custom prisons through the online modding communities (for example, Steam Workshop), giving players access to community-made challenges or the opportunity to design their own layouts.

Name: Bigger And/Or Better
Overview: Welcome to the working world. We're gonna leverage your synergy and have you shove some boxes around for some reason. There's free coffee in the break room.

Name: Bibz
Overview:
Bibz is a multiplayer party platform brawler with lots of unlockables and customizable characters.

Artwork is by kids in Ethiopia, Australia, and Canada.

Name: Big Tidy Up
Overview: Grab your friends and duel it out in three action-packed mini-games! Test your reactions in 'Wastefall'. Put your memory to the test in 'Carnundrum' and hone your button bashing skills in 'Poodamonium'!

Name: Billy the Kidney Bean vs. The Foo Fighters
Overview: It is 1944 and the axis forces have managed to get hold of alien 'Foo Fighter' technology. The aliens are helping them to build anti-gravity battleships in their secret underground base in the Nevada desert. This would allow them to alter the course of the war. Billy must stop them from altering the future and help the allies win the war ...... again!

Name: Birth Order
Overview: Birth Order is a horizontal scrolling shoot'em up with a few twists. Twelve different stage types could be on your path to the final fight. You can pick up cards, that can be played out between the stages, to give you even more power or help out in other ways. Each enemy is controlled by a color coded letter, the only way to destroy it is to press the corresponding button on the game pad.

Name: Bit-Hacker
Overview: Take on the role of a professional hacker who has finally released him/herself into the internet after many years of studying hacking. Fight your way through, avoiding viruses and worms - or even other hackers - along with breaking firewalls to reach your destination.

Name: Biology Battle
Overview:
TauCorp Pharmacuticals [sic] developed medical nanobots. The player is one of those and is sent on missions to kill stuff. In practice, this is a survival mode. The controls follow the usual twin-stick shooter conventions and there are some special moves available: blackhole (sucks in everything, including the player), blast and a lightning attack. Those have a cooldown period after usage.

Additionally there are a number of versus modes against other players or the AI available, for example turrets (the players can deploy turrets), wire cycle (players leave hazardous trails behind them), lasso (similar to wire cycle, but the trails disappear after a time), froghop (checkpoint races) or worms (getting close, but don't touch, worms which fly around the playfield).

Name: Bioerosion
Overview:
It is a TPS (Third Person Shooter).

Defeat the crazy monsters that approach you! As you progress through the stages, the city changes its appearance...

Name: Bingo
Overview:
Bingo!

Play with up to 4 people and with up to 10 cards each.

Name: Bit Digger
Overview:
Play as Dougal McTaggart, an intrepid adventurer caught up in a magical world of cubes! Place over 50 block types including TNT, Ladders, Water, Lava and Sheep!

Take in-game photos and show them off to your friends in the gallery, and let your imagination take over in this ultimate block-building game!

Name: Bird Assassin
Overview: A bird murdered the protagonist's father, so he has dedicated himself to killing every bird he can find. The player controls the protagonist, who can move, jump, and shoot. Avoid obstacles and kill birds to make money, which can be used to buy better guns and other upgrades, to kill birds more efficiently.

Name: Bitcoin Tycoon
Overview:
Build your small town into a bustling metropolis using the power of virtual currency.

Starting with only a small hot-dog stall, you must accumulate Bitcoin, breed Alpacas, build Hydroelectric power stations, and wrangle with Red Tape to create a thriving city.

Name: Billy's Job
Overview:
Billy's Job is an arcade game.

Your task is to store all the object in the room. For this, push them on the conveyor belt. When all is done take the key to next levels.

Features:
-Over 25 Levels
-Continue support
-Highscore online

Name: BioHack
Overview:
We've all played physics-based games before. But have you ever tried one based on biochemical kinetics?

BioHack is a simulation game where you must solve challenging design problems. The game includes 25 unique levels, plus randomly-generated mutant levels.

No science background necessary!

Name: Bingo Party
Overview: Enjoy four different types of Bingo with up to 31 players in a game. With over 50 different winning patterns and plenty of unlockable items, everyone has fun with Bingo Party!

Name: Bit Crunch
Overview: Bit Crunch is a retro style twin stick shooter that focuses on exploration and adaptation. Players are given a sprite and stats based on their name and pushed into an ever changing world. Tasked with retrieving an orb from the boss, players set out against rooms and waves of enemies who get more powerful with each new room that's explored.

Name: Black Jack Card Counter
Overview: You have heard the stories about people going to Vegas, counting cards, and getting rich. To bad you can't keep dozens of numbers and probability tables in you head. Let your Xbox will take care of the details of keeping track of the cards and sorting thru the tens of thousands of possible hands to calculate the odds. You are free to mastermind the strategy. Can you achieve simulated riches?

Name: BitStream
Overview: Feel the beat as you weave your way through the pounding techno race tracks of the Bitstream universe. With 4 tournaments spread over 16 challenging courses, it'll take all your skill to defeat your rival racers and claim the title of ultimate Bitstream champion!Bitstream takes classic vector line racing gameplay and gives it a unique audio-sensory makeover. Each movement by both the player and the AI racers is accompanied by beat matched audio cues, which build into a constantly evolving, dynamic sound-scape that ebbs and flows as the race progresses.The full version of Bitstream includes:- 16 unique tracks- 4 challenging tournaments- Freestyle music generator mode- Gamecenter leaderboards and achievements

Name: Blackjack Strategy King
Overview: Blackjack Strategy King has plenty of help and tips for beginners, and advanced features for experienced players. Features include Basic Strategy, Card Counting, Simulation, Awards, and Cheating. Player can define custom strategies or use the default. Includes options for Bank, Table Limits, Hit Soft 17, Surrender, Number of Decks, and more.

Name: BitzKrieg
Overview:
"It's Super Smash Strategy!" in a fast-paced Real Time Strategy game featuring chaotic 4-player local multiplayer, a full single player campaign including an insidious AI, and fully customisable characters!

Build your army using the 4 unit types to outmaneuver your foes in an RTS designed specifically for console.

Name: Biz School: Twist-Ed
Overview: Here is your chance to go to a super elite business school and earn an MBA. However, Future Robber Barons University is like no other business school. It is not about lectures and exams. There is only one test and only one thing that counts - can you make money? How much? 1 Billion dollars in four years or you flunk out.

Name: Bizzy Bee
Overview: Bizzy Bee is a one or two player co-op game where you and a friend race to collect pollen from fields of flowers in the shortest amount of time.

Name: Blastarock!
Overview: Based on the classic asteroids model, BlastaRock! From Reaper Gaming Studios is a fast-paced twin-stick shooter. Play through the campaign to unlock more powerful weapons and equipment, then take your ship to battle in survival mode. Featuring 2-player local multiplayer, online scoreboards, and RGS Awardments.

Name: Blazin' Balls
Overview: Bounce your way along the cosmic path, collecting coins and trying to beat the clock in this 3D bounce-along pick-up-and-play knockabout!

Name: Block Destruction
Overview: Destroy thousands of blocks through 50 levels of increasing difficulty with this retro style game! Includes many items and bonuses such as multiball, expand paddle, laser and much more!

Name: The Blaggers
Overview: The Blaggers is a single-screen platformer. In each level, the protagonist first has to collect all keys so he can open the exit door. Of course there are several obstacles in the way such as hazardous objects, moving enemies (which don't actively target the player), conveyor belts or platforms which dissolve after stepping on them. Each contact with something dangerous results as instant death and the need to start the level over. There is also a time limit.

Name: Blaster and Morion
Overview: Blaster and Morion is a sci-fi themed twin stick shooter, and the sequel to Blaster and Amethyst. Playing much like its predecessor, the goal of each of the seven stages is to blast enemies off the stage, collect all seven crystals, and reach the exit before the timer runs out and without falling off the stage. As before, contact with enemies or enemy fire is not directly harmful, but will cause the character to fly backwards a good distance, and likely off the stage to his death.

Name: BLASTEROIDS
Overview:
Classic Vector based arcade game. Power shields, Smart bombs, Extra lives.

In the 1980's games like this cost 25 cents per play and made millions, now they might make a few pennies.

If you are over the age of 30 you may have seen this game before and enjoy the nostalgia!

Name: BlindGiRl2
Overview:
BlindGiRl is back. This time she is not alone.

Play split-screen or with a friend to solve echo-location puzzles, and find your way through confusion to understanding.

Name: Blazin' Balls Xtreme Edition
Overview: Make your spinning, sizzling way along the road as fast as you can without falling through the gaps. Simple? Few will be good or fast enough to complete all 20 stunning 3D levels, but everyone can enjoy the 2-player battle mode - smack your opponent's ball around in the race to the line! Can YOU find your way to the top of the global online score table?

Name: Blaster and Amethyst
Overview: Blaster and Amethyst is a simple top-down shooting game. Each stage contains seven amethyst crystals, and the player must collect them all to open the gate to the next stage. Making this more difficult are the swarms of buglike monsters populating each stage. They will attack and shoot at the player, and while no attacks will do direct damage, they will cause the player to fly wildly, easily careening off the edge of the stage. The player has a blaster with which to ward off enemies, but this also only pushes them around and off the stage. The player is awarded with a time bonus for remaining time at the end of each stage, and there are seven stages total.

Name: Blaze of Glory
Overview: Action hero Buck Forrest is being forced into retirement! Help him end his career his way, in a Blaze of Glory. Blast your way through an endless stream of Thugs and Ninjas with a variety of different weapons and powerups.

Name: Block Slam
Overview: Punch, kick, shoot and smash - in Block Slam, you use your PowerBall and Minigun to destroy all the blocks in each level. Gather Bonuses, avoid hazards and always keep your PowerBall in play - this is 3D block busting action like you've never seen before!

Name: Block Ops
Overview:
Kill your friends, earn medals, unlock new abilities, customize your character and so much more in Block Ops!

Fight Zombies together, duel 16 players at once in Deathmatch or show off your strategy in Flag King.

Name: Block Puzzle's Revenge
Overview:
The block's are getting their revenge! Take control and move between four fields at once and try to keep the fields up and alive.

The timer keeps ticking, boss blocks keep dropping, prolong the block menace as long as possible!

Features visual and audio changes to keep the pacing up, along with classic and two player competitive modes.

Name: Block the Laser
Overview: In Block the Laser, your goal is to reach the exit while evading deadly lasers along the way. To accomplish this youll have to step on floor buttons to turn lasers on or off, open and close doors, or activate turnstiles which push anything that stand in their way. You can also manipulate mirrors to redirect the lasers path or use doors and turnstiles to block the laser.

Name: Block Fight!
Overview: The premise is simple, hit a ball with a paddle to take out your opponents blocks so you can get a single ball by his wall to win. Things heat up quickly with multi-ball action. Ping-Pong on Steroids. It's simple, it's fun, and it's addicting! Have Fun!!

Name: Block Killer
Overview: Kill blocks, save the world! Block Killer is what 1980 thought we'd be playing in 2010. Classic, single stick movement, simple push button shooting. Over 30 levels of arcade-style action! Do you have what it takes?

Name: Blackstone- Part One
Overview:
Blackstone Part I is the first in a trilogy of adventure games in which you take on the role of our heroine Kate, the innocent and unknowing victim of an evil sorcerer's attempt to harness the powers of the mysterious Blackstone. As she embarks on a brave mission to save her village and help her friends, her quest soon leads her to the Clouded Mountain where she must discover both the true extent of her task and the real reason Blackstone is so desperately coveted.

You control Kate as she starts in her home village and then moves through the different areas of the game. You must help her find, pick up and use items, solve puzzles and meet lots of new faces on her journey. The story unfolds as you progress in the game, and is shown via multiple cut sequences in fantastic 3D with full character voiceovers.

Blackstone was available for the Xbox 360 and was released in July 2011. It remained there until the marketplace closed in October 2017, and is no longer available on any platform.

Name: Block King
Overview:
Blast the floor out from under your opponents' feet to send them to their doom; before they do the same to you. Will you risk an early loss to grab the power up and gain an advantage?

Unlock dozens of models and skins as you defeat online opponents or computer controlled bots. Show off your new looks while sniping the floor out from under your friends' feet.

Play with up to 8 people in each match.

Name: Block King 2
Overview:
Experience a unique 8 Player FPS DeathMatches that breaks all the rules you're used to, as well as the ground beneath you!

Test your skills offline against challenging bots or with a friend. Split screen is supported.

Double XP Weekends!

New levels and powerups get patched in weekly!

Name: Block Smash
Overview: Block Smash is a challenging block puzzler. The idea of the game is to get three blocks of the same color in a horizontal or vertical row in order to remove them from the grid. For each level you are given a certain amount of blocks to use in order to complete the level.

Name: Block Vengeance Alpha
Overview:
Imagine breakout, except this time the blocks aren't as happy about you firing balls in their directions and are fighting back!

Collect power-ups to get back in the fight and juggle as many balls as you can to get extra points. Battle through 10 Levels of 3 stages each in arcade mode, take on survival mode, or play versus another player.

Name: Block World
Overview: You and your friends create worlds in BlockWorld. With the best graphics, largest worlds and most items you can do anything you want. Unlock new blocks and items with Awards in uniquely generated worlds during the day and night in BlockWorld. Swords, Arrows, bombs and Guns let you challenge your friends to combat and destruction in BlockWorld.

Name: BlindGiRl
Overview: An intriguing mix of puzzle solving, adventuring, and strategy, BlindGiRl puts the player in the shoes of a girl lost in a world of darkness, where the unknown lurks around every corner.

Name: Block Jump
Overview:
Jump blocks, draw blocks, and get to the top in this intense platformer!

Fall off the screen and fail, or succeed in reaching the top as fast as you can, but beware; this game is HARD!

Name: Block Shift
Overview:
Block Shift is a puzzle game requiring you to piece together a picture from its parts. You can move each row and column as a whole unit.

Includes over 80 puzzles including your gamer image in puzzle form! Also includes a mapmaker to build your own puzzles.

Name: BlockBuster
Overview: Block BUSTER is inspired by the old classics from the 70's. Knock out the blocks in vivid 3D. Experience over 20 challenging levels for hours of game play. Choose from 3 difficulty levels for the best experience. This is my Tribute to the great legacies of gaming!

Name: Blocks and Big Robots
Overview:
Online deathmatch with big robots, featuring huge explosions in your typical fully destructible blocky world.

Also supports CPU opponents for offline training.

Name: Blocks and Choppers
Overview:
Online deathmatch with helicopters, featuring huge explosions in your typical fully destructible blocky world.

Also supports CPU opponents for offline training.

Name: Blocks & Tanks
Overview:
Online deathmatch with avatars and tanks, up to 8 players! Use your big gun to explode the blocky world, or build anti-tank obstacles.

Features bots for offline training.

Name: BLOCKPLUS
Overview: This is a retro Breakout-style game. 50 stages in all.

Name: Block Zombies!
Overview:
In a world gone wrong, one girl stands alone. Alone, but not unarmed!

In a world gone wrong, one girl stands alone. Alone, but not unarmed!

Strange crystalline structures have turned people into mindless, zombie-like creatures.

Fight the Zombies! Stop the Infection! Save the Day!

Explore a variety of environments while blowing zombies into blocky bits.
Find new weapons and upgrade them, from pistol and shotgun to flamethrower and RPG.
Make use of flares, grenades and mines.
Wii U GamePad modes for off-TV play and map display.

Name: Blockey
Overview:
Ever wonder what two teams of right-angled people playing hockey looks like? Well look no further!

Seriously, stop looking.

Name: Blockhead
Overview: Drop blocks into the cube. Watch the the blocks change color. Get three in a row. Eat a sandwich. Repeat.

Name: Blocks Indie
Overview: The object of Blocks is to deliver a wooden create to a magical floating island using a jet-powered platform. Along the path to the island, you are confronted with obstacles designed to impede your progress. You must dodge moving blocks, squeeze through tight spaces, and turn sharp corners at blinding speeds. Blocks will rock your socks!

Name: Bloody Mary
Overview: Bloody Mary, Bloody Mary, Bloody Mary.

Name: BloodyCheckers
Overview:
Enter the medieval world of KnottedHand Hall, and take on 20 dead NPC's who will try and stop you at all costs. Enjoy 30 hours of leveling, exploring, and hiding as you take everything you have learned online.

Gorgeous graphics and 3D gameplay almost go unnoticed as the action overtakes you, and you become immersed in volleys of spells, arrow barrages and cannon attacks from your opponents.

Name: Blocks That Matter
Overview:
Blocks That Matter is a 2D puzzle game where the player controls a tiny Tetrobot. The robot was designed by two independent Swedish developers, Alexey and Markus, but they have been kidnapped to work for a large corporation. Their Tetrobot invention is the only one who can save them. Players guide the robot through the different levels to reach the exit. It can be moved around and can drill many different types of blocks to collect them. Once stored, the blocks can be recycled to design new constructions and they also each have their own qualities. This technique is reminiscent of the contemporary Minecraft and is used for most of the levels to get past obstacles and reach higher platforms. Blocks cannot be reconstructed randomly. They have to be laid out in patterns called tetrominoes. Only a single block can be drilled at a time and its disappearance often affects the blocks around it. In construction as well: wood and iron blocks are stable enough to stand on their own, but a sand block will not stand unless it is supported by another block.

At any time the puzzle mode can be activated. It pauses the game and overlays the screen with a green grid. Players can then design their constructions with the available blocks without pressure. By completing levels up to 40 Blocks That Matter are collected. These awards unlock new parts of the game and reference classic games where blocks play an important role, such as Boulder Dash for instance. Not all parts of the game are slow-placed. There are chase sequences with giant monsters and different types of enemies in general. In the execution of design, classic block games are often referenced next to the use of tetrominoes, by clearing a line of blocks Tetris-style for instance.

In the Adventure Mode the main campaign is The Underground Rescue. There are also Bonus Levels and a separate menu where the game' soundtrack is unlocked. In the Community mode players can create their own levels or play custom levels designed by others.

Name: Blockt
Overview:
Collect all the blocks, and navigate to the goal. But be careful how you connect them -- some shapes don't roll around very well!

Featuring innovative game mechanics with 3 block types, gorgeous space nebula environments, and 75 mind-bending, fully 3D puzzles to solve.

Name: Blood on the Dance Floor
Overview: Zombie killing action! Survive as many rounds as you can! Up to four players on a local machine with multiple characters, a variety of weapons, two intriguing worlds and almost certain death. Grab your friends and fight your way through the zombie devastation in a fun cartoon world with plenty of zombie killing dance music to start a revolution!

Name: Blood Tempest
Overview: Take the wheel of a heavily armed speedboat as you take on enemy boats, frigates, and battleships with a multitude of weapons and upgrades including missiles, machine guns, mines, armor, engines, and more. After your first intense dog fight you wont be able to put it down!

Name: BLOOD&BACON
Overview:
Blood And Bacon is a Multiplayer Shooter that pits heavily armed players against undead deadstock as you attempt to butcher your way through 100+ levels of insanity and twitching gristle.

Day and night levels, players will take on 25 enemy types and numerous bosses, like the gargantuan monster affectionately named, 'Princess Blubbergut' and Minibosses every 10 days as you explore, shoot and run for your life against the onslaught of porcine monstrosities.

Boasting over 15+ hours of gameplay and the ability to battle a staggering (or shambling) 500+ undead creatures at once, "Blood and Bacon" looks to feature more barnyard excitement than you can shake Old MacDonald's severed femur at!!

Name: Bloody Death
Overview:
This game was classified by the community with the following category scores - Violence=3/3, Sex=2/3, Mature Content=3/3.

Are you brave enough to bear anguish and terror? Faceless Killer is back, to end what he didn't accomplished three years ago. Fear is waiting for you just around the corner. Write your destiny, nothing is still settled..12 different dooms are waiting for you.. The new masterpiece signed by The Prince of Terror, Claudio Battiato..

Name: Blocks Editor
Overview:
Let your imagination loose and create all the 3D objects you can think of with BLOCKS.

With the ONLINE SHARING feature, you can download all the community creations, and even destroy them with the BAZOOKA.

Name: Blocky
Overview:
Blocky is an addictive 2D arcade style game with an RPG style reward system. Easy to learn with simple game mechanics. As you perform well, you are rewarded with unlocks and currency to buy additional items.

The game has two game modes: Retro mode, only one life and try last as long as you can. Waves, a selection of levels with different goals.

An easy to play addictive game!

Name: Bloom*Block
Overview: Let's bloom flower with Popo! This is a greening 3d puzzle. Rules are simple. The game is cleared if flowers can blossom in the faces of all blocks. It is a failure when stepping on the same face twice. When it is a little action frequency, it is a high score. Let's play Bloom*Block!

Name: Bloop!
Overview:
Brave barrages of colored 'Bloops' and treacherous flying pebbles to defeat your friends in this exciting action-puzzle game.

Match Bloops on the opposing 'rock' and conquer your opponent's den. Experience match three mechanics combined with classic combat gameplay in a head to head experience that’s familiar - yet unlike anything you’ve played before.

Name: Blow Me Up
Overview: Proof that dynamite is the solution to all the world's toughest problems.

Name: Blue Beacon
Overview: Save your land by collecting the 3 discs of power. Stomp, crush, and plow through the insect menace to save your land. To destroy them, you must become them...via cool bug suits like the Beetle Suit, Grasshopper Suit, and Butterfly Suit.

Name: Blowball's Adventures
Overview:
Help Blowball to save the world by stopping the evil rose and its allies in this funny Shoot 'Em Up for kids and adults.

Enjoy four different levels, tricky enemies, unique art style and impulsive music!

Name: BluePrint Racer: The Next Generation
Overview: BluePrint Racer: The Next Generation is a time-based driving game in which the player navigates a car from the behind view. The gameplay takes place on a minimalistic blue, flat surface that contains only two elements: blocks that obstruct the player's view and gas cans that must be collected. Each level challenges the player to gather all gas cans before the time runs out.

Name: BlurBall
Overview:
Blazing Forge Games puts a hardcore spin on retro paddle ball games with BlurBall - a highly competitive multiplayer game with 7 levels, up to 16 balls, and 24 paddles on a single match!

Play head to head with a friend or on a team with over 100+ unique paddles to choose from.

Name: Bluebones Curse
Overview: Arr! What a horrible night to have a curse. Can Bluebones find the lost gold of Davy Jones to break the curse and return to his true form? He only has until midnight, and the clock is ticking!

Name: Bloc
Overview: Bloc is a new twist on the top-down shooter. Destroy blocks by firing like-colored orbs while dodging a swarm of enemies.

Name: Pi
Overview: Learn the first 1000 digits of pi, take the 1000 digit challenge, or play a game of "repeat after me".

Name: H.i.v.e.
Overview:
A board game with a difference: there is no board!

Pieces are added to the playing area, creating the board. As more are added, it becomes a fight to capture the opposing Queen Bee first!

Name: Hive
Overview: Simple RTS where the goal is to destroy the other hives of robotic beetles by spawning a hive of your own. Witness the hive mind as each beetle relays messages through the colony to accomplish your goals. One of five DreamBuildPlay 2008: Silicon Minds Warm Up Challenge winners.

Name: Invader
Overview: Your system has been invaded by unknown attackers, the fleet is disabled. Can you repel the intruders alone in your single fighter? Twin stick action melded with old school shooter. Multiple planets and levels of of gameplay.

Name: Zoom
Overview: From the creators of "Rumble Massage": Brave the memorizing world of ZOOM as you push the boundaries of speed. Race through a mind numbing 3D landscape in 5 unique hoverships to gauge just how much speed you can handle.

Name: Nasty
Overview: The world is under siege by evil forces. It is up to you alone or teamed with a partner to save humanity in this fast-pasted, action/platform shooting extravaganza. Do you have what it takes to complete 100 levels of non-stop excitement and prove that good can triumph over evil? And when you're done saving the world, relax with up to 4 players in all-out battle mode for galactic bragging rights.

Name: Venture
Overview:
Thrown into five epochs of human art of warfare you have to proof your skills in tactics and leadership.

An advisor will assist the strategically underdogs, whether battling for the caves in Stone Age, conquering castles in the Middle Ages, protecting trade routes against Pirates, defending villages in World War 2 or reaching for the stars in outer space.

Name: Chains
Overview: Chains is a small puzzle game that is a sort of mix between Hexic and Tetris. Gameplay involves forming chains of colored blocks for points. The player must fight against the timer blocks; when one expires, a new line of blocks will fall, preventing a level up. The player can use special blocks such as Multiplier Blocks, Add Time Blocks, Bomb Blocks, Shuffle Blocks, and Lock Blocks.

Name: Olu
