Overview: Dive into this rhythm-based rail shooter and track down an artificial being born in an isolated network. As the music drives you and you will drive it. Feel the pulse as every action is represented through rhythm, visuals, and rumble feedback. Straddle the analog and digital worlds to prevent the artificial life-form from gaining control.

Name: Balls
Overview: Philip Muwanga proudly presents: Balls, a comprehensive bar room pool simulator for Xbox Live Indie games. Bring your avatar down to Phils fruit & Juice bar and take on all comers in games of eight ball or nine ball. Customise the games setting to match your local pool rules then challenge the world over Xbox live. Also includes Grunt Assault, and demos of HexyTrench & Extreme Jigsaw Madness

Name: Rift
Overview: A top-down shooter with a time-stopping twist. Use your time powers to escape sticky situations and rack up a huge score multiplier.

Name: Nega
Overview: Place markers on the playfield to lead the ball towards the target, but watch out, since every marker you place will turn into a deadly obstacle!

Name: Bobbin's Quest
Overview: Join Bobbin the apple in his quest to defend his homeland against banana and orange invaders. As you battle across Starfruit Island, the real menace is revealed! Along the way, make sure to save your buddy apples! Bobbin's Quest features six vivid levels, and a comic book story line to follow. In each level there is a unique mini-game. Replay Bobbin's Quest to achieve the highest score!

Name: Board Games Live
Overview: Create your own board games and try them out with your friends online. Both new pieces and boards can be built using a simple block builder tool, like in Lootfest. There are no movement restrictions, like in real boardgames, making the editor free from scripting. Comes with 16 classic games, that can be both modified and played.

Name: Boarders Beyond Borders
Overview: Boarders Beyond Borders - SnowBoard on several challenging levels.

Name: Bobby Says: Dance with Me!
Overview: Bobby says - dance with me! Repeat after Bobby and train your memory while having loads of fun. Challenge friends and family while playing up to four players. Fun for all ages!

Name: Bomb Disposal Expert
Overview: You are a Bomb Disposal Expert in training. Hold your nerve while you exercise your memory and rhythm, following the light sequences. Hurry up or the bomb will explode! Play with up to eight friends (only one pad needed) in a crazy multiplayer mode. And if you start to think it's easy to defuse a bomb, try the special modes: mirror, clockwise and counterclockwise... and think again!!

Name: Bobby
Overview: "... like an out-of-this-world mashup of billiards and Lunar Lander ..." - iFanzineBobby the Bullet Dude is on a mission to defend the planet from the Evil Green Ball Guys in this pick and and play arcade bouncer. But don't let the simple mechanics fool you, there's nothing easy about beating this game. Make your way through 65 distinct stages with 10 Game Center achievements and you and Bobby will be part of the elite few who can claim victory over the bouncing menaces.The gameplay features the player playing as Bobby, a rocket powered, robotic bullet. The goal of the game is to find a green portal to take you to the next dimension. Green portals are normally unlocked by knocking all of the bouncing balls into the red "black hole" portals, though some levels are mazes with already unlocked portals. Various game elements exist to make your job of knocking balls into portals and navigating more fun and challenging!iPhone/iPod Touch 4 highly recommended for this game due to the retina display graphics.- Supports Joypad for using an iPod Touch or iPhone as a gamepad!- Supports 60beat GamePad on iPad/iPad2, iPhone 3GS/4/4S, and iPod Touch 4 and up- Retina display graphics- 65 crazy levels- 10 Game Center achievements- Cool music, or listen to your iPod- Slick graphics and animation- Learn good strategy- 3 star rewards system- Un-lockable character- 14 different game objects and obstacles

Name: Bomber
Overview: Bomber is an arcade-style 2D shooter. Shoot down airballoons with your tank and collect the goods to increase your rank! The game features 12 single-player levels and 4 unlockable challenges.

Name: BomBomEngine
Overview:
Strongest futuristic racing game"BomBomEngine". Get a licence and participate in a race.

The aim is a champion. Furthermore the aim is king of the BomBomEngine.

Name: Bombies
Overview: Zombie defence with a twist, see how many waves of bombies you can survive in this multiplayer shooter.

Name: BombLocker
Overview: BombLocker is a puzzle game inspired by Minesweeper, but with several improvements. Use reason, clues and hints to locate and lock bombs hidden within a field of hexagons. Each level is random, but difficulty increases as you progress. If you like sweeping mines, you will love locking bombs.

Name: Bombs Away
Overview:
Can you save the city from a not so friendly green Alien named Iggy? He loves to drop bombs off the tops of buildings. You must catch these bombs before they hit the ground. If you miss, they explode and you die.

You will receive power ups along the way. You will have to deal with explosive bombs, smoke bombs, duds and changing weather conditions.

Also included are day and night time levels!

Name: A Bomb's Way
Overview: A Bomb's Way is a 2D platformer that puts the player in the role of a bomb whose fuse has been lit. It is up to the player to guide the bomb around each of the levels by jumping between platforms and tilting the level in order to collect clocks and extend his fuse before it gets the chance to detonate. There are also enemies in your way hindering the bomb's search for clocks.

Name: Bomber Boing
Overview: Sign up to Bomber Boing championship, where strange creatures fight with no mercy for victory. Destroy the floor to finish with your rivals through its 30 scenarios with many different conditions. Ideal for playing with family, friends, or anyone with its online mode for Xbox Live!. Amazing music for an atypical and very funny game. Ready...GO!

Name: Bomb Those Wheelers
Overview: Use the alien bomb squad to stop the blue wheelers from reaching the mothership.

Name: The Book of Biblets: Part 1
Overview: Help your children learn important Biblical stories with the colorfully-illustrated Book of Biblets, the first game of a seven game series. Part 1- The Creation contains seven Old Testament stories, along with narration, story-related games, and trivia questions to test your knowledge.

Name: BoneD: Dead Men Don't Jump
Overview: The WORLD's #1 undead parkour racing simulator for your Xbox 360. Featuring funky fresh visuals, rockin' beats, and copious amounts of innuendo, this quirky new twist on a video gaming favourite is the full 'package'. Get BoneD or get lost!

Name: Bonded Realities
Overview: Enjoy an unpredictable, wacky adventure in this turn-based RPG! Crisp graphics, quality music, hilarious dialogue and ridiculous enemies are some of the things that await you in a title that brings the classic gameplay of 8- and 16-bit RPGs into an updated look and feel!

Name: Boom Chick Chick
Overview: Use a series of satisfying weapons to annihilate hordes of monsters in this unique "single stick" shooter. Experience 4 levels of difficulty, up to 4 player coop, local highscores, and a killer soundtrack courtesy of Razorback Records. "Boom Chick Chick", it's music to my ears.

Name: Boogeyman
Overview: Sleep tight.

Name: Boot Hill Heroes
Overview:
Boot Hill Heroes is the first episode in a game series that fuses elements of spaghetti western film - gunslinging outlaws, brave lawmen, and the untamed wilderness - with classic RPG storyline and gameplay. 90s console RPGs like Final Fantasy, Earthbound and Chrono Trigger created lasting memories and impacted us as gamers. Now, Boot Hill Heroes brings back those experiences while revitalizing the genre with a Wild West spin and innovative new gameplay elements.

It's an experimental combination of old and new ideas intended to bring a new and unique experience to modern gamers and old-school fans alike. It's an epic Wild West adventure packed with excitement, intrigue and a dose of humor.

Name: Boom Kikker
Overview:
Boom Kikker is an addictive puzzle game!

Boom Kikker is Afrikaans for tree frog and an amazing assortment of these colorful frogs need your help returning to their pond. Place your frog tiles correctly to clear the board and win the game.

Sounds easy, right? Not so fast! 25 levels of frog mayhem will challenge even the brainiest puzzle aficionado.

Name: Boopa Zap
Overview: Join Eekeemoo as he and Boopa Blast their way through the subterranean caverns of the mysterious dark planet!

Name: Bop N' Pop!
Overview: One of the most addictive puzzle games on the net is now available for your Xbox 360. This award-winning game offers three different modes of play and hours of addictive fun! Play alone, battle the computer, or compete with friends in Party Mode!

Name: Border Wars
Overview: Border Wars is an imaginative side-scrolling 2D Space Shooter that lets you battle through the margins of your notebook. Draw your own ship from scratch or with pre-made parts and fly it in the game. Kill enemies to earn points that can be used to purchase upgrades and customize your experience. Fight your way through 16 levels of various enemies and bosses, all to a rocking custom sound track.

Name: Bot Stoppers
Overview: Grab hold of this robot-zombie bashing brawler and lay waste to all who stand in your way!

Name: BounceCrazy
Overview: The original BounceCrazy! Ball bouncing fun for children of all ages. Six balls on each side of the field. Try to get your balls into your opponent's goal while preventing balls from the other side from entering yours. Simple to play. Loads of fun. Play against a friend or play against the robot hand. Great for kids or adults.

Name: Bouken Ou Kyuu Juu Kyuu Hyaku
Overview: Bouken Ou Kyuu Juu Kyuu Hyaku is an Adventure game, developed and published by Seama Rooky, which was released in 2012.

Name: Bounce!
Overview: It's Bounce! Hit those creatures with your ball. Bounce your ball off of the wall! Try to beat that last high score, and win the game forever more!

Name: Border Dash
Overview:
Chuy just can't seem to get it right. He's tried everything to get back to his family. Can you guide him back and help him to avoid the immigration and DEA agents?

Guide Chuy through an infinite number of routes back to the border. Gather tacos to summon the Witch, the Goat Sucker and the Boogie Man to scare away and terrorize the immigration agents.

Name: Bored Meeting
Overview: Bored Meeting is a casual group game where deceptively simple game play quickly leads to fun and interesting situations.

Name: Boring Space Shooter
Overview: Manipulate Time to survive and earn as much points as you can in a classical spaceshooter game.

Name: Boss
Overview: Build and defend an empire.

Name: Bopscotch
Overview:
Bounce, jump, smash and munch across the colourful world of Bopscotch!

Challenge ninety fiendish levels solo in adventure mode, or take on a friend in head-to-head race mode!

Name: Hopper
Overview: Play as a Hopper who is a grasshopper trying to get to the top of a tree. Jump on the leaves to get higher and watch out for falling apples.

Name: Hangman
Overview: You've played Hangman before... but you're tired of always waiting for your friend to come up with a word, or waiting for them to remember how to spell it when you guess a letter. Well, these problems are GONE with Super Awesome Hangman Deluxe. Enjoy Hangman with no fuss, no muss! Now with unlockable trophies! Wow!

Name: Blox
Overview:
Try as fast as possible to clean up the playfield, earn bonus time with speed combinations and discover all special items.

Fast endless Levels with special items and great graphics!

Name: Dead Sea
Overview:
A girl lost in the ocean infested by sharks. Will you be able to make her survive, swimming without drawing attention of sharks?

You will face a new breed of sharks more deadly than the great white shark, which leaves behind a trail of death and blood.

Name: Bouncing Avatars
Overview: Trapped in a bubble you can only bounce and climb up. Your goal is to rise as high as you can while avoiding dangerous objects, insidious platforms and much more. Play alone for the record or against your friends in a funny multiplayer match!

Name: Bowling X
Overview: A realistic physics simulated bowling game with charming graphics, immersive controls and supportive sound effects. Multiplayer mode supports up to 8 players.

Name: Br00t4l Qwest
Overview:
You take the role as an alien cowboy or a gigantic mutated brain as you fight your way through an onslaught of enemies, alone or with a friend, in this br00t4l top-down multidirectional shooter.

Awarded for "best execution" at Swedish Game Awards 2010, it features two full episodes as well as an intense survival mode, all playable either by yourself or with a friend in co-op mode.

Name: Br8kIn' Chalkboard Edition
Overview:
Br8kIn'; pronounced (Break In) is a remake of a classic console hit. This new version has been created using the HuskySoft engine with a progressive design. Gone are the simple blocks of yesterday, and your "paddle" is now as dynamic as the levels that you are using it in.

Enjoy!

Name: Boxed In
Overview:
Play in 3D! Travel through distinct environments fighting intense bosses and mobs. Learn unique and creative skills to help you in your quest to save an endangered village.

You can go in alone or team up with friends in up to 4 player cooperative play!

Name: Brain Jump
Overview:
Jump start your brain! Exercise your math, words and puzzle skills across 11 different games.

Give your thumbs a rest and give your brain a workout by playing this game.

Name: Brain Jump 2
Overview: Jump start your brain! 10 challenging games including Sudoku, anagrams, odd one out, general knowledge and money.

Name: Brain Jump 3
Overview:
Test your knowledge in this time-based quiz game, with thousands of questions spread over 18 categories and three difficulty levels.

Give your thumbs a rest and jump start your brain!

Name: Brain of Bob
Overview: Welcome into the Brain of Bob! Delve into Bob's world and help him on his quest to regain his sanity...all the while traversing your way through a mind bending version of reality. It's time to prove you have what it takes to conquer all 30 LEVELS that await you!

Name: bricks4ever
Overview: bricks4ever is a Breakout variant. The classic game mode is the closest to the usual mechanics: The player controls a paddle which is confined to the bottom of the screen and can move left or right. it is used to bounce a ball towards the blocks positioned all over the playing area. The goal is to destroy all blocks by hitting them with the ball - but failing to reach it with the paddle and letting it fall down the screen causes the loss of a life. Sometimes destroyed blocks leave behind power-ups which can be collected for beneficial temporary effects, e.g. the ball is glued to the paddle instead of bouncing off directly or the paddle becomes bigger. There are overall 50 levels and three additional playing modes: Zen (blocks move automatically downwards and the goal is to destroy as many of them as possible before the end is reached), 4ever (an endless mode) and bipolar (the player controls two paddles simultaneously with the two analogue sticks).

Name: Brethren of the Coast
Overview: Realtime Strategy set during the Golden Age of Piracy with a unique control system built for the xbox controller. Use wind, terrain and different ship types to out manouver your enemies. Presented in 3D, moveable camera to get close in or take a long distance view. Multiple locations, times of day and weather conditions.

Name: Brain Party
Overview:
Looking for a great way to keep your brain in shape? Brain Party is a puzzle-solving, brain-stretching game that comes with over 30 minigames designed to push your brain to its limits, testing memory, logic, mathematics, reactions and more.

Brain Party is split into two main modes: test mode gives you five random games to measure your general brain power, whereas practise mode lets you play your favourite games as often as you want.

As you play, more minigames are unlocked and Brain Party automatically tracks your test results so you can monitor your progress over time. If you do really well, you can unlock secret games and a whole new game mode designed to keep you playing and enjoying your favourite games even longer.

All the games in Brain Party are family safe and fun for all ages - here's the full list: Balloon Blaster, Bomb Hunt, BP Says, Bubble Trouble, Card Match, Connex, Dice Off, Flash Counting, Flashlight, IQ Test, Jewel Flip, Jewel Jam, Marble Drop, Memoryblox, Memory Box, Memory Maths, Mine Sweep, Moon Jump, Number Snake, Odd One Out, Perfect Paths, Route Finder, Rock Paper Scissors, Scrambled!, Set Finder, Sharpshooter, Short Sudoku, Shuffle Puzzler, Symbolic Logic, Teeter Totter, Under the Hat, Untangler and Word Smash.

Where else can you get so many games for such a low price? Brain Party lets you train your brain and have fun at the same time!

Name: Brand
Overview: In this challenging 2D action platformer, the goal is to increase a sword's power by completing quests for the Smith, the Chemist and the Mage. There are many powers to explore, and some of them combine together to create new hidden abilities. You can only increase your weapon a set amount of times before putting it to the test, so choose your upgrades wisely!

Name: Break In
Overview: It was supposed to be a simple arcade game, but something has broken down the barriers between game worlds. Can you resolve the mystery in this revealing Breakout-style game with a twist?

Name: Break Limit
Overview: Prepare to go mind-numbingly fast as you Blast, Smash and Break Limit through every one and thing in your way! Powerful weapons that get stronger as you play, will help to power a ship that becomes an invincible wrecking ball while accelerating. Alpha Centauri will never be the same! Featuring online scoreboards for Gold subscribers, and local scoreboards to prove youre better than your siblings!

Name: Breeze
Overview: Breeze puts you in control of the wind as you gently blow a flower towards the goal. Master both tilt and touch controls to guide the flower across 60 seasonal themed levels while listening to Breeze's smooth, relaxing soundtrack. Add to your Xbox LIVE account's gamerscore by earning achievements. Breeze is light entertainment for all ages.

Name: Bricks
Overview: Classic breakout style game

Name: BrainBox360: Physics Edition
Overview: BrainBox360 (Physics Edition) is an Avatar Quiz for brainiacs and anyone trying to boost their brainpower. Scene It Pad compatible! You use it as a revision tool or just a bit of fun for the whole family. You'll be surprised just how much physics you already know and you'll definitely learn some along the way!

Name: Bridge Physics
Overview: Avoid catastrophe by building bridges across dangerous chasms and rivers. Employ engineering skills to defeat the ever-present threat of physics!

Name: Bubble Buster 360
Overview: Bubble Buster 360 is a re-imagining of a classic game mechanic. Protect your bubble cannon by popping surrounding bubbles before they get too close. With many levels of difficulty, from extremely easy to insanely difficult, over 60 levels, puzzle, endless, and time-attack modes, Bubble Buster 360 offers fun for the entire family!

Name: Bug Ball
Overview:
Bug Ball is a competitive volley ball style game for up to 4 Players on a single Xbox 360 or over Xbox Live!

Choose from a variety of adorable bugs, each with their own beautiful 3D arena. Jump, Spike, Dash and Super Spike your way to victory!

Who's the best Bug Ball player in the forest? It's time to find out!

Name: Brixx
Overview: Brixx is a traditional board game in a new exciting outfit. Aim of the game is to get more stones of your kind than your opponent. Both players move one after another. If it's your turn, you have to place an own stone on an empty field next to an opponent's stone so that this stone or a row of stones is between your stones. The game is over if no one can place a stone.

Name: Build 'n Bump
Overview:
Build 'n Bump is a local multiplayer, 2D head-stomping brawler where you build your own levels right before you play on them!

Inspired by the classic DOS game Jump 'n Bump, Build 'n Bump retains all of the same head-stomping, multiplayer fun with a twist. You can build your own levels right before you play on them!

Name: Bullet Trap
Overview: Movement is restricted but weaponry is not. Bounce bullets off walls and use your shield to deflect incoming projectiles, but be warned, every bullet that you fire could bounce around and kill you. This is Bullet Trap. Take on 50 levels yourself or try working co-operatively with a friend. Try not to kill yourself, or each other, unless your playing one of the 12 Vs arena's of course.

Name: Brittle
Overview:
Brittle is a puzzle game about gaining points by moving across a map while avoiding dangers.

1-hit-kill enemies and a crumbling level stands between you and finishing each map.

Name: Broken Pearl
Overview:
Long ago we settled down on this planet, the three of us. We each formed our own country, as we always do, and we always named them after ourselves.

The minerals of this particular planet had a different structure than what we were used to. It was more powerful and had an extra shine to them, we called them Pearls.

Our offspring all had this shimmering with a slightly different hue resembling the natural form of each of us. We'd never been so complete or happy before.

But then, one day one of us attacked the others.

Fly something resembling a space ship and defend yourself from the opposing forces and destroy air and land based creatures. A retro shooter as it was made in the 80s.

Name: Bubble Buster
Overview: Bubble Buster is an addictive bubble breaker style game. Slide bubbles along the horizontal and vertical axis to get groups of the same color and make them explode. This game includes three different game modes (Level Mode, Time Trial and Biggest Bust) and includes a highscore table for each mode along with six awards to be earned throughout the game.

Name: BugO StinkO
Overview: Battle your enemies with your farts. Eat food to fill your gas meter. Eat the kettle of beans for a "Silent But Deadly" that will kill any enemy. Fart near an open flame for an explosive kill. Find lighters to ignite your farts for a fiery jetting flame. Spit to distract enemies. Spit on flowers to grow them to reach higher platforms. 32 levels & 13 enemies!

Name: Bumblicity
Overview:
Bumblicity: It's a frantic head-to-head word game! Utilizing an army of bees, you must drop the letter tiles to spell words, chain combos and get as many points as you can!

Play against a friend or any of the CPU's 4 difficulty levels. Think fast and you'll never be at a loss for words!

Name: Burn1420
Overview: Multi directional, level pattern, strategy shooter. Campaign and Practice modes. Global high scores.

Name: Bureau: Kendall Rising
Overview:
Crime solving game like no other. You are Agent Kendall. Hurled into the gritty world of arson, murderer and an anti-extremist extremist.

Original music score, full voice acting, cut scenes, multiple endings and crime scenes to explore.

Name: Bureau- Shattered Slipper
Overview:
This action packed sequel to Bureau - Agent Kendall, stars a sexy FBI agent with special talents. The visually stimulating crime solving continues with enhanced puzzles and mind-bending clues.

Picking up from the last episode, Agent Kendall has become a rising star in the Bureau. She is confident and bold. The game now offers a new way to solve crimes and an improved smart phone.

Name: Brimstone- An Action RPG
Overview:
Brimstone is a top-down, Hack'n'Slash Role Playing Game for up to 8 players.

Procedurally generated dungeons, a huge variety of monsters and endless variations of loot ensure that no two sessions will ever be the same!

Name: Bub Block
Overview:
A fast-paced multiplayer party game with blocks, spinning blades, and ghosts. Oh my!

Dodge the spinning blades while trying to trap your opponents with blocks! Each round is fully customizable, from how fast the blades move to how many blocks you can carry to the ability to turn into a ghost and seek revenge after you die.

Name: Bubble Booster
Overview:
Burst the bubbles by connecting at least three of the same type. Earn bonuses for speed and breaking off chunks of other bubbles.

Work your way through the many levels and climb the online high score tables.

Name: Bulbs
Overview:
Blaze the trail to the future! Fight for survival and aim for the role of God, The Filament!

Up to four clansmen, Gunslinger, Mage, Bomber and Hero! Kill your opponent for total domination! Disarray on the battlefield is no problem for a true God!

Can the world of Tungsten be yours?

Name: BULKHEAD Survival
Overview:
BULKHEAD Survival is an action packed survival FPS for single player and multiplayer online co-op.

How long can you survive against the increasingly skilled AI opponents?

Name: bumblepig
Overview: A color-matching twist on the classic top-down scrolling shooter. Help bumblepig pollinate flowers and earn money to buy himself some fancy new clothes. Master the perfect lines through each level to earn top scores and unlock rewards.

Name: Bungee Ferret Tossing
Overview: In this unique, action-packed experience, defeat the terrorists and storm their desert base using the most advanced Ferret Weapons Technology...all while swinging from a helicopter in style!

Name: The Bunny Game
Overview: Just for kids...an easy to play game with narration, so your children can have fun playing on their own. Easy to follow directions for one or two players. A game that will sure to be played over and over again as they race around the board to get their bunny to the carrot patch first!

Name: Bug Off
Overview:
Can you stop the bugs? Zap them, spray them and explode them through 30+ levels of bug-filled mayhem!

How long can you last?

Name: Bulkhead
Overview:
Board a derelict space station to salvage a lost alien artifact. Unknown dangers await you in this atmospheric first person shooter.

Features LIVE multiplayer and singleplayer.

Name: Bumper Knights
Overview:
Bumper Knights is fast-paced, action-brimming, trajectory-flinging fun!

Bounce your way through procedurally generated forests, villages, and castles to save the land from the forces of greed. Collect rare and powerful weapons in your favorite replayable quests. And most importantly, meet the infamously impressive band of Bumper Knights- Spring, Pierce, Appel, and Thud. Together we will win!

Name: Bunker Buster
Overview:
From the makers of Platformance: Castle Pain comes a game about:
Bombs and bombers, skills and rankings, babes and bunkers: BUNKER BUSTER!
Blast your way through 32 levels of destruction madness.
Put your piloting skills to the test with planes, helicopters and missile launcher mounted jetpacks that cut through rocks like butter.
r Features:

- Destructible landscape
- Simple controls
- 6 different aircrafts with their own physics
- Local scoreboard
- Comic book style graphics
- A story with twists and turns
- Unlock missions as you go
- Destroy targets but avoid hostages
- Save your mission at any time
- Collect Rewards but avoid Flopwards!

Name: Bug Zapper
Overview:
Go big or buzz home!

Bug Zapper is the adventure of Skeeter, the mosquito, as he defends his fellow bugs from the unstoppable lure of the Bug Zapper.

Punch and throw Bugs to their safety with up to 4 local players! Upgrade your Bug with special abilities, speed and strength to stop every bug from getting Zapped!

Name: BugRace
Overview: BugRace is a 1 to 4 player multiplication practice game. Playing like a board game, the object is to answer multiplication problems correctly so you can spin the wheel and advance around the board. Careful, if your unlucky ant lands on a red stone, an unfortunate accident will occur as a fully rendered animation, causing the player to miss a turn. How well do you know your multiplication tables?

Name: Bureau- Agent Kendall
Overview:
As Agent Kendall, you have been reassigned to work on a special crimes team. Things will never be the same again.

Welcome to a new type of adventure / story game.

Name: Bytown Lumberjack
Overview: Take the role of an angry and violent woodsman on a journey to take back what's his. Slash and carve your way through a bloody forest of ravenous creatures to track down the fabled Stag! Invite your friends along in this violently gory forest adventure. Team up against wolves, hunters and bears and fight your way to victory.

Name: Bust a Wall
Overview: Explosive & relentless old skool arcade action where the object of the game is simple: use your paddle to hit and deflect the ball around the angles to destroy all coloured bricks, progressing through each stage while attempting to get the highest score you can. Scores are then shared with the community to see who comes top! The game features 3 themes and over 30 levels of non stop action.

Name: Burger Jack
Overview: Are you ready for a rush hour frenzy at the local diner? Burger Jack is a fast-paced, casual arcade game suitable for all ages. Serve customers as fast as you can, and help the teenage boy, Jack, earn money to buy the gadget hes been dreaming about.

Name: Burning Fist of Rage
Overview: Experience violence, political corruption and heroism. Where the actions you make, affect the outcome, but mostly you walk right and beat people up! + Play 2 player Co-op and use the buddy move to devastate the enemy. + Multiple endings. + Knock opponents into the air and keep them bouncing. + Save the city from the forces of evil.

Name: Burning Rubber
Overview:
Burning Rubber is a fast paced retro racing game where the player must fight the other drivers while trying to come 1st place.

The game includes 24 different race tracks over 3 difficulty modes, a mix of different weapons and upgrades to buy for your car and random encounters where the player can either win or lose money.

Name: Button Holding Extravaganza Party!
Overview: The ultimate game of deception, quick reflexes and luck is here: ButtonHoldingExtravaganzaParty! This multiplayer game for 2 to 4 players will test your skills at deceiving your friends and holding buttons.

Name: Button Memory
Overview: Memorize the the sequence of buttons and repeat it in an ever growing chain. Get it wrong and get a surprise. With 4 different play modes from Easy to Extreme(with only Easy available until purchase), Button Memory can appeal to anyone. So who can go the longest?! Is it you?

Name: Buttons
Overview: The computers randomly generated button press sequence and level up. Have your Avatar cheer you on. Strap on your virtual blindfold and try your luck with the dreaded blackout mode. Do your best and unlock challenges from the main game and follow your progress by checking out the stats menu. Become a Buttons top 100 champion!

Name: Bush Hunt
Overview: Play as a safari hunter re-capturing animals that have escaped from RidKim Zoo. Play over 20 levels across 4 different terrains capturing some of the most dangerous and unusual animals. Try survivor mode to see just how long you can survive against a never ending barrage of animals.

Name: C.L.E.S. Party
Overview: Futuristic sport game, where players battle it out into several arenas, collecting power-ups and pushing the ball into the opponent's goal.

Name: Calculator360
Overview: Calculator360 is a powerful calculator with a wide range of math operations. Unlimited calculations are now at your fingertipsand on your TV. Calculating has never been easier!

Name: Call Me
Overview: "Call Me" teaches you to read and adapt to different personalities. Using simulated conversation, "Call Me" will also give you a snapshot of your own personality.

Name: Call Me Skyfish
Overview: Skyfish is an angry orange fish who must bubble-shoot and tongue-swing his way through this humorous and silly platform adventure. He now faces his greatest enemies like his ex-girlfriend, floating heads, tsunamis, screaming cats, and a radioactive stick-figure hedgehog!! Laid back silly fun is here!

Name: Can You Handle 2 At Once?
Overview: So you think you're pretty good don't you? Got used to 1 game at a time, but can you handle 2 at once? Do you have the speed, dexterity, and focus for that kind of a challenge? Only one way to find out...

Name: Candies vs Hypnodeer
Overview:
Definitely the sweetest game you'll have ever played!

'Candies VS Hypnodeer' is about building a kingdom out of candy, in a world made entirely of... candy!

Match-3 game with a fresh twist on the genre. Quality artwork and engaging gameplay combined form the game, together with not-so-bad Hypnodeer characters who make the title more complex.

Grab the game now and start building your own candy empire. 8 different types of buildings, 2 special items and 2 types of Hypnodeer.

Make yourself a pleasure of getting hypnotized in 'Candies VS Hypnodeer' and beat your friends high-scores on-line!

Name: Carcophony
Overview: Carcophony is the NEW, FREE puzzler, featuring classic frantic and strategic gameplay designed for today’s touch and swipe controls, which combine to produce a satisfying feeling of (traffic) flow.There’s panic on the streets again. But don’t just wonder to yourself. Bring order to the traffic chaos in this addictively fun and increasingly challenging traffic management game.SURVIVAL MODE•How long can you keep the traffic moving?•Create optimal traffic flows on 5 tactically-different road network layouts.•Deal with increasingly difficult waves of incoming cars.•Score big with non-stop colour streaks, ambulance bonuses and other added surprises.CHALLENGE MODE•Can you clear the traffic jam in time?•64 increasingly difficult bite-sized puzzles (with many more to follow shortly)•Featuring number-of-moves based puzzles, time based puzzles, and both! •Replay to direct traffic differently for a more optimal result. Every second/tap counts.KEY FEATURES •Mind-bending multi-tasking gameplay – control multiple junctions to keep traffic flowing.•Earn power-ups and upgrades to turbo boost your cars or remove pesky obstacles.•Unlock new, unique car designs including trucks and tanks.•Dynamic in-game online leaderboards and achievements.•A uniquely English feel through the UK’s road signage and automotive pioneers high-scorers.PRESS•"carcophony is one of those games that you just have to put your hands on your hips, pull up your zip and say, Wow - that's absolute genius", Robert Florence.

Name: Car Washer: Summer of the Ninja
Overview:
Summer break, a time to relax and have fun. But what's the difference between a good summer and a great summer? Spending money, of course! And what better way to earn some extra cash than a car wash? Unfortunately, the local branch of Ninja Car Washing Corp. is right across the street and they don't appreciate the competition...

Wash cars quickly to keep your customers happy and keep the money coming in. But beware! Those pesky ninja will do everything they can to run you out of business. You'll need to use your wits, reflexes, and collection of basic car washing tools to defend against their attacks while keeping your customers happy.

Name: Cassie's Christmas Magic
Overview: Cassie shares a few reflections on life. Also includes many soothing winter themes.

Name: Cars Shooting at ALIENS
Overview: Made by kids....... to challenge grown ups!

Name: Cassie's Animal Sounds
Overview: It's bad enough she doesn't even know what some of the animals are, but a few of them don't even exist! ...or do they?

Name: Card Creator Xmas
Overview:
Create your own unique Xmas / New Year Cards! Send them to friends/family with and without Xbox. Your friends don't need to purchase the App to view your cards!

Fun and easy - Try now!

Name: CarneyVale: Showtime
Overview: Become history's greatest circus acrobat in the enchanted land of CarneyVale! Perform aerial displays of flawless flings, death-defying stunts and fantastic flips with ragdoll physics action as Slinky the puppet in a show that will captivate your audience.

Name: Case o' Games
Overview:
A collection of six full-length, high-quality games from genres such as action, puzzle, tower defense, platformer, and many more.

This was created by over 20 developers, and 100% of the profits from this game will go to benefit the Child's Play charity.

Name: Capture the Oong
Overview: Capture the Oong is a space based multiplayer shooter. The object is to capture the oong and return it to your base. The evil rongs however don't like invaders in their space and will do anything to destroy you.

Name: Caroline's Important LifeDiary
Overview:
Experience life in Caroline's shoes.

This is a short game with multiple possible endings. You'll get to decide what was in her Diary. And was she cool or not?

Name: Carrum
Overview: The Grandfather of Pool comes to XBox 360! Play the classic game of Carrum against your Xbox or up to 4 friends, including on XBox LIVE! Win games and score with style to gain bonus game tables and items.

Name: Canno-Blast
Overview: Get ready to blast your friends away in a frenzy of colorful action! Attack, defend, and just shoot your way to victory. Paint the spiked ball with your color to keep you safe, but don't let it touch your power cell when it's a different color. Earn points to unlock upgrades and powerups and make the matches more fun!

Name: CannonBotGo
Overview: One Robot vs. an Alien Invasion -- in this puzzle game with an action edge. Time your moves just right and release a symphony of fire and destruction.

Name: Canyon Viaduct
Overview:
As the Chief of the Canyon Project, rescue the civilians from zombies and help them by building a bridge across the Canyon.

The Canyon Viaduct demands challenging assignments in three different modes - Normal, Expert and Killer.

Can you take up this job?

Name: Candy, Please!
Overview:
Ahh, Halloween - a time to dress up, carve pumpkins and amass glorious amounts of candy!

In order to collect enough candy, once around the neighborhood just won't do - you are going to need several different costumes to pull it off. Let nothing stop you from getting your fair share - and more!

- Classic adventure game fun.
- Explore a lighthearted, interactive world and solve puzzles.
- Search your house and the neighborhood for what you need to make costumes.
- Carve your own pumpkin.
- Go trick-or-treating and collect that sweet, sweet candy.

Name: Catch Me If You Can
Overview:
Classic Maze Chase Game with a Twist!

Play a cat-and-mouse game as you race against time to collect all the castle’s treasures.

GAMEPLAY

- Play as both Thief and Guards! Switch when the Thief is caught!
- Use each character’s special ability to gain the upper hand.
- No time to lose! Remember, only the Thief can collect treasures.
- Challenge mode: catch all thieves!

GET FREE NEW CONTENT

Join the community and send your treasures to the Band of Thieves’ Vault to unlock new levels and contents. The more you play, the more you get!

UNLOCKABLE FEATURES: 500 000 gold

- New Guard Challenge
- Leaderboard

Name: Cassie's Corner
Overview: Welcome to Cassie's Corner.

Name: CastleMiner Warfare
Overview:
CastleMiner Warfare is a competitive FPS with modern day firearms. It takes place on block based maps that are completely build-able and destructible. While playing you can freely switch between build mode and fight mode allowing you to build fortifications in the heat of battle.

In addition there is a free build map mode where you can build your own maps, host and distribute them online.

Name: Cannon #12
Overview: Cannon #12 is a 2D shooter reminiscent of early arcade games. Defend Earth against wave after wave of the incoming fleets armed with large cannons. Arm your cannon and blast theirs out of the solar system! But be careful! There's all sorts of nasty things up there in orbit, from asteroids to space junk, to the intelligent seeker missiles of the enemy!

Name: CardArcade
Overview: CAUTION! These five arcade-style card games are dangerously addictive! Due to the 14 challenging Goals, four game modes, and worldwide in-game score competition over Xbox LIVE, downloading CardArcade may cause addiction...you have been warned! Online rankings require a LIVE Gold membership.

Name: Casino Nights
Overview: Casino Nights contains many exciting casino games, including Blackjack, Roulette, Video Poker, Slots, and more. Beat challenges to unlock trophies, and see how much you can make without breaking the bank!

Name: Captain Foraxian
Overview: The 1990 arcade classic bursts onto Xbox! Now with optional Reflex Assist, you too can dodge lasers like a pro in this seminal bullet hell shooter.

Name: Card Creator
Overview: Create your own unique Greeting Cards! Send them to friends/family with and without Xbox. Your friends don't need to purchase the App to view your cards! Fun and easy - Try now!

Name: CastleMiner Z
Overview: CastleMiner Z is an online coop survival horror game in a block based environment. Travel with your Avatar with your friends in a huge spanning and ever-changing world while defending yourself from the zombie horde. Mine the world for resources, to craft the weapons that you will need to survive. Find out why CastleMiner Z was picked as the best of 2011. Castle Miner Zombie Dragon

Name: Castle of Pixel Skulls
Overview:
In Castle Of Pixel Skulls you play as an animated skeleton that wakes up in a haunted castle. In order to escape you need to overcome challenging levels full of enemies and traps while also racing against the clock to complete the levels as fast as possible. Spikes, fireballs, lava, timed platforms...everything in this castle is trying to kill you - will you have what it takes to survive?

Play through 40 intense and difficult levels in the perfect blend of fun and challenge that was a staple on the arcade classics. Calculated movement, well timed jumps and dexterity are your keys to success!

Name: CastleMiner
Overview: You create your own world in CastleMiner. Play online with your Avatar and up to 15 of your friends. Build amazing worlds on an infinite spanning landscape with over 200 block types! Mine treasures deep underground in a labyrinth of caves, different every time you play. Build worlds, save them and share them online. Castle Miner

Name: Cataclysm!
Overview:
You are the lasting remaining Robot on Mars. The Aliens have invaded destroying everything and everyone you have ever known.

How many Aliens can you annihilate in 10 minutes before the Planet is nuked?!?

Name: Catalyst 2012
Overview: Based on the 2012 FIRST® Robotics Competition, Catalyst 2012 is a game where up to 4 players compete in a basketball-like game with 5 foot tall, 120 pound robots! To win the match you will need to strategize with your alliance partner and customize your robot to one of over 900 unique configurations!

Name: Catch A Cold
Overview:
You're in control of virus! Complete the tasks while avoiding dangerous objects such as white blood cells.

Play local or online multiplayer and race to the finish, or play one of 4 creative single player challenges.

Name: Catch22
Overview: Classic block game with stunning features: many levels, rotating screens, explosions, moving obstacles, and more! Catch all blocks before they hit the ground. - classic game with modern look & feel - simple game play - dazzling graphics - fantastic music & sound effects - high scores

Name: Cataboom
Overview: Help the Cat-professor to fight his way back to our dimension, defeating angry monsters and treacherous bosses using his explosive powers and feline agility.

Name: Castle Ninja
Overview: Help a ninja on his adventure through plains, forests, caves and mountains collecting treasure on his way to the ultimate prize at the castle!

Name: Cattle Crashers
Overview:
Take control of Mr. horse who is trying to pay for his gambling debts by selling some cattle he found.

Use dynamite to tame the wilderness and collect hay with your cattle. Get as many as you can to the end of each level to cash in as many points as possible!

Name: CatHunterPopoy
Overview: To time, a goldfish is protected from a cat.

Name: Cavemen vs. Aliens
Overview: Battle to success across the land of Gondwanaland against the demonic aliens; who have an evil desire to take over your land. With your cavemen and pterodactyls crush the aliens hopes and prevent your race from extinction in this easy to pick up and play real-time-strategy game. Fight today! Live tomorrow!

Name: Caterpillar Capers
Overview: You are a caterpillar - move around the board, collect all of your coins, and return home to finish the level. But you'll need to avoid obstacles and other caterpillars to earn a high score.

Name: CatSaber
Overview:
This is a game of a cat fighter wielding a sword of light.

Press and hold the A button, which keeps the sword of light ready for the cat. You can call up enemies by pressing the X button.

Aim for as high score as possible within the time limit.

Name: CaveIn: Miner Rescue Team
Overview: There is a collapse at the San Marino Mines! Join the Miner Rescue Team to save the trapped miners before it is too late. Explore 80 dangerous puzzle-filled levels in this addictive 3D adventure.

Name: Celebrate
Overview: Visual delights to help you celebrate Valentine's Day and Birthdays.

Name: Cell: emergence
Overview:
Against the "smart germs" of tomorrow's biowarfare, nanites will be our drone soldiers, but for how long?

Based on a 3D version of mathematician John Conway's "Game of Life," the game puts the player in a biological world that is uncannily alive.

Enter the fluid living world of Cell (built from "dynamic voxels") to witness the emergence of new life: YOU, a nanobot who shoots deadly colloids, builds defenses and supercharged weapons, deciphers enemy nanotech -- and, by design, learns.

Name: Chick Chick Chicky
Overview: Play the new co-op or single player mode as Chicky &/or Ducky in this new fantastic HD game based on an all time classic... Collect a super feather and power up to turn the tables on the enemy kitty! Become "Super Chicky" or "Angry Ducky"! Features Jump-in and Jump-out Co-op play! "Harvest Fun in Chick Chick Chicky"

Name: CEPINAS
Overview: CEPINAS is a sci-fi Space Shooter / Strategy game. Conquer planets with the "CONQ" weapon, defend them against the aggressive invanders and become the new emperor of the universe. Choose wisely your path to victory, become a unstoppable one man Army or make your conquered planets to self-defending battlestations.

Name: Cerebral Arena
Overview: Reborn again from the ashes you take control of John as he awakens for the first time in his new robotic body. He immediately realizes that there is a problem. John is stuck in a arena and must fight his way through countless numbers of foe's to earn his freedom and his new life.

Name: CheneyStar
Overview: Half-Vice President, Half Killer Space Robot, CheneyStar threatens mankind. It is up to you to stop him in this arcade classic remake featuring hybrid 2D/3D game. Can you survive his devastating attacks and relentless insults?

Name: Chain Crusher
Overview:
Enemies from a faraway galaxy have invaded our beautiful solar system! You are the only one who can repulse these invaders using "Chain Crusher", last and strongest ship in the fleet.

Will you attack quickly and steadily, or get massive points by taking down many enemies at once?

Simple to play, but exciting to master! Show your personality on-screen through your play style with "Chain Crusher".

Name: Chainsaw The Zombies
Overview:
Society has collapsed. Zombies roam the streets. Survive, save the damsel in distress, and chainsaw the zombies!

Chainsaw The Zombies is an indie video game made in the classic 1980s arcade style. Eat all the donuts to win the level. Use the chainsaws and carve your path through the zombies. Save the damsel in distress for bonus points.

Name: Change of Color
Overview: Change of color is a 2D physics puzzle game for one player. Apply colors to objects to change their physical properties and use these new properties to solve the puzzles your works of art present to you.

Name: Chasing Styx
Overview:
Chasing Styx is an action-packed, three-headed dog, run 'n' gun, couch co-op, bullet-hell adventure.

You are Cerberus, feared guardian of the Underworld. While sleeping on the job, a herd of woodland rabbits hopped into the kingdom of the dead. Hades is not pleased - the boisterous bunnies are distracting the inhabitants from their endless torment. Find your floppy-eared friends and get them back across the River Styx before hell freezes over!

Explore the far reaches of the Underworld, including a forest bathed in darkness and a cursed bell tower. Levels can be approached in any order and feature multiple routes filled with disgruntled dead, tricky traps, hidden treasures, and screen covering waves of bullets. Defeat armies of the dead and collect their souls to level up and equip powerful attacks and abilities.

Name: Chemical Chaos
Overview:
Dr. Ludacki tried to engineer a crop that replicates the flavor of bacon dubbed “Facon”, Scientists and bacon enthusiasts worldwide ridiculed him. Ludacki vowed revenge. He would create a steak sauce that when released into society would turn any who ate it into mutants.

Help the mad scientist by carefully blending chemicals to create his evil concoction and destroy mankind.

Name: Chester
Overview:
Chester is a 2D platformer with over 10 unlockable characters, a light RPG element and leveling up system, loads of unlockables, around 50 levels, and 8 "styles" that allow the player to change the look of the game at will. These styles include sketchbook, 8-bit, LCD, blueprints, and many more. They also each give a unique gameplay bonus to the player.

The game also includes 4 difficulty levels so that almost anyone can beat the game or get a very challenging experience out of it.

Name: Chicken Origami Invaders
Overview:
Take control of a chicken carrying a cat. Defeat the evil video game store manager addicted to Origami. Wave after wave, he will unleash squads of his origami.

Fight against 5 final bosses. Unlock up to 164 crazy costumes.

Name: Chaos Gateway
Overview:
Daylight City is no longer safe. With the sudden appearance of crazed gangs and strange monsters a small group of civilians take refuge inside a military bunker, but are they safe...

Enjoy the debut Visual Novel by Black Ball.

Name: Cell Life
Overview: Cell Life is a life simulator based on Conway's Game of Life. There are a variety of game modes where you can explore Life by creating random simulations of anywhere from 100 cells to over 10000 cells at once, view a pattern library of amazing Life creations, experiment to create your own custom patterns and watch them evolve, or even use your entire TV screen as a simulation in screensaver mode!

Name: Chaos Node
Overview:
Experience a game like nothing you've ever played. Work with or against up to 4 players in a frantic local multi-player experience. Compete with the world to hold the top online score!

Infinite pulses of random physics driven game play, means no two matches will ever be the same!

How long can you survive to defend, the Chaos Node?

Name: Cherry Poke Prison
Overview:
King's Cousin Clyde is sentenced to "Cherry Poke Prison" where the Warden has just one rule!

Will the "Prince of Poke Prison" behave...?

Name: Censored
Overview: BLEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEP!

Name: CHESS MAGIC POWER 2016
Overview: Horizontally scrolling shooters.

Name: The Chickening
Overview: The Chickening is a run and gun platformer video game about a chicken who shoots lasers.. out of his eyes.

Name: Chillax HD
Overview: Chillax your mind body and soul with these soothing 5.1 ambient soundscapes - go on, treat yourself!

Name: Chaos Shift
Overview:
Classic arcade style gameplay in 3D.

Take control of an experimental alien vessel and blast your way through hordes of relentless enemy ships, satellites, mines and asteroids.

Kill as many enemies as fast as you can to boost your score and unleash the invincible "Chaos Shift".

Name: Centroid
Overview:
The Centroids have crash landed on Earth! Defeat the wormlike creatures before they eat you alive!

This platfomer/shooter will have you on edge as you chunk and break your way through 30 levels packed full of grubs, guns and more!

Name: Chain Reaction
Overview:
Set off your explosion at the right time to start a chain reaction and rack up the points!

Share highscores with friends, Addictive Gameplay, Innovative Sound Design.

Name: Chalked
Overview: Save the city... or destroy it! Play as the hero and save the city by calling in tips, surrounding suspect buildings, and running down the bad guys. Or choose to destroy the city by avoiding the patrolling heroes and setting bombs inside the buildings - leveling the city building by building.

Name: Chipmunk Christmas
Overview: Stop those pesky chipmunks playing with your Christmas tree. Using the coloured buttons and shoulder triggers on your controller, zap as many chipmunks as you can to increase your score and get to the next level.

Name: Chompy Chomp Chomp
Overview: Chompy Chomp Chomp is a frantic multiplayer game to play with your family and friends. Play against up to three friends with local and online multiplayer. Chomp your way through rich and varied arena environments, battle with frenzied power-ups and poison effects.

Name: Chopper Storm
Overview:
Introducing Chopper Storm, the first release from Iridescent Games! This dual-joystick allows you to fight with - or against - up to four local players at a time.

The game features 4 distinct modes, 6 helicopters to choose from, and 18 weapons to buy and sell to customize your fleet.

Earn all 22 medals to prove yourself as the ultimate pilot.

Name: Chopsticks
Overview: Use chopsticks to transport your sushi into the soy sauce tray. Improve your hand eye coordination and solve puzzles with chopsticks.

Name: Color
Overview: Welcome to Color ! A very fast game, that will strain your dexterity !! Play 3 different game style in 2 mode (arcade and survival), alone or with your friends and compare your scores with more than 140 different statistics! Surpass you and take up the challenges of the 16 game medals !

Name: Miner Warfare
Overview: MINER WARFARE is a frantic 2D shooting and digging multiplayer experience. With the innovative 2 player per controller system up to 8 miners can dig their way through dirt blocks and other miners in order to be the wealthiest at the end of the match. Ten maps, 28 weapons, up to 8 players (yep, 8 players with 4 controllers) and only 1$, MINER WARFARE is the perfect couch game friendship breaker!

Name: The Lumberjack
Overview: Hippies and treehuggers stay out! Enjoy our beutiful nature like real men do - with a shotgun! Put yourself to the ultimate lumberjack challenge, to find and cut down the 1000year old magic oak. This is a top view, classic style shooter for one or two players. Join the epic fight of man against nature, now!.. Oh, and watch out for Rambi, he is pissed off since you killed his mom.

Name: Christmas Carnage
Overview:
Blast your way past the enemies of Christmas in this multiplayer shooter!

Battle through over 20 levels of unique enemies to unlock new game modes.

Only YOU can save Christmas!

Name: Christmas Rocks!
Overview: Merry Christmas Everyone!

Name: Christmas Tree
Overview: Love decorating Christmas Trees? Decorate to your heart's content with Christmas Tree! With over 100 decorations to choose from you can decorate your tree however you like. Control the wind with your cursor and watch the ornaments sway and chime to the breeze. Makes for a great interactive holiday display, including Christmas music from Kevin MacLeod to help set the mood. Happy Holidays!

Name: Chris Unarmed
Overview: Journey through a world of evil monsters in this unique platformer. Marvel at the innovative level design and scale impossible feats, in an intriguing web of wall jumping fun. Ride powerful wind currents, uncover hidden keys, and much more. You are Chris Unarmed.

Name: Christmas Tree 3D
Overview: Decorate your own christmas tree! Have fun with your family while decorating tree together. Decorate tree and admire stunning effects: fully dynamic per pixel lighting, wind effects, snow and look how whole tree sways in the wind ! You can play up to 8 christmas songs.

Name: Chronodash
Overview: Challenge your skills in the most diabolical first person platformer ever made.

Name: Chrophidian
Overview:
Restore color to the cosmos in this bright twist on an arcade classic!

Players control an ever-growing snake that can change an object's color at will. As the snake lengthens it becomes possible to change more and more objects at once!

However, a long tail can make accurate color shifts tricky and time is running out in the color-drained universe of Chrophidian!

Name: Chromathud
Overview: A limited edition addition addiction!

Name: Chromatism
Overview: Chromatism is a 2D jetpack flying, colour changing game, in which you change colour to match the dots falling toward you. Hit correctly coloured dots in quick succession to increase your combo, boosting your score. The left stick is used to fly left, right or down, A fires your jetpack and X, Y and B switch between blue, yellow and red respectively. Beat the top highscore for a bonus item!!

Name: Chronoblast
Overview:
XBLIGs first shooter with full TATE support! Vertical manic shooter based on various arcade classics. Various modes of play. Challenging risk/reward scoring system. Online networked scores for competitive play.

Unleash the power of super mode for maximum scoring in single ranked games, or co-op with a friend using one of 4 ships up against enemies guaranteed to crush you with fearsome fire power!

Name: Chu's Dynasty
Overview: Chu's Dynasty combines the strategic fighting of street-fighter with the multi-tiered 4 player fighting mayhem of super-smash brothers. Chu's then adds a new twist to the genre with time manipulation. Fight through four campaigns and learn how the gods where born. Fight with up to 4 players in free for all and team modes. Control Time and Space with each of the characters unique time powers.

Name: City Condemned
Overview: Free the Condemned City from rotten zombies and loathsome bats. Featuring three amazing modes Deliverance, Mission and Weekend modes. Experience the ultimate sniping action and earn prestige points, awards and upgraded weapons.

Name: City Zombified
Overview: Zombies took away the peace and power from the Serene City. Rescue the civilians and bring back light into their lives. Enjoy two challenging modes - Sentinel and Survival. A dark adventure awaits you with cool upgrades!

Name: Circa
Overview:
Circa is a game that takes the best ideas of Geometry Wars and Rock Band and fuses them into an explosion of fun.

In Circa less always means more.

Name: City Rain
Overview:
City Rain is a strategic, ecological city planning simulation combined with timed falling block puzzle gameplay. The game is set in a future where environmental challenges demand drastic measures. This led to the formation of the Rescue and Intervention Non-profit organization (R.A.I.N.), created by the World Environment Protection Agency to help maintain and enforce environmental laws, and confront multinational conglomerates. Players start as a new employee with R.A.I.N. With the help of Catherine, a partner who provides hints, the player is gradually introduced to increasingly difficult challenges.

The game environment is shown as an isometric board of tiles. In each stage the player needs to complete a number of goals, such as building specific structures, cleaning waste, or raising money for research. While the gameplay is similar to a simplified version of SimCity, a fast element is introduced. New buildings drop down from the top of the screen and the player only has a limited amount of time, but more than ten seconds, to select a location on the field. Each "block" can be rotated to choose between different buildings such as schools, residences, factories, hospitals, police stations, and more. Certain buildings can be stacked multiple times to upgrade their level. During certain turns the player is forced to drop down four buildings at once in a set pattern, due to planning regulations.

Each decision by the player alters six main parameters: sustainability, jobs, health, leisure, security and education. Safeguarding security is for instance achieved by constructing police stations. Money is earned through the economy, but influenced by the chosen buildings. Residences and schools deduct money per round, while factories bring in revenue, but with ecological consequences. After a while, special buildings such as fire stations and recycling sites can be bought in a separate screen. The game's main campaign mode is divided into different levels. The player only has a limited amount of rounds to complete the challenges to progress. With each level, all previous work is generally reset.

Next to the campaign mode, there is quick play where different starting parameters can be defined. The third mode, blockmania, does away with all missions. The player simply needs to build a city by quickly putting down buildings in defined patterns. The buildings can be rotated to upgrade existing ones, but overlapping a wrong one destroys it. When too many buildings are destroyed, the game is over. To score, buildings need to be upgraded until a certain amount is met.

This commercial version is a reworking of a student game. It contains a new story plot and dialogs, profile management, a music soundtrack, updated AI and gameplay changes, online scoreboards and customizable settings.

Name: City Tuesday
Overview:
City Tuesday is an open world platformer game about the last five minutes before a terrorist attack. You play a man who has become stuck reliving those five minutes before the disaster.

Learn the city, track down the bombs, and possibly become unstuck from time.

Name: Classic Baker's Dozen
Overview: The classic Baker's Dozen solitaire, now for your Xbox 360! Includes many backgrounds to customize the game.

Name: Classic Spider
Overview: The classic Spider solitaire card game, now for your Xbox 360! Includes many backgrounds and card backs to customize the game.

Name: Classic Minesweeper
Overview: The classic Minesweeper, now for your Xbox 360! Includes many backgrounds to customize the game and the ability to save your best times.

Name: Classic Solitaire
Overview: Klondike, the most widely known solitaire card game, now for your Xbox 360! Includes many backgrounds and card backs to customize the game.

Name: Classic Works Library
Overview:
Enjoy classic novels the way they were meant to be read: On your big screen television!

Over 25 complete classic works are at your fingertips in one digital collection including Sherlock Holmes, Alice in Wonderland, War and Peace, and many more.

With easy navigation, chapter jumping, advanced bookmarking and customizable font sizes, you’ll wish you could read every book like this!

Name: Classicard
Overview: Classicard simulates six real-life six trick-taking card games: Euchre, Hearts, Oh Hell, Spades, Knockout Whist and Romanian Whist. The game can be played either solo against the AI or with up to four human opponents. The game rules can be tweaked to some extent.

Name: Claustrophobia
Overview: It's going to be a bloodbath...

Name: Classic FreeCell
Overview: The classic FreeCell solitaire card game, now for your Xbox 360! Includes many backgrounds to customize the game.

Name: Clock 24-7
Overview:
Bring the sophistication of a fine wall clock to your home with ease!

Features 12 varied clock designs. Beautiful wall clocks, funky natural clocks, and quirky one-of-a-kind timepieces! There’s a clock for everyone. The digital alarm is great for taking a nap after playing some games.

Name: Cocktails: shake it up!
Overview:
Mix the perfect cocktail! Find out the flaming drinks and the exclusive gamer drinks!

Over 160 drink recipes on your XBOX. Dozens of ingredients and a lot of new ways to find your drink.

Name: The Co-Op Zombie Game
Overview:
Play single player or online with three other people in a co-operative zombie hunt through 19 levels.

Rid the city of the zombie horde while collecting weapons, ammo, smashing crates, and avoiding exploding barrels.

Name: Claw Machine Arcade
Overview:
Choose from 3 claw machines, each with 5 claw types and their own quirks. Includes a normal machine filled with random junk, a fish machine that has swimming fishies, and a space machine filled with sucking blackholes and exploding supernovae.

Can you master the claw?

Name: Clover: A Curious Tale
Overview: The new and enhanced version of Clover - now Clover: A Curious Tale - updates the hand-crafted watercolour political platform puzzler and invites players to put their puzzle-solving skills to the test by confronting the mysteries of its fascinating medieval world.

Name: The Co-Op Zombie Game 2
Overview:
Play single player or online with three other people in a co-operative zombie hunt. Try to make it through 20 challenging levels infested by the zombie horde.

Collect weapons, smash crates, and detonate barrels along with three of your friends in this fast paced zombie shooter.

Name: Colony Defense
Overview:
Colony Defense is a tower defense game. Player takes place of GalCon war academy graduate with mission of protecting human population on distant planets of year 5736.

The game field has a shape of sphere, with several enemy landing bases and peaceful citizen colonies connected by roads. Various gun towers should be built (keeping the distance between each other) across the paths in order to prevent alien invasion, but they also might be sold (useful when enemy gets immune to certain damage type) or upgraded. The only resource are credits, for which towers are bought. When thing get really bad, it's possible to strike once in a while with orbital ion cannon, dealing large area effect damage.

After finishing the mission, player receives one talent point and another one in case of zero civilian population loses. They are spent for upgrading certain aspects of alter ego, like cheaper building price or higher damage.

Name: Colonies: Neociv
Overview: Neociv is a perfect world were people only work on their passions. But something is not right and you are scrambling for your life and the future of Neociv in this story-driven adventure game.

Name: Clyde Hopper's Trajectory
Overview: Play as Clyde Hopper or Danger the Turtle to discover your inner swinger and become king of the swing. Race the clock and fate to save the backyard from Aunt Verna and her band of miscreant weevils. Perform tricks and get faster to increase your skill counter and improve your belt ranking from novice white to master black.

Name: Cold War Commander
Overview:
Cold War Commander is a side-scrolling platformer in which the player assumes the role of Ronald Reagan, navigating a series of levels themed around the fight against communism. The primary objective in each stage is to collect all jellybeans before reaching the exit. Gameplay emphasizes evasion, as Reagan lacks any means of defense against environmental hazards such as lava or against patrolling communist enemies. Progress depends on precise jumping and careful timing to avoid these threats.

Additionally, Cold War Commander has two non-game functions: Controller Massage and Controller Race which both utilize the rumble function of the Xbox 360 controller.

Name: Coastal Defence
Overview: Sink the ships and defend the coast to increase your score. Also contains bonus history quiz.

Name: Coagulate
Overview:
A fast-paced, addictive block-drop game. Stack like-colored blobs together and watch them Coagulate to form a larger high-value blob.

...But don't get too caught-up building the biggest blobs: make sure to keep some free space before the screen fills up!

Name: Cocktail Paradise
Overview: Be a real bartender, 100 cocktails and 20 drinking games on your Xbox. More than 120 searchable ingredients to find anytime the cocktail you like. Enjoy and impress your friends with your bartender attitudes!

Name: Color Sense
Overview:
Train your brain! No matter how old you are, this game is fun for everyone!

Challenge yourself and play against the computer. Try to reproduce as many patterns as possible!

Name: Colosseum: Hammerball
Overview: Hammerball is the latest bloodsport from the world of Colosseum. Two teams face off in a fast-paced and deadly mix of hockey and gateball. Equipped with a big war hammer you have to smash your way through your opponents and get the ball in the goal.

Name: College Lacrosse 2011
Overview: College Lacrosse 2011 features motion capture animations, overhauled graphics, improved Xbox LIVE play, enhanced right joystick shooting, new right joystick dodging, new bullet and loft passing, new dive shots, new penalties, new sound effects, new stick checking system and over fifty gameplay improvements!

Name: College Lacrosse 2012
Overview:
College Lacrosse 2012 features improved graphics, player movement, online play, shooting, passing, and defensive stick checks.

Thanks to the lacrosse community for the support. Stay tuned for updates and more lacrosse video games.

Name: Color 2
Overview:
Welcome in COLOR 2!

Increase your dexterity to next level for play 5 different game mode in arcade or survival.

Challenge yourself by collecting the 66 medals and improve your 290 statistics!

Name: Code Breaker
Overview: Can you crack the code? Play against the computer, a friend or online in this adaptation of "bulls and cows".

Name: Codex
Overview:
Test your spatial logic reasoning skills! Collect the most Gold medals by solving the puzzle in the least amount of moves.

This game supports music visualization for your own music tracks shared through Windows Media Connect and USB devices.

Name: Color Ball
Overview:
Color Ball is a fast and fun casual game for your XBOX 360 game console.

Play over 100 levels of fun. Shooting the colored balls into the goals to score points. Combine primary colored balls to create a secondary colored ball. Separate secondary colored balls into two primary colored balls.

Name: Color Break
Overview: High-speed take on an old classic. No more blocks to destroy. Simply keep the colored balls in play by bouncing them with your paddle. A new twist means not as easy as you think, though. Only balls of the same color as your paddle will bounce, so you must change the color of your paddle to that of the incoming ball.

Name: Colosseum
Overview:
Colosseum is a brawler set in Ancient Rome. The single-player campaign follows the nameless player character who fights through six levels (plus a tutorial) to become famous. Combat during the campaign is wave-based.

The player has the choice between four combat styles (mace, spear, sword & shield and dual wield) which come with their own set of combos. These are powerful attacks which are performed by using the correct attack pattern with the correct timing. Besides attacking, the character can also block (the block button can be held as long as wished, but breaks after a few consecutive hits), dodge or use rage actions (refill health, pull opponents toward the player, push enemies away or a power attack). The latter requires rage fuel which is earned with successful attacks or by performing bravados (feats like a perfect block, double kill, etc.). New weapons and armor is unlocked by completing challenges.

Besides the single player campaign, there are also five competitive multiplayer modes: deathmatch, holy ground (domination), banner carrier (collecting banners), giant (player-controlled giant vs. the other players; the winner needs the most kills as giant and the most damage against giants) and survival (last man standing against enemy waves).

Name: Colotristar
Overview: A simple combine three puzzle game. Both single and splitscreen play is available. Your goal is to remove as many stars from the grid as possible. You remove stars by combining them in groups of 3 or more. Try to leave as few stray stars behind as possible, with a little luck you might get rid of all 81 of them. Beware, you might get stuck.

Name: Combat Tanks
Overview: Full game 3D. it destroys all your enemies before they destroy you...

Name: Combo- red moon rising
Overview:
In this addictive mixture of action and strategy, your mission is to defeat the enemy planet.

Gather resources through collecting sequences and command ships to conquer asteroids, to build more ships and launch weapons.

Features ten single player levels, four multiplayer maps, awards and more.

Name: Combat Tanks Part II
Overview: This is a game in 3D. Each level has a lot of adventure and emotion. Destroy all the enemy tanks, before they destroy it to you. good luck....

Name: Comedy Night
Overview: If you enjoy watching comedy and discovering new talent or if your an aspiring comedian with an ability to entertain then this is a great game to show off your talent in front of a live audience!

Name: Commander: World 1
Overview:
Mankind has swarmed out all over the universe, but is now attacked by aliens throwing asteroids at the Earth and its colonies.

Commander: World 1 is an 8-bit-inspired tower-defense game. The player is a commander and must set up mercenaries, who can shoot the asteroids, on each planet. These asteroids come in waves and travel a path marked as a white dotted line. During the course of the level, these paths can be changed, while the planets are moving as well. Destroying asteroids earns money, which is used to upgrade the different classes of mercenaries.

Name: Concentrix
Overview: A mind-bending game of falling rings.

Name: Concept Car Series 2010
Overview: Get behind the wheel of some of the fastest concept cars, racing on closed roads around the world. Featuring 12 customizable cars across 3 performance categories, 8 reversible tracks, 2 championship modes, challenging computer opponents, 2-player splitscreen mode, trophies and global (P2P) high scores.

Name: Comet!
Overview:
Comet! It's a classic arcade game and a modern puzzler - in the back seat at a drive in B-movie. A deceptively simple game of flying saucers, space mines, alien worlds and, of course, comets!

Comet! features high-speed action gameplay, unique but intuitive controls, extensive stat tracking, classic sci-fi flair, millions of points and lots of explosions.

Name: Compromised
Overview:
Compromised is a twin stick/bullet hell/shmup hybrid best described as a mix between Insanely Twisted Shadow Planet and Geometry Wars, inspired by our childhoods playing NES, SNES and Sega games.

Explore the world of Se-Da and struggle to return home after being cut off and isolated from everything during the BIOC invasion.

Fend off 25+ enemies with various attacks and strategies using your standard machine gun, missiles and bombs, plus 4 special attacks used by spending collected energy.

Battle ridiculously large and awesome bosses, each boss battle is their own insane level.

Name: Concept Coaster Craft
Overview:
Design, build and ride your very own roller coasters. Choose between a wide variety of different carriages & environments and also paint the track as you like. Once you are happy with your roller coaster you can then share it with the world over Xbox Live. Roller coasters others have shared will also be available for you to download, ride and rate.

Start constructing today!

Name: Comet Turn
Overview:
“Comet Turn” is a game that can score when a comet completes “techniques” like that it goes around a planet or it confines all the planets in orbit. You can find the techniques in the "technique list". And there are also hidden techniques that are related to the constellation.

The rule has ”Gain” that only gets the score and “Arrest and Escape” that takes it when the planet captures the comet.

Name: Constrictor
Overview: Constrictor is a Snake variant. The player controls a snake which grows larger after eating yellow dots. The game is over when crashing into obstacles (such as obstacles, the own tail or other players) and the goal is to accumulate points by surviving long enough. While the single-player is basic, there are also three multiplayer modes: predator (trying to eat them), wraith (running away from them) or sport (playing ball). There a few additional options which change the game, e.g. power-ups for gaining special abilities.

Name: Contagion
Overview: A 3D action-strategy game in which the player is to maintain the stability of planet SL-49 by raising and herding a breed of bugs whose spores are capable of powering machines that keep their universe in equilibrium.

Name: Contract: Void Justice
Overview:
Contract: Void Justice is a sci-fi third-person shooter which can be played in single and multiplayer (2 player co-op) modes. Players take on the role of a mercenary who has just delivered a prisoner to the space prison ship PPG-871. When prisoners escape during a blackout and begin rioting, the mercenary is hired by the warden to kill the rioters.

The objective is to kill all the enemies on a given level, and players are equipped with both a gun and a sword for this purpose. Money collected by killing enemies can be spent on items at a shop such as a compass and a level map.

Name: Conquest of the Planet Earth
Overview: This is a game in 3D. Where strange creatures want to eliminate the whole humanity. You must defend at any expense. Good luck...

Name: Constructor360
Overview: Build something abstract, build something cute or build something awesome - whatever your mood is. This game offers a truly open-ended experience where the limits are only your imagination and ..360 building blocks. The game also comes with a challenge mode, 3 levels of difficulty and in-game awards. Train your perception and memory building against time randomly generated 3D structures.

Name: Controdazone
Overview:
Controdazone! It’s "Control" + "The" + "Zone", get it?

This game is a twin stick shooter with a twist. Instead of killing your opponents you fight vigorously for control over the “zone”, a circular area that travels around the screen. Battle with up to 4 friends, or hone your skills against the bots. Grab power ups to give you an edge in battle.

Name: Cosmic Cab
Overview: The XBOX Avatars need to get places and you are the only one Dr. Jacque will trust with his ship. Test your flying skills in a series of mind bending gravity scenarios. Venture deep into the core of planets and dodge asteroids as you deliver avatars to their destinations. If you're really good you just might be the first person to beat the last level. We never have.

Name: Convextrix
Overview: Shapes drop down and dart across the gridded aisles, connecting through electric impulses with the solitary goal of expending their energy as the breaking integer is reached while tech-inspired beats caress the aural waves until complete vicissitude. Can you get SSS in each one of this challenging, quick-paced puzzle game's 10 zones?

Name: Cootie Crusher
Overview:
You are the cootie crusher! People come to you to resolve their cootie infestations.
