Crush those little bugs as quickly as you can. You get bonuses for speed and accuracy.

Name: Cops and Robbers
Overview: Cops and Robbers is a throw back to the classic arcade style that we all love. Get all the coins without getting busted by the cops!

Name: Controller Doctor
Overview: Ever wish you could check to see if your controller is working properly? Now you can with Controller Doctor! Perform over 10 tests that examine your controller's buttons, thumb sticks and triggers!

Name: Convict Minigames
Overview:
A collection of 5 arcade style mini-games that will keep you and your friends hooked and entertained for hours on end!

Include High Hopes (winner of the 2009 48 Hour Game Making Challenge in Brisbane, Australia), Jurassic Bar, Cave In, Triangle Man and Bop!

Fun for the whole family!

Name: Corsair
Overview:
Corsair is a fixed-screen shooter in which the player either takes the role of the defending Camariam Consortium or the attacking Valaxus Empire. The Camarians use small and fast fighters called Corsair which use the classic Asteroids controls: The ship keeps its momentum and the player can use thrust to accelerate into the ships current alignment which can be changed by rotating the ship. It also governs the direction of the shots. However, in contrast to Asteroids, the ship can also brake and strafe. The Valaxus Empire uses Decimators instead. These ships are almost as big as the screen and therefore has very restricted movement. It is also equipped with four turrets which can be individually rotated and fired.

Whichever mode is chosen, the goal is always to kill the opposing forces within a time limit to earn a high score. The fight is always one Decimator against four Corsair.

Name: Constellation
Overview:
Due to light pollution the stars in the sky are now barely visible near major cities. It is your job to fix this problem and brighten the stars!

Using gravity to sling-shot yourself around levels you must brighten the cosmos so everyone can enjoy a bright starry night in all its splendour.

Name: Console Info
Overview: Measure the speed of your USB storage devices, hard drives, and memory units, and view other information about your console and controllers.

Name: Controller Buster
Overview:
Race against the clock or your friend to get the highest score you can.

How well do you know your controller?

Name: Cool Shapes
Overview: Cool Shapes is a new puzzle game where you have to fill in the hi-lighted area on the grid. But the Shapes can't pass through each other. So you may need to navigate around to get the pices where you need them.

Name: Cooties: Patient Zero
Overview: Circle. Circle. Dot. Dot.

Name: Coral's Curse
Overview: Help Coral in her quest to break the spell that has transformed her into a frightening new form. Use your tail to slither to high ledges and solve unique puzzles. Cast spells like fireball and frostbolt, or use your tail to defeat various enemies. Collect resources to improve your abilities and become even more powerful. Coral's Curse is a platformer unlike anything you've seen before!

Name: CoreDase
Overview:
A unique 3D platformer that starts out easy enough but soon supplies tension in gargantuan degrees!

Wrestle with 50 challenging levels as new elements appear and old ones change. Take to multiplayer to experience something new where every one of 20 levels fundamentally changes play.

Though your ultimate aim is to come out on top, sometimes survival takes a higher priority.

Name: Corrupted
Overview: Hack and slash your way through hoards of enemies, with up to 3 other players. Upgrade your character's skills while working to accomplish a sinister goal. Featuring a unique dual-stick control scheme, for both melee and ranged combat. Corrupteds campaign and arena modes provide hours of fun!

Name: Cosmic Caverns
Overview: Stuntman Joe is lost in space. Will he find a way out?

Name: Cosmic Crash
Overview:
Survive the ever growing waves of Alien space ships in this arcade style shooter!

With five different gameplay modes including an epic boss battle against the mothership, set yourself the highest score and survive for as long as you can!

Name: Craftimals: Build to the Sun
Overview: One part crafting game and one part 2D platformer, Craftimals lets you build your own way to the top! Play single-player or local co-op and help the animals reach the sun. Checkpoints along the way give you new powers and hats. Find out what happens when you touch the sun, or simply have fun building!

Name: Cow Catch
Overview: Push your reflexes to the limits with this challenging game of endurance and skill. Featuring four progressive modes of stylish bovine action, defend the Earth against otherworldly invasion by intercepting genetically modified cattle being launched at rural communities. Save the world from destruction with the aid of your trusty wagon and become a legendary folk hero!

Name: Crawlers and Brawlers
Overview:
Crawlers and Brawlers is a RPG descended from the 8bit classics. It has you choose between three different classes to become an adventurer and go on a fantastic journey through many epic procedurally generated dungeons. Collect powerful loot on your way to develop your character with nothing to stand in your way of being exactly what you were meant to be, AWESOME. Join your friends in local or online co-op crawls through the dungeons then brawl online on 12 different multiplayer maps after you're so powerful no dungeon can contain you.

Three different classes; warrior, mage and cleric.
Collect loot to make your character more powerful.
Hundreds of procedurally generated dungeons.
An engaging single player campaign.
Online multiplayer with up to 16 players on 12 multiplayer maps.
Two, three, and four player local split-screen co-op.

Name: Couples Sudoku
Overview:
Couples Sudoku is a variant of the number puzzle Sudoku. The definition of this traditional pen & paper puzzle can be found in the associated game group.

The specialty of this version are the two-player modes. Players can either compete against each other or work together by solving the same puzzle. Single players have the choice between four game modes (standard, timed, first to number and arcade) and multiple difficulty levels. The puzzles are randomly generated.

Name: Cowbots
Overview: This twin-stick shooter mixed with a turn-based card game offers loads of fun! Through three unique game modes, experience the wild west with explosions, teepees, cowboys hats and robots! Play with a friend in multiplayer mode.

Name: Crazy Balloon Lite
Overview:
Crazy Balloon Lite is a fun game of navigation and nerves.

The Land of the Balloons has been invaded by nasty spikes. You need to navigate this overrun terrain to make it back to your balloon friends!

Name: Crazy Coins
Overview: Whoa - an ATM that spits out money, all you need to do is move your remote controlled piggy banks to catch it as it falls from the sky. One or Two Players.

Name: Crazy Ball
Overview: Crazy Ball is a wild and fast-paced soccer game, designed with multiplayer action in mind. This is a game that will captivate you as soon as you feel the satisfaction of scoring your first goal and rubbing it in your opponent's face. That is until they become a giant, swat you away like a fly, turn the ball in a tiny bullet and smash it into your goal. The rules are set, the battle can begin.

Name: Crisis Nuclear Holocaust
Overview: Artificial Intelligence has gone too far. Only you can prevent a Nuclear Crisis.

Name: Croc's World
Overview:
Croc´s World is a really nice jump'n'run with 60 incredible levels and many challenging enemies!

Jump and run through the levels and dodge all enemies.

Collect a helmet to crush stoneblocks. Collect the stonebag to throw stones.

If you collect 100 diamonds you´ll get an extra life!

Name: Crazy Particles
Overview:
Play with CRAZY particles! Activate special effects to make the CRAZY particles even more CRAZY!

Change the CRAZY Color, Speed, Size, Angle and Gravity direction.

Name: Croc's World 3
Overview:
Croc's World 3 is a really nice jump'n'run with 60 incredible levels and many challenging enemies!

Jump and run through the levels and dodge all enemies. Collect a helmet to crush stoneblocks. Collect special items like 'Firehelmet' (walk through fire) or 'Shield' (Invincible for 10 seconds)!

If you collect 100 diamonds you´ll get an extra life!

Name: Flex
Overview:
Flex -- the flexible piece dropping game.

Flex is all about options. There are over 30 options that can be changed to customize the game to your liking. Hopefully, there's something here that will interest you.

If the game is too hard or too easy, change the settings. If you want a different style of game, change the options.

Name: Critter Skater
Overview: Puzzle running game. Find the end portal beat the game. Contains JRPG train your critter to defend you from wild attacks. can you train you critter to Level 99?

Name: Cro-Mag Rally Extreme!
Overview: The Extreme! edition of the popular Kart-racing title brings an all-new UI and tons of multiplayer fun. Capture-the-Flag, Tag, and vs racing across Xbox LIVE, System Link, or even split screen! Includes 8 all-new multiplayer battle arenas. All for a special introductory price of just 80 points!

Name: Crazy Hobo
Overview: 3D Survival - They say I's crazy, but this shotgun ain't crazy! There's demons everywhere, and I know what to do to demons. Point my boom stick at em and exorcise their face off! -- Kill waves of demons using a variety of weapons and abilities in this 3D overhead action game.

Name: Crazy Ride with Zombies
Overview: In Crazy Ride with Zombies, players are tasked with trying to survive a thrill ride on a dangerous rollercoaster that is set on the side of snow covered mountain. The game is all about having good timing. Players have to punch hanging zombies and falling rocks at the right time to remove them from the tracks or else the player will crash into them. Players also have to jump tree branches being wielded by zombies.

Name: Crazy Wizard in Creepy Castle
Overview:
Help Crazy Wizard defeat the evil that lurks in Creepy Castle!

In this fun platformer you fight monsters, ghosts and dragons!

Name: Creed Arena
Overview:
Creed Arena is a third person shooter where the player takes the role of a contestant in a futuristic gladiator game. There are two perspectives that the player can switch between at any time: behind and bird's eye view. The goal is to become the most famous gladiator of all time and to accomplish that the player has to enter the arena and compete in a tournament consisting of several challenges. The success of the player is measured by how many fans he manages to win over to his side. To gets the player has to impress the stadium crowd by killing enemies and completing challenges. Quick successive kills and melee kills are some ways to really increase the fame of the player while dying will cost some fans. The player has a crowd rage meter that goes up as the crowd gets impressed. When full the player becomes faster, tougher and can do extra damage.

There are four different game modes that the player will come across in the tournament. In the survival mode the player and a team mate has to survive an onslaught of monsters, wave after wave without losing all lives. The deathmatch mode is everyone against everyone and the winner is the one that first reaches a target number of kills. It also exist in a team variant. Collect the Kegs is the game's variant of capture the flag. The player has to retrieve kegs from the enemy and bring them back to the base. In the popularity mode the player competes against a team mate and has to kill waves of enemies. The one that reaches a popularity target first wins.

The Xbox 360 version features multiplayer. It allows two players to play through the tournament in co-op, both online and offline. While online up to eight players can compete.

Name: Criminals Under Arrest
Overview: Gangs are fighting for the control of Norpen City. As Special Agent John Adams, you are sent to bring back order in the city. Criminals Under Arrest is a story driven beat'em up, where you have the possibilty to start from any level. Wanna start with the last boss? That's up to you.

Name: Crisis in the Gulf
Overview: The Government and Oil Corporations have failed to stop the oil leak. Clearly they haven't tried TOWER DEFENSE!! Do you have what it takes to cap the leak?

Name: Crisis: North Korea
Overview: It's the year 2012, take to the skies in an effort to liberate the North Korean people from their ruthless dictator. Fight planes, ships, and subs in this exciting arcade style shooter.

Name: Croc's World 2
Overview: "Croc's World 2" is a really nice jump'n'run with 60 incredible levels and many challenging enemies!

Name: Crimson Blues
Overview: Crimson Blues is an action puzzle-platform where the player is able to shift between red and blue modes, gaining new abilities when interacting with different colored objects. The game features a full tutorial mode leading up to the single player game, as well as a 2 player gameplay with unlockable extras and new modes.

Name: Crystal Crush
Overview:
Crystal Crush is a tile matching puzzle. In the middle of the screen is an arrangement of hex tiles which can be rotated by the player. On the sides are entry points for colored crystals; in all modes but repulse the launch is manually triggered.

The specific goal depends on the playing mode: match three (creating same colored groups of three or more to remove them from the playfield), colour match (there are three big arrangements which need to be filled with correctly colored crystals), repulse (only one color is allowed to be placed; the others need to be deflected by touching them with a placed crystal) and join (the player needs to connect gold crystals by placing silver crystals).

Besides the standard crystals, there are also four special crystals: star (rewards bonus points), diamond (appears after a high combo and destroys all nearby crystals), virus (appears after four consecutive combos and destroys all connected crystals) and skull (game over when placed).

Name: Crystaloid
Overview:
Crystaloid is a breakout game. Clone of the famous Arkanoid.

Features:

-Over 40 Levels
-18 Power bonus
-Continue support

Name: Crypt of the Serpent King
Overview:
Crypt of the Serpent King is a medieval first-person hack'n'slash dungeon crawler with roguelike elements.

Explore large, randomly generated dungeons.
Fight goblins, orcs, skeletons, giant spiders and all sorts of underworld creatures.
Wield an array of melee and ranged weapons.
Jump over lava pits and spike traps.
Level up your character's abilities.
Choose between 3 levels of difficulty, from casual to hardcore.

Name: Crosstown
Overview: Crosstown is a retro-style, top-down action game. Up to four players navigate a randomly-generated maze, collecting "qreds", avoiding and fighting various monsters, and drilling through walls. Once a player collects four qreds, play advances to the next level. Between levels, a computer named "PIGGY" tells the players about the rules of the game, the history of Crosstown and the monsters therein, and the strange nature of the reality where the game takes place.

Name: Crystal Hunters
Overview:
Crystal Hunters is a top down puzzle game featuring two playable characters, Thomas and Amelia. The game features an optional tutorial level, consisting of 5 levels, in which Grampa Buckley guides the player on game mechanics and offers tips for good crystal hunting. There are four worlds to journey through: the caves, the forest, the castle and the crystal caves. The goal of each level is the collect all the crystals on the map, which unlocks the door out. Thomas or Amelia must solve puzzles to reach the crystals, however, by pushing boxes to block enemies or adjust lasers to trigger switches. Challenges are added as the levels progress, such as new enemies and advanced ways to manipulate lasers, like mirrors.

There's also an art gallery, time challenges and achievements. The art gallery includes menu art and sketches which are viewable after finishing levels or meeting time challenges.

Name: Crystal Spear remake
Overview: Avoid obstacles, and Aim the goal! It takes only two minutes, and no restriction code, so you can play well in the trial.

Name: CTG
Overview: Take on hordes of grannies in HD and make their dentures fly, you get an arsenal of weapons at your disposal: gravity gun, grenades, crazy madness and MEGA BLASTER. Make the grannies fly into the granny grinder when they attack in buses, rascals they even got cannons and kamikaze-allies. You can actually combo the grandmothers into the grinder for more points and awesomeness.

Name: Crystal Skies
Overview: Bubbles was quite the loveable pet fish, offering his owners endless hours of entertainment. Unfortunately, even good fish don't last forever, and like so many of his scaly brethren he was found floating at the top of his bowl, fins up. Having been unceremoniously flushed down the john, he now finds himself lost in the swirling vortex of the great beyond. (20 levels with “save anywhere” support)

Name: Cromo Dynamix
Overview:
Classic Twin-Stick Shooter. Single and Online Multiplayer Battles in a retro style.

The Earth is under attack from an invisible enemy. In a microscopic world beneath the nature we can perceive, a battle rages for supremacy.

If you can handle the pressure then you must join the fight.

Name: Cubage
Overview: Rotate sections of a cube to make each side a single color in the fastest time possible.

Name: Cuadro
Overview:
Cuadro is an action game centered around the gradual unveiling of hidden historical paintings. Each level begins with a concealed artwork, and the player's objective is to reveal it by navigating a ship across the canvas. As the ship moves, it uncovers the painting beneath. Players can also fire colored balls that bounce off walls and reveal additional areas.

A key mechanic involves balls of the same color colliding with each other. When this occurs, a larger portion of the painting is revealed, and the ship’s speed increases. While there are no traditional enemies, black balls pose a threat: they erase previously revealed sections and reduce the ship’s speed when struck by other balls. Occasionally, yellow balls appear, triggering temporary special effects upon impact for a few seconds.

Once the entire painting is revealed, the player receives a score based on their speed, the number of balls fired, and their accuracy. This score determines the type of key awarded - bronze, silver, or gold - which can be used to unlock new paintings, game modes, and bonus content within the museum. Achieving high scores also reveals the title and description of the painting, which becomes accessible in the museum. The museum serves as a hub for progression and exploration and is presented in a first-person perspective.

Name: Cuddle Bear
Overview: Everyone dies :'(

Name: Cutouts!
Overview:
Cutouts! A game made entirely from felt!

Run, duck, jump, and throw objects at your enemies! Collect buttons for extra lives!

Nine levels across three worlds!

Name: Curse of Shadows
Overview: Experience the story of a thief who can transform into her own shadow. In this 2-D side scroller, alternate between normal and shadow mode to navigate platforms and solve puzzles. Walk on the shadows of objects to get to new areas, move objects and light sources in order to change the shadow environment. Beware shadow monsters who stalk you and seek to destroy you.

Name: Curse of the Crescent Isle
Overview: A king sets out to rid his kingdom of a horrible curse.

Name: Cuckoo Crack
Overview: Your egg-laying skills will be tested as you fly your Cuckoo bird through the forest. Will you go for the lower, more valuable nests but risk your bird by crashing into trees? Will you play it safe and risk running out of time? Complete all five challenges and claim your awards! We warn you: this game is addictive and fun for the whole family!

Name: Cubism
Overview:
Cubism takes the puzzle genre to a new dimension. Solve exciting and fun cube puzzles in an easy, yet challenging, intuitive way. Drag pieces onto a cube shape to solve the three dimensional puzzle.

Choose between three playing modes, including more than 50 levels, a puzzle and a free form mode. Choose piece type, cube shape and texture to play your unique puzzle.

Name: Cursed Loot
Overview: The ultimate dungeon crawling experience!

Name: Cut And Run
Overview: Face off against the computer or three other friends and their avatars in the ultimate sprint. From the 100m dash to a 1500m endurance race, all mixed in with optional hurdles, only one can come away with the gold!

Name: Cubix Classic
Overview: Cubix Cube is a digital adaption of the toy Rubic Cube. It consists of a cube with six faces, each made up of nine smaller squares in one of six solid colors. The puzzle's internal mechanism allows each face to rotate independently, scrambling the colors. The challenge is to return the cube to its original state, where each face displays a single uniform color. This version presents the puzzle in 3D and also includes a flat pattern view.

Name: CyberDeck
Overview:
Tired of zombies? Try cyberpunk instead.

Enter a world run by corporations that hire cyberrunners known as Deckers to hack systems. The matrix, however, is filled with intrusion countermeasures (ICE) that can kill if you aren't careful.

Name: CyberSnake
Overview: A new take on the classic game Snake. The CyberSnake is a prototype circuit build and repair program being put to the test in a crisis which could wipe out everyone within proximity.

Name: Cylinder
Overview: Need a challenging alternative to the current wave of puzzle games? Look no further Cylinder is here! Cylinder is a puzzle game that will bend minds of players as it features an original 3D puzzle interface that tasks you with piece placement not only side to side, but across to the other side of your cylinder. Download it today!

Name: Curling 2010
Overview: Learn to curl! Play a competitive curling match against friends and family. Choose from 3 opponent difficulty levels or play online over Xbox LIVE. Compete for the most accurate shot in target competitions. Place stones anywhere on the ice and replay shots in practice mode. Earn awards and badges and track your curling statistics. A guided tutorial and overview of the rules of curling are included. Get sweeping!

Name: Cute Pets
Overview: Match 3 or more Pets to uncover the cute picture.

Name: Cute Things Dying Violently
Overview:
Hey kids! Do you like failure? Are you suspicious of success? Do you smile at the thought of "accidental" electrocution? Then boy have we got the game for you!

Introducing Cute Things Dying Violently, a game where nothing bad happens. CTDV is all about hapless Critters, and the Critters need your help! Launch them around to get them safely out of each level. Dodge all sorts of lethal goodies like spikes, buzzsaws, and fire, and use a variety of wacky items to pull it off. And if a few dozen (or hundred) of them get turned into charred, smoking husks in your attempt to save them... something something omelettes and broken eggs. Broken, bloody eggs.

Featuring:
* 48 mind-bending, reflex-testing singleplayer levels * New Levels of the Week * 24 Achievements * Built-in Level Editor * Steam Workshop integration for sharing user-created levels and custom Critter designs * Free Android copy of the game included * A murderous, bucket-headed robot

Name: Cyber Lander: Mission Space
Overview:
Test your skills as a space module pilot as you navigate the treacherous terrain of alien landscapes. Two modes allow you to hone your skills in basic play before showing off your abilities in advanced mode.

Coordination, finesse and nerves of steel are required to get top score. Do you have what it takes?

Name: Cubicity
Overview:
Our hero Seamus can't fly, but he never touches the ground. Instead, he hangs by a rope and harness as he maneuvers his way through over 60 challenging puzzles!

In Cubicity, you pass across five worlds, in each world he'll need to acquire new weapons and learn new strategies in order to solve the increasingly difficult puzzles that block his path.

Part action/adventure, part puzzle/strategy, you'll need to be both smart and quick-fingered to reach the end. Are you up for the challenge?

Name: Cubicle
Overview: As the newest intern on the job, keep up with the rapid flow of cubicle work to keep your job. Use intuitive thumbstick controls to master your daily routine. Player in single player mode, or compete head to head against a friend.

Name: Cyborg Mice Arena
Overview: 1-4 players can play as Cyborg Mice in this fast paced arcade shooter. Blast training drones to earn money and buy new weapons, upgrades and maps in the store. Customize your mouse with unlockable fur colors, cybernetic implants and extra equipment. Enlist now in the Cyborg Mice Arena virtual training program!

Name: Cycloid
Overview:
Cycloid is original arkanoid with realistic physics.

Explore 20 levels of dynamic environment, nice graphics and addictive gameplay.

Name: CuBlocks
Overview: Rotate the gems to form clusters of four or more within the time limit, then hit the targets to make it into the next round. Every few rounds the bar is raised. Two players can go head to head in an attempt to remove more gems then their opponent. Doing so will allow your avatar to attack. Knock out your adversary to win!

Name: D-Cypher
Overview: D-Cypher is based on a board game from the mid 1970's. The objective is to decypher a colour code by interpreting result information supplied after each code breaking attempt. You will have to work quickly but carefully as your score is dependent on the number of attempts made and the game elapsed time.

Name: Dark Forest
Overview:
Dark Forest is a strategy game where the player must build up their magical kingdom to lure in various types of creatures and drive the opposition out of the forest.

Dark Forest contains 11 different types of creature, 11 campaign missions and 14 skirmish missions.

Name: Dangerous Conflicts 3D
Overview: Relive the glory days of the first person shooter with Dangerous Conflicts 3D! Experience exhilerating, oldschool shooter gameplay not seen since the dawn of the genre in the early to mid 90's. Gold members can post their highscore to a global list of players worldwide and compete for the top spot!

Name: D.O.T.S.
Overview:
From the mind of a high school student, D.O.T.S. has a simple objective- Can you guide the purple dot to the blue dot?

It may sound easy, but with multitudes of obstacles, vicious toast, and over 100 levels, this may be one of the most difficult games you ever play.

Good luck.

Name: Danger Rally
Overview:
DangerRally is a simple racing game. Drive doesn't spin and drift, so you can easily manipulate a car.

The course is automatically generated by computer every time.(There are other premade courses.)The course is solid, so the car drops down when it went off the road. But the car can glide with wings. You can continue to race if your car land on the down road. And good use of glide make a shortcut.

Name: Dark Delve
Overview:
Sharpen your swords and study your Spellbooks, great adventure awaits!

Dark Delve is a first person dungeon crawler where the player explores a sinister dungeon and engages deadly monsters in exciting turn based combat. Create a custom group of characters to dissolve a centuries old curse in the 6+ hour campaign or test your skill in one of several unique challenges available.

Name: Dark Matter
Overview:
You awaken to find yourself trapped deep in enemy territory. Who knows where the aliens are, but you must escape quickly... to do that you will need Dark Matter.

Travel through 80 levels to collect the DARK MATTER needed to power your ship and escape from the alien base.

Name: Dark Quest
Overview:
Dark Quest is a turn based fantasy role playing adventure game where players assume the role of a mighty barbarian on his epic quest to destroy the forces of the evil sorcerer and save the land from evil.

An evil sorcerer has appeared in the lands, he has built a dungeon in the nearby village of Darkwood, where his minions use it as a base to raid the surrounding villages to bring terror and death to all its citizens. A hero by the name Zantor dares to defy the powers of the sorcerer and seeks to destroy the dungeon and put an end to this.

Features

• Enter a world of fantasy and adventure: Explore twisted mazes, find hidden doors and fight bloodthirsty orcs!

• Roll the skull of fate and reveal your twisted fate: The evil sorcerer will torment your soul for his own amusement, he will summon you in the sphere of judgment where you will be forced to play a twisted game of death, and can you survive his magic?

• Slaughter endless hordes of orcs & undead: Your strength, courage and strategy will be the key into wining every battle.

• Trade with the people in the village: Spend the gold you find in your adventures in the village to buy new potions, weapons and spells for your characters.

• Control a party of up to 3 characters each with their own unique abilities: Use the unique strengths of each character and work together to defeat the minions of the evil sorcerer.

Characters

• The Barbarian: A powerful character who can bring terror and destruction to all his enemies with his destructive force and skill of sword.

• The Wizard: This character is very weak in close combat but his highly potent spells are capable of altering the outcome of any battle to your favor. Use his powers wisely and you may stand a chance against the hordes of the evil sorcerer.

• The Dwarf: The dungeons are vast and dangerous but with the help of your ally Thorin the Dwarf you have nothing to fear. His quick feet and eye for danger will save you against numerous traps and grave danger!

Name: Dark Seal
Overview: DarkSeal is a strategic war game using the armies and the magic. You have to cooperate with the other magicians to protect the seal. But you also have to betray them to become the new Dark lord. Up to four players

Name: Dark Skies: Constellations
Overview: Explore the night sky with more than 116,000 stars by learning the locations, shapes, and names of 88 constellations all from the comfort of your game console without ever putting down your controller! Dark Skies offers three modes (Explore, Hunt, and Screen Saver), Explore lets you toggle constellations on and off to learn the locations while Hunt will put your skills to the ultimate test.

Name: Dark Skies: Messier
Overview: Explore the depths of space with Dark Skies: Messier Edition. Zoom in on 110 unique Galaxies, Nebulas, Globular Clusters, and Star Formations just for the fun of it or else put your sky hunting skills to the test and see if you can locate all of them without the aid of the locator. Dark Skies: Messier also includes the ultimate space screen saver of 50 Hubble Space Telescope greatest photos.

Name: Dark Storm Blast 360
Overview: "Dark Storm Blast 360" is a multi directional shooting game. The player must use both sticks to move the land fighter and destroy the target. Experience 8 levels.

Name: Darts Arena
Overview: Defeat your opponents playing online or offline 501, 301, Round The Clock and Cricket darts game. Try to get the highest winning streak in the 'Arena Mode' and compare your skill in the Online Highscore tables. Game on !!!

Name: Dashing Donuts
Overview:
Race your rolling donut down an obstacle course as quick as you can while you jump, slide and avoid obstacles along the way. Accumulate race times as a single player or multiple players can challenge each other for the best time down the track.

You'll always have a new challenge version with an unlimited number of different tracks.

Name: DATABITS
Overview:
This game is an experimental casual RTS. Player's do not directly control their units. The units are controlled by AI. All the player has to do is give the AI the right personality traits, select the best upgrades, and use items to help eliminate the enemy.

This game is designed to be relaxing.

Name: Date The Boss
Overview: Explore Peponi Island and get to know its inhabitants! Play mini-games, gamble for cash, buy and trade gifts and see if you can flirt your way to the top in this hilarious comedy RPG adventure!

Name: A Day at Grandma's House in Winter
Overview: Watch your child spend the day at grandma's house in the winter, as they sled down the mountain, skate on the ice pond, catch snowflakes, or simply make a special picture for their favorite person. Simple games designed for your young child's entertainment.

Name: Dawn of the Fred
Overview: Ever wanted to kill zombies with a Piranha launcher? Well now you can! Take on waves of the undead using some of the most ludicrous and over-the-top weapons zombies have ever seen! With over 70+ weapons in your arsenal, 5 playable characters, 2 different maps and local co-op, you're never short of ways to kill zombies with Dawn Of The Fred!

Name: Dead Meat
Overview: Stand off against an endless zombie horde. Outrun them, blast them, and collect power-ups to give you the edge! Local multi-player for 1-4 players

Name: A Day at Grandma's House
Overview: A Day at Grandma's House is a compilation of four games for children designed to improve hand/eye coordination that include a racing game, catching butterflies, jumping to catch bubbles and a game that requires the player to hit areas of a picture in order to color it in. As it is a children game A Day at Grandma's House has been designed to require a minimal amount of input from the player for ease of use.

Name: Dead Sea II: Mutation
Overview: The nightmare is not over for Shelly. After being rescued by soldiers Shelly wakes up inside a structure surrounded by the sea. Faces a new threat, and discover how it all began.

Name: Dead War
Overview: Break out of prison and fight against the growing tide of the undead. A story-driven survival horror game with elements of role-playing, squad control and combat.

Name: Dead Kings
Overview:
Dead Kings is a creepy dungeon crawling adventure. Players are reincarnated as medieval knights who must explore the ghastly interior of the hilltop castle. Able to wield daggers, swords and a single candle to light the way, gamers must battle untold creatures lurking in the darkness.

Can you survive long enough to loot the entire castle and take the Sword of Valor for your own?

Name: DeadlySpace
Overview: DeadlySpace is a game set in the far reaches of a distant galaxy. Choose your faction, build your towers, defend your Starbase. How long can you last? 1-4 Player Coop Split-Screen Action. Master 6 Different Factions. Conquer 60+ maps. Discover 25+ Towers. Musical soundtrack written just for DeadlySpace.

Name: Death Quota R
Overview:
Battle the forces of the ultimate overlord.

Split screen co-op levels and online multiplayer versus all mode.

Name: Decay: Part 2
Overview: The story continues in the sequel to Decay: Part 1. Decay: Part 2 is a thriller/horror adventure game with a very creepy atmosphere and challenging gameplay. Beat the game and unlock the extras section to get your personal code and download the amazing soundtrack.

Name: Death Closet
Overview:
In Death Closet, the player is trapped in a closet and must move swiftly to avoid energy balls which kill when touched. Energy balls are foreshadowed by brief wisps appearing where they will spawn, which allows observant players a moment to prepare to dodge them. The player can move left and right across the room as well as double-jump.

There are four modes of play. In Checkpoint Mode, the player is able to unlock checkpoints after surviving for certain amounts of time which will spawn the player there rather than at the beginning upon each restart. Hardcore Mode is the same but without checkpoints. Infinite Mode also lacks checkpoints but features random spawning patterns for the energy balls so that the game can progress indefinitely. Infinite Coin mode adds coins for the player to collect and tallies the coins collected instead of time survived.

Name: Death Goat
Overview: Death Goat is a bloody twin-stick shooter featuring hordes of brutal enemies & eardrum destroying Heavy Metal. Featuring the music of Between The Buried And Me, God Forbid, Holy Grail, Vanisher, Konkeror, Immortal Guardian, Lorelei and Ovid's Withering.

Name: Death N' Failure
Overview: You're going to die. A lot. I mean it. You'll probably even tear out all your hair and/or smash every Xbox controller you own playing this game. So for your own mental well being, I recommend you don't play it. After all, you just aren't good enough... Also includes Avatar Dash for FREE.

Name: Death Orb Wars
Overview:
Death Orb Wars is a 2D time attack game of reflexes and virtual agility where a player survives a barrage of increasingly difficult orbs as long as they can.

Beware, each type of orb has properties of its own that make it unique to the rest.

Keep your ship alive as long as you can and go for the high score!

Name: Decimation X
Overview: 1-4 player intense retro shmup. Classic 2D fixed gallery shooter. Features: Insane firepower, progressive defenses, tons of power-ups. Smooth 60 frames per second, pure arcade action.

Name: The Deep Cave
Overview:
A young boy named Pi has stumbled across a cave. An eerie light from somewhere below calls him downward, and he is compelled to follow. Where it will lead him, he does not know, but having now entered, there is nowhere left to go but down...

The Deep Cave is a retro-style platform game. Controlling Pi, the player must simply reach the end of each room to continue. However, most rooms contain numerous dangers, be they environmental hazards like spikes or gravity panels, or more active monster threats. Death is quick and painful, sending Pi back to the beginning of the room. He has unlimited lives, but the game tracks how many times he dies. There are multiple endings depending on how well the player performs.

Name: Decay: Part 4
Overview: This is the last game of the Decay series. With multiple endings, it's up to the player how the story will end. Unlock all the extras and get your personal code for the new soundtrack.

Name: Decimation X3
Overview: DECIMATION X3 (4 player shoot ‘em up): The thrilling sequel to the #1 Japan hit and proud member of the INDIE GAMES WINTER UPRISING. Back with intensified gameplay, extra power-ups, more firepower, improved retro graphics, huge bosses, and a beautifully remixed IMPHENZIA soundtrack. Developed by the “empower the player” philosophy of XONA GAMES, award-winning creators of DUALITY ZF and SCORE RUSH.

Name: Decoy
Overview:
Take a job as a professional decoy. Learn to master your vehicle and let the commander take you on an action-filled journey of crazy missions. Avoid magnetic mines, bomb planes, tanks and EMP-dropping choppers.

In infinite mode you can challenge yourself and see how long you will survive.

Name: Defender of Zorgaba
Overview: Enemy ships are starting to invade the planet Zorgaba in this fast-paced vertical shooter. Your mission is to destroy the invaders using your various weapons, bombs and unique missile locking technology. Travel through space to get to the Zorgaba atmosphere and annihilate the invasion once and for all.

Name: Defenders of the Last Colony
Overview:
The Starians came from nowhere, decimating the colonies as they passed.

Only one colony survived, carrying four prototype ships they are travelling to save what it's left of the other colonies, and taking as many Starians as they can on their way.

Defenders of the Last Colony is a Top-Down Shooter with Strategy gameplay mechanics, where you have to protect the Colony's core while you gather resources and build defenses. You play as one of the 4 classes: Fighter, Striker, Carrier or Engineer.

Fighters and Strikers focus on gun power while Engineers can build more structures (like turrets, repair platforms...) and Carriers can defends themselves while carrying more orbs to the colony.

Name: Defense Matrix
Overview:
Prepare to experience the next level of intense, tower-defense warfare in full, pristine 3D!! Plan your strategy, place and upgrade your towers, send your enemies to their watery or lava deaths!!

Source: xbox.com

Name: Decay: The Mare: Episode 2
Overview:
A new psychological horror adventure game from the creators of the successful Decay series.

Sam has ended up in an institution named "Reaching Dreams" to get rid of his drug addiction and his miserable life.

But during the first night, something happens and he gets stuck in a nightmare that never seems to end ...

Name: Deck of Heroes
Overview: Welcome traveler, to our tavern "The Laughing Elf"! Sit back and relax with this popular strategic card game. Play as either Human, Undead, Elf or Orc. Build a deck from 108 unique cards. Compete with friends and foes alike, in both local and online matches, or practice your skills against the Ai.

Name: Defend Earth or Die!
Overview:
Defend Earth Or Die! is a reinvention of the classic tower defense genre.

Build and upgrade towers in space against an invading alien horde. Unlock and use special combat powers to win battles. Push onward to the alien home world and exact your revenge!

Brace yourself for a goosebump-inducing, epic experience.

Name: Decay: Part 3
Overview: Decay is an episodic thriller/horror adventure game. The story in Decay is very dark and the game has a very creepy atmosphere and a challenging gameplay.

Name: Decay: The Mare: Episode 1
Overview:
A new psychological horror adventure game from the creators of the successful Decay series.

Sam has ended up in an institution named "Reaching Dreams" to get rid of his drug addiction and his miserable life.

But during the first night, something happens and he gets stuck in a nightmare that never seems to end ...

Name: Decay: Part 1
Overview:
Decay: Part 1 is a dark and atmospheric point and click adventure that places you in the role of a person somewhere between life and death. The game opens in a bathroom of a the players character who has just committed suicide, with the characters dead body hanging from a noose. Then the character wakes up from this 'death', not knowing what has seemingly brought him back from the dead to find a hand written note on a table outside of the bathroom that merely says ‘No friends, no family. Dead in bathroom.'

It is at this point the player takes control of the character and sets about finding out where the player is, where they are and what is going on. To do this, the player has to explore the immediate environment to uncover items that will give hints as to whats going on, either on their own or by combining the various pieces found to aid the investigation.

Name: Demon House: FPS
Overview:
Demon House is an intense first person shooter set in a steam-punk universe.

An evil alchemist has discovered how to imbue steam powered machines with the souls of the dead. Using this power he is creating an invincible army to unleash upon the world.

Armed with weapons utilizing a newly-discovered anti-spectral energy, you must delve deep into his dark abode to challenge the forces within.

Name: Denizen's Den
Overview:
A top down dungeon adventure that is randomly generated so every game is a new experience.

Over 25 weapon types, including projectiles, will be at your hero's disposal. Scrolls, Wands, Rings and potions will help tip the scales in the favor of your valiant adventurer, but beware, these dungeons will house traps, darkness like no other, secret doors and more.

Name: Denizen's Den: The Black Knight
Overview: A randomly generated turn based adventure. Become the Black Knight and explore the dungeons in search of your enchanted gear that has been taken from you. A new adventure everytime you play.

Name: DepthAttack
Overview: TPS Game. Homing is divided out of the Balkans and is characterized by.

Name: Defy Gravity Extended
Overview: A platform-puzzle game set in space. Besides the ability to jump, and a jet pack you can use in short bursts, the main novelty here is the ability to create gravity wells (and gravity repulsors) anywhere in your line of sight, which can help you traverse levels or change the trajectory of objects and enemies. The wells are strong enough to hold your weight completely, but your gravity gun has limited charges and can only be refilled when you touch solid ground. Avoid lasers, pits, and many metallic obstacles and get to the exit of each level in "The Gauntlet" to earn your "Gravitymancer Emperor" title.

Name: Delta Energy 2.0
Overview: Delta Energy 2.0 is a full combat simulation with tanks and air support units. The Game features a fully functional A.I. system, multiple player modes, and multiple teams to choose from. The game can be played with one of four teams, each with different objectives and capabilities.

Name: DEM.S-Blue Partisan
Overview:
DEM.S-Blue Partisan- is vertical scrolling shooter game.

The world is reviving from the apocalypse war. But mankind repeat the same mistake. You become cyborg Soldier "Dem.B" and fight it out.

Name: Demo Durb
Overview:
Demo Durb is a fun and simple vehicular combat game centered around demolition derby. Not only must you destroy your opponent's vehicle, but you must also strike down their driver to prevent their car from re-spawning.

The game includes two other game modes tag, and the cooperative zombie mode.

Demo Durb can also be played over system-link for a 16 player frenzy.

Name: Demon Dash
Overview: Hell has taken over earth. Now you are taking the fight to them as you run through the ruined city and take down the spawns of hell. But watch out it's dangerous in the streets and the demons are not the only thing to worry about.

Name: Derp of Duty
Overview: EX-Special Forces, EX-CIA, EX-Mall Security, EX-Assassin and All Time Ladies Man - he's the Derp! He may be the worst pool cleaner in the state but he put Derpville back on the map!

Name: Device Hero
Overview: How fast is your storage device? Has it aged well or has it become encumbered over time? Get informed with Device Hero. Go online with the full version to access global high scores and taunt your friends with the brag feature.

Name: Devilsong
Overview:
Devilsong is a third-person space dogfighter set in a dark future where mankind finds itself under constant threat both from within and without.

"Deviljacks," the spacefighters of this era, speak of the siren song of space: the lure of freedom, fortune, and glory that calls the unwitting to venture out into its depths - only to find it cold, hollow and full of danger. They call this the Devilsong.

Name: Desert Hoppers
Overview: Desert Hoppers is an ATV racing style game with four different campaigns. One for hopping into airborne emoticons for bonus points, another for on-track jumps for airtime points. Another for destructive track obstacles. Another for just racing with no hopping.

Name: Detect
Overview: Let's detect a target with the help of a picture.

Name: Devil Blood
Overview:
Journey to the dark citadel of Nethermorne in a quest to kill demons and fulfill your destiny.

Learn spells, upgrade weapons and loot powerful items to aid you on your epic quest.

Name: Desert Commando
Overview:
Oldschool 80's style military action on your very own arcade machine!

Five tough multi-objective missions including stealth, a tank rampage and of course straight up explosive enemy annihilation.

Multiple weapons include grenades, rockets, C4 and good old semi automatic machine gun.

Name: Destruction Tank
Overview: Destruction Tank is a TPS tank shooting game of full 3D. As for this game of the simple TPS-style, a single play mode and the multi-play with greatest 4 of all the 6 stage are possible by five kinds of tanks. I do not have any problem even if there is not an opponent by a multi-play. Bot makes up for lack of number of people and becomes your opponent.

Name: Diamond Digger
Overview:
With a unique puzzle mechanic, use your wits to get all of the diamonds to the bottom of the screen to collect them. Each block will crush only one other, so you need to carefully manage your playfield to avoid deadlock.

Includes a puzzle mode with 40 puzzles, timed and endurance modes and P2P high scores.

Name: Diamond Challe
Overview:
Challe is on a journey to find diamonds in caves.

Many dangerous traps or enemies can hurt Challe on her way through the caves. Beware of poisonous slime, acid, explosions and hostile creatures.

Name: Diamond Caves
Overview: In Diamond Caves you just have to collect enough Emeralds and Diamonds and then reach the exit in time. Sounds easy? Then watch out for Bugs and Spaceships, Bombs and Dynamite, Keys and Doors, Acid Pools, Teleporters, Conveyor Belts and much more obstacles to conquer. You can play this game alone or in cooperative teamwork mode!

Name: Divided Combat
Overview: Fight up to 100 waves of non-stop chaos! Divided Combat takes a unique form of a tower defense genre where you are protecting an HQ from attacking enemies. Like any other tower defense game, you use a store to create your fighting troops. Come up with a strategy early, or you may not last long enough!

Name: Diehard Dungeon
Overview:
Combining its own unique take on the real-time roguelike genre, with a nostalgic 16-bit look and feel, Diehard Dungeon is a game that feels both familiar and quite different at the same time.

Followed by a trusty, treasure collecting companion chest, you must make your way through the dungeons many randomly-generated rooms and levels. Armed with a sword and a 'hand cannon', all manner of nasty dungeon dwellers, bosses and traps will need to be defeated or traversed in order to emerge from the dungeon victorious!

Do you have what it takes to survive the dungeon?

Name: Dizeaze
Overview: How long will you last in the zombie apocolypse? Scavenge, craft and fight to survive. Play solo or in a network game with up to 8 players. With PvE and PvP game modes.

Name: Dodge These Balls
Overview: Dodge These Balls is a simple arcade action game. The player takes control of a red ball that is viewed from a top-down perspective. On the screen are also three grey balls that bounce around it. The aim of the game is, as the title says, to avoid touching these. Any contact with a ball will lead to an instant game over. As the game goes on it gets harder as more grey balls are added. The player's objective is simply to stay alive as long as possible. On mobile platforms the ball is controlled by tilting the device. The Amiga version features online leaderboards through the developer's AmiBoing website.

Name: Didgery
Overview: Didgery is a unique fantasy based card/puzzler that pits you against the rising forces of hell. Chain together huge combos of cards to restore harmony to the failing Earth. Unlock powerful entities to extend how you play and unearth a deep storyline. Will you be able to restore Didgery's throne and save the Earth from a terrible curse? Play and find out!

Name: Division Omega
Overview: Hop into your tank and prepare for battle in Division Omega. Take on hordes of enemies with up to three friends in this scrolling tank shooter. Use a range of primary and secondary weapons to lay waste to opposing tanks and terrain. The final advance has begun; do you have what it takes to lead the front lines?

Name: Divine Justice Zero
Overview: The player can choose between 6 different ships and enter in a fictional universe where 6 factions are at war. The game mechanics are pretty basic: the analog controller to move the ship with the, "A" button to shoot, "right trigger" to accelerate, which consumes shield; shield is the ship energy, if it reaches to 0 then its game over. and the "left trigger" to decelerate, which regens shield.

Name: Doc Logic
Overview: "Doc Logic" is an arcade-style platformer with an emphasis on explosive action and survival. Doc blasts across the screen with upgradeable weapons and abilities through expanding levels of increased difficulty that will challenge and engage the true gamer in you. Unique level designs combined with increasing enemy difficulty makes "Doc Logic" an intense sci-fi adventure. Do what you can to keep the clock running as you collect points, destroy enemies, and collect time bonuses.

Name: Dirchie Kart 2
Overview: Challenge your avatar against a host of Dirchie characters in fast and furious single or up to 4 player split screen multiplayer karting. Featuring standard cup races and a unique party mode, where the players alternately select from Race, Battle and Drag events across 5 or 10 rounds. On top of these modes are numerous modifiers and a penalty system so you can customise your experience..

Name: Don't Be Nervous Talking To Girls
Overview: Are you nervous talking to girls? All you need is practice.

Name: DoCoNoid
Overview: A Classic clone with special features.

Name: Dock'em
Overview: Dock'em is an addictively simple game that will tap every ounce of your multi-tasking ability. You will be responsible for safely navigating multiple ships into their correct ports while avoiding collisions with land and other boats. Share your times online over Xbox LIVE and compete for ship docking supremacy.

Name: Don't Be Late For Your Date
Overview:
When you finally get a hot date, you don’t want to be late.

Collect the coins to buy the items for the date, but don’t take your time as you are against the clock.

Also watch out for police speed traps along the way.

Name: A Difficult Game
Overview: Use the left and right triggers to control your block as you avoid obstacles in this addicting and highly challenging game!

Name: Dirchie Kart
Overview: A Hi-Def remix of 16bit kart racing in 720p and 5.1 surround, detailed physics, track friction and multiplayer options add new depth to an old formula. Challenge your avatar against a host of Dirchie characters in fast and furious single or multiplayer karting, join up to 4 friends in a split screen party of Race, Battle and Drag events with an assortment of rockets, mines and other items.

Name: Don't Call Me Skyfish
Overview: Skyfish returns in this expansion of the original "Call Me Skyfish"! A certain radioactive stick-figure hedgehog has given your game a bad review. You must defeat him with more of the same! Resave the world!

Name: Divining Orb
Overview: Divining Orb: a mystical device created to answer all of life's questions.

Name: Dogfight SKETCH!
Overview: Battle out against your fiends with Dogfight SKETCH! - the ultimate World War 2 aerial fighting contest! Set in a world of wartime sketches and doodles, you must skilfully avoid your enemy's fire and boldly take down your foe in a blaze of victorious glory! Who will be the champion?

Name: Die Pad Die
Overview: Destroy your pad today! A classic button basher with an Avatar twist. Includes 3 game modes, and online leaderboards.

Name: Dino 'Splode
Overview: Dino 'Splode is an exciting action platformer where the player controls a nearly nuclear dinosaur named Sandwich. The player travels through various unique locations, solves puzzles, survives harsh environments, and makes their way through the bloodthirsty and constantly feuding Caveman nations.

Name: Dinora
Overview:
BUILD, MINE, FIGHT, EXPLORE and PROCREATE in your own world of Dinora.

Brave it alone or share the experience with up to 3 friends in drop-in/drop-out split screen multiplayer. Hours and hours of fun in one unforgettable sandbox adventure.

If you liked Terraria you’ll love Dinora, with its unique spin on NPC interaction.

Name: Distant Galaxies
Overview: Fun and easy to play classic space shooter that tries to keep the atmosphere of those retro games from the 80s-90s. Many levels, final bosses, extra weapons and the ability to upload your score and share it with the rest of users in the World Ranking.

Name: Dice XY
Overview: Dice XY is a challenging puzzle where you must wipe out all the dices from the board. Includes several nature ambiances to get a relaxing environment. 50 levels included for children!

Name: Distraction
Overview: Plays some music and makes smoky effects on the screen. The behavior of the imagery can be affected by the xbox360 controller. Play with the effects, or turn it on in the background of your next neighborhood rave! Now featuring full 1080p support! Press Start to access the menu.

Name: Dirt Track Racer
Overview:
If there's not DIRT in your beer, you ain't at a real race!

Welcome to DIRT TRACK RACER, an incredible racing game where you fight it out on track against 40 opponents.

Name: Dokee the Dog and the Musical Rain
Overview: Help Dokee the Dog create cool music by catching falling instruments from the sky. Expand babies and children's creativity. It is more fun when a more skilled kid or an adult uses a second gamepad to play cooperatively.

Name: Distortion King
Overview:
Distortion King is a music game that is optimized for the Guitar controller, with the added option to use the standard controller. The music ranges from hard rock to heavy metal, with the options of three difficulty settings: easy, medium, and hard.

This game is ideal for anyone wanting to challenge their music skills and rock to awesome music!

Name: Don't Die Pluto
Overview:
Pluto, always being looked down on, seeks revenge and a desire to fit in.

Don't let Pluto die.

Name: Don't Fear The Sweeper
Overview:
Don't Fear The Sweeper is a straight Minesweeper variant. There is a grid and each time the player clicks on a field, the game either ends (a hidden bomb was found) or a number is revealed. This number shows how many bombs are found in the direct vicinity. Using those hints, the player has to work out where the bombs are hidden. Flags are used to mark the bomb spots. The game successfully ends when all fields without bombs are revealed.

This variant features four difficulty levels and a high-score list based on the time required to clear the field.

Name: Don't Feed the Trolls
Overview:
In a world of mountains and forests, honor the famous warning: "Don't Feed the Trolls".

You need sharp reflexes to feed the bears without accidentally feeding a troll. Don't get scared and chase them with huge slaps!

Don't Feed the Troll is a fast-paced reflex game played in 1-minute levels. Compare your scores with your friends and the best players with the online leaderboards.

Name: Don't Die Dateless, Dummy!
Overview: Man up and get a girlfriend! Choose your route carefully and win the heart of a special girl or you might end up a level 30 wizard.

Name: Doodleman!!!
Overview: Prepare yourself to fight legions of doodles with only one thought in mind: destroy. Go it alone or team up with a friend to control the page and be the greatest thing a pencil has drawn.

Name: Doomed Zombies
Overview:
The city is in distress. You are it's only hope for peace.

You are the Zombie Hunter and you must rid the city of the zombie plague. It is up to you to bring DOOM to the zombies.

25 floors to clear, power-up items and multiple weapon types.

Name: Doom & Destiny
Overview:
Four geek friends think they are going to play another night of tabletop role-playing games, but instead see themselves sucked into a fantasy world where they become would-be heroes as a mage, a fighter, a rogue and a pirate (which sort of doubles as a Spaghetti God Cleric). There they rescue a princess, battle Angry Chicken (and many other monsters) and eat pizza in their quest for hero-hood.

Doom & Destiny plays very much like a SNES classic Japanese-style RPG (down to the Attack/Skill/Item/Guard menu during the turn based battles), but with many pop references and tons of nerdy humor. As usual, you control a party of four characters, which can be equipped with all sorts of armor and weapons, and gain XP in battles which can be used to raise your stats. Battles are turn-based, and a line displayed at the top of the screen shows the order in which all characters and monsters will act, adding a layer of tactics. The game also features many optional side quests, some of which can only be performed after the end of the game.

Name: Doppelganger
Overview: Doppelganger is an adrenaline filled 2d side scrolling shooter. Save the astronauts from the evil alien invaders! Play 2 worlds simultaneously in a test of dexterity and courage!!!

Name: Dossun Island
Overview: This is scroll action game. The enemy can be defeated by causing the wave. The player can make the wave by the hip attack etc.

Name: Dossun World
Overview: This is scroll action game. The enemy can be defeated by causing the wave. The player can make the wave by the hip attack etc.

Name: Dot Dash: Episode 1
Overview: Dot Dash: Episode 1 is the first in the Dot Dash series. Full of fun and frantic action this game will leave you addicted and begging for one more go!

Name: Dot Wars
Overview:
Dot Wars is an arcade style shoot-em-up game that supports up to four local players.

Choose from any of the four commanders of the dot armies and take to the battlefield, guns blazing. Game objectives range from classical 1-on-1-on-1-on-1 brawls to cooperation in taking down legions of doom.

Capture flags in electrical power plants or hunt down your enemies while relaxing by the lava riverside.

Name: dot.Error
Overview: Dot Error. Delete the unmanned space rockets before they breach the atmosphere, edit the music, and share your high scores with friends!

Name: DoubleVision
Overview: Think you have good vision? Put it to the test! Spot the differences in the pictures. Arcade has you race the clock to get the top score. Freeplay lets you relax by yourself or compete with a friend. Want something different? Try PuzzleJunk and put your mind to the test! With over 150 different puzzles, there is something fun for everyone!

Name: DownGate Deathmatch
Overview:
Battle your friends while flying with jetpacks, walking on walls and ceilings with gravity boots, and building or destroying the world around you.

Inspired by first person shooter classics like Quake and Unreal Tournament, with all the fun of a buildable and destructible environment, DownGate is the new multiplayer deathmatch shooter from Gristmill Studios, makers of hit indie builder XenoMiner.

Name: Dr Mazing in Infinite Energy Crisis
Overview: Help Dr. Mazing save the planet! Battle ruthless robots and cold-blooded, merciless aliens in this epic journey to stop evil Lord Gazal Nim from taking over the planet. Up to 2 players can play (locally), 10 levels of robot busting mayhem.

Name: Dreams of Witchtown
Overview: Dreams of Witchtown is a 2D side scrolling action RPG. Players join elderly witch Aurora, as she embarks on a quest to save her world from the sinister forces trying to destroy it. Defeat your enemies, increase your level, and save your progress; all with one foot in the grave!

Name: Dream Divers
Overview: Guide sexy divers as they explore the seas to find hidden stars, but beware of creatures trying to ruin your day !

Name: Dream Divers 2
Overview: Explore the marvelous world of Dream Divers again while controlling sexy and talented divers.

Name: Dragoon
Overview: Dragoon is a weapon-based versus fighting game. Using 3D graphics and old-style controls. Dragoon: An exhibition match given by the hunting people who lives with dragons. Contestants wield a large weapon for their hunting.

Name: Drinkards
Overview: Drinkards is the hot drinking game on Xbox! Bring your favorite drinks, then start drawing cards. The cards dictate who must drink. Try to stay sober though, or you'll quickly start failing the Sobriety Test - and lowest BAC wins! Up to 30 players can use 1 controller, so throw a party with Drinkards! This game is for players above the legal drinking age only. Always drink responsibly.

Name: Dr Li's Extreme Beam Machine
Overview: A simple puzzle game where the objective is connect four same colored balls together and make them explode! Earn points and drop uncolored gray balls on your opponents! Includes single player and 2-player local multiplayer.

Name: Dr Popper
Overview: Dr. Popper is a bubble breaker game. Pop matching groups, the bigger the group, the bigger the score. Five game modes each with their own challenges and high scores table. Try Extreme mode for huge pops and huge scores.

Name: Dragon Forge
Overview: Unleash the deadly force of the dragon! Fight archers with bow and arrow, and mages with powerful magic! Earn upgrades and bring entire castles crashing to the ground! With awesome 3D, Hi-Def graphics, and killer goth-rock soundtrack. Dare you unleash the dragon!

Name: Drinkards: Beer Pong
Overview:
Play Team Drinkards simulation of a classic college drinking game! Powerful 3D physics make each throw a thrill while you compete with friends - at home or on Xbox LIVE.

Set the House Rules for Re-Racks, Bounces, Overtime, and Island Shots! Hone your skill against AI and a Global Score list! Unlock 3 venues and 25 tables!

Crack a can or pop a bottle, but please play Beer Pong/Beirut responsibly.

Name: Dozer's Gem Jam
Overview:
Guide Dozer through labyrinths in a quest for Star Gems.

Dodge explosions, use powerups, and find hidden passages along the way!

Name: Drag Impact
Overview:
Drag Impact is an exciting and intense, speed-action game that will keep you at the edge of your seat. The game features drag races with insane chases, car crashes and explosions. It includes multiple style themes and levels with action-packed boss battles.

Drive your engines fast with power nitro boosts and explode the enemies with explosive traps CRASH! BANG! BOOM!

Are you ready to race?

Name: Dragons vs Spaceships
Overview:
Dragons Vs Spaceships is a top down shooter which seeks to capture the essence of the genre, while putting a new spin on old conventions.

Travel across many worlds destroying the enemy, using three weapon types that combine for a total of six special weapons.

Fun and challenging, players will quickly master the controls.

Name: A Dreamland Chronicles Game
Overview: A Dreamland Chronicles Game is one part comic book, one part trivia game. To begin with, the player must read the comic "A Dreamland Chronicles", which tells the tales of a magical necklace that takes Alexander Carter into a world of magic based around his childhood dreams that is at war with the Nightmare Realm and Alexander must save. Once the player has gone through the comic, he is tasked with answering trivia questions based on the events, created by the fans as well as the creators of the Dreamland Chronicles series.

Name: The Drinking Game
Overview: The Drinking Game is a multiplayer-only game for up to 16 players which requires some real-life accessories to play, namely a lot of alcohol. The first action of a round is deciding if the player wants to continue or give up. If answered positively, the slot machine with three slots is started and depending on the result, the player needs to drink between zero and six drinks. Besides some unimportant fruits, there are three symbols of relevance: one drink, two drinks or the wrench (everyone drinks). The player who gives up last, is the winner.

Name: Drum XPlosion
Overview: Play freeform drums with up to two Xbox controllers. Simulate a full drum kit by using two drum-kit controllers. Newer model-drum controllers are velocity-sensitive! You can customize button/drum assignments; for example, you can assign a second pedal to control the hi-hat or add a second kick drum. Select from more than 50 drum sounds and modify sounds to create new drums, all while watching cool "X-Ploding" visuals.

Name: Drum XPlosion 2
Overview: Play, record, and jam along to original music with Drum XPlosion 2. Select from several predefined drum kits or mix and match from over 70 different drum sounds to make new kits. Each drum sound can be modified by manipulating pitch, volume, and reverb.

Name: Dual Zone
Overview:
Dual Zone is a fast-paced action game with space ships on a disc in space. In the Solo mode the player controls two space ships, one with each pad's thumbsticks. The red ship has to protect the blue ship from the evil red enemies and vice-versa. To protect the partner, the player has to have the ships collide with enemies of the identical color, or make them collide with the ships' particle tail. Space ships can collide with each other (and their particle tails) too. In Coop mode, each player controls one space ship.

The game contains 50 levels and a Panic mode with unlimited gameplay time. It also includes an award system that tracks both level and game skills for each player.

Name: Dromedary
Overview: Dromedary, an interactive cartoon-based camel oriented action adventure! Maybe one of a kind!! You and your trusty steed are 200 miles from home and on the wrong side of the desert. Chased by lions and cunning natives, tormented by mother-nature herself you must use your wit and guile to get home.

Name: Drooop!!
Overview: Move player to turn the field. If you clear all conditions, an exit will appear. Let's complete all stages! You can also play the endless mode.

Name: Drop Zone
Overview: Defend your cannon from incoming paratroopers.

Name: DrumMachine
Overview: Download and start creating your own drum beats with this realistic drum machine. Features multiple drum kits with high quality samples, reverb, adjustable BPM, live input and more!

Name: Drunk Zombies
Overview: Its year 2012 and the dead are coming to life! They are only after one thing, the thing we value the most..........our alcohol! You must defend your last stash of booze. For every zombie that gets past you, you will lose a bottle. Once all the bottles are gone, its Game Over. If you are able to defend your stash against all 10 waves of zombies, a special surprise waits for you.

Name: Duckinator
Overview: A game of poultry hijinxes, baby duck capturing goodness and fowl combos.

Name: Drive Fast Think Faster
Overview: Can your brain keep up with your driving?

Name: Drizzle
Overview:
Drizzle is a Frantic, Fun Puzzle Game. The player must try to collect different coloured acid rain, using different coloured buckets. The overall aim is growing trees to restore the planet to a lush environment.

Harvey the robot and his friends will help you along the way, but the hard work is really up to you!

Name: Droppin' Ballz
Overview: Play solo in two different modes and master up to three difficulties in Droppin' Ballz. Test your concentration in Fever mode and try not to fall for the many distractions that will hinder your progress or simple enjoy a simple game of classic while listening to the custom made soundtrack. Droppin' Ballz is an excellent game for all ages.

Name: Drum Studio
Overview: Finally, play, record, edit, save, and playback your own song creations using your Xbox 360 drum kit or controller! All Seeing Eye Games' Drum Studio features a powerful but easy to use recording interface, hundreds of high quality drum sounds, fully animated characters and eye-popping 1080p visuals. "8.7 out of 10", Editor's Choice Award -teamxbox.com, "9 out of 10" -xblaratings.com

Name: Dungeon Tales
Overview: Pit your might against the Dungeon Defendor. Uncover nefarious plots, battle ferocious enemies. And save the peasants! Discover 24 intense levels, with up to 4 player simultanious Co-op. Only true heros need apply!

Name: Dude, Where's My Avatar?
Overview: Don't get lost in the crowd! Use those quick reflexes to find your avatar and beat scores from your friends... and the WORLD!

Name: Duel: The Art of Combat
Overview: Duel is a side-view 3D action game full of shooting, jumping, fleeing, chasing, slashing, dodging, rope-swinging and trying to kill your opponent. The game shows its best when you're playing in split-screen mode with your friend. There's also challenging story mode and cooperative survival mode. Try it!

Name: Dungeon Smash: Dark Isles
Overview: Demons have kidnapped your princess! Battle hordes of monsters, forge your hero, rescue the princesses and bring peace to the kingdoms. Four champions each with their own agenda, infinite dungeons and multiple endings make Dungeon Smash an intense experience you'll want to share. This is the 4-player-co-op-twin-stick-shooter-fantasy-RPG you've been waiting for. Be a champion! Smash the dungeon!

Name: Dungeons of Desolation
Overview:
A mysterious stairway was discovered in the town of Desolation that leads down to a labyrinth filled with dangerous monsters and untold riches.

Do you have what it takes to explore the DUNGEONS of DESOLATION?

Name: Dunjax
Overview: Don your power armor and explore the caves of a distant planet. Battle monsters which have stolen a vital part to your ship!

Name: Duodecad
Overview: Duodecad is an arcade card battle and trading game. Configure each game exactally how you like it choosing to keep it simple or make it complex. Play against the AI or against a friend either locally or over LIVE and win yourself all the cards!

Name: Duende
Overview: High-speed robot TPS.

Name: Dungeon Adventure
Overview: Dungeon Adventure is a game in the vein of Rogue or NetHack. The player picks a character class, gender and race and sets out to conquer randomly generated dungeons filled to the brim with enemies and loot. There is a wide variety of items, weapons, armor and potions to be found. Just like in NetHack, these can be normal, blessed, cursed or do all sorts of random things to the player if he's unlucky.

Name: Duologue
Overview: Join the battle on the planet Ur to defeat the oppressive regime of Moloch, the evil leader of an army of strange and sinister aliens! Over 60 level campaign, four player co-op, and in-game medals to earn!

Name: Dwarf Madness
Overview:
A Zombi infestation forced Dwarves to leave their home of Dwyll and all the Gold they stored there, 300 years ago. Today, 4 Dwarves with Guns head back to Dwyll to take back what is theirs, and paint the walls with Zombi blood!

1-4 player Co-Op has multiple upgradable Guns and lots of enchanted Gear - but you'll need enough Gold to buy it first!

Name: E.Y.E.R.I.S.
Overview:
Every choice you make will influence the way the game is played. There is an immediate effect and a delayed effect for every decision. Choices have no explanations and you must use your own interpretation of the images shown to decide which path to take.

E.Y.E.R.I.S. awaits you. Discover your experience.

Name: Dust Devils
Overview:
Mankind was on the brink of destruction and had exhausted Earth from all its natural resources. A space exploration team then discovered that our neighbor planet Mars has a crystal that we could harvest energy from. Our last hope was to excavate those crystals. One year later the largest space launch in human history where launched to secure our future existence.

We thought we were ready for Mars, the thin atmosphere, the temperature and the tough environment, but nothing could have prepared us from what was coming. Will humanity be saved or forever perish in history? Only you can decide!

Name: Dwarven Depths
Overview: A multiplayer platformer that takes place underground. Dig down for gold, but you'll have to contend with monsters and other players. Gather treasure, lie in wait for an ambush, and lay devious traps. Procedurally-generated levels ensure that no two games are exactly the same. Struggle for subterranean supremacy!

Name: DUOtrix
Overview: DUOtrix is a colour matching puzzle game with double the action! Play two boards simultaneously in this fast paced, psychedelic game.

Name: Dyad
Overview: Welcome to Dyad! Dyads ten challenging single player puzzles and platforming levels force you to use two characters at once. Up to four players can battle to see who lasts the longest while avoiding obstacles and the competition in exciting multiplayer action.

Name: Dynasty of Dusk
Overview:
Dynasty of Dusk is a classic-style RPG set in medieval China where a young man must stand up to an emperor trying to gain immortality at the expense of an entire civilization.

Featuring four distinct classes and fully customizable skill trees, Dynasty of Dusk is a modern reimagining of the traditional JRPG style.

Name: Dysnomia
Overview: Your ship has made an emergency landing near the mining outpost on Dysnomia. All attempts to make contact with the base have failed. Your mission: Repair your ship and find out what happened here. A fast-paced futuristic shooter with exploration and survival elements

Name: The Earth Machine
Overview: The Earth Machine, a futuristic journey through an asteroid ridden space. (A combination of memory and coordinative gameplay.)

Name: Ectoplasmic Wars
Overview: Earth is again in serious danger. From the deapest space an asteroid full of ectoplasm has arrived. As the Ectoplasmic warrior your mission is to destroy the ectoplasmic menace and return earth to tranquility once again. Proof yourself through 49 levels in 7 different locations and save humanity from his terrible future fighting with your ray weapon and your brain. IF YOU DARE!!!

Name: Eat my Shuriken and Die!
Overview:
You'll need to hunt down a shuriken before you can attempt to sink it into your opponents!

Eat my Shuriken or Die! is a pure and ultimately hardcore tactical 2-4 player local couch action party game without any clutter.

Name: Earth Shaker
Overview: Can you survive 32 deadly diamond mines? Featuring anti-gravity, 4D teleport, forcefields, bubbles, elixirs, jumping jelly beans and much much more, Earth Shaker is a remake of a classic ZX Spectrum puzzle game. Written in 1990 by Michael Batty, this version includes the original graphics and sound, as well as an all new replay feature and level designer.

Name: Easter Bunneh
Overview: It's that time of year again! "You know who" is back with his construction partner, Fobahr, to help build some decorative delectable destroyable eggs! COLOR, PAINT, STICKER, SAVE, SHOW OFF AND DESTROY!!! With your help and the help of technology, the Easter Bunneh can once again spread his hard boiled painting joy to children and adults alike around the globe.

Name: Easy, Medium, Egghead
Overview:
Compete to be top of the high scores and complete exciting challenges to earn awardments for your trophy shelf. Gain experience to improve your Brain Name, move up the matheletic ladder and become Einstein!

'Easy Medium Egghead' is a new quiz style XBOX Live Indie Game for up to 4 players. Who's the best out of your friends at mental reasoning? Now there is a fun game to put it to the test.

Name: Echoes+
Overview:
Destroy the Universe in a rainbow of sugar rush colours, viewed through psychedelic sunglasses in a cheap 80's nightclub.

TRANSLATION: A fun, chaotic twin-stick shoot-em-up with 6 game modes, 4 difficulty settings, 24 high score tables, 100 trials, multiple power-ups and weapons. And it's not terrible (You might even like it!)

Name: Edgeland
Overview: "Edgeland: Trials of a lost circle" is a fast-paced, quick reflex platform game where you have to travel through the dangerous Edgeland to get back home to Circlia before it all goes square-shaped.

Name: Egyptian Rat Smash
Overview: This is a card based reflex game. The goal of the game is to collect all of the cards! Win the pile with face cards or by being the first to press the button when a pair is on the pile!

Name: The Earth Moves with the Moon
Overview: You can move the earth in space (of 2 dimensions) with left stick or direction key in your game pad. There is the moon in space.
