If both the earth and the moon are into goal area at the same time, you can clear the stage. All stars (including the earth and the moon) have universal gravitation. All stars attract other stars. There are stages where there are some black holes or some white holes.

Name: EchoSpace
Overview:
Pilot your ship and its energy weapon independently as you blast through hyperspace!

EchoSpace is a top down "shooter" which requires skill and determination. Controlling two objects at one time is difficult, but very rewarding.

You've never played anything quite like it!

Name: End of Days: Survivor
Overview: The Zombie Apocalypse has come! Can you survive the hordes until you are rescued? First person shooter survival game with unlockable weapons to destroy 1000's of Zombies.

Name: Elite Pinball HD
Overview: This is classic Pinball at its finest; Elite Pinball HD serves up a big portion of fun and addictive gameplay that will bring back fond memories of yesteryear. Explore the table through challenging and rewarding missions to prepare for an encounter with one of the strongest foes of the game, the Elite Boss. Save top scores, gain bonus balls, and warp into a new era of HD pinball!!

Name: Elite Trivia
Overview: One of the biggest and funniest trivia games ever made. Includes more than five thousand questions, custom penalties, cards with benefits, etc... In addition, an exclusive single player mode and ranking of top players. Up to four players with only one pad or more! Bigbutton controller compatible.

Name: Electric Racing Car
Overview: Race with slot cars against a friend in split screen or against the AI in one of the 24 available circuits or create your own circuit.

Name: Enigma Dungeons
Overview: Help guide the none-too-bright hero as he struggles to save the princess by going through the many dungeons set up by the odd - but evil - witch Malice.

Name: EleMental Orbs
Overview:
Forget everything you thought you knew about the falling block genre. EleMental Orbs allows you to destroy orbs with other falling orbs pieces.

You can buy pieces to help yourself or punish your opponent but be careful with your gold or you may find yourself in a hole you can't get out of.

Includes: 2P Versus and 3 1P modes.

Name: EOL
Overview:
FAST, FRENETIC, SIDE-SCROLLING, BI-DIRECTIONAL, ACTION-SHOOTER.

Defend the universe from giant spiderbots, bounty hunters, space hippies, skutterbugs, cosmic robot-dragon-sharks and many more. Survive the mind altering ‘tweaks’, the space and time bending ‘cuboid’s, and the fearsome ‘grow-blocks’. Earn permanent upgrades, new skills and powers.

DEFEND-BUILD-DESTROY.

Name: Elfland Reloaded Volume 2
Overview:
In Elfland Reloaded, you take on the role of Elfie or Elfita to try and save the elf village from threatening trolls. On your quest, you will encounter helpful turtles, aggressive birds, bouncing springs, purple elf-eaters, and other assorted creatures.

In the second volume, you will get the chance to defeat the Troll Chieftain, rescue the village elves, and receive the Elf Medal of Honor!

Name: An Elfy Winter
Overview: Wonder what the elves do after Christmas? Find out now when you play An Elfy Winter! Up to 4 players and 4 unique game modes. Fun for one or fun for all!

Name: Empire of Towers
Overview:
I am the Great Queen of Towervania. I require the bravest and most gallant knights to expand my kingdom!

Play the single player campaign or battle against others in an online world. Construct the highest towers to rule the land!

Name: End of Days: Infected vs Mercs
Overview: A plague has devastated the world! Be a Mercenary and hunt down and kill the Infected to stop the plague, or make a last stand as the Infected in online team deathmatch. Free for all matches include a 'Head Fest' option, only head shots count and your head is twice its size!

Name: The Endless Abyss
Overview:
Zachary Rickettz is a warrior who is on a mission: traveling through the kingdom and finding three relics. These are said to be cursed and, of course, play an important part in the eternal fight between good and evil. During his travels, he will visit various locations all over the medieval/fantasy game world and battle monsters as well as bosses.

The Endless Abyss plays similar to the early The Legend of Zelda titles, but focuses more on the combat than puzzle-solving: while walking over the maps, random enemies appear which need to be faced in action-based combat. Zachary has three weapon types available (two weapons of any combination can be equipped at the same time): swords for melee combat, bows for ranged combat (stun enemies) and tomes (actually not weapons in themselves, but give additional soul points). The player can activate a limited power mode which makes the next attack more powerful and results in less damage taken.

Fighting enemies rewards experience points which eventually lead to level-ups. These automatically improve Zachary's abilities (adds more magic spells) and statistics (health, stamina, soul). Stamina is used for using weapons (each attack detracts stamina and if it runs out, the player needs to wait for it to automatically recover before another attack can be launched) and soul is the magic power used for performing spells.

The overhead maps do scroll and have defined exits to the next map. In some cases, the exit leads to the world map where the next location to visit can be chosen. Besides combat zones, Zachary will also visit friendly places where he can chat with people and visit store to purchase health and soul recovery items. Gold is earned by slaying enemies or by opening chests (may also contain items). The main quest structure is linear, but there are also a few side quests (collect item X by killing monster Z) to perform. The game can be saved at any time and the hero's name changed in the beginning.

Name: Elemental Wizard
Overview:
Use your elemental staff to smash the incoming hordes of undead, orcs, goblins, troll and more.

Twin stick mayhem with fire, water and air spells and the fantastic spiraling lavaball.

Name: Endless Princess
Overview:
How long can you last in your never ending quest to free the princess?!

Defeat enemies, cheat death, and grab potions all in an attempt to make it to the highest difficulty, and with it, the top of the highscores!

Name: EP1C CAT G4ME FOREV3R!!
Overview: Help poor Kittycat get home.

Name: English 101
Overview: English 101 teaches you grammar, parts of speech, Noun - Verb Agreement, Punctuation, Misused Words, Spelling, idioms.

Name: Elfsquad7
Overview: The North Pole is in trouble and only you can help in ELFSQUAD7. Go solo or team up with your friends and family in a co-op Christmas adventure! Use your skills to stuff Santa's sac, smash freakish toys, fight Kevin - the haywire toy-building robot, and save Christmas for everyone! Santa needs your help! ELFSQUAD7...ASSEMBLE!

Name: ElectronZ
Overview: ElectronZ is a strategic puzzle game in which your goal is to dominate the board. The game isnt over until ultimately only one colour is left on the entire play field. Chain reactions and other dynamic events may turn the tide at any second and keep the game exciting. Learn how to master cells and trap unwitting opponents. Spice it up and use two colours per player!

Name: engram
Overview: Your objective in this puzzle game is to connect similar colored neurons.

Name: Epiphany in Spaaace!
Overview: Set sail on the U.S.S. Epiphany, one of the latest additions to the Universal Galactic Space Corps fleet. As Captain (or not) Philemon K. Bort, will you triumph over all of the trials that beset you or die in obscurity? A host of plot lines and possible endings await you in this tribute (or is that parody?) to all things science fiction.

Name: EquationFinder
Overview: Word search but for equation. You will have so much fun you won't even realize that you are brushing up on your math skills.

Name: Equitunes
Overview: Welcome to Equitunes, a game of balance... and bombs. Your goal is to arrange the cells of a grid, so that the number of bars inside each blue cell is equal to the sum of bars placed in the red cells around it. You only have a limited amount of time to balance the grid, so think fast!

Name: Enemy at the Gate
Overview: Only three defenders to protect our city from an endless horde of enemy invaders. They will stop at nothing, no weapon is off limits, in their quest to take and destroy what is ours. How long can you stand against the infinite enemy?

Name: Elfland Reloaded Volume 1
Overview: In Elfland Reloaded, you take on the role of Elfie or Elfita to try and save the elf village from threatening trolls. On your quest, you will encounter helpful turtles, aggressive birds, bouncing springs, purple elf-eaters, and other assorted creatures. In the first volume, your journey will take you into Gorgimer's Castle where you will have to overcome bats, puzzles, and Gorgimer's pet.

Name: Ermahgerd Ponies!
Overview: Ultimate pony racer! Collect jewels, play with friends, explore colorful worlds but whether you win or lose it's friendship that counts.

Name: Electron Defense
Overview: Total tower defense mayhem! Electron Defense is a 3D tower defense game featuring 30 challenging campaign missions with unique puzzle-like gameplay, plus an endless supply of random levels! Think you can stop those dastardly particles from escaping the game grid?

Name: Entropy
Overview:
Entropy is a 3D puzzle platformer in which you combine the effects of playing with gravity, temperature, weight and electricity and last but not least time to solve tricky mazes while exploring a mystic world.

What makes the game special is its highly interactive, physics-enabled 3D environment.

Name: Endless Swarm
Overview:
Endless Swarm is a strategy game with slight tower defense mechanics. At the bottom of the screen, there are ten spaces; two of them are occupied by factories while the player can build towers in the other ones. Those shoot at the space ships which come flying in and try to destroy everything. The player entity is the constructor which can moved horizontally, build or repair towers or manually aim towers. Building costs resources which are left behind by slain enemies (there is a dedicated button to leech those) or produced by the factories.

Additionally the constructor can shield a building or use one of three superpowers (kill all enemies on screen, repair all towers, shield everything for a time). This costs energy which builds up over time. After each wave, the factories are repaired, enemy force becomes stronger and towers can be upgraded. When the constructor dies, it gets reconstructed by the factories - if both are destroyed, the game is over.

Name: Escape From Robot Doom
Overview: Complete nine full 3D levels and escape from the recycling center.

Name: ESPERriririnTelekinesisTIME
Overview: ESPERriririnTelekinesisTIME is a 2D fixed-screen shooter. The player controls a character that must defeat square, box-shaped enemies which are constantly shooting in a straight line in front of them within a time limit. The most efficient way to achieve this is to use a combined time stop/telekinesis ability to make the enemies shoot each other, though the player can also shoot them directly too. The player's telekinesis (esper) gauge is depleted after use, but quickly fills up again a few moments later.

Name: Euchre 360
Overview:
The classic card game, Euchre, now for the 360.

Includes 3 levels of AI players and tracks several statistics from gameplay.

Name: Evacuation
Overview: Use a wide variety of tools and vehicles to hold off mutant hordes while you evacuate as many people as you can from the city.

Name: Eternal Nightmare
Overview:
You're tired of having your hand held and mindlessly stomping your enemies. What if a new game came along that required a mastery of both your wits and reflexes?

You long for shooting, platforming, leveling up, epic fights and a real challenge. These are your thoughts as you fall asleep, unaware that an evil nightmare is slowly creeping into your sub conscious...

Name: EscapePod
Overview:
Solve the puzzle and get to the escape pod before the time runs out.

There is just one problem...The enemy is trying to get to the pod first!

120 levels to complete across 8 different worlds. Includes a level editor to challenge your family and friends.

Name: Escape Hell Prison
Overview: You have been sent to hell by a demon and you must get out.

Name: Every Other Shooter
Overview:
In the year 2085, humankind has been eliminated from Earth and mutant robot death squads rule with an iron fist.

You are the resistance, a robotic freedom fighter who broke away and has gained access into their heavily guarded network complex in order to eliminate them once and for all!

30 levels of complete mayhem and tension including 6 challenging boss stages!

Name: Evil Shapes and Spaceships
Overview: You are the only spaceship left! It is up to you to defend against the ever growing hoard of evil shapes. Destroy more evil shapes to get more points, and buy better lasers!

Name: Evan Quest
Overview: Evan Quest - An interactive story book for young readers.

Name: Escapism
Overview:
A puzzle game for those looking for something different. 12 levels each with unique background art, music and increasing difficulty.

After the 12th level, Remix Mode is turned on to continue the experience until you are satisfied or until your awesomeness runs out and the game defeats you!

Name: Esoterica America
Overview: Esoterica America is an exciting mystery that weaves together the world of secret societies, esoteric literature, and personal and collective enlightenment. Sam, the son of a venerable Illuminati, goes on a search to uncover the truth behind his father's disappearance. Along the way, Sam encounters different lodges, different philosophies, and even different species.

Name: Ethel's Ice Cream Shop
Overview:
Take the role of Ethel, a little witch who has to pay for her school by working at an Ice Cream shop.

Serve as many customers as you can as fast as possible or else you will lose reputation. Keep your reputation up and meet the hourly quota to survive the first day at work.

Name: ETMD
Overview: ETMD - ExtraTerrestrials Must Die is an old school style shoot em up where you must defeat the hordes of evil aliens intent on destroying you. As you progress through the 20 levels you can gain many unlockable weapons and powers to help fight off the alien menace.

Name: Euphorium
Overview: 70-levels of chain-reaction, orb-blasting fun!

Name: Escape the Car
Overview: Collect items and use your puzzle solving skills to find your way out of this predicament! This is a port of the classic point-and-click flash game featuring new HD artwork and medals!

Name: Experiment 12
Overview:
In this prison, they do many experiments. Participation is voluntary but encouraged, as successful completion of an experiment will be rewarded with early release. Unfortunately, unsuccessful completion of an experiment generally results in death.

Experiment 12 is an action platform game where the goal of each stage is simply to reach the exit without dying. Grey squares are safe to touch, red squares are deadly, and switches will reverse the gravity. The player can also jump off of walls. Reach the door, and move on to the next room.

Name: Explosionade
Overview:
Lieutenant Atticus, the army's klutz, is stuck with guard duty during what should be the final battle in the war with the Horronym. In a shed he finds a prototype mech, "GRenaDOS", and sneaks it into the sewers for a bit of target shooting on some snakebats. Down there he unexpectedly encounters the Horronym enemy and discovers they are making a final sneak attack that could turn the tide!

Explosionade is an action platformer with some puzzle elements. All the levels are single rooms, and can be zoomed out to show the entire stage at once. The main goal of each level is to reach the hole that leads to the next, but killing enemies and picking up items will earn you points towards a highscore.

GRenaDOS is armed with a machine gun and a grenade launcher, and can hover briefly using its jetpack if you hold down jump. Grenades will bounce if you hold down the button, turning sticky once you release it. You also have a shield that can reflect enemy bullets back at them, or be used to bounce the mech for higher jumps. GRenaDOS runs on gold, so picking up gold bars will both recharge your health and give you plenty of points.

The game can be played single-player or with two players in local co-op. There are three different difficulty levels to choose from.

Name: Exisled
Overview:
Exisled is a twin-stick shooter. The player controls a helicopter which needs to destroy the HQ of The Smog in each of the eight levels. The available actions are the fire cannon (which can either be shot straight ahead by pressing a button or in an angle in the usual twin-stick fashion), bombs which are more suited to take down buildings and the afterburner for quick movement. Collecting power-ups increase weapon power.

The map can be freely explored (of course with enemy resistance) in order to find the enemy HQ buildings. After all are destroyed, the mission is won. However, there are two other building types which probably should be taken care of: radar stations (extend enemy range) and shield generators (protect enemy buildings). Being shot at decreases the helicopter's health bar, but it can be refilled (along with bombs) at the own HQ. The location of enemy and friendly HQ buildings are shown on the HUD.

Name: Experiment 13
Overview:
Experiment 12 was a success, it seems. What's next? Experiment 13, where even more deadly hazards await the inmates trying to win their release.

Experiment 13 is the sequel to Experiment 12, and plays much the same: reach the exit of each room without dying. As before, the player can run, jump, and wall jump. Grey squares are safe, red squares are deadly. Some stages have arrows that will change the gravity, this time in four directions rather than just two. Changing the gravity may also even cause certain parts of the stage to shift around. There are a total of 50 stages.

Name: Explodimals 3D
Overview:
EXPLODIMALS is a fast-paced physics-puzzle-platformer. Play as a bouncy, rolling animal head that shoots bombs from its mouth and loves cake!

Roll a giant chicken down a hill, blast pandas out of a circus cannon, bounce along a carpet of monkeys: it may not make sense, but it has 100 levels, destructible environments, customizable characters, unlockable hats, and a 3DTV mode!

Name: Exploding Imp
Overview:
Help Guff the exploding imp destroy all the magic flowers in the fairy gardens and bring them hell!

A chaotic platformer of mischievous fun. Bring destruction and carnage as you explode, hover and jump your way around multiple levels of mayhem.

Name: EvilQuest
Overview: EvilQuest is 2D retro action role-playing game. The player controls Galvis - an evil Dark Knight who wants ultimate power (and rule over the Kingdom). Galvis can find new weapons, armor and items, he earns XP to gain new levels, he can use 14 spells etc. Fighting is very simple and is similar to Crystalis. The game has 15 dungeon levels and overworld areas.

Name: Evolution: Fighting 4 Survival
Overview:
Swim, attack, eat, and engineer your species to take over the world in this action/simulation/strategy game.

All species are randomly generated for a new experience every game.

Name: Evolution II: Fighting 4 Survival
Overview:
Evolution II: Fighting for Survival is a real-time action life simulation game.

Conquer a world of randomly generated, evolving species. You and competing species eat plants and other organisms to grow and reproduce. Other species offspring randomly mutate. You can design your offspring with advancing parts. Each part can be moved and sized to achieve the best combination of acceleration, top speed, turning ability, reach and attack strength.

After you and your family eliminate all the other species, the next level is reached where your family splits and mutates into rival families. As levels increase, the challenge grows as your family split size shrinks.

Name: Excruciating Guitar Voyage
Overview: Excruciating Guitar Voyage combines a full storyline, with platform gameplay, and old-school style point'n'click elements. The "excruciating" element of the game coming from the ability to burn and electrocute the hairy moronic main character in order to solve puzzles and progress.

Name: Exelinya Burst
Overview: Exelinya Burst!, the sequel to Exelinya, is fast-paced single-screen arena shooter starring an anime character with a grappling claw. She is able to extend the claw to grab objects and then move it around to launch them again. Upon colliding these cause explosions. The simpler items are quickly followed up with larger objects such as an Xbox or large milk cartons that are partially protected by a red shield and fire bullets towards the character. These generally take multiple hits before they are destroyed. From the main screen the player can select the starting level.

Name: Exhaust
Overview:
Exhaust is a platformer similar to the Trial Bike. The player controls a monster truck and needs to guide it to the level exit. The truck can accelerate (both directions), crouch to fit into small ways, jump (usually only useful after accelerating) and has a handbrake. The levels are designed around physics challenges: the player needs to accelerate properly in order to make the jumps and avoid to overshoot. Sometimes the environment also changes because of the physics, e.g. a wood-like structure may drop down when the truck lands on it.

When the truck is in the air, it is important to balance it properly with the left stick or otherwise it may land on its roof. Usually there is no comeback possible and the level has to be restarted. Depending on the finishing time, the player can receive a bronze, silver or gold medal for each level.

Name: Exizency
Overview: The tallest tower of the city Sky Zoni is under threat. As the Air Commander, combat the militants, paratroopers and their helicopters. The game features four different modes and variety of bombs. Can you restore the Jewel of the Orio City?

Name: Extreme Jogging
Overview:
Take jogging to the next level with "Extreme Jogging".

Compete across 10 action-packed stages on the global highscore board to become the greatest jogger in the world.

Name: Explosive Gas
Overview: Fight it out in a battle royale to see who's the last man standing(and not on fire). Play with up to 8 players locally(2 per controller) or online. Includes multiple game modes and a full level editor that allows you to play your custom levels online or against merciless AI players.

Name: The Exterminator
Overview: The Exterminator is an action packed game loaded with unlockable content. Featuring a variety of bug's from bee's to flies, each with there own special power. Your goal as an exterminator is to make and get the most money and skill possible.

Name: Extreme Ball
Overview: You can demonstrate your ability and speed in this incredible game 3D. each level this full with a lot of emotion and it risks.

Name: Extreme Jigsaw Madness
Overview:
Philip Muwanga proudly presents “Extreme Jigsaw Madness” for Xbox Indie Games.

Race against the clock to solve jigsaws in this madcap puzzle game. Chain combos together to increase your score and deploy locks to guide your way while levelling up to unlocking even more fiendish jigsaws.

If it gets too hectic, bring your friends along for 1-4 players multiplayer games or relax in the classic mode

Name: Extreme XOXO
Overview: Annihilate your opponents in this strategic twist on the classic game of Tic Tac Toe! Breed your X's and O's and maintain a stable population to defend against your attackers. Welcome to Extreme Tic Tac Toe.

Name: Eye-Ball
Overview: Use your finger to knock the Eye-Ball past your opponent to score a Point. Gain points to win a Set. Win sets to win the Match! It's a little bit of pong and a little bit of tennis - just with a whole lot of eye poking! So when playing Eye-Ball, play it safe - don't blink (it could be dangerous).

Name: ezmuze+ 2.0
Overview: The follow up to the number one music package on XBOX Live Indie Games, ezmuze+2 gives you more control, more freedom and more than 1000 loops!

Name: Extreme Skill
Overview: Extreme Skill is one of the many one-button always-running platformers reminiscent of Canabalt or The Impossible Game. Using only the ability to jump, the player must navigate through increasingly difficult arrangement of blocks, pits, and spikes. Touch a spike, hit the side of a block, or fall off the stage, and it's back to the beginning to try again.

Name: ezmuze+ Hamst3r edition
Overview: Create amazing music easily with the most fun and powerful music creation tool on XBOX 360 - over 500 loops, automation controls, full screen visualizer and xbox live support to send your songs to your friends.

Name: Eyestorm
Overview: Eyestorm is a helicopter simulator game which takes place on a vast archipelago through forty exhilarating missions. The player must undertake rescue operations for survivors of accidents and shipwrecks, find missing expeditionists or transport important cargos, all within a limited time frame.

Name: Extreme RPS Online
Overview: Rock Paper Scissors World Championship's began! This game is a compound of Classic game rules and new features. Enjoy new Battle system! Fight against your enemy, became more powerful! Unlock all special characters! Play with your family or friends all over XBox Live and SystemLink...Who will be RPS Master?

Name: EyeCandy: Chromadose
Overview:
EyeCandy: Chromadose is a dose of visual coolness. Just turn it on and let it do its thing.

Use as a visual backdrop while listening to music, as a screensaver, or perhaps to make your television happy and full of life!

Name: EZ Message Sender
Overview:
English chatpad is supported. Full autocomplete support for built-in, chatpad, and T9-style messaging keyboards.

Full group messaging and banlist support. Built-in Text Art that you can send to your friends.

Name: EZmuze: Break and House Edition
Overview: Loop based music creation tool for the Xbox 360. Create great music in minutes with this fun and easy to use tool.

Name: Face-Plant Adventures
Overview: Face-Plant Adventures is a video game currently in development for Xbox 360 at indie developer oddworm games. This classic platformer features hand drawn 2D graphics, an original soundtrack, an adventure mode with 10 action packed levels to explore, unlockable medals and awards, three difficulty settings and online rankings.

Name: The Factory
Overview:
The protagonist of The Factory is the robot KC-001 who wants to escape a factory. Unfortunately he is a bit dumb and can only roll back and forth. If he meets an obstacle or a ledge, he just turns around.

The player controls a cursor and needs to manipulate the environment to reach the next screen (and eventually the next level). The most time is spent with picking up boxes, for example to build stairs so the robot can reach a higher platform. Additionally there are also switches which, when pressed, change the environment. For example, when the robot needs to reach a lower path, the player can trap him on a ledge and retract it by releasing a crate over the associated button. Besides picking boxes up, the player can also initiate a forceful push into any direction. The game features eight levels as well as a time trial and an advanced mode.

Name: A Fading Melody
Overview: Bring color and light back into the world of a coma patient as you run, leap, and roll your way through seven challenging levels. Fight off the fading darkness by stomping monsters, and watch as color returns to the black-and-white world of the game. A deep and powerful story unfolds as you progress through the levels. Discover how you got into the coma even as you fight your way out of it!

Name: Face Slapper
Overview:
Slap the ugly mugs of dudes and clowns for points, multipliers, and combos while avoiding the sweet faces of ladies and cuddly animals in this addictive slap-fest!

Earn awards by completing challenges to unlock bonuses, and compare your high scores against your Xbox Live friends and the world!

Name: Failing Bird
Overview: Flap your little wings to fly through a challenging course, but in the end you will fail! 16player couch co-op. 16player local versus mode. *Online P2P scoreboards for Gold members. This is a clone that preys on the success of an iPhone game, in hopes of a quick buck. All the money you waste on this title will be spent on my serious game project: "Lootfest".

Name: FallDown
Overview: The LAN party smash-hit comes to the Xbox. Featuring local 8 player support, this frantic, fun-filled platformer has you escaping down a deep shaft whilst deadly saw-blades whirl ever closer to you. With over 20 characters to unlock, 4 difficulty modes and unlimited levels to play, Falldown is guaranteed to keep you and 7 friends entertained for hours - or we'll find you some new friends!

Name: Falling Blocks
Overview:
Description
How long can you last, climbing up the endless tower of falling blocks?

Falling Blocks is a game where you climb up a randomly generated tower of blocks, either trying to get as as high as possible, or to tag as many blocks before the time limit expires.

It's a fast paced platformer which always has you looking for another route up the tower.

Name: Falling Down
Overview: In Falling Down, you are falling down!(wow!) Avoid the thorns, and try getting the best highscore! Made with the LarX game engine.

Name: Famous Celeb Quiz
Overview:
Do you love famous celebrities? Do you know your celebs from all walks of life, from all over the world, from the entertainment industry to science to politics - and cartoon characters and those that lived in past centuries?

Name it and we have it!

Prove just how amazing you and your avatar are, go against your friends with hundreds of questions across 5 challenging levels!

Name: Fanny Granny's Great Escape
Overview:
Blazingly fast addictive arcade madness!

Help Granny get as far as possible over several distinct landscapes. Collect food to build up boost and then "let rip" to blast your way to the next checkpoint. Collect misc. items for big scores.

How far can you get? How high can you score?

Name: Fatina
Overview:
The adventures of Fati, a little leaf fairy. You must protect Fati as she enters a dangerous forest and help her become a full-fledged fairy.

Use light and arrows to create a path for Fati, protect her from enemies, and guide her to the crystal, the goal.

Name: FarmFury!
Overview:
FarmFury! brings next-gen farming experience where you "physically" destroy your opponents farm in order to become the best in the industry!

The game is a simplified RTS game where you produce mice and cow to attack and protect defend farms and use upgrades and special skills as a tactical options.

Name: FAST FAST LASER LASER
Overview:
FAST FAST LASER LASER is the first great 4-player, top-down, competitive multiplayer game since Bomberman.

In combat, you have two weapons: a laser-blasting pistol and a plasma sword. Players can shoot lasers and tactically reflect them off of mirrors--or other lasers--to take out opponents. With the sword you can attempt to deflect incoming laser blasts with a well-timed swing.

Name: Faster, Robot! Kill! Kill!
Overview: In this fast action infinite shooter, four turrets seeking thrills encounter a young horde in the desert. After dispatching their infantry, they begin scheming on a crippled old mollusk, reputedly hiding a tidy sum of cash. They become houseguests of the mollusk, not realizing the old mollusk has a few sinister intentions of his own.

Name: Fatal Abyss
Overview: Fatal Abyss is a top down shooter in the vein of classics such as Galaga but with some modern twists. Automatically adjustable AI makes the game challenging for players of all skill levels. Raise your combo meter and get the highest score! Filled to the brim with codes and secrets, Fatal Abyss will keep you coming back for more!

Name: Fatal Seduction
Overview:
Late and drunk you stumble in, with my father ready to sin. You touch my dad to seduce, tightening your grip like a noose. But the angel said you would come, to replace my beautiful mom.

I’ll be watching you night and day, I hope for your sake you learn to pray. For if you try to kiss my dad, I’ll make you wish you never had.

Name: Fat Dragons
Overview:
Fly your dragon and do battle against enemy dragons invading your territories!

Fight within the ruins of an ancient city, then do combat among the trees in a lush jungle. Dodge the molten fireballs launched from an erupting volcano, and avoid pounding rain storms and lightning strikes amidst the clouds - all while taking out your enemies!
- Light-hearted arcade action.
- Colorful retro-styled graphics.

Name: Fantastic Fivesome
Overview:
After a visit to the doctor, the player is presented with a devastating diagnosis: death in one week! The only cure is having a fivesome with four beautiful women.

The Fantastic Fivesome is a choose-your-own adventure game. During each scene, the player interacts with one of the four potential fivesome partners. The only available interaction is choosing one of three dialogue options. Depending on the choices, the player either wins the scene (consequence: starting the next scene) or loses (consequence: trying the scene again).

Name: Farbles
Overview: Farbles is a deceptively simple retro style game featuring 30+ levels that will challenge your hand-eye coordination and dexterity skills.

Name: Fast Food
Overview: Are you tough enough to work in a fast food restaurant? Find it out with this fast paced video game and become a hamburger legend!

Name: FastBall 2
Overview: Over 5 million players, thank you very much...'Bird Tale' is the wild fly action released recently by us, get it now for FREE! FastBall is back and is faster, fun and addictive than ever...In FastBall, you control a rolling ball. In his way, there are many obstacles and his only ability is to jump. This is where he needs you, you'll make him jump by tapping the screen. With this simple mechanic, FastBall 2 contains 145 action packed levels spawned across 5 level packs. Through the levels, you'll need a good timing, pure attention as well as decisions on which path to follow to reach the level end. It is easy to play and easy to enjoy....FastBall 2 contains the following features :- An addictive gameplay enjoyed by more than 500.000 players in it's predecessor...- New game mechanics including speed zones, long jump blocks and direction signs.- Ability to play the game in different themes as "Cartoon" and "Futuristic" with wonderful graphics. More themes are coming in the following updates..- 3 Difficulty modes as easy, normal and hard. If you are an expert FastBall player or looking for maximum enjoyment than hard mode is strongly suggested.- Got stuck in a level? No problem, the new token feature allows you to skip any level anytime from the ingame pause menu. Tokens are earned by completing each 5 levels..- Includes catchy music and sound FX composed by industry leaders. Each theme has it's own music as well. If you want to listen your own music while playing, that's no problem either. Just start playing your own music before launching the game and you'll be asked at start to keep listening to it or not.- GameCenter and OpenFeint integration with online leaderboard and achievements support.

Name: Fat Cow: Hot Air
Overview: Can you help Hans Gruber the cow to elude warp-balls, save his friends and escape increasingly tangled labyrinths before his time runs out?

Name: Fast Manicz
Overview:
Fast Manicz is an arcade platform game. Collect one key on each level and go to the door.
Simple? No and yes, you can finish level at 10 seconds, but finish level before time ran out.

- There are over 70 Levels.
- Continue support
- Saving your High Score.

Name: Fear The Dronx
Overview:
Fear The Dronx is a strikingly unique puzzler for one or two players. Snare and destroy the evil Dronx mastermind on each of the games twisted levels.

A fresh and innovative take on the puzzle genre.

Name: Fawnix
Overview: Make the connection between written English and spoken English! Help engineer John Penman puzzle together English sounds and construct them correctly in their written forms. Master the fundamentals of reading through an engaging, immersive and addictive learning environment. Young gamers can team up with parents/older sibling. Reading is truly a decoding process. Crack the English alphabetic code!

Name: Feelin' Lucky, Punk?
Overview:
What path will you take? What lies behind the door you wish to open? Something basic or elaborate? Something refreshing or unforgiving? Completely new or familiar? Or something completely off the wall?

With no two excursions exactly alike, you'll never know exactly what lies ahead.

There only remains one question: are you Feelin' Lucky, Punk?

Name: FatSheep
Overview:
Play as the shepherd who has been chosen to rescue the sheep.

Call to lost sheep and get them to follow you, but they will follow you right into danger! So, be mindful of where you are leading them.

Swing a staff to fend off wolves.

Name: The Adventures of Felix Fox: Tale of the Night
Overview: The short but challenging adventure is mostly a beat 'em up formula with a few platformer elements. There's also minion adventure where players can join in as enemies to defeat you. If you enjoy the fighting or simply need a bit of practice, battle mode would be the mode of choice. There are 3 modes leaving players clawing their way to victory and 2 team modes on a total of 8 stages.

Name: Fierce Game Hunting
Overview:
A bead of sweat forms on your brow, but you resist the urge brush it off. Prone on the forest floor, ensconced by scrub and foliage, you draw the pristine, cool air into your lungs and hold it there.

With hands as still as the colossal trunks that stretch out endlessly before you, your crosshair now rests steadily on a majestic buck only a short distance away.

You, a proficient hunter?

Name: Fighter Mission
Overview:
Fighter Mission: Air Superiority straps you into the seat of modern jetfighter. Dodge missiles, engage in dogfights against enemy jetfighters, strike at enemy ships or ground installations.

Fighter Mission: Air Superiority is a fun and fast top-down-shooter with a unique tactical approach. Get it now!

Name: Figure 8 Racing
Overview:
Figure 8 Racing (F8R) is a casual racing experience which encourages vehicle contact in order to gain the advantage.

With up to 4-player split screen, multiple tracks, customisable options and mini-games F8R offers something for everyone.

Name: Fifteen
Overview: The classic Fifteen puzzle game in 3D with additional features such as a built-in Paint Studio and the possibility of importing your and your friends gamerpictures!

Name: Fight Monkey of Magic
Overview: Fight Monkey of Magic is an arena fighting game/party game with a role playing "player versus player" feel. Use magical powers and traditional fighting techniques to fight your way up to the monkey, or play in hack and slash mode to battle for the best score. 1-4 Players.

Name: Field Archer
Overview: This game is based on Field Archery, a pass-time which allows archers to experience bow-hunting without the need to shoot live animals. It involves shooting at a series of targets placed in a woodland setting and scoring for hitting the wound or kill zones of the target pictures. Features include, 40 targets set in scenic locations, 3 bow types, 1-4 players and high scores.

Name: Fields Reloaded
Overview: Your home has been overrun by enemy soldiers, and you and your crew have emerged from the ghetto to fight them head on! Face soldiers, ninjas, bombing runs, sand worms and a whole lot more. Use your time field to escape the hazards around you. Shoot through hundreds of foes and get your crew to safety in this gangsta stylized shooter / platformer!

Name: Final Failure
Overview:
Final Failure is an action platformer where the players have to choose between the sniper, the gunner, the defender or the medic to defeat a group of evil robots. Each class has a unique weapon and a special ability.

The game supports up to 4 players in local coop.

Name: Final Rift
Overview: Final Rift is a 3D game of space adventure and exploration. Collect bounties! Encounter pirates, aliens and galactic wars! Upgrade your ship to be the most fearsome fighting vessel in the Universe! Proceed deeper into rift space and help civilizations in perilous danger! Trade goods amongst the stars and meet your fate at the Final Rift!

Name: Figment
Overview:
In Figment you play as a child's action figures who have come to life in order to save a boy from dark forces. Toys that have turned into monsters!

Play as one of two characters, or both in co-op as you battle through hordes of evil figurines and mutated play things to save your human in this beat 'em up style action adventure!

Name: Filler
Overview: Filler is a simple and addictive action game originally released on the Xbox 360 in 2009.  Developed by SimianLogic, the game centers around a core mechanic where players must fill two-thirds of the screen with balls to progress through levels.  The gameplay involves strategically placing balls at the top of the screen, using them as a shield while they fall, and managing a dynamic difficulty curve that evolves with shrinking balls—introduced to prevent players from exploiting the game by filling the board with tiny balls.

Name: Finish
Overview: Finish is a simple game where the player controls a little black ball while trying to make it to a purple ball. The Player must watch out for the anything object other than the purple ball or else the player will lose a life. Nine Worlds. Ten Levels per World.

Name: Firebies, The New Zombies!
Overview: If you think you know everything about zombie games. You should try this one!. You would be surprised!

Name: Fireworks HD
Overview: Unleash the awesome power and beauty of an infinite supply of mortar shells. Take command or just use it as a screen saver. The choice is yours! The full version features rumble support, more simultaneous launches, 16 awesome backgrounds, and more!

Name: Firing Range 2
Overview: The sequel to the top selling FPS aiming indie game is here, bigger than ever! Featuring 12 weapons in 4 categories, sniper rifles, customizable weapons with lots of camouflage sets, night vision mode, and online versus multiplayer. Test your skills against other players in thrilling 1vs1 showdowns! Brought to you by Milkstone Studios.

Name: FireFly Vegas
Overview:
FireFly Vegas - an intergalactic themed casual twin stick arena shooter with action packed retro arcade gameplay, vibrant graphics, a frenzy of visually impressive particles systems and custom atmospheric audio.

Developed using the R.A.C.E (RockMint Application Construction Engine) and bespoke music by Phatso Records, providing an intense, immersive and highly playable dynamic gaming experience.

Name: Find Teddy!
Overview: Find Teddy! is a simple puzzle game intended for young children. The player is presented with a selection of teddy bears and must use a set of clues to determine which teddy is the correct teddy based on their physical appearance. Throughout the game, the player can unlock items with successful guesses that can be used to create their own teddies. The first level has 4 teddies with 2 clues, the second has 9 teddies with 3 clues, and the hardest level has 16 teddies with 4 clues.

Name: Finish 2: Colors
Overview: The sequel to Finish. Finish 2: Colors offers new levels and a whole different way to play. Use A,B,X,Y to control your colors and reach each mark. Test your skills.

Name: Firecracker HD
Overview: Do you love firecrackers, explosions and also more firecrackers? Yaystuff brings you what you desire...in HIGH DEF. All firecrackers contained within are genuine, real explosions. Chemicals were combined, ignited and are now no longer with us so that YOU could bring the action home for the new year!

Name: Fireworks Spectacular
Overview: Turn your Xbox 360 into an endless fireworks show!

Name: Finger Twist-Up
Overview: See how agile your fingers really are with this unusual game.

Name: Fire Up
Overview: A Velocity Game, Race against the timer to put out the fire which is quickly spreading through the building. With Local and global Highscores.

Name: Firing Range
Overview: Test and improve your FPS aiming skills! You'll need both reflexes and skill with all kind of weapons to get the best world ranking. Includes lots of dynamic camouflage sets to fully customize your weapons!

Name: Fireplace
Overview: Enjoy the awesome ambiance of a crackling fireplace in your living room. With realistic smoldering embers and flickering flames it sets the perfect backdrop for a relaxing evening.

Name: First South Beer Pong
Overview:
This Xbox version of the game beer pong allow for people around the world to join the brotherhood of First South and experience a match of beer pong.

The game is taking place in the kitchen of the legendary First South dorm at Helsingkrona Nation, Lund, Sweden.

Name: Fish Bait
Overview: Imagine arkanoid or breakout but under the sea. 20 Levels, featuring 5 different power ups including multiball and laser guns.

Name: Fish Squid Time Machine
Overview:
"Fish Squid Time Machine is scary and loud. Also the controller often vibrates. I hear that's called rumbling.

There is a donkey. I'm not sure why. I have heard that you control the fish squid, but this is not readily apparent." - Lan , doesn't play games, age 30.

FSTM interbreeds the Fishie Fishie and SYNSO series. Each button controls a different player.

Name: FishCraft
Overview:
FishCraft is a ballistics game heavily inspired by Finnish casual game Angry Birds. The fish are out to seek revenge on the cats for eating their friends and family. The way to accomplish this is by means of firing themselves at the cats (who have built fortresses to protect themselves) with a cannon.

Gameplay consists of the player adjusting a cannon (power and aim) towards the cat fortresses and fire various fishes at it, with the goal of eliminating all cats before running out of fish. The game is physics based, which means that hitting the fortress in certain weak points will make it collapse over the unknowing cats. There are several different types of fish with different properties (one, for example, can be made to explode on impact causing major damage), and each stage has a set number of various fish. The trick is to figure out how to utilize them best to finish the stage with a high score.

Stages unlock as the player finishes them, and there are 63 all together. For each finished stage, the player receives a star rating showing how well he/she did.

Name: First-Person Mathematics
Overview:
First-Person Mathematics is a mathematical adventure where the player must navigate rooms without standing on any tiles marked with incorrect sums.

Fail and you plummet to certain doom, but if you succeed you can take your rightful place amongst the great mathematicians of history.

Name: Fish Game
Overview: Save the lost fish by guiding them home before they wander off!

Name: Fish Hunter
Overview:
You are a fish in the ocean fighting to survive. Eat other fish, grow up, evolve and unlock new species.

Watch unlocked fish in aquarium mode. Play with your friend in Coop mode or deathmatch game with ranking.

Eat or be eaten, be an ultimate fish!

Name: Fish Listening to Radio
Overview: Fish Listening to Radio is a four-player minigame where each player controls a fish who must eat as many worms as they can off of fishing hooks, while avoiding the hooks as they rise back out of the water. However, all the fish together are listening to a radio, and must work together to keep the hooks from stealing the radio away from them -- if the radio is stolen, everybody loses. The game features a sketchy pencil and crayon art style that continually gets more colorful as the game proceeds.

Name: Fish Racer Arcade
Overview: Race through the sea while avoiding obstacles and your opponents. Collect powerups to give youself that extra edge. The last fish swimming wins!

Name: Fishbowl
Overview: A fishbowl is a small world. Battle it out between your friends or family. Race for food while avoiding mines and gaining power-ups to be the first to satisfy your hunger. Do you have what it takes to survive the bowl?

Name: Fishie Fishie Fifty
Overview: This is a one button game, but your Xbox has many buttons. Conundrum! That's why I added 52 person multiplayer. Grab one Xbox, 0-51 friends, and any button/stick/trigger/dpad, then mash like your score depends on it. Fishie Fishie was freeware, visited WiiWare, and now hits XBLIGeeware as a streamlined, burpified, poly-piscine wonder. Enjoy!

Name: Flag Hunt
Overview:
Flag Hunt extends the complex game play and strategy of Chess into a contemporary wartime environment.

You have a choice of different battle modes as you command tanks, jets, helicopters and missiles with the help from radar trackers to sniff out the enemy and win the battle.

Name: FishPop
Overview:
A competitive game where each player tries to take over the pond, filling it with their own fish, while knocking other players out of the game.

Overpopulate cells with fish so that they jump into neighboring cells, taking over opponent fish. Using special items- lure, freeze, or flush your opponents' fish.

An extended form of the chain-reaction type game.

Name: Fishing Girl
Overview: A game a about a girl, a boy, and an ocean full of fish. Fishing Girl is an arcade fishing game with over 10 different fish to catch and 8 rod and lure upgrades.

Name: Fishy Warfare
Overview: The goal of the game is to defeat the enemy toy submarines using a submarine you construct out of various components purchased through the shipyard, all while confined to a fish tank.

Name: Fiskal Clif
Overview: Fiskal Clif is the Cat to save the U.S. of A! Drive your prototype AmeriCar along a cliff of certain doom, where you earn more Money the faster you go! How much fiscal risk will you assume? Try to set your best Global High Score and earn enough cash to unlock helpful items and Medals of Honor! Driving this car may be a worse job than working for Congress, but only you can prevent a default!

Name: Fist Puncher
Overview:
Fist Puncher follows a team of vigilantes led by Dr. Karate, world renowned neurosurgeon and black belt, as they perform unnecessary surgery on the crime lords that hold a lawless city in their brutal grip.

The gameplay is true to the classic era of button mashing brawlers, as players choose from a colorful cast of characters and take to the streets to battle relentless waves of thugs and ruffians. Fist Puncher combines the glory days of multi-player beat 'em ups with modern gameplay elements like unlockables, easter eggs, achievements, and RPG elements.

Tase tweakers on a nude beach, crash a nazi birthday party, attack villains with swarms of killer bees, convert enemies to boyfriends with a flirtatious kiss attack, battle suicide bombers, power up your beard, punch out protesters, or just run around and collect as many hotdogs and cupcakes as you can carry - it's Fist Puncher so expect the unexpected.

Name: Fitba
Overview:
Fitba is a soccer game which allows players to participate in friendly matches, cup tournaments and leagues. This game's unique selling point is its approach to passing and shooting: instead of pressing buttons, the players directs the ball's direction and speed by using the right analogue stick. The movement direction is controlled independently. When on the defensive, the player can tackle. Another specialty is Fitba's approach to dribbling: how well the athlete controls the ball is shown by its highlight - if it is weak, he will likely lose control soon.

The game is action oriented and loses some real-life rules such as offside or added time. There are three camera perspectives, two difficulty modes and the teams/athletes can be edited.

Name: Fittest
Overview: Fittest is a dual-analogue shooter in the same style as Geometry Wars. It has multiple game modes, and many skins/music themes. There is an emphasis on multiplayer games, with unique bosses designed to be beaten through cooperation between the number of players in the game. The bosses encountered largely depend on the number of players in each game. Online play is enabled.

Name: FITS-Fishing in the sea
Overview:
Let's take part in the sea fishing rally!

This is a fishing game for up to four people. The rules are very simple. Push the A button when the float sinks completely.

You can catch about 100 kinds of fish in this game. Information on the fish that you caught is added to your record. When you win a championship, fish that you caught might swim in the aquarium.

Name: Flappy Worlds
Overview:
Help Flappy and all of his friends flap their way through all 6 unique worlds.

Flappy Worlds is the sequel to Flappy Feathers.

Profit for this game will be used to help fund Indiemon: Thunder Region and Indiemon Villain Version 2.

Name: Flap
Overview: In Flap you are Sir Erin. A brave knight on a quest to free the land of Erda from the rampaging Soastiks. The Soastiks are building magic standing stones to extract the Mana from the ground. Destroy the Soastiks to release Erda from their clutches! Flap is a simple sprite game designed for the Xbox 360. It is simple to control and has a range of levels designed for all the family.

Name: Flappy Mech
Overview: Flap into science fiction mechanized adventure as Flappy Mech! Soar between mechanical pillars and compete for top scores with Xbox Live Gold!

Name: Flapping Avatars
Overview: All the fun of the smash hit 'Flappy Bird' but with avatars on your Xbox 360! Enjoy the new multiplayer mode and share your scores globally with the updated scoreboards!

Name: Flappy Wrecker
Overview: Fly a determined bird to his inevitable death or just destroy everything. The choice is yours!

Name: Flappy Feathers
Overview: Help Flappy in this addicting and challenging game!

Name: Flappy Monkey
Overview: The gameplay is similar to Flappy Bird, but instead of a bird you play as a monkey, and instead of pipes this game features crocodiles as obstacles. Players will need to fly sideways and score points whilst doing that. These points can be obtained by eating a banana, shooting down birds, or pooping on a vegetarian, teacher or their chalk board.

Name: Flappy Avatar
Overview: All the fun of the smash hit 'Flappy Bird' but with avatars on your Xbox 360! Enjoy the new multiplayer mode and share your scores globally with the updated scoreboards!

Name: The Flashlight
Overview: Set your Xbox brightness to unsurpassed levels! With this flashlight app, you can quickly and easily illuminate the entire room with the push of a button, or activate STROBE MODE to experience the most awesome light spectacle you've ever seen!

Name: Flash Cards for Kids
Overview: Flash Cards for Kids - created to display the ABC's, Numbers, Colors, Shapes, and more. Never worry about losing flashcards around the house, use the included voice acting, or turn off the sound. Now includes a demo mini game, more to come! Future updates are planned to include more content/languages. Ages 0-4 and up.

Name: Flatland
Overview: Traverse your way through Flatland by maneuvering through each level and rotating the screen 90 degrees at a time. A new twist on the Point A to Point B puzzle. 100 total levels with varying degrees of difficulty.

Name: Flight Adventure
Overview: Enjoy the fun of flying while exploring the beautiful island. Try to land anywhere on the island. You can't believe you came safely to a full stop on the ground? Check out the replay function where you can examine in detail with all available cameras how you made it happen! Save the best part of the replay to show off your flying skills to your friends!

Name: Flowrider
Overview: Flowrider uses a large scale realtime fluid dynamics simulation to provide a unique top down racing experience. Online, split-screen and single player are supported. Futuristic visuals in full HD and a custom-composed soundtrack complete the package.

Name: Flupp the Fish
Overview:
Play the three Adventures of Flupp, a tiny fish! Dress your fish with nice little clothes and accessories for a little bit more fun.

Escape: Help Flupp to escape! Dive at the right time to float through the water. Avoid rocks and jelly fishes, they slow you down. Collect stars and diamonds to get faster and faster and swim away from the monster fish.

Survive: Navigate the little fish through the sea and avoid the obstacles.

Rush: Drive with a car and collect stars to get faster and faster. But be careful, there are some holes and enemies, you have jump over them. Try to get waterdrops to fill your fishbowl!

Name: FLIRT
Overview: Get busy chatting to Real People Online. You could meet that special someone today.

Name: The Flow
Overview: In The Flow, the protagonist is a ball which automatically moves forward. The player's job is to press a button to jump over holes in the ground. When the button is held, the jump gets longer. Additionally the player can change between three gravity modes (normal, light, heavy) which influences the ball's jumping behaviour. When it falls into the ground, the level has to be started all over. Points are rewarded for each second the ball touches the ground;

Name: FlipSide
Overview:
Flip and slide your way to action puzzle bliss. Whether you want relaxed-but-tricky puzzles, computer opponents or endless tiles raining down - Flippin' has you covered!
Flippin' uses a board made of double sided tiles. You can flip a tile so what was on your side is now on the far side and vice versa. Flip pieces to get 3 like symbols on your side horizontally or vertically and they will go away and give you points. How big of a match can you make? Pieces then fall quickly down and you can use them to make a combo to multiply your score. There's even a tutorial mode that quickly teaches you the rules as you play.
The best puzzle game you'll play this year on the iPhone or anywhere! Highly addictive, great looking, finely-tuned gameplay, 5 fun characters to chose from each with their own unique catch phrases and great sounds to boot. A steal at double the price.

Name: Fluidityk
Overview:
Fluidityk is a unique next-gen music visualizer: it uses realistic fluid dynamics (fire, smoke, oil and water) reacting to your own music for a beautiful and artistic result!

Fluidityk's high resolution fluid simulation uses 100% of the Xbox360's processing power and works with music from your hard drive library or streamed from a Windows PC using Windows Media Player.

Name: The Flight Before Christmas
Overview:
In The Flight Before Christmas, Santa Claus automatically rides his sleigh over the roofs of a city. His job: delivering all presents via chimney express. There are four presents available which are thrown by pressing the associated buttons. It is not only required to press the button with the correct timing, each chimney also requires to deliver a specific present.

The overall goal is to earn as many points as possible before the time limit runs out. These are obviously rewarded for correct deliveries (a combo is built up when not missing any shots), but points are removed for delivering the wrong present or not hitting a chimney. Santa's sled has an optional spotlight which shows when to press the button. However, using it has a point penalty.

Name: Fluffy: Operation Overkill
Overview: A virus. Mad animals. And a squirrel in a hazard suit. Fluffy: Operation Overkill is run and gun gameplay at its finest with powerful weapons, devastating special attacks, physics powered violence, epic boss fights and a rewarding skill kill highscore system. Oh yeah, and it has got zombies. Get ready for a rollercoaster ride into hell!

Name: Flippin' Shadows
Overview:
Light-hearted competition that's great for friends or family, and a great party game.

Watch the shadow of a moving object cast upon a curtain, and try to choose from 4 possible items quicker than opponents. Double-point and Lightning rounds spice things up so anyone could have the most points when the flipping is done!

Play with up to 4 players or CPU opponents, in multiple unlockable game modes.

Name: Flood Frenzy!
Overview: Test your speed and intellect with this addictive strategy-based puzzle-solving thriller.

Name: Flight Adventure 2
Overview: Experience the legendary P-51 Mustang. Unlimited free flight. Six race tracks. Race against yourself using the racing ghost option or test your flying skills in an online multiplayer session with a friend. Produced under license from Boeing Management Company. P-51 Mustang and Boeing are among the trademarks owned by Boeing.

Name: Flip Cup by Drinkards
Overview: The drinking game of friendship and rivalry, Flip Cup is now on Xbox. One-handed gameplay design lets you easily Chug and Flip while holding a drink! Party with up to 40 players and enjoy frantic splitscreen for 4 teams! Come see how we craft the best in drunk fun - with Drinkards and Drinkards Beer Pong under our belts this is our best yet. You won't be disappointed - or sober! Flip responsibly.

Name: Flip N Shift
Overview: A match-3 puzzle game where the player can flip colors to their complimentary counterparts and shift gems around the board across 50 levels of increasing difficulty.

Name: Flotilla
Overview: Lead your orbital battleships to victory in Flotilla! Fight, trade, and explore new planets in your journey through the galaxy. Discover upgrades and artifacts to install on your fleet ships, and engage in battle with bounty hunters and pirate space-chickens. Featuring tactically rich 3D combat, flank and surprise the enemy from any direction. And when the dust settles, generate another uniquely randomized universe for a brand-spanking new adventure!

Name: Fly Butterfly, Fly!
Overview: Introducing Butterfly, Mr Twiggles, Barnabus Bumble and friends, here to keep your children entertained for hours. Catch the butterflies and witness the joy as all their friends join in the fun. A game so easy to play and yet so much fun even grandma will want to play.

Name: Flyby
Overview:
Feeling nostalgic for a classic arcade shmup? Want to just sit back and blast some baddies? Then Flyby is the game for you!

Fly across space and take on an endless wave of enemies. Earn powerups. Keep track of high scores!

Name: Flycatcher
Overview:
Web swinging spider fun. Swing through the trees to catch flies, beetles and more. Avoid dangers such as gas attacks and hornets.

Includes local leaderboards.

Name: The Flying Dead
Overview:
The Flying Dead is a horizontally scrolling shoot 'em up in which the player shoots down aircraft piloted by zombies. Despite the goal always being right, the player can still turn around and fly in the other direction (however, this means there is no reverse flying). Each contact with a foe or other obstacle is deadly and results in a direct respawn. When all lives are gone, the level has to be started again. At the end of each of the twelve levels waits a boss. Besides a standard weapon, there is also a limited amount of smart bombs available which clear the whole screen.

On the way there are coins and power-ups to collect. The latter have certain effects when picked up, e.g. weapon upgrades, additional movement speed or temporary invincibility. The coins can be used in the level select screen to buy upgrades for the next started level: weapon upgrades (rockets, rapid fire), additional smart bombs or additional lives.

Name: Flying Zombie Invasion
Overview: Fly your avatar into explosive battles against a ridiculously massive swarm of flying zombies.

Name: Flytrap
Overview:
Flytrap is an arcade-style game where you control an anthropomorphic venus flytrap as it defends baby Flytraps from attacking enemies.

Since you're a venus flytrap, you not only need to stop enemies in their tracks with a squirt gun, but also swallow them down with your inhale attack.

Name: Foosball For Two
Overview: Foosball for Two is a table soccer game. In contrast to real tables (4 rows with 11 players per side) each side has only two rows available: one row with three players directly before the goal and one row with two players at the beginning of the penalty area. The participants can control the two rows separately up and down, use swings or do a random launch. While serving, the participant can aim, spin and launch. The game features two difficulty settings, the choice between a 10 or 21 points winning criteria and the option of watching a match between two AI teams.

Name: Football Games Room
Overview:
Play football with friends in your virtual games room. No friends? Then play against the computer.

Play one off Quick Games or compete against 16 other teams in a World Cup Tournament. 32 National Teams. 15 Built in formations or create your own to gain the extra edge.

Play as male or female characters.

Name: Frequency
Overview: The world is your weapon! Use the colour from the world around you to fight enemies and solve puzzles. Features unlockable game modes with multiple endings.

Name: Fortune Cookies in Bed
Overview: The most advanced "Fortune Cookie" game ever made.

Name: Fun in the Gulf
Overview: Fun in the Gulf is an implementation of the abstract strategy board game Lines of Action. We hope you enjoy our unique, internet-phenomenon-influenced theme as you play this classic board game for what is probably the first time (if you are a college-aged male who spends 10-20 hours per week online, we know you will).

Name: FreaKick
Overview: FreaKick is a soccer free kick game that allows 2 players to either be goalkeeper or kicker and try to score or block the goal. The player can also practice against the defenders. Curving with the thumb stick allows for special free kicks and the instant replay feature allows the player to see the amazing goal. The camera can be controlled to fit specific viewing needs.

Name: Footboholics
Overview:
Select one of 4 football teams and run through 40 levels of frustration and fun.

Good luck!

Name: Fridgy
Overview: Have you ever made words or messages using alphabetti spaghetti or the magnets on your fridge? Well, Fridgy allows you to do exactly that by turning your TV into one big fridge! In Fridgy you'll be able to spell out words, messages and simple math using the letters of the alphabet, the numbers 0 to 9 and symbols like + or =. Fridgy may not be a proper game but it is a lot of fun and time flies by!

Name: FortressCraft Chapter 1
Overview:
There's never been anything like FortressCraft on Xbox before now. A world of blocks that YOU create, on your own or online.

Playing as your Avatar, place blocks to shape the landscape around you. Build huts, houses, forts, castles, cathedrals, towers, mazes anything you can imagine. Find Relics - Boots of Speed, DestructoGun, FreezeRay and more!

Name: FortNight
Overview:
In this game you wake up in a forest, with nothing but your knowledge of zombie killing, and your bare hands! You must collect materials to build shelter before night falls, and zombies attack.

Build epic fortresses, construct weapons, and survive for as long as you can! Invite a friend to help you in your journey, and kill twice as many zombies... together!

Name: Fruit Attack
Overview: Match falling pieces of fruit to make combinations in this arcade puzzle game. Four 1-player game modes are available, including Quest Mode, which presents a series of interesting gameplay challenges. Battle Mode allows you to play against a computer opponent. Two split-screen 2-player game modes are also available.

Name: Fractalus
Overview: Explore the MandelBrot and Julia fractals. Light up your TV with fantastic patterns. Play with the colors to create a beautiful scene. Listen to your music or the music provided with the fractals pulsing to the beat!

Name: Funky Punch XL
Overview: Bust a funky beat down on friends and foes in this crazy, quirky 3D fighter. Battle it out with 12 funky brawlers, 9 scenes and 5 modes of play, including Training, Arcade, Versus and Survival. Also, get in a little funky networked chaos on XBox Live in Online mode. So go ahead and get Funky Punch XL and feel the funky flow within you!

Name: Freeze Everything
Overview: "Esko the Eskimo" must save his town from The "Baddie Bads" and their Master "King Baddie."

Name: Four Player Tangerine Fight
Overview: Four Player Tangerine Fight is a hilarious 2-4 player fighting/party game built on the Herman game engine.

Name: Four Winds Fantasy
Overview:
An old man, shunned by the people of his town, has always stayed on the outskirts of his village. When his son disappears, however, he must enter the town and explore the cave nearby in order to understand what happened.

Four Winds Fantasy is an action/RPG presented in the traditional Quikding style. The crude graphics and abstract dialogue combine to give an overall nightmarish feel. The gameplay is simple and roughly-presented, but the short length and multiple endings encourage multiple playthroughs.

Name: Fractopia
Overview:
Fractopia uses the power of your Xbox graphics processor to enable fast, interactive exploration of the beauty of the Mandelbrot and Julia fractals.

Math has never been so pretty!

Name: For Glory
Overview: Battle your way through a seemingly endless horde of monsters on a journey to stop their evil leader. Defeat monsters to earn glory and upgrade your equipment.

Name: Fright Light
Overview: Experience an intense, strategy dependent game disguised as a cheesy parody of all those jump scare "games" we love to laugh at. Master the art of tracking up to four intruders at once along with timing your flashlight reloads for maximum protection from your enemies.

Name: A Frog Game
Overview: The object of A Frog Game is to jump and use the frog's tongue to catch flies for lunch. The player is awarded points based on how many flies get caught and also how quickly they are retrieved. Get 10 flies in a row and the player will be rewarded with a 20 point 'multifly' bonus. A two-player competitive mode is also included.

Name: FromPulse
Overview:
Your world is at risk in this story-driven retro rhythmical platformer!

Discover the universe of music creatures in their battle against forces disrupting the harmony of their planet. In search of a lost artifact, you play as the young Vegah in departure for Earth.

Do you have what it takes to travel through time and bring back the mighty item?

Name: Four Corners
Overview:
Use ninjas, witches, archers, vikings, samurai, and a slew of other units to destroy your opponent's capitol and make yourself the superior season! You will have to conquer spires and golems as you battle and make them your own.

Design custom maps, possess units for special abilities and auras, and discover all the secrets!

Name: Full Contact Racing
Overview: Oval track racing inspired by British stock car racing where contact is encouraged and necessary to win. Crash and bang your way to victory with 5 player online multiplayer or practice and experiment with physics in single play test drive mode.

Name: Freak Out
Overview: Do you think you can beat this game? Control your speed and your jumps to get through, but remember: Don't freak out!

Name: Fredriksdal Assault
Overview: Fredriksdal Assault is a multiplayer game with two game modes, Assault and Deathmatch, where you can play with split screen, over a local network (System Link) or over the Internet (LIVE).

Name: FS racing
Overview: Fight against time in this old school arcade racing game. Race in 14 circuits in 9 different scenarios with four cars with different characteristics. High speed at 60 frames per second.

Name: Fumbo
Overview: Fumbo is an African themed puzzle game designed to be casual yet mentally challenging. Fumbo does away with the overused bubble bursting, board clearing, time limited scenarios of the puzzle genre and replaces it with a puzzle that is challenging but allows the player to solve it at a comfortable, relaxed pace.

Name: Frankystein
Overview:
Frankystein is a platformer game. Guide professor X to collect all bones to reconstruct the skeleton of Frankie.

You must take the skeletons flashing first.

Name: FUNNY MINI GOLF
Overview:
Play MiniGolf like you've never done before! Complete the to 20 challenging holes placed into 4 unfeasible scenarios: a city, a medieval castle, a beach and a farm ...

A fully 3D environment with physics of the ball near real, bonus for time and score and 'strange' animated obstacles. Try to center the holes if you can ...

Name: Fork Lift
Overview: Play as Charles the fork as you climb the never ending kitchen, but be careful of the broccoli that awaits above...

Name: Frog SPLAT!
Overview: On a magical island where seasons change super quickly live tree frogs who are in a struggle for dominance all year around. It's every frog for themselves in a froggy free for all. Stay up in the branches and come down on your enemies like a ninja, or catch special flies for super powers!

Name: Fruitbash
Overview: Fruitbash is challenging puzzle action: Either try to solve all puzzles in the campaign mode or prove your reflexes when you're battling against up to 4 other players via XBOX Live!

Name: FPS Trainer
Overview:
Dominate in your favorite first-person shooters! Increase your thumbstick accuracy! View a graph of how much you're improving. Try and get into the High Scores!

Practice in the Training Grounds mode and completely customize your training sessions. Impress your friends with your pure speed!

Name: Fractal Dive
Overview: Explore the fractal space rendered in real-time! Sometimes geometrical, sometimes biological, but everytime spectacular, wonderland expands in your display. You might feel the God in the infinite pattern generated from simple mathematical formulas.

Name: Funky Balls
Overview:
Blast off to space with your avatar and tackle 25 fiendishly difficult levels of platforming action, designed put your skills to the test.

Race against the clock to collect gems and monkeys. Unlock new balls to roll, jump slide and grapple your way to goal!

Name: Furball
Overview:
The ultimate party game!

Gather up to 15 of your friends for non-stop competitive arcade action! Furball combines the fun of a great 2D shooter with an innovative 4-players-per-controller style you've never seen before.

Features include computer players, lots of powerups, and full customizability.

Name: Freestyle Football Trials
Overview:
Think you’re awesome with a football? How will you fare compared to the best on the global score boards?

Easy to learn, difficult to master keepy-uppy and freestyle football trials, let’s see if you’re as good as you think you are.

Name: Fritter and Waste
Overview:
What's the most action-packed part of any game? Boss fights!

Fritter and Waste won't slow you down with a heavy story line or an endless grind. In either single player or 2 player co-op mode, fight boss after boss and their minion horde in this action-oriented MMO-gameplay inspired game.

Name: Fortress Wars
Overview: This isn't an expedition to mine or craft! We're here to battle! Take your avatar online for a showdown in a fully destructible and customizable world! Tag other players and avoid getting knocked out as you shoot to be the best!

Name: Fuel Depot 360
Overview: Fuel Depot 360 is a space combat game. Your mission is to protect the 10 fuel pods from the invading pirate ships. To help you succeed your ship is equipped with a variety of weapons. As you advance to higher levels the game difficulty increases.

Name: G-Men
Overview:
Have you ever wondered what it's like to be a garbageman? Wonder no more and step into the exciting world of garbage collection.

Dodge obstacles and collect garbage in 4 unique garbage trucks!

Name: G.O.R.K.
Overview: Battle your way through 12 levels of intense action as you seek revenge against your misguided creators.

Name: The Galactic Aquarium
Overview:
The Galactic Aquarium is a fun, addictive game that's easy to get into but hard to master! Try to breed all the different types of fish to get the daddy of them all, The Cod Father!

Watch out for fish with special abilities, like the Chameeleon and the time warping Bronzefish, that can cause chaos in your fish tank! And try to manage what's eating what so you can make the most money and be top of the online scoreboard.

With over 40 different types of fish, you'll have to keep on your toes - or fins ;) - to keep your tank running smoothly. Luckily, you've got your handy breeding guide to help you along your way, and your freezer to store fish that are ready to breed.

Good luck!

Name: Game 35: The Experiment
Overview: At first glance, Game 35 would seem to be another of the simple jump-only platform games like Canabalt or The Impossible Game, with the addition of control over forward motion. However, it quickly becomes apparent that this is a game about trust -- trust that nothing is as expected. Spikes fall, platforms appear from nowhere, and in general, the way to success is often the most reckless. But what about when that trust becomes the expectation? Well, everyone makes mistakes...

Name: Gallows
Overview:
Poor Billy is hanging for his life. Save Billy from a gruesome death upon the gallows.

Strap on a bow and arrow and cut Billy down. Better have a good aim, Billy only has so much air.

Test your skills in 40 unique levels.

Name: Galactic Thunder
Overview:
Aliens have taken over your base and turned your own defenses against you! Fight back against overwhelming odds and battle your way through six action-packed levels, alone or with up to three friends in co-op play.

Non-stop side-scrolling action, classic arcade-style gameplay, and an explosive soundtrack!

Name: Galactic Conquest
Overview:
Galactic Conquest is a old school RTS where you retake the galaxy from the evil Arachnid Empire.

Specialize your planets and fight back with five different types of ships in fleet-style space combat. Or fight your friends in two-player online multiplayer space battles.

Name: Galactic Escape
Overview: Ready to escape from the galactic caves? Challenging levels await you so watch out! You might encounter unpleasant surprises! Can you make it to the top of the Best Times list? Will you still be able to handle the stress of running out of time, fuel or health and making it to the end safely?

Name: Galax-E-Mail
Overview:
In the future, e-mails are no longer sent via internet - they are delivered via space ship. The player controls one of those delivery ships and needs to finish various deliveries. The ship can be freely moved through the 2D plane, the goal is to kill all enemy bases (which also spawn hostile ships) and enter the wormhole which opens up afterwards. Gameplay is the traditional twin-stick shooter style: one stick moves the ship while the other aims and fires.

Each destroyed base also rewards a buddy, basically a copy of the main ship which mimics its moves. Those buddies do not only increase firepower, but also serve as extra lives. However, after each death the emails are scattered through the level and need be collected.
