On the way there are a variety of extras to find which can be positive (e.g. health, power-shot or more aggressive buddies) or negative (e.g. slow speed or reversed controls). The effects stack.

The difficulty increases after each level and before starting a new game, it can be set between 0 and 100.

Name: Game Type
Overview:
Help Hoodie Girl fight the evil MediaBall's inane advertisements and get a new high score!

A game in two parts: First, brave your way through a confusing maze of menus, then take to the air as the indefatigable "Hoodie Girl" and blast sentient advertisements into cold, hard cash!

Name: A Game About My Cat
Overview: Go for high scores and do tricks as you sled the legendary slopes of Mt. Kittimanjaro. Also includes a laser pointer toy for your cat.

Name: Game Frenzy
Overview:
With eight games, you will have fun for hours. This collection features many of your favorites such as Blackjack, Slider Puzzles, Tic-Tac-Toe, Concentration, Reaction, Skeet Shooting, Ballochet, and Pong.

All of the games are in one convenient package providing you with hours and hours of enjoyment.

Name: Game of Horror
Overview: Forced to play a "Game of Horror" by your disturbed capture, you must search frantically for the key to escape the mansion before you are hunted down. Jump scares galore await those not faint of heart!

Name: Game Training Volume 1: Dexterity
Overview: Hone your controller dexterity with the first installment of Game Training series. Play through 10 levels of excitement with custom music, fantastic backgrounds, and increasing difficulty.

Name: A Game of Hockey
Overview:
A Game Of Hockey is a version of the classic Pong variant with two sets of paddles. The goal is to bounce the ball past the opponent's pair of paddles to score points.

In this version it is possible to play up to four players in teams of two.

Name: A Game of Tennis
Overview: A Game of Tennis takes the classic game of Pong and brings it into the present day. Gameplay is still the same as it always was (use the paddle to get the ball past the opponent paddle to score points), but added to this version are local and online multiplayer modes, plus online scoreboards.

Name: Game Training Volume 2: Flight
Overview: Hone your flying skills with Game Training Volume 2: Flight. Fly fighter jets and take down enemies to complete achievements in this breathtaking flight simulator. GT2 is a great "Starter Flight Simulator" for people who are new to the genre and don't want to purchase a full Flight Sim or for people who just want to casually fly a fighter jet around and shoot stuff.

Name: Game Created by a 5th Grader
Overview: This is a simple shooter game. The goal is to shoot down various aircraft and the objects dropped by them. There are multiple levels with a story line. The game was conceived and initially written by a 4th grade student, and ported to XNA (with help from Dad) when he was in 5th grade. All game design, artwork, and the storyline were done by him.

Name: Game about a soup factory
Overview: An abstract/artistic fast paced puzzle game entirely in greyscale. Match the shapes to remove them before they encroach on your safe area, destroy multiple shapes at once for a combo bonus. Features a dynamic ambient soundtrack which builds spookily the closer to losing you get. Stores a previous best score.

Name: A Game You Can't Beat!
Overview: Jump over blocks and nails to Take the Ball to the end of the level, sounds easy, well it is not. If you want a good challenge, try this game.

Name: A Game You Can't BEAT! 2
Overview:
A Game yOu can't BEAT! 2 is a sequel to the XBLA Indie game A Game you can't BEAT!!. As with the original, meaning the player once again has to guide a ball across a 2D side scrolling screen whilst having to dodge hazards such as gaps in platforms, floors that collapse as well as spikes. A Game yOu can't BEAT! 2 also has had its graphics re done and improved.

As with the first game, co operative gameplay also makes a return for two people on a single Xbox 360 console.

Name: Gemologist
Overview: Your objective in this puzzle game is to find similar colored gems in groups of three or more.

Name: Gamefarm Math Quiz
Overview: Choose your favorite farm animal and go hog-wild challenging your barnyard buddies in a game of cerebral mind-ticklers. Hen-peck your way through a range of math problems, from basic math for the baby chicks to mind-crushing equations for cocky roosters.

Name: Gems N Rocks
Overview: Gems N Rocks is a remake and expansion of the classic Boulders type game. Many different enemies and objects are included. Also included is a level editor, so you can create and share (via Memory Unit or USB stick) your created levels. Challenge your friends to complete levels you create! Many built in levels included for entertainment and inspiration!

Name: GameFinder
Overview:
Find the right game for you with a myriad of ways to sort through all the games available on Xbox LIVE Indie Games!

View the games in 3 intuitive interfaces. Rate and review them, and then share reviews with other users. Tell a friend about games you like quickly and easily.

The best way to find and review games on your Xbox!

Name: Gamerbots: Third-Robot Shooting
Overview: An exciting LIVE third-person shooter where you can: Stick your Gamer Picture on Gamerbot; Customize your Gamerbot with 15 heads and unlimited color combinations; Fight with 6 basic weapons and 10 levels of upgrade in 4 criteria; Compete with worldwide players on LIVE; Challenge to 24 single player missions; Get promoted to 7 Gamerbot classes; Fight with random enemies in 6 scenes.

Name: Gamerscore Tracker
Overview:
Gamerscore Tracker tracks day to day Gamerscore changes, ranks players against their friends, and ranks them globally in the Global Tracker by total Gamerscore, games played, and total achieved as well as Gamerscore gains over periods of time.

Where do you stack up against the world?

Name: Gentlemacho
Overview: Exploit the power of a true gentleman and whip enemies with your mustache on your noble quest for freshness in this funny and lighthearted 2D action-adventure sidescroller, with old-timey movie cutscenes, classic but crazy gameplay and HD graphics!

Name: Geo Bots
Overview:
Geo Bots is a challenging, 3D, top-down shooter similar to Asteroids or Geometry Wars with single and co-op gameplay.

Players compete for the highest scores, which are saved for posterity.

Name: Geology Business
Overview:
Have you ever wanted to know how it feels to drown in money? Say no more fam, in Geology Business you get to mine for ancient hidden gems worth a fortune, and don't forget about the spicy memes on the menu.

Getting tired of pickaxes? How about a gun?.. How about an AK47? How about choosing between over Twenty different tools to mine with? Everything from Lasers to Bamboo sticks.

Having stones as the only items to find can be rather boring, so the boys and I decided to add anything under the sun the list. Which has led to a collections of over one hundred different items to find.

Name: A Game For Alexander
Overview:
A Game For Alexander is a game made for 8 month old toddler Alexander by his gamer dad. Since Alexander isn't old enough yet to shoot aliens or dodge space rocks, this game was developed with his skillset as a gamer in mind.

Pressing the different buttons or moving the analog stick will trigger things to happen on screen. For example, pressing the blue X button will make the screen flash blue followed by a voice naming the color. Moving the analog stick will create a colorful trail which the player can sweep over the screen. Pressing the other buttons will trigger different actions on screen, such as farting noises and much more.

Name: Gerbil Physics 2
Overview: Our gerbil friends are back and they are more foolhardy then ever! Help them learn the impact of ropes, slingshots, bombs, disintegrators and machine guns on their slight furry forms. Venture into heaven, hell and several places in between exploring 40 new levels, mini-games, and dastardly puzzles. Gerbil Physics 2 is the most fun you can have with gerbils whilst still being borderline legal.

Name: GemChase
Overview: Help Cpt. Kurky to collect powerful gems. Time is running against you, threats can approach, you need to utilize the stations architecture, find the shortest ways to the gems by using portals or opening gates with triggers. While Cpt. Kurky is narrating your doing in his special way you have to take care of the time, fuel, hull damage, stations damage, incoming threats and much more.

Name: Gateways!
Overview: Gateways is a 2D platform game set in the lab of an inventor called Ed following an outbreak of a number of his more "creative" experiments. Can you help him escape the lab?

Name: Generic Space Shooter
Overview:
Welcome to an epic world of endless carnage, where you battle alien foes at lightning fast speeds, and engage in mind meltingly epic boss battles.

Immerse yourself in a beautifully hand crafted world, with visually stunning top down graphics and unlimited action packed levels.

Name: Genix
Overview:
Genix is an action packed shooter and puzzle game, that strips back vanity in favor of tight and addictive game play. Featuring crafted line-art graphics through a 3D perspective, wickedly sharp controls, 30 unique levels, 9 awesome weapons plus much more!

This game is ideal for those who have nostalgia for games like Space Invaders and Galaga.

Name: Games Master: Xbox Game Guides
Overview:
Games Master features over 500 Game Guides and Walkthroughs for popular XBOX 360 games.

All guides are fully searchable.

Name: Garden Gnome Carnage
Overview:
Because video games cannot be completely abstract, they sometimes spitefully adopt absurd plots: an obstreperous garden gnome, fed up with cheerful elves dropping presents down his chimney, has ripped his apartment building from its foundations and installed it on wheels allowing it to roll left or right. To defend it from their resolute holiday cheer, he has tied himself to the end of a bungee cord secured to the chimney atop the building, and threatens to dislodge any elves attempting to scale its sides using his own body, manipulated (much as in xWUNG) through subtle adjustments in the building's rolling motion.

But the elves don't give up, and soon show up in flying sleds to parachute down! Fortunately this arms race escalation goes both ways, and the gnome can snatch bricks from his building's facade to fling at the elves and sleds, racking up bonus points for combo collisions. If things get really hairy (when elves reach the building's roof, they untie the bungee), he can even call in a limited number of air strikes to level the playing field! (This is a well-connected gnome.)

Name: Gentlemen Start Your Engiiines
Overview:
Experience the thrill of pack racing at high speed, dodging cars in the 43-car field at 200 MPH.

Powerslide your way to victory!

Name: Garrett the Slug
Overview: Garrett the Slug is a Snake variant. The player controls Garrett over the single screen in order to collect colored items (labeled foodstuff). However, each time one is eaten, Garrett leaves a longer slime trails behind his way. When he hits either his own trail or one of the rocks, the game is over, the amount of collected foodstuff is displayed and a new level is created. The rocks are permanent during one round, but the foodstuff re-spawns in other locations when collected.

Name: Gerbil Physics
Overview: Physics-based gerbil demolition fun! Buildings formed of gerbils await destruction for your amusement using a variety of demolition tools. Use bombs, ropes and disintegrators across 24 levels of gerbil mayhem including the 'terrifying' Iron Gerbils. No gerbils were hurt during the making of this game.

Name: Gear Head
Overview:
Help the mechanic find all of the parts for his car so that he can continue to enjoy his summer time cruise across the country.

The full version includes 12 levels of platform action where you can explore 3 worlds while avoiding lions, badgers, rabid penguins and more to help save the day.

Name: Gem Breaker Twist
Overview: Gem Breaker Twist is a fun and addictive colour matching game with a twist. Break matching gem clusters, while rotating the game board to create new and larger clusters for larger scores. Play three game modes all with local highscore boards and each mode tracks players statistics. Gem Breaker Twist is fun for the whole family, easy to learn but hard to master.

Name: Gem Chaser
Overview: Simply collect the coloured gems to match your colour - then change your colour to collect the others - Simple - but amazingly Challenging - With 70 levels to beat.

Name: Galactic Fortress
Overview:
The ultimate game of skill and teamwork!

Pick from five different classes with unique abilities that suite your playing style.

Don't just fire and forget. Take complete control of your weapons. Fire rockets and guide them around corners, zoom in for head shots with snipers, and hurl grenades over walls!

Play cooperatively or competitively against bots in team deathmatch and capture the flag!

Name: Gem Chaser II
Overview: Gem Chaser’s back and his quest for precious gems continues. Collect the coloured gems that match your colour - then change your colour to collect the other., Simple - but amazingly Challenging - Now with Warp tunnels, Gravity switches and Mirror levels. With 70 new and even more challenging levels to beat.

Name: Geriatrix: Zombie City
Overview:
The apocalypse is here!

City streets around your retirement village lie in ruin while zombies run amok! Only you... an 82 year-old ex-vietnam war-veteran with alzheimers and a heart condition is able to put a stop to the undead's reign of terror.

Try not to soil your pants!

Name: Football League Simulator
Overview: An exciting simulation of English football (soccer). Sit back and follow your team through a season of hard fought matches. Fully simulates all four main leagues including promotion and relegation. Also simulates end of season playoffs. View statistics like consecutive wins, consecutive games without defeat. Great for the armchair football fan!

Name: Geroneko
Overview:
Geroneko is a nonsensical Japanese 2D action game. In "the month of 2X157", Earth is destroyed in an explosion, launching all of its animals into space. One such animal is the titular Geroneko, the "ultimate companion animal", who flies through space aboard his tuna-powered Mug-Rocket. In order to create a new planet to replace Earth, Geroneko must shave all of the floating animals he comes across so that he can construct the new planet with their fur.

To complete each level, Geroneko must shave every animal (by colliding with them) before they can be sucked into the black hole in the middle of the screen. Geroneko's Mug-Rocket has limited fuel, but can be refuelled by collecting cans of tuna. If Geroneko allows any unshaven animal to fall into the black hole, if he falls into the black hole himself, or if he collides with one of the dumbbells floating around, it's Game Over.

Name: GET TO THA CHOPPA!!1
Overview: Zombie apocalypse has come!!1 Can you survive zombie hordes, mines and heat seeking missiles to safely get to tha choppa in this twisted and addictive reaction game? Global high scores will put your skill to the ultimate test!

Name: Get Your Cell Together
Overview:
Evolve or die!

You are a tiny cell floating around somewhere in the universe. You will have to evolve and add cells to your original cell.

BUT!!! Watch out for evil bosses and nasty viruses.

Name: Get Your Girlfriend Into Games
Overview: Get Your Girlfriend Into Games! is a set of minigames designed specifically to engage any woman in video games entertainment. Best played in couples in versus mode. Suitable for children too!

Name: German 101
Overview: Learn German with 1000 flashcards featuring the most commonly used words.

Name: Get Off My Island
Overview: Tourists are invading GOMI island - use a slingshot to toss fruit at tourists & destroy their buildings, or create your own boards & share with friends.FEATURES:-63 original boards-Game center integration with achievements and leaderboards-Multiple fruits, each with unique abilities - shooting, bombing & heavy duty destruction.-Physics-based demolition game; the more you destroy, the more points you get-Introducing BUILD-A-BOARD!!!!!!!!BUILD YOUR OWN BOARDS-Use our custom board builder to create your own unique boards. -Share your custom built boards with friends-Search and play the best boards built by people all over the world giving you UNLIMITED amount of boards!-Level editor: save & revisit your levels-Save your favorite boards built by others in our favorites section.-Rate your friends boardsBOARDS-WITH-FRIENDS-Share and play as many custom built boards with your Facebook friends-Play any of your Facebook friends boards with a click of a button-Send your friends a push notification and email to simply challenge them to beat your board.BOARD-OF-FAME-Each month the 21 MOST PLAYED boards will be entered into our board of fame section and be part of our game forever!-When someone plays your board you will receive 1 play. So make sure to share your board with as many friends as you can!To see where your board ranks, go to www.VisitGOMI.com

Name: Get The Ball
Overview: Although it may not be the most complicated game, Get The Ball could possibly be the most addicting game you'll ever play. The objective is simple: get the ball as quickly as possible. Features intense, fast-paced 4 player gameplay.

Name: GET TO THA CHOPPA TWOOO!!2
Overview: Are you ready for round twooo?! GET TO THA CHOPPA is back! Control a hot gun wielding girl, dodge missiles and mines, shoot zombies and use all new extras like the njyon pup or knight power! Not enough? Online highscores will put your skill to the ultimate test! Go, go, go!

Name: Get Rich or Die Gaming
Overview: A young man, Wilson Cooper, is playing video games at home, something his Dad forbids him to do. His Dad unexpectedly returns home early to find Wilson in the midst of a game. Dad is so furious, he kicks Wilson out of the house and leaves him on the streets of a ghetto. It is at this exact point you take control of Wilson Cooper, and guide him to riches.

Name: Giball
Overview:
Giball is a breakout game. Do you like Arkanoid? You'll like this.

Features:
- Over 50 Levels
- Continue support (Password)
- Big Monsters
- More Bonus...

Name: Ghosts of Tarr-Minos
Overview: Thirty years after the defeat of the dreaded Minotaur, it is time to return to the maze of Minos Island once again in this retro dungeon adventure. Randomly generated items, monsters and mazes will test your luck, skill and perseverance. Seek out hidden doors, locked chests and the best equipment as you delve ever deeper. Relive the times when television had both intelligence and vision!

Name: Ginga Saikutsudan
Overview:
Dash. Leap. Fly through 3D space.

Mining robot "Binyon" needs ore, and he will stop at nothing to get it.

Name: GGC X
Overview: Christmas, Schmistmas. STOP THOSE PESKY CHEER-SPREADING ELVES!!

Name: Ghastly Ghouls
Overview:
LOW PRICE FOR A LIMITED TIME ONLY (MORE LEVELS ON THE WAY)

The city is under attack by monsters, can you rescue the town's people before it's too late?

- Fight your way through 6 challenging levels, with more levels to be added regularly at no extra cost.
- Each level contains unique enemies which get progressively meaner and harder.
- Contains original artwork and music.
- Retro style gameplay

LOOK OUT FOR VERSION 1.1 CONTAINING THE ALL NEW HALLOWEEN LEVEL

Name: Ghost Mine: Dig for Survival
Overview:
Imagine you were hopelessly lost in an abandoned mine, struggling to survive. By the faint light of your lamp you peer into the darkness.

You have the sinking feeling that someone, or something is watching your every move...

Name: Ghouls N Gals
Overview: Explore a scary mansion, encounter sexy damsels in distress and join up force with other gorgeous ghoul huntresses to clear the mansion from it's terrible curse!

Name: GHXYK2 Classics Vol. 1
Overview:
GHXYK2 Classics Vol. 1 is a collection of surrealist art pieces disguised as games. It contains:

Maek Like Bike: A side-scrolling adventure where the player controls a bicycle on a mission to catch the Apollo 13 rocket launch. The environment is extremely surreal, constantly flashing with random words and images. After catching up with the rocket, the bike is taken into space, where it must locate a black hole. The black hole then turns the bike into a shaver which is then used to shave a man's head.

Random Cartoon Generator: A animation of two pointy-eared creatures who head into town after being dissatisfied with what's on TV. The dialogue spoken by the characters and locations visited is randomized each time.

My Humps My Dumps: A side-scrolling infinite runner game where the player controls a camel running through a desert. Points awarded are based on time spent alive, with more points awarded the closer to the moon the camel jumps. Colliding with a dune ends the game. The player's high score is recorded.

Name: Giant Hunter
Overview:
Go giant hunting with friends online or in single player using your Avatar in a huge block based world!

Mine for resources, craft the items you need then set out on an epic adventure together!

Build amazing creations in the offline and online creative mode too!

Name: Gizmo the Puzzle
Overview: This is a puzzle game. Gizmo (green) and blocks (red) fall at random , well stacked, Sometimes the water appears, it flow Gizmo. Blocks arranged in a row, it will disappear.

Name: Gladiators Escapade
Overview: Join Xanthus in his journey to take revenge for his tribe and see the down fall of a tyrant. Gladiators Escapade brought to you by Drop Dead Interactive is a puzzle / maze, action game full of exciting dungeons to explore and escape.

Name: Glare
Overview: Glare is a fast paced arcade style shooter that bases its difficulty on the players skill level during the game.

Name: Glow Arcade Racer
Overview:
A retro top-down racer reimagined in a 3D world of light. Perfect for when you need a quick fix of frantic arcade action.

Intuitive controls for up to 4 players as you race to beat the AI, unlocking new tracks, weapons and play modes as you progress.

Extend the game by creating your own tracks for limitless racing combinations.

Name: Globe Clicker
Overview: Test your geographical skills with Globe Clicker, a full 3D experience of Planet Earth! Rotate and zoom to point at the given location. Points are awarded for accuracy and speed. Try the challenge mode to be the first in the scoreboards, or play only with a restricted list : World Capitals, USA, Europe, World Heritage Sites, ...

Name: Glowbz
Overview:
The year is 6,000,004. Earth has depleted its energy reserves as a result of leaving appliances on stand-by 24/7.

A new source of energy has been discovered in the form of Glow Power contained in a nice crispy outer shell called Glowbz. However, the only source of Glowbz is located in a remote sector of the galaxy inhabited by the Blatnokz... more »

Name: Gingerbread Holiday Sharing
Overview:
Decorate gingerbread houses and share your creations with friends over Xbox Live.

Have snowballs fights against your buddies or enemy gingerbread men.

Name: GLITNIR
Overview: The human race constructed the space station [GLITNIR] as a first step of the space advancement. But, the space alien doesn't like us. They will attack our space station! Defend the space station by using the space satellite!! This is "3D Tower Defense" game.

Name: Global Hawk
Overview: Global Hawk is a game where the player controls a plane searching a city for geotags. The player can color their plane in several different shades before entering a level. Levels are 3D environments which are explored from a behind view perspective. Geotags are represented by spinning objects in the level and are collected by flying into them. A certain number of geotags must be found and collected in order to complete each of the game's four levels.

Name: Globoid
Overview: Avoid the falling balls and stay alive as long as you can.

Name: Gingerbread Holiday
Overview: Decorate gingerbread houses with your avatar in a wacky physics environment. Play with friends to decorate faster or throw snowballs to mess up their decorating. Construct icing, nut and candy structures to stand on, bounce on marshmallows from rooftop to rooftop, or play with the snow. Come and play!

Name: Gitigiti
Overview: In this crossbreeding RTS, you have to keep crossbreeding stronger slimes to counter onslaught of evil slimes!

Name: Global Warfare
Overview:
This is an online first person shooter game, where you play free for all against up to 7 other players or bots, play on 6 unique multiplayer maps and rank yourself up to become General of the Army.

Mission coop 4 players. Play up to 4 player split screen local or online, and if you have a 3D tv, you can even play the game in 3D.

Name: Go! Avatar Go!
Overview: Just push A! Avoid bottomless pits, spikes, the Wall of Death and bring your Avatar to safety. With each level comes a new A Button challenge. Discover what the A-button does, tap it slowly, press it fast, or hold it down to get past the treacherous obstacles.

Name: Go Gimbal Go
Overview:
An evil robot has imprisoned the children who inhabit the once-peaceful Rainbow Island and is filling the world with monsters in this 2012 racing-style platformer for Xbox 360. As the spherical hero Gimbal, the player must master 24 challenging path-based, obstacle-filled courses before the clock runs out if they are to free the children and restore peace to the land.

Each level features a series of ribbon-like strips that Gimbal travels along. In order to dodge enemies and traps, Gimbal can morph to the other side of the pathway, jump to other nearby pathways, or take flight in his ship the Star Rider. Each segment of pathway has its own gravitational pull, which leads to some exciting gravity puzzles and challenges. Each level has a time limit, though, so the player has to be quick on their feet and dutifully rescue trapped children who in turn help Gimbal by adding a few precious seconds back to the level clock.

Name: Go Go UFO Smackdown
Overview: Fly into outer space in order to defend your planet from destruction! But, beware. In this four-sided celestial brawl, everyone is fighting for their own survival. Be the last planet standing by bouncing the onslaught of oncoming comets into your neighbors. When the mushroom-clouds settle, only the vicious and the quick will remain!

Name: Goals!
Overview:
EXPERIENCE GREAT SOCCER GAME PLAY IN THE MOST
ENJOYABLE FOOTBALL GAME ON THE APP STORE
_____________________________________________

INTUITIVE CONTROLS
You're at the heart of the action as you direct your players with the joystick touch control. Deliver a timely pass to your striker with the action buttons and then round the keeper and blast the ball into the opponents net.

ATTACKING
Pass player to player or hit a long ball up field as you take on the opposing team. You have full control of the player with the ball and can change to other players when the ball is free or with the opposition.

DEFENDING
Guide your defenders and help them block or slide tackle to win back the ball. Slide in from the side and steal the ball to win back possession.

SHOOTING
In GOALS you can score in many varying ways. Shoot from close range, round the keeper and slot one into the empty net or blast one from long range and curve it into the top corner! Yes, you can add after touch curve to the ball which makes taking free kicks a real joy.

FREE KICKS & PENALTIES
Slide tackles from behind may bring the referees whistle! Outside the box and a free kick will be awarded. Players line up to form a wall, so try bending the ball around and into the goal. An infringement inside the box will bring a penalty, use your judgement to slot the ball into the corner of the goal.

FEATURES
* Fast and fun arcade game play
* Goal kicks, corners, throw-ins, free kicks and penalties
* Set opponent AI skill
* Five difficulty levels
* Atmospheric soccer sounds

REPLAY
After each goal is scored you can view it back in slow motion, reliving your awesome footie skills!

CASUAL GAMING AT ITS BEST!
GOALS is a great time killer, always ready to fill your spare time with a quick match.

Name: Go 3D
Overview: FrogSlayer Studios presents, Go, an ancient Chinese game of strategy now available on XBox Live Community Games. Learn to play with our interactive tutorial and then play against your friends locally or against players at all skill levels via XBox Live.

Name: Gold Digger The Comic 1-7
Overview:
One of the longest running comics in history by a single artist. Celebrating 20 years in publication and still counting, Gold Digger by Fred Perry is a unique blend of humor, adventure, and science.

Now you will be able to experience the first 7 issues of the action paced color series on you XBOX 360.

Name: Gold Miner
Overview: Classic game of gold miner. Travel through a mine collecting gold. Watch out for the creatures in the dark cave!

Name: Goblyn Stomp
Overview: Help Mr. Chap Scaliwag clear his street of the goblyn infestation! Use your fantastic stomps, remote mynes and spinning cane to defeat as many of the menacing monsters as you can!

Name: Good Sir, A Balloon Race!
Overview: Challenge the Automated Aeronaut or a fellow Gentleman to a sport of ballooning courtesy of Super Boise Games.

Name: Golden Tangram
Overview: Can you solve the mythical Tangram puzzle and transform all pieces into pure gold? Challenge your brain with 250 puzzle patterns for three different puzzle types. Or create and save your own puzzles in freestyle mode.

Name: Gory Cyber West
Overview: This is THE best cyber western duel simulator 2013!

Name: Googly-Eyed Splitters
Overview: A fun side-scrolling platformer, with a twist! Roll, Jump and Split your way through a whopping 40 levels to finish the game. Beware lava pits, lava boulders and being crushed by platforms as you play! With both skill based and puzzle based levels you're sure to enjoy playing this cute little Indie Title!

Name: GOOLIN
Overview:
Get in Goolin, the giant robot!

Use only the A button. Try to carefully consider how to go about each step along the way.

Can you manage to get a higher score than your last attempt?

Name: GoonyCru Day One
Overview: A store. A customer. And a trainee with grenades. What could go wrong?

Name: Grabby Grabby Plushy Plushy
Overview: It's time to grab stuff! Use your crane to collect plushys in this physics based game! Cuddly cute characters are just waiting to meet you! 30 Levels of grabby grabby fun fun!

Name: Grand Theft Froot
Overview:
Take on the all powerful Advanced Weapons Research Corporation in this twisted, dark story RPG/platformer/adventure mixture.

Steal all the Froot, hack through security systems, take out the guards, find all the secrets and most important of all, figure out what is going on!

Featuring around four to five hours of gameplay the final ending will blow you away... If you survive...

Name: GraphSpacer
Overview: The future of fast-paced-high-tech-space-shooter games...on paper. Features HD graphics and online scoreboards.

Name: Grand Class Melee
Overview: Grand Class Melee is a 4-player action game centered around multiplayer combat. Advance through 8 different rounds of battle and 60 unique character classes to achieve victory. Combine your class's ability with abilities you've gained in previous rounds to create hundreds of combinations and strategies to suit your fighting style!

Name: Graviton
Overview:
Freely inspired by the old Gravitation of the Net Yaroze with some improvements.

Learn to perfectly control your ship and challenge your friends in both making the best lap time or fast dead match.

Thirty-one race map, nine dead match map, nine power up in dead match mode, in a fast simple and good looking game.

Name: GravArena
Overview:
GravArena is a fast-paced couch multiplayer shooter set in SPACE.

With realistic gravity physics, stunning visuals, and drop-in-anytime gameplay it is the perfect game for you and your buddies.

Name: Gravitas
Overview: Challenge the AI and up to three of your friends in a game of galactic artillery. Whom will gravity defeat?

Name: The Gravity Effect
Overview:
The Gravity Effect is a side-scrolling platformer. The goal of the 30 levels is easy: reaching the end. The gimmick is that the player has two gravity-based abilities: increasing (for higher jumps) and decreasing (for higher jumps down without damage) gravity for a short time as well as affecting other objects, e.g. pushing a block without physical touch. Using those abilities decreases the power bar and when it is gone, no more actions are possible. It automatically refills when not using it for a short time.

The game is puzzle oriented. This means the player needs to find out how to use the gravity power to progress in the level. Most puzzles are related to the three switch types (stay pressed, only stay activated while it is pressed and others which only last for a limited) which usually change the level gravity. For example, pressing a switch may change the gravity direction to left and allows to walk on walls. There are also gravity fields which only affect the gravity in their range of effect. After death (e.g. after touching a hazardous object or falling too far), the player needs to restart at the last checkpoint. There are no limitation of tries.

The strength of all possible actions are rated with a power level. The abilities are upgraded when finding secrets. Additionally there is a level editor to build more levels.

Name: GrappleBoy
Overview: Grapple through caves, valleys, buildings and more! Tackle challenges like finding hidden items and completing levels without touching the ground!

Name: Grave Breaker
Overview: Grave Breaker is the first in a series of Survival Packs from Veks and Silence. Features local co-operative multi-player, fight the horde with a friend. This game features three all new graveyard themed arenas. Compete for high scores while working together to kill zombies and survive waves of undead. Random bonus modes allow you to get extra points for killing zombies under specific conditions.

Name: Gravi Dot
Overview:
The Happy Fun Time Friends have descended on to your XBOX and bring with them joy and fun for all ages.

Guide your Happy Dots around the levels and visit all of the friends! Charlie the Cactus and Susie Sunflower are ready to brighten your day with fun and excitement.

Only 80 MSP and fun for the whole family.

Name: Graviton AI
Overview: Graviton AI is an innovative hybrid of strategy elements and classic side scroll shoot-em ups. This is a game in which the strategic selection of weaponry and equipment are just as important to victory as adrenalin and quick reflexes!

Name: Gravitron
Overview:
Gravitron is a retro styled arcade gravity shooter boasting stylized neon vector graphics in which you must pilot your way through some of the most devious terrains ever devised.

Destroy subterranean bases and indigenous life forms while avoiding traps and depleting fuel. Rescue stranded scientists and get out of there before the planet explodes.

Over 70 stages and 4 exclusive game modes.

Name: Gravity Bounce
Overview: Gravity Bounce is a unique game with deceptively simple yet challenging and addictive game-play. Slingshot your way through over 30 orbiting, bouncing gravity systems. Once you start you won't want to stop.

Name: Gravity Dash 2
Overview: The sequal to Gravity Dash. Change gravity to avoid old obstacles and new obstacles that may come your way. Play through all 15 new levels.

Name: Grid Space Shooter
Overview:
It's a twin stick shooter. Fly with the left thumbstick, shoot with the right.

Choose one of 4 scout ships and try to survive against swarms of fighters, enormous capital ships, and space centipedes.

Name: Grey Infection
Overview: Grey Infection is an addictive platform game: the environment changes with each action! Shoot at particles, destroy them all! But be careful, each particle has got its own behavior! Do you like the challenges? Do you like hard games? Do you want to save the planet, on a futurist world? Grey Infection is for you!

Name: greenTech+
Overview: Get ready to save the world from the threat of global meltdown with your mighty hurricane in this action-packed arcade experience! Steer pollution into cleaning centers and watch out for the high-pressure zones. The follow up to Vertigo Games competition winning title, greenTech, this new version features sixteen levels, upgraded graphics, unlockables and a classical, relaxing soundtrack.

Name: Grid Chasers
Overview: Grid Chasers is a multiplayer focused action game where players try knocking each other off a grid of blocks. Up to four players can compete for the gold while enjoying a fresh gameplay experience along with a wide variety of fantastic particle effects.

Name: Grid Legion: Deviant Remix
Overview: Grid Legion is an easy to learn but difficult to master, innovative strategy gameplay experience. Play cards to build structures, train combatants, and cast spells. Fight for resources on a grid to grid combat system. Play your friends online. Create a custom deck from over 120 cards. Make and share maps. Learn how to play from easy to follow tutorial levels.

Name: GT Attack
Overview:
Race one of six high performance cars in one of three modes; Battle, Elimination, and Poker.

Race online, singleplayer, or splitscreen.

Name: Gravity Fighters
Overview:
This game is inspired by the old Amiga game Gravity Force 2, with a little touch of Worms. There is no single player mode so you will need at least one friend to play it.

There are four local multiplayer modes: 1 vs 1 (2 players), 1 vs 1 vs 1 (3 players), 2 vs 2 (four players) and a last man standing mode where you can be a group of players passing the controllers around.

Name: GravSheep
Overview: A herd-em-up... in space! Round up the floating sheep whilst battling against gravity and fuel consumption!

Name: Growing Pains
Overview: Growing Pains gives the traditional platformer a shake up with psychedelic graphics, a thumping sound track and an ingenious twist that you’ve never seen before. The ‘Vessel’ which you control continually grows and expands leaving you in a permanent race to clear the area and escape before you get too big and find your butt wedged in a tight spot.

Name: GravityPong
Overview:
Enter the madness of GravityPong! A classic concept gets turned on its head in the wacky, fun-filled game of paddles, powerups, tubes, and laser fields!

Train your skills against the wall or grab up to three other friends and play head-to-head in Paddle Pong or Tube Pong mode.

With 35 unlockable powerups, a bumpin' custom soundtrack, and 50 AchieveGoals to unlock, you'll have endless fun!

Name: The Great Paper Adventure
Overview: The Great Paper Adventure is a single-direction scrolling shooter with funny 2D graphics and awesome chiptune music composed by Spintronics. Explore many levels, defeats giant bosses and discover a fantastic and papered world!

Name: Guitar Tuner 360
Overview: Turn your Xbox into a digital chromatic tuner.

Name: Guarding
Overview: Guarding is your classic RPG adventure. Follow a group of young warriors as they begin their perilous journey. Choose your party and fend off monsters with a variety of magic and skills!

Name: Gyroball
Overview: Race across the six faces of the cube - dodging your opponents spheres while trying to cut them off with your own. Compete against your friends on Xbox Live to see who will be the champion. To really test your skills, play in survival mode where the AI are invincible and your challenge is to stay alive as long as possible.

Name: Guns Loaded
Overview: Exotic locales. Epic boss battles. Control over time. Missiles and guns loaded. What are you waiting for?

Name: Gumzoobo!
Overview:
Oh no! Robots have invaded the zoo!

Join forces as Bupper the seal, Froofy the tortoise, Clavis the toad and Cheekeze the penguin to take back the zoo in this fun filled retro style platformer game.

Use different types of bubble gum and special items to battle your way through all of the 100 levels as you and your friends work together to defeat the many different kinds of robot enemies.

Name: Gum Drop Celestial Frontier
Overview: The shooter where you don't shoot, but smash your enemies. Featuring physics based gameplay in space, Gum Drop defines a new way to play SHMUP's by removing the shooting mechanic and adding a big ball attached to your ship that you use to smash your opponents. Featuring 20 levels of destruction, and a infinite mode where you can smash enemies indefinitely.

Name: Guppy: Collects! 2
Overview:
The highly anticipated sequel to Guppy: Collects! finally comes to Xbox Live Indie Games!

Collect all-new items in diverse environments to the beat of a compelling original score. Old and new fans alike will enjoy pushing Guppy to new limits in a race against the clock to collect it all!

Name: Guns N Noses
Overview:
Guns N Noses is a fun third person shooter with cartoon style characters. You can choose between different male or female characters with specific attributes and customize their appearance.

Select a tour in the Wild West and eliminate all the outlaws you find on your journey increasing your abilities throughout the game.

Play alone or in co-op mode with up to 4 local players.

Name: Forza Motorsport 3: Ultimate Collection
Overview: The Forza Motorsport 3: Ultimate Collection combines the original game with all of the DLC released up to that point, along with additional exclusive content. The DLC is provided as a separate install disc, and the Stig's Garage pack as a download token.

Name: Hack This Game 4
Overview:
The fourth and final installment of our popular Hack This Game series is now available.

25 all new files and a new mini game.

Name: H0W 2 P1NG A Trademark Removed
Overview: It has been suggested that this game, which is comparable to (trademark removed) with additional paddles on the top and bottom of the screen and additional modes be renamed, so I removed the second half of the reference to the classic table tennis game from the title.

Name: Hack This Game Collection
Overview: The Hack This Game Collection includes all 4 games from the HTG series. This pack also includes a set of 20 bonus challenge puzzles.

Name: Hack This Game 2
Overview: Will you be the first to hack this game? Play through increasingly difficult puzzles and collect your reward. The first three to complete the game will have their avatar featured on the cover!

Name: Hack This Game
Overview: Hack this game is a puzzle game that simulates hacking. Be the first to beat the game and get your avatar on the cover!

Name: Hack This Game 3
Overview:
The third installment of our popular Hack This Game series.

Play through puzzles of increasing difficulty.

Name: Halo 3: Essentials
Overview:
Halo 3: Essentials is a bonus disc compilation for Halo 3. Content includes the following:

Disc One:

* Only compatible with the Xbox 360.
* Included in both Collector’s and Legendary editions.
* A/V calibration tool.
* Exclusive Halo 3 gamer pictures and dashboard theme.
* Gallery of concept and production art (set to music).
* The popular internet flash game Warthog Launch (available here).
* Bungie guided network set-up.
* Typical day at Bungie Studios.
* Making of Halo 3.

Disc Two:

* Usable on anything that plays standard DVDs.
* Only included in the Halo 3 Legendary Edition.
* Completely remastered, high resolution versions of the Halo and Halo 2 cinematics with 5.1 audio and an optional "Director’s Commentary" track featuring Martin O'Donnell, Joseph Staten, and Jason Jones.
* Bestiarum: An expanded digital guide to the creatures, cultures, and worlds of Halo 3, with art and assets exclusive to this interactive edition.
* The Cortana Chronicles: Jen Taylor, the voice of Cortana, takes us on a tour of the worldwide Halo fan community, where she meets Halo fanatics from near and far, obscure and famous alike.
* All-new, exclusive Machinima episodes from Red vs Blue and This Spartan Life, as well as a novel "mockumentary" voiced by Sgt. Johnson himself, David Scully.

Name: Marvel: Ultimate Alliance Special Edition
Overview: This Special Edition is a budget release of Marvel Ultimate Alliance in the Greatest Hits series. Next to the main game, it contains a bonus disc with behind-the-scenes videos and a collection of trailers.

Name: Halfbrick Rocket Racing
Overview: Experience intense speed and intuitive control with Halfbrick Rocket Racing! Use the two triggers to fire up rockets on either side of your craft, and simply alternate power to drift, slide and grind your way around over 40 tracks! With four-player racing and global leaderboards, Halfbrick Rocket Racing is packed with action.

Name: Happyface
Overview: Get five happyfaces in a row to clear them from the board and score points.

Name: HACOTAMA
Overview: A true puzzle game without an action element. "Features" A mysterious virtual world where you can stand on any box or ball surface. Beautiful graphics with balls that reflect, refract and concentrate light amid colorful boxes. An entirely new experience! Thinking three-dimensionally makes this a simple but profound game.

Name: Halloween Scream
Overview: Can you survive a supernatural adventure to claim your inheritance before All Hallow's Eve?

Name: HackTris
Overview:
The goal is hack the system, changing numbers positions and doing triple! Decrease the target number before timer fall to zero.

Let's see how far you can go!

Name: Halfbrick Blast Off
Overview: Blast Off is an interstellar arcade game featuring gravity fields, lost astronauts and bizarre planetary systems. Use your rocket ship to rescue astronauts and carry them through the warpgate to safety. But be careful! The ever-present force of gravity can help you on your journey, but can also bring you crashing down.Each planet and celestial body within a level has a gravity effect which must be accounted for. This gravity must be used to the player’s advantage in combination with rocket boost power and directional control. Various hazards must be avoided, and if the ship crashes into an object the mission fails.- 45 missions across four difficulty settings.- Planets and Asteroids will have gravity and attract the ship, allowing players to float around the level.- Black Holes will attract the ship with even more ferocity.- White Holes have a reverse gravity field, pushing the ship away.- Mission success is ranked on several factors: remaining fuel, remaining air, astronauts collected.- Awarded Silver, Gold or Brick medals based on final mission outcome.Good luck and Blast Off!

Name: Halloween Scream 2
Overview:
The sequel to the critically acclaimed Halloween Scream.

It is two years since you became a vampire. A new lead beckons... can you succeed against all odds and lift the family curse?

Name: Halloween HD
Overview: Frighten your friends and terrify your enemies with these creepy 5.1 halloween-themed soundscapes. Spooooooky!

Name: Hangman's Revenge!
Overview: Stop Lord Double Hockey Sticks in his attack on the United States! Stick Figures are revolting due to their comrades being killed in the game know as 'Hangman'. You must stop the Stick Figure Armies while acquiring top secret vehicle upgrades along the way. Vehicle modes include Tank, Helicopter, Hovercraft, and Submarine.

Name: HakoSekai
Overview:
In this game, you can make the world with “what could not be a part of the world” by transforming it.

Let's make your own world.

Name: Hang 'em High: A Hangman Game
Overview: Classic family entertainment in a western setting. Guess the correct letters of the hidden word(s) before your character is hung.

Name: Halloweenies
Overview: Malcolm is tired of all the other kids in the neighborhood stealing his candy each Halloween. This year he is ready to take back what is rightfully his!

Name: Hangman 360
Overview: One of the most popular games of all time, now for your Xbox 360! Includes 30 word categories, 3 difficulty levels, high scores and many backgrounds to customize the game.

Name: Happy Pong
Overview: Oddly colorful, yet weirdly fun. Come take a dive into trip nation. Happy Pong will deliver your daily dose of abnormal in the convenience of a video game. This visual buffet offers a wide array of animated sensory experiences for you to choose from. Whatever happens, you are in for one wild ride.

Name: Halfbrick Echoes
Overview: Race to collect crystals while dodging the Echoes shadowing your footsteps in this innovative, seat-of-your-pants arcade game. Try the blend of action and strategy in Arcade Mode, the tense maneuvering of Clockwork Mode, the frenetic pace of Survival Mode or challenge a friend to an intense Duel Match. With dozens of surreal levels across seven unique gameplay modes, there's plenty for everyone.

Name: Hard 2 Morrow
Overview: You wake up one day to hear a stranger laughing at you, claiming that his reactor tank is bigger than yours. This cannot be happening! Choose your gladiator and prove your superiority in this hardcore, nonstop straight-in-your-face fast-paced 3D multiplayer action trip! Hard2Morrow comes with never-seen-on-indie cutting-edge graphics and an awesome metal driven soundtrack.

Name: Headshot
Overview: Shoot the killer before time runs out.

Name: Hartacon Tactics
Overview:
Hartacon Tactics is a turn-based tactical RPG, featuring highly deterministic mechanics, beautiful hand-painted 2D art and deep gameplay.

Hire characters of unique classes, and wisely use their strengths, skills and weapons to defeat tough enemies as you travel through the continent of Kaus.

Name: Head Banger
Overview: In Head-Banger, an avatar stands on the stage and bangs his head to one of four songs. Regarding gameplay, this is a standard rhythm game: on the top of the screen, there are four lines corresponding to the four buttons of the Xbox 360 gamepad (alternatively the Guitar Hero controller is also supported). Button icons come in from the right of the screen and when they reach a certain point, the player needs to press the button. A correct press rewards points (consecutive ones combo points) and a missed one retracts from the health bar. The game is over when the song is finished or health runs out.

Name: Head Shot 2
Overview: A terrorist organization is loose in your city. They are masters of disguise and can expertly hide in a crowd. You are the best sniper we've got. It's your job to take them out!

Name: Head Shot Z
Overview: Soldier, you're the only thing standing between these people and a nuclear bomb. If you don't contain this outbreak, well have no choice but to destroy the city. Shoot these zombies in the head!

Name: Head Shot God
Overview: It's God's plan.

Name: The Headsman: Deathlike Silence
Overview: Only the best will achieve the rank of HEADSMAN!

Name: Heart Breaker
Overview:
In a world where love is taken for granted, one Cupid has had enough!

Play as the Anti-Cupid, using your abilities and special powers to crush budding romances, fighting the special forces of the Cupid agenda and generally ruin the day of anyone else in your path.

Name: The Hearts of Men: Throne of Deceit
Overview:
The Hearts of Men: Throne of Deceit is an action game with similarities to the Gauntlet series. The motivations of the four heroes (warlock, viking, elf and warrior) are different, e.g. the viking seeks revenge for his murdered family, but the result is the same: visiting a dungeon and killing everything inside. The story is told with comic pages.

The most obvious change to the Gauntlet formula are the controls: when playing with a gamepad, it uses the twin-stick shooter style (movement and aim direction are controlled separately). The player moves through the maze-like dungeon, kills numerous enemies (most spawn from monster generators which should be destroyed to stop reinforcements) and searches for keys to open up the doors to the next section. Each enemy hits removes some of health bar and eventually leads to death. The player character then respawns at the location of death and loses a live; running out of them means the game is over. Of course there are some things which help to avoid this fate: the player can instantly warp a short distance (costs mana) and collect hearts (from fallen enemies) and meat to restore health. Between levels, collected coins are used to upgrade weapons and other abilities.

Each level ends with a boss fight and some sections use automatic scrolling. This means the player needs to constantly move forward and should avoid turns which lead to dead ends (and therefore instant death). While the campaign is designed for local co-op with up to four participants, it is also possible to play alone. Additionally there is an arcade mode available in which player(s) battle an endless horde of enemies. Here weapon upgrades have to collected from killed enemies. Online multiplayer is restricted to competitive modes like deathmatch.

Name: A Hard Game Without Zombies
Overview: Are you tough enough to control the character FootHeader through all the 25 hard levels, and collect 75 stars. Do not worry the arent any Zombies

Name: Hardboiled Pinball
Overview:
Hardboiled Pinball is the first game of the Stryde Games pinball series, which aims to provide an old-school fast scrolling 2D pinball experience.

Sharpen your reflexes to conquer the silver ball and score the jackpot in this crime noir themed table.

Name: Harmonium
Overview:
Harmonium is a tone matrix game with a twist! Whether you're scribbling, drawing, or composing, the pentatonic design means it always sounds good! And what's the twist, you ask? Well, at any time you can turn on the "Life Mode" and let the music write itself!

Sit back and watch Harmonium apply John Conway's game of life to write generation after generation of autonomous music!

Name: Harvester
Overview:
Harvester is a game for the season. Race to harvest the most wheat before winter sets in.

Good luck.

Name: Heart and Mind 2
Overview:
Heart and Mind are travelling across Poland in order to see the Championship. Help them to hit the ball into the goal. The fewer movements you make, the more points you get for each goal.

Collect bonuses in order to get additional points. You have to carry out additional tasks at 4 special levels.

Name: HaXor LooZ
Overview: Are you the Ultimate HaXor or just a LooZ3r? Outwit and out-maneuver your opponents to claim LEDs and become the top HaXor. Up to 4 people can play. Play against easy, hard, medium and expert AI. See how long you can survive...

Name: Heavy Payload
Overview: Heavy Payload is an aerial shoot 'em up set over the European Theater of World War II. The player must use machine guns to defend their bomber from enemy planes en route to the mission target. The game has two distinct modes: Arcade (classic game play) and Advanced (a new twist to the original game). Each mode has 9 missions with 4 levels of difficulty.

Name: Heavy Payload 2
Overview: Heavy Payload 2 is an aerial shoot 'em up set over the European Theater of World War II. The game has two modes (Arcade and Advanced) with 18 missions and 4 difficulty settings. Heavy Payload 2 has more enemies, faster machine guns, carpet bombing, a new map and other audio/visual enhancements.

Name: Heavy Recoil: Convoy Chaser
Overview: Heavy Recoil: Convoy Chaser is a 2D side-scrolling platform run-and-gun game. The player can control one from three characters: Matti, Max or Annika (Annika is not in the OUYA version). They have different statistics for speed, energy and firepower. The character must go right, shoot enemies, jump on platforms, release captives, destroy barrels and collect bonuses such as secondary weapons like grenades or a laser beam that targets the entire field. The mechanics are similar to Contra, but the character can only shoot straight ahead. Up to three hidden stars can be collected per level. There is no continue option, so if all lives are lost the game is over.

Name: The Heckler
Overview: In The Heckler, the player visits the show of a performance artist who reads poetry. By pressing a button makes an interjection and the player's point score rises. However, with each interjection the performer's annoyance bar rises. It decreases over time and if it rises above a certain level, he leaves the stage and the game is over.

Name: Hedge Wizard
Overview: You and your loyal servant wander the world seeking out the only thing all wizards truly love: gold. Use your spells, wits and helpful local peasants to get the gold before the village or your tower is burned, flooded, buried, eaten by zombies or in some other way horribly destroyed. The game includes over twenty puzzling levels.

Name: Heli Good Spelunker
Overview: Fly your helicopter through a dangerous cavern. And yes there is an end to the cave...you probably just aren't good enough to get there. Game play couldn't be simpler just press a to fly and let go to drop. Enjoy. Programming and art by Jordan Hample.

Name: Hell's House
Overview: A girl alone in a haunted house ... will you be able to make her survive unharmed? Francesca Mamo, the same actress of "Bloody Death" lend her interpretation into the last nightmare from Brave men games.

Name: Hoardzz
Overview: Gather your friends and family for an exciting 4-player adventure! Gather armies of bugs to build the largest hoard, then convert them into 3 different attack bugs to be the last bug standing! With 7 levels, 4 difficulty levels, English and Spanish languages, and great artificial intelligence, prepare yourself for hours of competitive game play!

Name: Heroes of Rock
Overview:
Guitar Hero 5 has been cancelled and Rock Band has stopped DLC. Heroes of Rock gives gamers a chance to rock out again but in a whole new way - through an action game.

Heroes of Rock is a side scrolling action game designed for the guitar peripheral and injected with Heavy Metal influence. Experience original heavy metal music composed by Leeland Campana and take on the satanic music industry.

Name: Hoardzz Heroes
Overview:
Band with a group of friends to defeat the evil sorcerer who has converted you into small insects.

Face spiderwolves, mothamancers, and giant snails in your conquest to regain your human selves.

Name: Hive Attack
Overview: Battle through 12 levels of increasing difficulty to face the Hive's Queen in the final conflict in this addictive 2D Space Shooter.

Name: Holy Moley
Overview:
A war has broken out, deep underground, a Holy War...between Moles!

Battle as 1 of 5 fanatical moles, tunnel your way to victory through 24 hazard filled levels. A fight for up to 4 players, friends or CPU.

Use Power-Ups, win Awards and destroy your enemies in an effort to be the last mole standing.

Name: Henway
Overview: The goal is to cross the road without being killed; hence this game is based on real life.

Name: Hellhounds
Overview: Legend says that Hellhounds guard the entrances to the underworld. And once you trespass their domains, there is no escape...

Name: Helico Hero
Overview: Helico Hero lets you fly four different helicopters in three different areas with multiple missions.

Name: Home Run Challenge
Overview: Hit a Home Run with your Avatar! Features: Addicting Gameplay, Global High Scores, Large Avatar Crowds, and much more! Smash targets and send the ball deep on your way to the top of the Global Highscore List! Home Run Challenge is for gamers of all ages and skill levels.

Name: HexChess 360
Overview: Play chess as you've never played it before! With six sides to each tile, more pieces and larger boards of up to 91 tiles, the game is more complex than a square, 64 piece board. Play against your friends on the same XBox with one or two controllers, or play against three different AI difficulties. Three different versions of board and gameplay available!

Name: Hockey Fights
Overview: Hockey Fights is, as the title might suggest, a recreation of the most exciting part of a hockey match: the fights! Choosing from one of eight teams, the player must beat the snot out of the opposing player in best-of-three bouts. The player can punch or block both high and low; punching will reduce the player's energy, resulting in less damage, but energy can be recharged by blocking attacks. If three punches in succession connect, a "Jersey" attack will be launched where one player pulls the other's jersey over his face and punches him mercilessly, while the other player must mash buttons to break free. The player earns "Victory Points" for winning fights, which can be spent on ability upgrades for the various teams.

Name: Homeless
Overview: Be thankful for what you have.

Name: Honey Badger: Slayer of Memes
Overview: The 'World Wide Interweb' has invaded the sport of boxing! Take on internet celebrity look-alikes in the quest to become the greatest meme slayer of all time.

Developer: A name not yet taken AB
Name: Hockey Action
Overview:
Experience fast paced hockey action with your friends at home, in an online match or by playing single player against the computer. You can create your own hockey team and battle for the win in local matches or online matches.

Be prepared for hockey action!
Publisher: A name not yet taken AB

Name: Hexothermic
Overview:
In Hexothermic, atoms are aligned on a hexagonal grid. The player can select each desired atom and add electrons to it. If an atom has enough electrons, it explodes and hurls electrons into all six directions. The electron counter of each hit atom rises by one and may directly explode when its condition was right. Of course chain reactions reward bonus points for the high-score list. How many more electrons the atom needs is indicated by its color.

The player has only a limited amount of electrons available, but they can be earned back by creating chain reactions. The four playing modes are marathon (the game keeps going until all electrons are used), timed (similar as marathon but with an additional time limit), survival (the player has 99 electrons and can't earn any back) and puzzle (pre-determined situations which have to be solved with the provided electrons).

Name: Holiday Trivia
Overview: Get in the Holiday Spirit with some Holiday-themed trivia! Play as your Avatar with up to 3 other friends or family members and enjoy hundreds of Holiday-related questions while listening to wonderful Holiday music! Fun for all ages!

Name: Hello Rocket
Overview: Can you steer the little rocket to its little target? Hello Rocket features hours of gameplay, hilarious physics-based demolition and lots of replay value. Complete with 72 levels of toppling towers, exploding bombs, rolling orbs and cute little bad guys that you bump into and knock over. Best. Game. Ever.

Name: HomeSlice and the Zombie Bunnies
Overview: An evil dude has unleashed the Zombie Bunnies and now you, HomeSlice, have to send them packing. Slice and Shoot the Zombie Bunnies with high scores, unique game look, and play style.

Name: High Gravity Wells
Overview: Travel around galaxies by changing gravities to change your orbit. Avoid asteroids, black holes and more as you guide spaceships to their stations.

Name: Heroes of Hat
Overview:
Heroes of Hat is a multiplayer 3D puzzle platformer where you use the power of hats to traverse levels, solve puzzles, and fight enemy forces.

You'll have to tie all of your hat abilities together to make it through levels and conquer what lies at the end.

Name: High Stakes Zombie Monkeys
Overview: Take control of your Avatar and gamble your way to glory in the infamous Zombie Monkey Arena! Fight for your honor against hordes of Zombie Monkeys by smashing them to bananas.

Name: Hexement
Overview:
Hexement is a falling block puzzle puzzle viewed from a slightly angled top-down perspective. Players rotate and position descending blocks made of connected hexagons, each representing one of three elemental types: land, water, or fire. The interaction between the falling block and the tile it lands on determines the outcome - hexagons may stack or transform. For example, placing water on water adds another layer, while dropping fire on water removes one.

Strategic placement is essential, as terrain evolves dynamically. Volcanos form when fire is placed on fire or when neighboring tiles differ in height by more than four layers. These volcanos erupt after a fixed interval, introducing hazards that can destabilize the field. However, players can prevent eruptions by dropping water directly onto volcanos, which removes them. If no volcanos are present when an eruption is due, one is randomly created on the highest tile layer.

The game ends if water spills over the edge - triggered by placing water tiles on boundary hexagons - or if the field tilts due to uneven tile distribution. The objective is to survive as long as possible while accumulating points through block

Name: Holiday Bonus
Overview:
What's in Santa's sack? It's a Holiday Bonus that the whole family will love. Chill out with this cool winter-themed puzzle game from Grey Alien Games - it's slicker than Santa on an icy roof!

Line up the dancing seasonal shapes against stunning snowscape backgrounds with an epic music score and work your way up the decorated tree. You can gather winter scenes in your gallery and even display them on your desktop. Make the right moves and your power gauge will build a bigger, brighter bonus blowout!

This one's gonna snowball...so don't miss the festive fun!

Features:

- Family holiday fun
- Smooth addictive match-3 gameplay
- Beautiful winter backgrounds
- Gallery of unlockable pictures
- Crazy bonus items including Santa's sack!
- 55 unique levels
- Enchanting winter music
- Universal Binary for Macs

Name: Hollow Ball
Overview: Simple but addictive 2D tennis game for 2 players. Easy to control but hard to master, find a worthy rival and you will suffer the "just one more match" syndrome. And remember to take advantage of the advanced physics and the game events.

Name: Herbert and the Skyship
Overview:
Guide Herbert in his skyship past squorbs dropped on the Rainbow Planet.

How long can you last?

Name: Herman
Overview: Herman is a unique action scroller with 25 long levels, 5 difficulty levels and hours of gameplay. Herman is in the midst of a midlife crisis, and you must help him escape from work. The game has a brilliant story (told in over 200 beautiful backgrounds), 15 professional music tracks, many different enemies and a nice mix of upgrades, including Herman's lucky fedora! VERY challenging and fun.

Name: Heroes vs. Zombies
Overview: Play with up to 4 people in order to fend off the zombie horde. Gain exp to learn new techniques. Can you survive?

Name: Hey Aliens: Ill Mash You Up!
Overview:
The ultimate alien shooting game is at hand mixing arcade classic into the modern world.

Fight your way through an infinite number of levels to rack up the points. Choose to play in one of several graphics packs including new style and Retro classics, or switch in real time between them during play.

Name: Hieronymus Bash
Overview:
Angels want control of all Heaven, Hell and everything in between. Devils want the same thing. How to settle this? Battle with weapons? Been there, done that, got the T-shirt. Then somebody had an idea: DODGEBALL!

Hieronymus Bash is a dodgeball game between angels and devils. Two players can play on the same team or on opposing teams. Up to four players can play. The game, somewhat, plays like dodgeball. The ball is thrown at an opposing player. If the player is hit, they are out. If they catch the ball, the other player is out and an outed player can return. Last team standing, wins. The game is not on a flat playing field but there are, instead, platforms above and below.

Name: Hide and Scare
Overview: Boo! Haha.

Name: Hop and Pop
Overview: With Cute or Trash Mode, Hop and Pop is "Some fun for smart people". Single, 2 player or Battle. Jump around, make color combinations and use more than 20 Powers to win. The more balloons you pop, the more points you get, but the faster it goes. Other Features : 20+ Awards to unlock, shout messages, 4 custom musics style, High-Scores, Quest or Battle mode

Name: Hop Til You Drop
Overview:
Hop til you drop in this new multiplayer adventure. Collect the coins and avoid the dangerous obstacles.

Challenge up to three of your friends! The more you play the more Hoppers you unlock!

Name: Honor in Vengeance
Overview: Jump in the cockpit of one of the year's most powerful and addicting Indie Games to hit the Marketplace. Featuring a full blown voice acting team, detailed graphics and intense gameplay, Honor In Vengeance will leave you speechless as you fly above Earth as Martian rebel pilot Juno Lucas, fighting for Mars' independence from Earth's abusive grip on the Martian colony.

Name: Horn Swaggle Islands
Overview: Engaging real-time strategy and puzzle gameplay are combined in this slick and action-packed game. You are in charge of a tropical archipelago and must make careful use of each island's geography to outwit enemy pirates. Complete the game as a Cabin Boy or test your mettle as a Pirate King; unique puzzle island maps and features will push your skills as far as you care to take them!

Name: Hostile Hustle
Overview: Platformer meets vertical shoot-em-up in this retro genre mashup! Fight off alien hordes who are out to protect the valuable space gems you are rightfully trying to steal! 7 Levels of action plus challenging accomplishments to shoot for!

Name: Hot Potato HD
Overview: Hot Potato HD a high tech take on the popular childrens game Hot Potato! Pass the potato (in the form of the Xbox Controller) back and forth while the music plays. But be careful! If you're holding it when the music stops, Hot Potato! It's fun for the whole family.

Name: Horde of the Damned
Overview:
Campaign led, strategy game with city and army management. Defend the Kingdom from the Hordes of Evil Undead!

Quickbattle mode supports up to 4 local players with 5 different maps designed specifically for quickbattle mode.

Develop your cities and build bigger armies!

Complex AI, multiple map types, full on battle, defend the convoy, special missions.

Name: Honor in Vengeance II
Overview:
Tensions are at a high, weapons are at a ready.... and the only thing missing is a spark to set it all off.

Jump in the cockpit of Leo Lucas' starfighter, and lead the way for the Martian people as the Earth-Mars conflict reaches a climatic turn in the second installment of the Honor in Vengeance series.

Name: Horned Toad Hornswaggle
Overview: You are one of the last of your kind. The endangered Horned Lizard, sometimes known as the Horned Toad. You are trying to survive by eating ants, but must defend yourself by the only ways you know how. Squirting blood at your enemies and running away. Play this fast paced twin stick top down shooter today.

Name: Hotel Danger
Overview: Let's play a little game. Open 2 doors each turn. If both doors contain tenants, you save both tenants. If one door is a killer and one door is a tenant, you lose the tenant. Save 10 tenants to win each level. Be careful! The killers will move after every turn!

Name: The Houchi Play
Overview:
The Houchi Play is a 2D title based on the popular real-life children's game Statues. The aim of the game is to get the character Taro Heibon close to cosplay girls without having the girls notice him. The player has to wait until the girl faces away and then quickly alternate between pressing the two trigger buttons quickly to move towards her. As soon as she faces Taro again, all movement must stop. On the way, he will pass some alcoholic beverages which are drunk by solving a quicktime event. Doing this fast and successful, improves Taro's movement speed. After all stages are passed, the girls can be viewed in a gallery.

During the standard challenge mode, Taro gains experience points based on the difficulty of the level. Reaching a level up improves his cuteness (more time before the girl turns around), quickness (maximal movement speed), stamina (how fast the momentum decreases) and drinking (difficulty of the quicktime events). Some girls have special behaviour traits, e.g. they sometimes close their eyes or do not announce when they turn back towards Taro. In free play, the player can choose unlocked girls and costumes freely.

Name: House of Cockroach
Overview: House of Cockroach is 3D shooting game. Simply enter the house with full of cockroaches and there will be various rooms with 14 missions to completed. Using 3 different weapons (reflect gun, machine gun and bomb) to win against cockroaches.Build a highest score or challenge your friends and beat their score.

Name: House of Spice
Overview: House of Spice is 3D arcade shooting game. Shooting monsters with spice gun at 4 different fresh locations. Beware of monsters shooting you back since it decreases life point. Collect Old Spice to increase life point.

Name: How Quick Are You?
Overview: Improve your reaction time with this addictive game!

Name: House of 1000 Demons
Overview:
Are you ready to play the wildest, sexiest, scariest game ever made? No? Well good, then how about HOUSE OF 1000 DEMONS!?

Stumble through a house haunted with terrible demons from a dimension far more annoying then our own.

Are you a bad enough dude to save your house? Probably not.

Name: How to Get a Girlfriend
Overview:
How to Get a Girlfriend consists of a series of questions aimed at measuring the user's knowledge about how to succeed with girls. For each question, there are four possible answers; only one is correct. Each answer is followed by a comment, that sets out why the right answer is so, and, for some questions, explains why the other ones are wrong.

A question, for instance, says: «A girl you like comes up to you and says she isn't interested in being with you. What do you do?». And available answers are:

Ask her why she thinks that and try to convince her otherwise.
Splash her with your drink.
Cut your losses and move on.
Act sad and start crying to make her pity you.
Questions finished, the game invites to restart or «go out and try your new moves!».

Name: Hoyle Texas Hold 'em
Overview: Hoyle Texas Hold 'em delivers the very best of Hold 'em style poker for the Xbox 360. Choose to play with up to 9 friends or against any combination of AI and Live players. Customize your game type by choosing limit, no limit, spread limit and table limit style games. Full support of Microsoft's Avatars let's you bring your own style to the game.

Name: Human Invasion
Overview: Defend your alien home world against 10 incoming waves of heavily armed human invaders.

Name: Human Subject
Overview:
You've been abducted by aliens who are conducting tests on you to determine whether or not they should invade Earth.

Can you perform well enough to frighten them into changing their plans? Or do they have something else in mind?

Name: Hungry Snake
Overview: Guide the snake around the board eating food. Just to spice things up a little, different foods have different effects on your snake.

Name: Hypno Vol. 1
Overview: Take the role of a dangerously powerful hypnotist in this dark story-driven experience. Use your abilities to cut a bloody swath through the city by ripping the intentions from one person and branding them down on others. Wherever you go, the people around you are your weapons - use them through 17 varied missions of assassination, interrogation, and mayhem as you exact your revenge on the world.

Name: HuntersLunch
Overview:
The wastelands are a dangerous place, filled with wolves and monsters ready to turn anyone foolish enough to venture there into a handy meal. A young girl named Natsuki has ended up stranded there after her buggy broke down, and must now navigate the rough terrain and find a path to safety.

HuntersLunch is a puzzle game similar to classics like Adventures of Lolo and Sokoban, and is a sequel to SummerVacation. Each single-screen stage is a puzzle where you must reach the goal, and is filled with various tools to help you, terrain to traverse, and enemies to get in your way. You can only cross rocky terrain using a buggy, but can only cross spiked land on foot; rocks can be destroyed with hammers, bridges can let you cross water, and drums can be pushed around to block attacks or fill holes dug with a shovel.

The game includes 30 different puzzles to solve, and will save a replay of your most efficient solution for each puzzle. There are also five different BGM tracks to choose from, and two characters to play as, as well as Natsuki's original outfit from SummerVacation.

Name: How Smart Are You? IQ Test
Overview:
How smart are you? Take this IQ test and find out!

Features include a detailed IQ breakdown, question generation that allows for retesting, and a full length 50 question test.

Name: Hypnotizing
Overview:
Turn your TV into a Hypnotizing machine.

WARNING: USE AT YOUR OWN RISK!

Name: Hurdle Turtle 2
Overview:
The fastest turtle in the world is back, and he's bringing 3 friends!

Engage in intense 4 player action as you try to work together to progress through levels, while trying to outdo each other's high scores!

An all new game with upgraded graphics, new levels and for the first time ever, Hurdle Turtle swims!

Name: Hypership Still Out of Control!
Overview:
Space is still a dangerous placed for even the most seasoned starship pilot, full of asteroids, multicolored floating blocks, and space mines. It's still even more dangerous when your accelerator is stuck to the floor and your brakes are out.

Can you survive long enough to get that elusive high score or are you still destined to add a new crater to the face of an unsuspecting asteroid?

Name: Hypotenuse
Overview: Hypotenuse: The longest side of a right angle triangle... or the proper way to kill a rectangle ninja!

Name: Hurdle Turtle: Celebrations!
Overview:
To celebrate Hurdle Turtle's 3rd birthday and the upcoming release of Hurdle Turtle 2, we proudly present this 2nd companion to the original game which can also be enjoyed as a standalone title.

Take Hurdle Turtle through a gauntlet of holiday themed levels and keep challenging your own hiscores until the sequel arrives this fall!

Name: Hyper Button
Overview: Can your thumb act fast? Play many challenging games that make use of the four face buttons and test your timing, speed and nerve!

Name: Hypercube Arcade
Overview: A collection of addictive multiplayer mini-games. Play it with your friends on split-screen or over Xbox Live. This includes an online matchmaking system to play with random opponents, and AI bots for an extra challenge or if you would like to play by yourself.

Name: Hypership Out of Control!
Overview:
Your space-brakes are out, the accelerator is stuck, and you can't stop. Hypership Out of Control is a scrolling shooter for up to four players. The titular Hypership continually accelerates forward, and the player must shoot and avoid obstacles while collecting coins and items trying to get the highest score possible before crashing.

The game includes several modes, including a standard mode where the speed limit increases after each wave, a "hardcore" mode with even higher difficulty, and even a practice mode. In the multiplayer mode, crashed players can be revived by those who are still alive.

Name: Hydro Electric Worker
