Overview: A massive electrical failure has occurred in Power City. As a result, lines are surging, and the doors at the animal store opened automatically releasing dogs and hawks. Fixing the lines won't be easy, be sure to save money for better tools, faster boots, and Clones just in case. Do you have what it takes to restore electricity to Power City and become the #1 Hydro Electric Worker?

Name: Hurdle Turtle: Level Pack #1
Overview: The fastest turtle in the world is back for more zany 8-bit arcade action in 3 all new levels! Join him and his new pal Pirate Turtle as they race to a banging chiptune soundtrack composed by Octapus! This companion to the original game can also be enjoyed as a standalone title.

Name: Hurdle Turtle
Overview: Hurdle Turtle is a game about a turtle who doesn't believe that "slow and steady wins the race"; he believes in going as fast as he possibly can! The player controls a turtle who moves forward at an ever-accelerating rate, and must dodge obstacles and jump over hurdles to keep from crashing. Run out of lives, and the run is over. The game includes three different courses to play, and also includes a two-player simultaneous mode. The game tracks the best score on each course.

Name: I Suck At: Word Games
Overview: Do you suck at word games? We do, but we like them anyway. Play online and review your scores with other players. Play public games with anybody or private games with your friends.

Name: Ice 9
Overview: Save the world by catching the deadly balls of Ice 9 before they explode! This simple yet addictive game will keep you playing "just one more game" to beat your high score.

Name: The Impossible Dungeon
Overview: Explore a Brutally dangerous dungeon in this funny text-based adventure.

Name: iCandy
Overview: iCandy is an addictive puzzle game full of delicious candies and gorgeous women! Place your tiles to clear the board. Unlock 25 trophies and 9 amazing pictures! Think you can handle it? 25 levels of fun await you!

Name: Ice Crush 10.000 B.C.
Overview: Try as fast as possible to clean up the playfield, earn bonus time with speed combinations and discover all special items.

Name: I Miss My Girlfriend
Overview:
My girlfriend lives 3000 miles away :( I want to see her... please help me. Please try my game.

Enjoy this AMAZING game starring my girlfriend and help us out too!

Name: I Want It!
Overview: Good things come to those who beg.

Name: The Impossible Game: Level Pack
Overview: Two brand new levels, each with a new, awesome soundtrack! Make sure you play 'The Impossible Game' first before trying this.

Name: I MAED A GAM3 W1TH Z0MB1ES!!!1
Overview: This video game product represents a culmination of years of intensive psychological research, bleeding edge engineering, and artistic collaboration by over two dozen internationally recognized art houses, using such technologies as the HYPERMAGIC 3.0 engine to power never-before-seen eye candy with the MEGACORE X parallelization processor for smooth-as-glass presentation.

Name: Drift
Overview: Drift features gently drifting generative visuals and music. It is not so much a game as a collection of customizable ambient art works.

Name: I Heart Shift
Overview: Shift between gameplay while the visuals are shifting colors. Each round starts as a puzzle game and ends as a dual-stick shooter. The better you solve the puzzle the fewer enemies you have to fight. Choose how you want to play. The full game contains 15 levels, 15 colors, 15 enemies and a procedurally generated soundtrack.

Name: I, Zombie
Overview: I, Zombie is a 2D, almost top-down arcade game with small strategy elements. The player controls a zombie and he must infests all armed enemies and harmless civilians, somewhat similar to the concept of Stubbs the Zombie. The zombie can also control infested comrades with three commands: "stay", "follow" and "attack". The game has a simple structure based on one-screen missions. Wounded zombies are very slow and are easy targets for enemies. People stand or move on special roads.

Name: Incursion
Overview: In Incursion you control immigrants from all over the world. Use resources to train four types of immigrants: the digger, the snipper, the sprinter, and the mine sweeper. You will face treacherous terrain, rivers, barbed-wire fences, border guards, and even landmines! Players will glimpse what so many people all over the world strive for, a chance to start a better life in a new country.

Name: Indiemon Card Adventure
Overview:
Indie Island needs a new Defender to protect it. Play as Rik, a kid from a small town. Play through different areas to collect new cards to build your deck and train to get stronger.

Become the new Defender of Indie Island in this multi-genre game!

Name: Icebreaker
Overview: Skill and luck are required in your search of the Yeti as you break through 40 treacherous levels of ice and snow terrain. Surprising rewards await you at the completion of the game. Compete against peers for global high score.

Name: iFate Tarot Explorer
Overview: A classic Tarot Card simulation for the Xbox 360 featuring a wide variety of tarot card spreads, beautiful music, effects and 3D animation.

Name: Impact of Towers
Overview: Hordes of creatures from a distant planet want capture our poor animals. You can not allow that. You are our last chance. Be the commander and the strategist. This is a Tower Defense. This is Impact of Towers.

Name: Incident of Dreamy Vale Church
Overview: A sideways scrolling beatem up adventure. Download the demo for free and see how much fun it is yourself!

Name: ig Pool
Overview:
A game of classic pool for the XBox 360 with 3D visuals and realistic ball dynamics.

Play a 1 player match against the XBox or a 2 player match against a friend, or play an exciting game against the clock.

Name: Ignition Force
Overview: Ignition Force is a side scrolling arcade style shoot-'em-up. Players control a flying ship and have to gun down the opposing forces. The game puts an emphasis on speed as the mission only lasts two minutes and where the faster the player goes the more points that are earned.

Name: Immunogen
Overview:
Immunogen tests your memory skills by having you match pills to viruses. Nice and easy right? Let’s see if you can focus when viruses multiply faster than you can think.

Tired of the same old game? Levels, music, and backgrounds in Immunogen change every time you play so the playability is mind blowing. Really, mind blowing!

Name: In the Pit
Overview: An "audio-only" stealth action game. Control a horrible monster who lives at the bottom of a dark pit and eats the people who fall in!

Name: Indiemon Battlegrounds
Overview:
Enter the Battlergrounds! Fight your way to the top in this collect them all tile based game.

Over 150 Indiemon tiles to collect!

Name: Indiemon Thunder Region
Overview:
Long ago, the 5 great nations lived in peace, then the Region of Flames attacked. Our hero, Landon traveled the Earth Nation protecting it and fending off flame intruders.

Now Landon must travel to the thunder region and do the same.

Name: Ikaroids
Overview: Defend the universe from the alien hordes! Ikaroids is a fast-paced, innovative arcade-style shooter with blistering graphics and detailed physics. The game offers a challenging campaign with a variety of twists, turns and surprises and an addictive survival mode that you can challenge alone or with a friend.

Name: Imaginary
Overview: Imaginary is a platformer where you run, jump, and hide from enemies. Then wait for you chance to strike back.

Name: Impossiball
Overview:
IMPOSSIBALL is a re-imagining of Atari’s "Pong" with three different game modes that can be played in singles (1-2 players) or doubles (1-4 players). The game modes are: IMPOSSIBALL, DODGEBALL and LONEBALL.

IMPOSSIBALL is like Pong but with 500 balls instead of one. There are 10 different Power-Ups to collect (or avoid).

DODGEBALL requires you to avoid getting hit by the orange balls as they get bigger and faster.

LONEBALL is our love-letter to Atari's original game featuring one, lone ball drenched in a neon glow and all set to a chip-tune soundtrack!

Name: Impossible Shoota
Overview: Try it now. Bring back color to the world! The colorless enemies have arrived and they want to turn you the last color fighter into one of them. It is up to you to put color back into them in order to save your world! Featuring fast paced twin stick shooter action, this game will keep your heart pounding throughout the whole game.

Name: Impossibly Dodgeable
Overview:
A vast mass of obstacles are between you and the finish line. Can you dodge the impossible and make your way to outer space?

Supports Multiplayer, XBox Live & System Link Co-Op action.

Name: Indiemon Villain Version
Overview:
Play as Landon, an Indiemon Tamer who betrays the Earth Nation. Conquer The Earth Nation by defeating the Defenders and obtaining the Earth Nation emblems.

Capture all 100 Indiemon, discover and conquer new and old areas, and be the villain.

Name: Indiemon VS Zombies
Overview:
Fight your way through hordes of zombies with your favorite Indiemon characters.

Choose from up to 12 different Indiemon each with unique attacks.

Name: Indiemon: Earth Nation
Overview:
Play as Landon, an Indiemon Tamer, who travels across the Earth Nation protecting it from intruders.

Capture and train Indiemon to help you on you journey.

Name: Indirian Solitaire
Overview: A selection of over 25 solitaire card games including Canfield, Klondike, Spider, Stonewall and Yukon. Complete each game's Challenge to earn Gold, Silver and Bronze medals.

Name: Inevitable Outcome
Overview: Survive through day and night, defend yourself against waves of attacking Slugs!

Name: Infect ED
Overview: Welcome to the world known as "The Body"! The world has been infected with an evil virus and it's your job to cure it. Venture forth with your weapons of medicine (grenades, needles etc.) to find the core of the virus, curing everything in your way! Go nuts on your own, or with friends. Two to four players co-op.

Name: Infinite Doodle
Overview: Let your creativity loose with a doodle pad of infinite depth. Zoom into your drawing to create an increasingly detailed picture as you scribble, doodle and stamp in a world of physics defying infiniteness.

Name: Inferno Ball
Overview: Action packed ping pong style gameplay with a combustible twist. Inferno Ball puts your reflexes and skill to the test. Play any of 4 difficulties from Easy to Insane. Play against the computer or a friend either locally or over xbox live.

Name: Infinity Danger
Overview: Become a test pilot and fight against an almighty mothership that evolves to exploit your weak points!

Name: Influence
Overview: The opposing team is always coming down on the wrong side of the issues. It is time to change their minds. Blast them with your Enticer, rocket them with your Convincer or nuke them with your Paradigm Shifter towards influential dominance. With Influence, you can change the world.

Name: Insane Bash
Overview: Are you ready for the sporting challenge that is "Insane Blur:Summer Commonwealth Runfastathon 2011" ? - Race with up to TWENTY NINE buddies on one Xbox - or just race on your own to beat the high scores! Fun for all the family, friends, neighbors and anyone else you can squeeze in your living room!

Name: Inflamous
Overview: Burn the office down! Are you ready to set fire to your fellow colleagues?

Name: International Mooing Contest
Overview: Mootastic Moosical Moohem! (with online highscores)

Name: Insane Game
Overview:
An awesome multiplayer shooter, featuring 4-player deathmatch and randomly-generated fully-destructible terrain!

Avoid the black holes, collect the crazy powerups and drive your friends INSANE! (friends sold separately.) You'll keep coming back for more insanity!

Name: Insane Zombie Carnage
Overview: It has begun. The Earth is infected. There is no time. You gotta save the Word and it is not going to be a stealth mission. Fight your way through endless hordes of the undead, shoot 'em, burn 'em, blast 'em, beat 'em. Kill 'em in dozen different ways. And, oh, yes, die hundreds of times in the process. Three different game modes. Unlockable weapons, surprise boxes and hours of edge-of-your-seat frantic action.

Name: Insanity X
Overview: You are a rebel warrior imprisoned in The Evil Robot Master's domain. In order to escape, you must traverse room after room of the electrified wall maze while destroying his robotic minions. A throwback to classic arcade games, this game will test your reflexes, your skill, and most of all, your sanity! Are you insane enough to survive?

Name: Insecticide
Overview:
Run, jump & wall kick your way through a procedurally generated world infested with dangerous insects.

Chaotic platformer action. Great fun with a friend or two or three.

Name: Insanity
Overview: Can you pat your head and rub your stomach at the same time? Insanity is an intense blend of classic pong and space invaders. Multitask through twenty challenging levels to save your home planet, NExidus, from alien invasion.

Name: Inside Lacrosse's College Lacrosse 2010
Overview: Inside Lacrosse's College Lacrosse 2010 brings you the fastest, most physical game on two feet. Now anyone can dodge hard to the cage, throw crazy stick checks, and snipe corners in the first ever field lacrosse video game. Build your own roster, edit your jerseys, upgrade your equipment, and challenge people from around the world to a game of lacrosse on Xbox LIVE!

Name: InterGalaXia
Overview:
Conquer Galaxies across the entire universe in InterGalaXia. You can play 3 game modes including Arcade, OSK (Survival) or Story (Mission) mode. Featuring unlimited galaxy generation meaning that two games will NEVER be the same.

Select your weapons, choose your galaxy and go conquer it!

Name: invAIders
Overview:
invAIders is a Shoot'em up powered by a Genetic Algorithm.

The Genetic Algorithm evolves the enemy AI based on the player's performance. As the player gets better, so does the AI.

The question is, can you evolve faster?

Name: Invisipong
Overview:
Engage in a pong battle for up to four players! Predict the ball's movement as it goes invisible.

Do you have the balls to be the last survivor in the "Survival" mode?

If you are feeling lazy you can just let the AI fight in the "Endless" mode, and bet which paddle will win!

Name: Iron Core
Overview:
Welcome to Iron Core. Your space fleet is launching an all out attack against the enemy. Your mission is to be the diversion.

This is a suicide mission, last as long as you can to give your fleet the distraction needed to launch a surprise attack.

Name: Island Adventure II: Karma
Overview:
The adventure continues! Peril... humour... romance... What surprises await? The mystery deepens...

A one player point and click adventure game. Although this is a full game in its own right, It is recommended that you purchase and play Island Adventure part1 first.

Name: Island Adventure 3: Penultimate Climax
Overview:
Yet more humour and peril!

A one player point and click adventure game.

With multiple different endings dependent on choices made (entering codes from last game allows for even more variation!).

3D stereoscopic version included (red/cyan 3d glasses needed).

Game contains some adult humour and innuendo.

Name: Iota
Overview:
Platforming finesse required!

Master the expanded colour switching mechanic (IKARUGA) to smash, race and maneuver your way through challenging levels.

Iota features a groovy custom soundtrack and all original art.

Name: Island Adventure: The Beginning
Overview: Adventure... Intrigue... Mystery... …and one very sexy maiden! This Game is Bigger, Better, Sexier and even more Ingenious! Buy it now… You won’t be sorry you did! Don’t believe me? Then download the free demo now and try it for yourself! Red/blue glasses required to enjoy 3d

Name: Inventions of Evil Intentions
Overview:
Battle your friends in a crazy robot rumble. Destroy their thruster so that they cannot fly, their weapon so they cannot shoot and then avoid them when they try to self destruct, taking you with them.

Compete for the highscore at a single player race by surviving in a devious world while being forced to flee from the rising lava.
 Lots of sheep included in every game!

Name: Island Adventure IV: ...The Conclusion
Overview:
The grand finale of the Island Adventure point and click adventure series is here!

Will you find a way to get home? What will happen to the girls? And what of the creatures?

Multiple endings dependent on choices made.

Includes side by side 3D version.

Name: iRiS 2.0
Overview: Iris 2.0 is a Music Visualizer Creation Studio that features a suite of tools that allow you to easily and intuitively create your own Music Visualizers, which can be shared with other users over Xbox Live. Iris 2.0 can access music on your Xbox or PC. It comes with 10 Classic and 21 Custom Visualizers. Pick your favorite songs, build a perfect Visualizer, and then sit back and enjoy the show!

Name: Invasion Defender
Overview: Invasion Defender is a game based on the classic and popular Tower Defense concept. It brings two new features to the genre including enemies that attack back adding to the overall challenge as well as intelligent AI who will search out for the safest route from A to B increasing the need for tactical planning.

Name: Invasion One
Overview:
The second title in the simple, fun campaign series by Amalgamation Softworks, Invasion One is a tongue-in-cheek 2D sidescrolling shooter.

You are the pilot of an alien attack ship, dispatched ahead of the fleet to the Terran homeworld to test its defenses by inflicting widespread damage across urban environments.

Name: Investigate This: Scarecrow!
Overview:
This is a story-focused mystery game where you'll experience the thrill of cracking your first big case.

To enhance the adventure, you can play as either a male or female protagonist and choose from multiple story paths to reach the gripping finale.

Name: Irekae Maho-chan
Overview: Irekae Maho-chan ("Exchange Maho-chan") is a puzzle platform game where the player controls the young girl Maho-chan, who has the curious ability to swap places with other creatures. She does this by throwing rainbow stars at them, and must use this ability to pass through walls in order to reach the exit door of each stage. Green walls can be shot through, while purple walls are solid and will block Maho-chan's exchange stars. There are a total of 50 stages, most of which have a very strict time limit, but the player can choose any stage to start or continue from.

Name: Iron Girl Kyon
Overview: Iron Girl Kyon is a cute action puzzle game. Play the heroin Kyon and attack monsters with iron maces!! The monsters who are hit will change colors randomly. When monsters of the same color are lined up, they will disappear. Try to win big by the line-up attack! Will Kyon achieve her dream of becoming a princess by protecting the Treasure Vault!? Enjoy our game full of lovely characters.

Name: Isagoras
Overview:
The human race is in danger! The Solar System will be your battlefield, only you can stop the alien forces that are trying to exterminate our species.

Join the Humanity Defense Force as Crow, the pilot of the new starship prototype Isagoras-001 together with captain Crozier and lead the battle for survival.

Name: Itza
Overview:
Itza is an exciting puzzle game where your goal is to remove pairs of matching tiles and trying to clear the board before the time runs up.

Explode tiles in combos to clear the level faster and to receive powerful powerups!

Name: Iredia: Atram's Secret
Overview:
"Iredia, Atram’s Secret" is an entertaining video game in which you will travel through a world of magic where you will be able to see and experience sounds in a different way.

Help Sara recover the flute that Kikarazu the cat stole from her and discover Iredia’s secrets. Amazing characters will share your adventure.

Complete all levels, challenge Atram and recover Sara’s flute!

Name: Iris
Overview: Iris is an intuitive Media Player and Music Visualizer for your Xbox 360. It features 10 unique customizable music visualizers, along with access to your Media Library on your Xbox 360 and on your Windows PC using Windows Media Connect. Pick your favorite songs, then sit back and enjoy the show.

Name: Itano Alpha Flight
Overview: Lock-on and fire! Take down countless waves of enemy fighters as you fly towards a distant horizon.

Name: Iron Axe
Overview:
Enter the maze in Iron Axe. Can you survive and escape through this challenge?

Careful, you only have three lives.

Name: Jellyfish MD
Overview:
Pollution has struck Jellyfish City!

Take on the role of the esteemed Dr Jellyfish's new assistant. Use your powers of perception and spatial reasoning to match up colored bubbles to cure the adorable denizens of Jellyfish City in this unique and challenging puzzle game.

Name: Jackpot Stadium
Overview: Hit the ball as hard as you can to increase the jackpot, slam it on your opponent's wall and grab the accumulated score! Test your skills playing with a friend or against the AI!

Name: JamSouls !
Overview:
Get ready for some crazy battles with your friends in the colorful arenas of Jamsouls!

In the hope of bringing back the golden era of multiplayer classics, Jamsouls focuses on fast-paced and manic fun with simple and accessible gameplay.

Take control of one of nine naughty evils freed from Pandora's Box and fight your friends inside vivid arenas full of dangerous power-ups and traps ! Use your characters special attack to show enemies whose boss in Deathmatch Mode ! Develop strategies to master the arena and make your opponent cry in Capture the Flag or Foot Mode.

Jamsouls is best played with friends, but you can count on AI and a brand new Challenge Mode to make sure the fun never stops.

Name: Japanorama
Overview: Put your imagination (and your surround sound system!) to the test with these stunning Japanese-themed panoramic soundscapes. Using unique 360 degree photography and dynamic 5.1 ambient effects, they'll transport your mind straight to the land of the rising sun!

Name: Jawsome the 3rd: Orca's Revenge
Overview: Jawsome the 3rd: Orca's Revenge is the third game in the Jawsome series. The player controls an orca trying to catch sharks. The player can choose from several different orcas to play as before entering a level. Levels are 3D environments which are explored from a behind view perspective. A certain number of sharks must be caught in order to complete each of the game's five levels.

Name: Jake's Room
Overview: Jake's Room is a 3rd person, zero-g flightsim shooter. It has two modes, single player and two player split-screen co-op. It takes place in a room filled with toys. The object of the game is to fly around the room avoiding and destroying toys and other various items.

Name: Jet Pack War
Overview: Play online with your avatar and immerse yourself in ridiculously awesome jet pack combat! Choose between 4 unique 3D worlds where you will get to blast your friends with your energy rocket launcher and compete over power-ups all while soaring through the air and climbing the ranks on the global high scores list. Featuring 6 mind blistering jet pack songs provided by The Song Club.

Name: Jet Set Willy 360
Overview:
Miner Willy, intrepid explorer and nouveau-riche socialite, has been reaping the benefits of his fortunate discovery in Surbiton. He has a yacht, a cliff-top mansion, an Italian housekeeper and a French cook, and hundreds of new found friends who REALLY know how to enjoy themselves at a party.

His housekeeper, Maria, however, takes a very dim view of all his revelry, and finally after a particularly boisterous thrash she puts her foot down. When the last of the louts disappears down the drive in his Aston Martin, all Willy can think about is crashing out in his four-poster. But Maria won't let him into his room until ALL the discarded glasses and bottles have been cleared away.

Can you help Willy out of his dilemma? He hasn't explored his mansion properly yet (it IS a large place and he HAS been VERY busy) and there are some very strange things going on in the further recesses of the house (I wonder what the last owner WAS doing in his laboratory the night he disappeared). You should manage O.K. though you will probably find some loonies have been up on the roof and I would check down the road and on the beach if I was you.

Good luck and don't worry, all you can lose in this game is sleep.

Name: Jet Star Universe
Overview:
Game featuring 8 levels, variety of enemies, and power ups to choose from.

Take in command of the Jet to shoot in outer space and beating the final boss. Reach your goal towards a high score and getting to the top 10 list.

Name: Jake's Discount Video Game
Overview: Jake's discount game is a multiplayer strategy platformer game.

Name: Jammer
Overview: Jammer is a rhythm game in which each level visually represents one of ten included songs. Gameplay unfolds across up to five vertically scrolling lanes, each capable of displaying three parallel nodes, though only one node per lane is active at any given moment. Players control a device with three aligned circles that match the node layout of a lane. The device can be moved horizontally to switch lanes, and the player must press the correct button when a node aligns beneath a circle. Multiple lanes can have active nodes simultaneously, allowing for dynamic input across the field. While there is no failure condition, sustained accuracy on a single lane fills a progress bar, altering the musical output.

Name: Jemboree
Overview: Jemboree is a game in which you place ‘jems’ onto a board in order to make collections of three or greater to score points.•Normal and Time attack modes•Intuitive controls – simple drag and drop•High scores and achievements through GameCenter and OpenFeint•Universal app with Retina enabled graphics

Name: Jetpack Man
Overview:
Navigate Jetpack Man (and his friend Sonic Sid the Squid) through the mazes, avoiding the baddies, collecting power-ups, and eating whatever is in your way!

Play simultaneously with a friend as you try to make it to the Theoretical 4th Dimension!

Name: Jade Konoichi: Ep.1
Overview:
Follow the adventures of the young ninja girl, Jade Konoichi, as she races through the forest to save the butterflies from the evil wasp king.

Dash through four colorful seasons! Avoid angry wasps and ants as you leap over pits in a quest for a high score! Use your collected butterflies to buy power-ups, like Speed Boost, Monarch Song, and even a feisty Sidekick.

Name: Jetpack Rapture
Overview:
The Rapture happened. You were left behind.

You own a jetpack and have a sweet punk rock mohawk.

REVENGE!

Name: Jewel Dervish
Overview:
Jewel Dervish can be a meditative action/puzzle game. On the other hand, it can be a panic-inducing race against time and friction!

Whatever you prefer, you will find Jewel Dervish to be a great gaming experience with high replay value. Come meet Hypno kitty and smash the pretty rocks!

**No Jewels were harmed in the making of this Dervish**

Name: Jigsaw Jumble Xmas 2012
Overview: Jigsaw Jumble is back with 15 more puzzles in this special Christmas themed edition. Play cooperatively with a friend and solve the puzzles together or play alone for a greater challenge. Features 3 difficulty modes for each puzzle and the ability to resume a puzzle at a later date. With Christmas music included and custom track support.

Name: Jigsaw World
Overview: Jigsaw World is jigsaw puzzle game with a twist. Perform combos to increase the time and finish the puzzle on time. Compete through the story mode doing over 150 puzzles on the 5 continents or select a puzzle and configure the difficulty level to play in. A great classic family game for people of all ages and experiences thanks to its configurable difficulty level.

Name: Jewelry Master Twinkle Light
Overview: Jewelry Master Twinkle become easier and re-release ! The jewels drop one after another. Join the jewels and enclose by the stones to erase ! The Graphics and the scenarios are changeable. It will depend on game play. You can enjoy the game kind of like a date. The game system has been changed. It's Especially recommended for beginners !

Name: Jewelry Master Twinkle
Overview:
Jewelry Master Twinkle is a falling-block puzzle game similar to Cleopatra Fortune and Tetris 2 from the makers of Tetris: The Grand Master. Each piece that falls into the well is made up of jewels and blocks. Jewels come in seven colors: three primary colors (red, blue, and green), three intermediate colors (yellow, purple, and turquoise), and the "perfect" color, white. Any jewels that touch will combine colors until they reach white.

If a group of gems is completely surrounded by blocks, then they will combine colors; if they are already all the same color, then they will vanish along with any other similarly-colored gems on the screen. If a line of blocks is completed, all blocks in that line will vanish. Blocks and gems can fall to create continuing combos. If the pieces reach the top of the well, then the game ends.

There are three difficulty settings, each of which is accompanied by a cute girl. As the game is played, the girl will react and say different things to the player. If the player does exceptionally well, the girl may even change into a different outfit. Game replays can be saved, and there is also a screen-saver mode where images of the girls are displayed.

Name: Jigsaw Guru
Overview: Jigsaw Guru is a relaxing jigsaw puzzle game, with some useful helps for players having a hard time finishing a puzzle, or wanting an easier experience. Very casual, with no time limit, you can save whenever you want, and pick up where you left off. Depending on the difficulty level you choose, a game can last between a minute and a whole hour.

Name: Jigsaw Jumble
Overview: Jigsaw Jumble is a game for one or two players. With over 20 different jigsaws to play each with 3 difficulty levels and the ability to load and resume games, there is plenty of gameplay for all the family.

Name: Jimmy vs Zombies
Overview:
Take Jimmy and burst zombies with your lazer gun, your fire gun, your plasma gun or your bazooka!

Roll on them with you car ! Put turrets and landmines to blast them and to protect your granny !

This Retro 2D game mixes Run & Gun, Tower Defence and Waves shooter.

Name: JewellCity
Overview:
JewellCity is open for business and you are the mayor.

Use the tiles to build a thriving city but be warned: Line up three tiles in a row and watch it all come crashing down!

Name: Jimbo Vs Legion of Darkness
Overview:
The hordes of the underworld have finally come to enslave the humanity that has thrived above them for ages. Needless to say, mankind was not prepared and is fading fast, but one may yet prove he has what it takes to send a legion of darkness packing.

As Jimbo, a good ole' boy from Mississippi, use your arsenal to shoot, dismember, and explode these evil trespassers back to their unholy source!

Name: Jewel Fever
Overview: "Jewel Fever" is an addictive match-3-puzzle-game.  If you ever get angry just play "Jewel Fever" to relax!

Name: JigDoku
Overview: JigDoku is a jigsaw puzzle game in which the player reconstructs a completed sudoku puzzle that has been divided into separate pieces. On the easy difficulty setting, each piece consists of a 3x3 grid. As the difficulty increases to medium and high, the puzzle pieces become smaller. All pieces fit together without overlapping and can't be rotated. The game includes a total of nine distinct puzzles.

Name: Johnny Platform's Biscuit Romp
Overview:
Johnny Platform's Biscuit Romp is pretty much exactly what the title suggests: a man named Johnny jumps around on Platforms, some of which are Biscuits, and he generally Romps around. Not mentioned in the title, but also important, are Johnny's affinity for coffee as well as the army of evil robots he must defeat.

Johnny Platform is a single-screen puzzle platform game where the player must find a way to eliminate all on-screen enemies and reach the door. Some stages feature biscuits which can be pushed around, and Johnny himself can also double-jump and pop enemies by jumping upon their heads. There are also cups of coffee on each stage, and if Johnny collects enough of these, he gets an extra life. There are more than 50 stages, and the game saves a checkpoint every five stages.

The Xbox 360 version is a port of the original Nintendo DS version. The 360 version has some re-ordering of the levels for difficulty balancing purposes plus also adds an additional 5 levels, but is otherwise the same game.

Name: Joint Strike Future
Overview: Joint Strike Future is a vertically scrolling shoot'em up. The player controls a space ship which has to destroy space pirates which try to invade. Enemies are color-coded to the Xbox 360 controller buttons which are used to switch between the four weapon systems. Choosing the correct weapons is important because the enemies are vulnerable against their color. Killed enemies leave behind colored orbs which power up the corresponding weapon when collected. Colliding with an enemy or their shots results in the loss of life energy which eventually causes the loss of a life. There are multiple levels which end with a boss fight.

Name: Johnny Carnage
Overview: Help Johnny Carnage rescue the girls from the evil skeletons from mars! Bullets, explosions and pure violence in this addictive platformer/shooter. Show your hero skills to the world! Brought to you by Milkstone Studios.

Name: Journey To The Top: QFTLG
Overview:
Journey to the top in your quest for the lost gems. The gems must be retrieved and re-forged to break the spell that cast the human race to the depths of the ocean.

Enjoy a classic platformer with modern twists. Journey to the top for the fate of the human race depends on you!

Name: Juggle!
Overview: JUGGLE! is a heartfelt tribute to classic gaming. It's a trip back in time to the origins of arcade games that captures the 1970s vibe. Use your paddle to bat balls into the air. The more balls you juggle, the more points you score. It's as simple as that.* No-nonsense rules and immediate action.* Heart-warming retro styling with a distinctly modern flavour.* Space-age audio effects take you on a trip.* Find your own groove by playing along to your favorite tunes.

Name: Jonny Crush
Overview: Jonny Crush is a full-out 3D first-person shooter, filled with intense bug-killing action. Experience the thrill of taking down swarms of up to one-thousand bugs in a single level. Unlock your weapons on a point-based system, as well as having the opportunity to be one of the top ten players in the world. The combos you make with your guns are limitless.

Name: Juggler
Overview: In a post-apocalyptic future, the only way to save the world is by hitting balls with a paddle. Keep balls alive as long as you can to get the highest score and maybe a pony.

Name: Johnny's Minefield
Overview: Happy-go-lucky Johnny playing in the field.

Name: Johnny's Skydiving Lessons
Overview: The first lesson of skydiving is...

Name: Jump Duck
Overview:
In Jump Duck the goal is to either jump or duck to avoid laser beams flying across the screen from the right. Avoiding certain number of lasers will unlock additional characters.

The game features (aside from the single player mode) local multiplayer for up to 4 people or online play over Xbox Live Arcade for up to 16 players.

Name: The Jump Hero
Overview:
The Jump Hero is an auto-run platformer: the hero automatically moves forward (the speed changes with the pace of the background song) and the player presses a button to jump. The longer the button is pressed, the higher the resulting jump is. Additionally the character can also double-jump, glide in the air (prolonging the time until the ground is reached) and dive (the opposite). The basic goal is to survive as long as possible to earn a place on the high-score list.

There are two main ways to lose a live: falling down a hole or running into one of the various hazardous objects (e.g. mines or a ceiling) which are marked red. The platforms are not solid on the sides which means a return is still possible when running of a ledge. On the way there are several extras to collect, e.g. extra lives, stars (four equal a live) or points which give an instant speed boost.

Besides playing the levels based on the seven songs (optionally with only three or one available lives), there is also a free run mode where the songs and difficulty can be customized.

Name: Jump Jet Challenge
Overview:
Fly across Europe in a Jump Jet, perfecting your landings on runways, helipads and ships; buy and sell goods to fund your trips; but watch out for the guns.

Complete all sixteen levels and make a million to win.

Now with three levels of difficulty - Normal, Difficult and Impossible.

Name: Junk Fields
Overview: Use be anyway... Must be survive! Speedy 3D Robot Action Shooting

Name: Jungle Blocks
Overview: Jungle Blocks is a Breakout variant in which the player controls a paddle located at the bottom of the screen. The paddle moves horizontally to deflect a ball upward toward destructible blocks. The objective in each level is to eliminate all blocks using the ball’s trajectory. Unlike traditional versions, this game does not impose a limit on lives; when a ball falls past the paddle, it results in a point deduction rather than a game over. Points are awarded for each block destroyed, and a score multiplier is applied when multiple blocks are broken in succession without the ball returning to the paddle. There are 14 levels and a co-op mode.

Name: Junior Street Ninja
Overview:
Junior Street Ninja is a 2D platformer game with an authentic Asian soundtrack & fast & fun game play.

The young ninja is named Sheng-Li who must pass a series of tests that will prove that he is a skilled & intelligent fighter without using any weapons so that he can rightfully earn the title of "first born ".

Name: Jungle Friendzy
Overview:
Welcome to Jungle Friendzy, a hysterical online team deathmatch sporting cartoony graphics and three unique classes, each with its own set of abilities.

Wreak havoc using an array of amusing weaponry including a Bee-cannon and a Carnivorous plant.

Bring your friends and team up against the indie community!

Name: Junkyard Battle
Overview: The goal of Junkyard Battle is to build a higher junk tower than your opponent. Use your crane claw to stack stuff and pick up power-ups to gain speed, time och concrete your tower. Single player training missions are available but make sure you try out the multiplayer battle mode!

Name: Jump'n Bounce
Overview: Test your skill and learn to master the brain-racking world of spikes and sawblades in 50 levels of pure splatmania, including 10 additional hardcore Directors Cut maps inspired by old arcade games from the 80s and modern platform games of today. Jumpn Bounce is a 1.00 dollar old-school platform game with modern-day gameplay featuring a bouncing emoticon with hardcore abilities.

Name: Jumper Robot
Overview: Jumper Robot is a classic style platformer in which you have to save the robotic world through more than 30 levels.

Name: Jungle Jam
Overview:
An energized Match 3 game with a slight problem. Just when you think you have everything under control, a mischievous monkey jumps in to induce disorder.

30 levels of fun and aggravation await you deep in the heart of the jungle. Venture all the way through and you will truly deserve the title "King of the Jungle".

Let's get monkified.

Name: A Jumper Robot Adventure
Overview: A Jumper Robot Adventure is a basic side-scrolling platform game starring a small robot, which plays much like the classic Super Mario series. The robot must reach the end of each area and defeat the boss. Green and red squares award points; collect 100 squares to win an extra life. There are also various powerups like temporary invincibility, and bullets that award the ability to shoot if enough are collected. The robot can also jump on many enemies to defeat them. Progress is saved at disk doors in each stage.

Name: Final Fantasy XI Online: Vana'Diel Collection 2008
Overview:
This collection extends the 2007 compilation with the inclusion of the fourth expansion pack. The bundle contains:

* Final Fantasy XI Online (base game)
* Rise of the Zilart (add-on)
* Chains of Promathia (add-on)
* Treasures of Aht Urhgan (add-on)
* Wings of the Goddess (add-on)

Name: Kaleidoscope
Overview:
Kaleidoscope is a side-scrolling platformer in which three "Pigments" may be collected in each level and accumulated to unlock any subsequent levels and reach the end of the game. Levels are explored by moving and jumping, and the player has three regenerating "color" gauges at their disposal which they can use to run faster, double-jump, or shield their character from projectiles. Obstacles include grumpy animals, spikes, shooting flowers, moving platforms, and air currents.

The world of Kaleidoscope is a fictional planet with inhabitants, places, and history with names and references based on things having to do with colors and painting. The world has been afflicted by a disease which drained it of all color, and the protagonist, named Tint, is on a mission to restore all color to Kaleidoscope and save its inhabitants. He does so by collecting color spheres, which slowly brings color to the monochromatic background and objects of each level, and jumping on top of monochromatic "enemies" to return them to color and render them harmless. Each level ends when Tint has collected one out of three "pigments" which he must traverse the level to find.

The game consists of 12 levels over-viewed by a world map. The levels are split up into 4 different areas, the last of which challenges the player with slightly different ways of collecting the three pigments of the level. Each level has a number of pigments which must be found before the player is able to play the level. In addition to the goal pigments the player tries to find, each level has red, yellow, and blue color spheres scattered throughout it which, when collected, refill one of the color gauges. When enough of each color sphere is collected, the level art starts changing in steps from monochromatic to colorful, and tracks are added to the background music to accent this change as well.

Name: Kaiten Patissier!
Overview:
Pipi is a girl who loves children. She travels from village to village, making delicious sweets and giving them to children everywhere. Today, she is out looking for ingredients to use for baking more sweets.

Kaiten Patissier! is a puzzle platform game where the player controls Pipi, who must collect all of the food items on each stage. Her primary method of traversing each stage is to rotate the entire stage ninety degrees by pushing on walls. This will reorient the stage as well as some of the objects within it, allowing access to different areas depending on the direction of rotation.

There are 50 stages total, and the game will track the player's best time and rotation count for each stage, as well as if the secret item for that stage has been found. There are also par times and rotation counts for each stage; if the player beats both and also finds the secret item, then a gold medal is earned for that stage. The player can freely choose any stage to play at any time.

Name: Kaotik Puzzle
Overview: Arrange the blocks to make them disappear, make chain reactions, attack to your opponent, play versus the CPU or versus human players, locally or in Xbox Live, customize the game the way you want... Kaotik puzzle is the puzzle of puzzles!

Name: Katana Land
Overview:
Awesome 2D ninja platforming action!

Play as the Katana Kid and fight to save Katana Land from devious ninja's, hordes of the undead and demon bosses. Along the way help an old guy out, rescue your allies and save a princess from the fate of becoming a demon bride!!!

Name: Karnn Age
Overview: Survive through 9 intense levels, including 3 epic boss fights ! each level is available in 4 difficulty modes ! Replays of your best performances in each level/difficulty are automatically saved and reviewable ! Also contains replays of each level on Hard difficulty to watch and learn from !

Name: KGB: Episode One
Overview: Blow up machine-gun nest, Destroy an ammunition-dump, Navigate a land-mine infested maze in a burned-out forest, Rescue a helicopter pilot, Man dual M60's mounted on a helicopter, Search terrorist camp sites and burn down their operations to find the intel on their evil plans! One square mile of open sandbox! RPG's, Grenades, Heli Mounted M60's!

Name: The Keep: Zombie Horde
Overview:
During the zombie apocalypse, the player found an interesting job: taking care of the Citizen Protection Facility, a fortified tower. It has four windows which allow free view into the cardinal directions. During each wave, both a big number of zombies and some survivors move towards the tower. The goal is to protect the survivors from zombie attacks until they reach safety. Between waves, the player can spend the earned money (rewarded for each saved survivor) for new weapons, more ammo or more tower floors. Every other wave is a bonus round during which as many zombies as possible have to be killed with a machine gun: the more deaths, the more survivors appear in the next wave.

In contrast to other wave-based shooters, the waves last relatively long (about five minutes) and even the standard pistol has limited ammo. The alternative is a knife, but it is only useful against zombies which manage to enter the tower and attack the player directly.

Name: Karsus
Overview:
Karsus found a magic book during an expedition. When he returned home, a storm struck with full force, forcing him to drop his book in a cave.

Help him find the magic book.

Name: Kapture
Overview: Enroll as an agent to capture the one who has plagued our nation. Intensive training, aerial combats, ground battles and a car chase for a plethora of medals, glory and recognition in this action adventure. Find it tough? Enroll an accomplice and play as a team! Aim for 20 medals and 5 stars and build up an impressive profile.

Name: Star Wars: First Assault
Overview:
Star Wars: First Assault was a video game in development at LucasArts. It was canceled due to the closure of LucasArts after The Walt Disney Company's purchase of Lucasfilm.

Star Wars: First Assault was a multiplayer-focused Star Wars video game. The domain name for StarWarsFirstAssault.com, which is currently empty, was registered by LucasArts' parent company, Lucasfilm. The trademark for the product relates to "interactive entertainment software." This has in turn made several gaming sites such as GameSpy.com and IGN.com speculate that the then-upcoming product was indeed another LucasArts video game. Kotaku.com revealed leaked footage from the game and speculated that it would be a title for the Xbox 360 on the downloadable arcade that would feature gameplay similar to the Battlefront series.

Richard Lim created concept art for the game which featured conflicts between Rebel troopers and stormtroopers. Additionally, Tim Temmerman served as a Systems Designer on the project. According to Patrick Wren, who worked as a designer for LucasArts, the game was mere months from launch when it was canceled, with development costs having already been taken care of. He further elaborated that the official announcement for the game was scrapped about 24 hours before it would have been announced, thus preventing it from entering beta testing and leaving it in obscurity compared to other projects like Star Wars: 1313.

Name: A Killer's Dream
Overview: A Killer's Dream is a part horror, part puzzle game in which the player must experience in game dreams in order to identify a murderer. During the dreams scenes,the player will observe places that are relevant to a murder and it is important to observe what is going on and look for letters scattered throughout the dream which will allow the player to determine who the murderer is.

Name: Kinect Playfit
Overview:
Microsoft today unveiled Kinect PlayFit, a new Kinect fitness dashboard on Xbox LIVE that lets players track calories burned across multiple Kinect games. Available as a free download from the Xbox LIVE Marketplace, the app calculates and aggregates the calories players burn so they can track their progress over time, see how they rank against friends, and earn Xbox achievements.

Kinect PlayFit lets players track their calorie burn across multiple games.

The goal of the app is to motivate families to get off the couch and reward them for having fun, said Chuck Frizelle, executive producer for Kinect PlayFit.

Kinect PlayFit will track fitness progress across a dozen games at first, with more titles to come later, Frizelle said. The dashboard lets players view their daily, weekly, monthly, and overall calorie burn totals, and Xbox leaderboards offer the chance to compare progress with friends and the overall Xbox LIVE community. Players can also earn up to 20 Xbox achievements, including bonus avatar awards, and post them on Facebook.

The key features - rewarding players for their time and effort with achievements, giving them challenges, and comparing their calorie burn totals with friends -make Kinect PlayFit a healthy parallel to the joystick-based-gamer score.

Name: KILLBOX
Overview:
Experiment with over 200 guns against 45 different enemy types, ranging from the mafia to armor outfitted spec-ops, to cyborgs and zombies in 48 animated levels, each in 1080P HD. Each gun has its own unique properties, realistic stats, and sound.

Slow down time and watch the bullets as they fly through the air.

Name: Killa Hurtz
Overview: Race your RC car against AI opponents armed with an assortment of weapons. Race on one of five detailed courses or create a custom course.

Name: Killer Crypt
Overview:
Make your way past several stages into the heart of the crypt to find and destroy an ancient vampire.

An old school platformer filled with deadly traps, jumps, puzzles, and secrets, along with the vampire's countless evil minions.

But beating the game is only half the battle. You'll need to explore and use your wits to find all of the relics for the true ending.

Name: Kick'n It
Overview:
Kick’n It! is a Hacky Sack style game that friends and family can play together with their Avatars.

Perform kicks, stalls, tricks and combos. Compete for high scores. Take full control of your Avatar.

There’s plenty of gameplay packed into 4 Single player and 4 Multiplayer game modes - including crowd pleaser Bomb Squad!

Name: Kissy Poo
Overview: A game for the littlest of gamers. The animals are sad and need some cheering up. Here comes Kissy Poo bringing happiness and cheer. With a lot of love and the help of some little hands, help Kissy Poo fill the Care Meter and enjoy a fun, dancy time with all the animal friends.

Name: Knights of Jadora
Overview: An RPG themed tower defense game, with a gripping story and intense combat.

Name: King Swing
Overview:
King Swing is the first ever physics based swinging game for Xbox Live Indie Games. Fly high above the jungle canopy launching from one dangerous cliff to the next! However, make a mistake and you will tumble toward the river below, quickly becoming a victim of hungry piranhas!

Features include ragdoll physics, online high scores, three unique game modes, day and night cycle.

Name: Kiss Kiss
Overview: A fun new Quiz game - Can you impress the girl in to joining you under the mistletoe? 15 out of hundreds of possible questions are all that stand in between you and a first person view, virtual kiss with the girl of your dreams under the mistletoe! 3D version included in full game (you will need red/blue glasses to enjoy effect)

Name: A Kitchen Sink War
Overview: A Kitchen Sink War is similar to the classic game Asteroids. It puts the two players in control of a spoon and a goblet that are being drawn towards the sink's drain. They must destroy other pieces of kitchen equipment whilst trying to avoid being sucked down into the pipework. This is achieved by rotating and shooting. Between rounds the players can purchase upgrades with owned points.

Name: Knock Balls: Spin to Win
Overview: Play against friends and show them who has the best control over the ball. In this fast and interactive game no moment will be a slow one. With game modes as Goal Hunting, Deatmatch, Team Deathmatch and Hunted, and with 10 different maps, you can be sure you get a lot of gameplay for your money. This game is the ultimate party game!

Name: King Spray
Overview:
Turn your Xbox controller into a spray can and start creating masterpieces using spray paint, markers, rollers and stencils. Use the camera to take photos of your work to show your friends.

The in-game old school Ghetto Blaster can be used to play your tunes. The Projector mode allows you to project and spray on real-life objects.

Name: King's Cup
Overview:
Everybody's favorite drinking card game is now available on your Xbox! No more digging through the junk drawer for lost cards or scouring the internet for the card rules. Just grab some friends and some drinks and pass that controller around!

Get ready to laugh, drink, and even take off some clothes with King's Cup.

Please remember to drink responsibly.

Name: Kobold's Quest
Overview:
Three chapters of hardcore baby stealing action! Cut Scenes straight from the bowels of Newgrounds!

Join your Kobold compatriots in this platforming grief game.

Name: Kinetic Kube S
Overview: Kinetic Kube S is an electric blend of intense action and split second decisions served with a side of "zone to this" music and "cannot take your eyes away" graphics!

Name: Kollectiv360
Overview: Kollectiv 360 is a fast paced puzzle based action game that combines elements from other popular puzzle and strategy games to come up with a brand new, unique and addicting gameplay style and objective. Players will delight in the multiple levels of difficulty and various gameplay modes. Plan your moves accordingly and try to aim for the awesome bonus of the Kollectiv!

Name: Kollosus Roar
Overview:
This game has 4 levels with different gameplay in each one, featuring in-your-face cut scenes.

WARNING! This game is extremely difficult. Do you have what it takes? You really have to ask yourself this question.

Rock out to an original soundtrack containing various styles of music such as chiptune, dubstep, trance, and trap.

In space no one can hear you scream, but they can FEEL THE ROAR!!!!

Name: Kong360: Gorilla Warfare
Overview: Kong360: Gorilla Warfare is a top-down shooter game featuring monkeys with a thirst for blood in a full 3D environment. The rules are simple, pick up as many health/armor packs and weapons as you can before blowing your enemies into smithereens. Computer controlled bots are provided as target practice but the real fun comes from playing in multiplayer split screen, system link or Xbox LIVE.

Name: Kozu
Overview: Kozu: a tale about Nothing. Twin stick shooter. Cooperative Multiplayer. Strange weapons, improbable enemies.

Name: Kodu Game Lab
Overview: Kodu is a new visual programming language made specifically for creating games. It is designed to be accessible for children and enjoyable for anyone. The visual programming environment allows rapid design iteration using only a game controller for input. Share your creations with friends over XBOX LIVE.

Name: Krazy Alienz
Overview:
A unique take on a classic shooter, with previously unseen powerups/downs, which truly enhance the gameplay.

Smooth local multiplayer for up to four players.

Three game types, each with its own unique gameplay elements and tons of levels. Local highscores and many options.

Not just another button basher, but it sure is a blast!

Name: Krisotron
Overview: Krisotron is an action packed shoot-em-up game. You play as Krisotron attempting to rescue Princess Noida from the evil Dr. Gacy. Make your way through 4 chapters (20 levels) of non stop action. Increase your abilities along the way by finding action point power ups.

Name: Kukaku
Overview: Kukaku is a 2-player competitive puzzle game where the player must shoot colored blocks in order to match them. The player can fire blocks onto their field from the side; if three or more of the same color touch, they are destroyed, causing blocks to appear on the opponent's side and raising their tension bar. If the tension bar for a player fills completely, their entire field is moved one square closer to their launcher, and if the blocks reach the end of the field, the other player wins. There are versus CPU and survival modes for one player, as well as a two-player versus mode.

Name: Kung Fu FIGHT!
Overview: Fight the bad guys, save the girl - you know the drill! Relentless old-school action as your run, jump and fight your way through your quest of rescue and revenge.• Non-stop action!• Retro-styled, old school gameplay.• Battle through varied environments against unique enemies.• Multiple difficulty modes add challenge and replayability.

Name: Kube Ball
Overview:
Action packed ping pong with power balls that deliver intense specials online and off.

Fun and kid friendly, with a challenging edge for both the casual and hardcore gamer.

Name: Kubrik 3D
Overview: Kubrik 3D is an addictive 3D take on a block stacking classic. Rotate the falling shapes then drop them into place to clear layers. The object being to prevent the blocks from reaching the top and to survive as long as possible. Featuring colourful 3d graphics and exciting fast paced gameplay, Kubrik 3D takes this style of puzzler into the next dimension!

Name: Kuchibi
Overview: Explosions anyone? Beware, this captivating puzzler melts your mind while you are flipping the fuses to build ever longer chains, for ever longer explosions and higher scores. Featuring lots of extras, four game modes, highscore lists, medals (with replays!) and online top-score lists - all wrapped into a stylish design, for hours of mind bending puzzle fun.

Name: Guitar Hero Encore: Rocks the 80s
Overview:
Welcome to the Future of GH80s!!!

Background
GH Rocks the 80s was an underappreciated PS2 exclusive Guitar Hero entry. It had unique character models and venues that never made their way over to Xbox. But what if they did? Thanks to tooling (superfreq), and knowledge advancements, both are now possible on real Xbox 360.

Features
No "Deluxe" features
As vanilla as possible
has all 80s characters, venues, songs, ui, but now on Xbox 360
only has 80s chars and venues selectable, not gh2 chars and venues
all songs are completely vanilla 80s
Strum limit is even here
does not load dlc to be even more faithful to 80s

Name: Ridge Racer Collection
Overview: A System 22 emulator fine-tuned for the Ridge Racer series on XBOX 360. Supports Ridge Racer, Ridge Racer 2, and Rave Racer. Offline solo play enabled in all three titles. Online Head-to-Head play enabled for Ridge Racer 2 and Rave Racer.

Name: DmC: Devil May Cry: Vergil's Downfall
Overview:
Aside from playing as Vergil throughout the content, Vergil's Downfall features additional hidden items to collect, two new enemies and a new boss, and has a leaderboard with which to compete with others. The content also comes with four difficulty levels, new combos, and new locations.

Vergil uses many of his traditional skills, including several based on Slash Dimension, Air Trick, and Summoned Swords, and is able to use Devil Trigger to generate a doppelganger.

Name: Ace Driver Collection
Overview: The Ace Driver System 22 Collection features an arcade emulator designed to run the Ace Driver games on Xbox 360 hardware. The games run at full speed in HD with native 16:9 rendering.

Name: Spelunky
Overview: Spelunky is a critically acclaimed roguelike 2D platformer created by Derek Yu. Players explore procedurally generated, destructible caves filled with treasure, traps, and monsters. Famous for its punishing difficulty and permadeath, the game requires players to learn from their mistakes and master the environment to survive.Core GameplayPermadeath: If you lose all your health, you start the game from the beginning with only your base equipment.Randomized Levels: Every playthrough generates a unique cave system, meaning you have to adapt rather than memorize layouts.

Name: Dirt Dash
Overview:
This is an arcade emulator designed to run Namco's Dirt Dash on Xbox 360 hardware at full speed in HD with native 16:9 rendering.

Dirt Dash is a solo only game, there is no multiplayer at all in this game. The usual options apply; widescreen/4:3 toggle, Controller/Steering Wheel toggle, customisable controls etc.

Name: Burnout Paradise: The Ultimate Box
Overview:
Burnout Paradise: The Ultimate Box is the definitive edition of Criterion Games' acclaimed open-world racing game. Set in the sprawling streets of Paradise City, players can compete in high-speed races, Road Rage events, Stunt Runs, and Marked Man challenges while freely exploring the city and discovering shortcuts, jumps, and hidden secrets.

The Ultimate Box includes the original Burnout Paradise experience along with major content updates, including the Cagney update, Bikes expansion, and Party Pack. Players can take to the streets in a wide variety of cars and motorcycles, earning new vehicles by winning events and taking down rivals. Online multiplayer supports up to eight players in Freeburn challenges, while Party Pack adds local pass-the-controller multiplayer for up to eight participants.

Featuring spectacular crashes, intense takedowns, and seamless open-world gameplay, Burnout Paradise: The Ultimate Box delivers one of the most exciting arcade racing experiences ever released.

Name: Virtua Fighter
Overview: Virtua Fighter, Model 1 version, ported to Xbox 360.  Features 60fps HD Widescreen. 1 or 2 Players

Name: Virtua Racing
Overview:
Virtua Racing ported to Xbox 360, via Sega Model 1 emulator optimized for Xbox 360.

Features:

* 60fps HD Widescreen.
* Force Feedback racing wheel.
* Rumble on controller.

Name: Ladybird Galaxy
Overview: Ladybird Galaxy is a fixed-screen arcade game. The player controls a space ship which collects gems in order to achieve a high score. A combo multiplier starts after collecting stars which allows to earn even more points. It runs out after some time, but this can be prevented by collecting more stars. Ladybirds which move over the screen but don't actively chase the player cause the loss of a life when touched. This is made more difficult by the big turning arc of the ship. Revenge is only possible after collecting special stars which allow the space ship to briefly shoot. Occasionally laser beams appear which have to be dodged by utilizing the fact that the ship appears on the opposite site after leaving the screen. After enough points are earned, the difficulty level rises and the game ends after all lives are gone.

Name: Lair of the Evildoer
Overview:
Lair of the Evildoer is a top-down shooter set in a closed environment that consists of 20 floors. The player has to descend and clear the floors off enemies to reach Dr. Odious who locked up the character in his lair. It is primarily an action game but also contains a number of RPG elements.

The character can be moved around and aim in any direction. Enemies can be destroyed using melee attacks or long-ranged weapons. Only two ranged weapons can be carried at any time. Guns need to be reloaded and have a limited amount of ammo. When a new weapon is discovered, the statistics can be compared to decide whether to swap or not. Ranged weapons are defined through damage, force, firing speed, damage per second, spread, clip size, ammo consumption and reload time.

By destroying opponents the character gains experience and can level up. Points can be assigned to dexterity (primary damage, sidearm damage, and accuracy), strength (melee damage and max ammo), vitality (max XP and regeneration rate), and defense (defense and mass). Enemies have health bars and often appear in large numbers. Pick-ups include weapons, ammo, and health. The levels are procedurally generated and that way they are different for each playthrough. The game contains 30 enemy types and 25 weapons with additional variations.

Name: Labyrinth X
Overview: Explore a mystic labyrinth filled with strange and sexy creatures.

Name: Labyrinth
Overview:
Step into the strange world of the Labyrinth as Amelia, a young woman with no memories of who she is, or why she is trapped here. All she knows is that she must travel deeper, towards the tall Black Tower.

She will learn that even darker secrets await her in the deeper layers of the Labyrinth. She wants to escape and regain her memories, but the Labyrinth is more than just a maze.

Name: Lab Rabbit
Overview:
You are a worthless rabbit. However you have the privilege of helping further science. What lies before you are a series of experiments. They will test you speed, your agility and the effects of high powered lasers on rabbits.

Why you may ask? SCIENCE!

Name: Lamingtons Zero
Overview: Hordes of delicious but evil coconut and chocolate covered treats are trying to take over the world! Grab your guns and fight back! Or you can team up with a friend and fight together!

Name: Landmark
Overview: Landmark is a concentration variant. The player is confronted with a number of tiles concealed tiles. During each turn, two of them are chosen and revealed. If they have the same picture, they stay open - otherwise they become concealed again. The goal is to open up all tiles. The game features four difficulty modes which differ in number of tiles (six or nine pairs) and rotation (the playfield either does not rotate, rotates after each wrong guess, rotates after every turn or rotates continuously).

Name: Lander Mania
Overview: Welcome to Lander Mania, an exciting single or multi-player game, where each player racks up points by landing their ship safely. Rotate your ship and fire your thrusters to get the perfect speed and angle or you will crash! Battle your friends for the top of the scoreboard, by bashing into them and getting to the landing pads first!

Name: Larry's Loot
Overview:
Try to collect as many money bags as you can, while avoiding baddies. Up to 3 friends can join you to help you collect more money and find the exit to win!

A very addicting and fun game, which is randomly generated, so you will never play the same game twice!

Name: Laser Fry
Overview:
Use the lasers to zap the different colored orbs, but be careful not to zap yourself!

Try to complete all of the challenges as you rave on.

Name: Laserbreaker
Overview: LaserBreaker is a fun game in which you have to destroy a target employing laser shots of four different colours. In each stage the target is protected by some blocks, which only can be destroyed by laser of its own colour.

Name: The Last Cannonball
Overview: You have one cannonball left. The enemy is too far away to hit.... but don't fret. Bounce the ball off of landmines and fallen foes to get more distance. Watch out for birds and sand traps though. Go the distance and get the high score. Play with up to 4 players on one controller.

Name: The Last Fortune
Overview:
Bennetor is attacked by forces from the neighbouring, and so far allied, kingdom Variste. After protecting his/her home, the player character sets out to find out Variste's motivations for the attack. Soon it becomes clear that the whole balance of power of the region hinges on finding one last fortune...

The Last Fortune is a side-scrolling action game with platforming elements. While walking from point A to B (usually left to right), the player jumps over gaps and other obstacles and primarily fights various enemies. Besides swinging the melee weapon up close, the only other available option is using the character's active special attack. However, this requires energy which is refilled by picking up lightning symbols during the levels. Between levels the player character visits a shop and can spend coins (earned by slaying enemies) for additional health, extra lives or more abilities like a double jump or other special attacks. Getting hit by enemies deducts live energy and eventually leads to death and the need to restart from the last checkpoint. When all lives are gone, the player needs to restart the whole level or purchase a continue.

When starting a new game, the player has the choice between two characters: Andre and Jeanne. They do not only have different special attacks, but also have their own dialogue during the frequent story sequences. Those consist of animations in the game engine and speech bubbles of the speaking characters. There are three difficulty levels and an optional arcade mode which does away with the story.

Name: Laser Logic
Overview: A test of deduction and perseverance: engineer the grid's clues to leave no section devoid of laser beams. Once you've become a master of the board, challenge your friends in VERSUS mode, or challenge yourself with an endless supply of generated puzzles.

Name: LaserCat
Overview:
LaserCat returns home one day to find that his owl friend Owlfriend has been kidnapped by the evil magic space frog Wizzord. Wizzord demands one million British Pounds Sterling of LaserCat for the release of Owlfriend, to be paid in full before tea time...but LaserCat doesn't have one million British Pounds Sterling! Thus, he decides he must take matters into his own hands, venturing into Wizzord's castle to rescue Owlfriend himself.

LaserCat is a multi-screen exploration-based platform game comparable to Jet Set Willy or VVVVVV. Exploring the castle, which contains 225 rooms total, the eponymous LaserCat must collect the 30 keys hidden throughout in order to open the gate to Owlfriend's cage. When collected, keys send LaserCat to the Riddle Realm, where they are presented with a trivia question -- answer correctly, and he can keep the key, but answer wrong and he is dropped in a pit of lava. Checkpoints are generously placed around the castle, and can also be warped between for easy travel. Death sends the player back to the last checkpoint reach, and returns and keys carried to their original location, but carries no other penalties.

Name: Last Dragon Standing
Overview:
Become a Dragon and face up to three of your friends in an epic battle!

Conquer the realm and become the Dragon God. Breathe fireballs at your opponents to destroy their Eggs. Destroy Villages to gain Powerups and buy upgrades to keep evolving your Dragon.

Can you be the Last Dragon Standing?

Name: The Last Pod Fighter
Overview: Fight your way through waves of ships in this 3D arcade style space shooter! Use your laser blasters and specialized weapons called "Pods" to destroy your enemies. The Pods' effects range from giving your ship a speed boost to creating a gravity well to suck in your enemies. Rack up the points in Survival or play through Arcade mode where you'll fight your way through to face the capital ships!

Name: Last Stand
Overview:
You are the Zombie Hunter. You are ready to make your Last Stand against the zombie horde.

You are trapped in a small bunker with zombies digging their way up through the ground. With each zombie that you kill, they grow even stronger.

Purchase stronger weapons to help you to last as you can. Get power ups to give you an advantage against the zombies for a short time.

Name: Lawnmower vs Zombies
Overview: Even when the undead strike, someone's gotta do the lawn!! Mow the lawn before the zombies get you in this fun, yet heart-pounding, revisit of a Commodore 64 classic! Start your lawnmowers!

Name: Lazy Gamer
Overview: I can't feel my legs... [ This games contains Coarse Language. Player Discretion is Advised ]

Name: Lazy Caverns
Overview:
Lazy Caverns is an arcade platform game. If you like retro game(Manic Miner,Jet Set willy..) You like this Game.

Features:
-Over 25 Levels
-Online High Score
-Retro graphics

Name: Lazy Caverns 2
Overview: Lazy Caverns 2 is a platform game. Guide Robby's father again to collect all marbles on each level.

Name: LCD Dungeon System
Overview: A first person dungeon crawling adventure in the style of early 80s LCD gaming. Explore seven levels of monsters, treasure and teleportation traps to reclaim the crown of kings. No watch batteries required!

Name: LCD Dungeon System XL
Overview:
Return to the monochrome dungeon in a newer, bigger adventure.

Gain XP and level up, find different weapons, face wandering monsters and save high scores.

Name: Learning can be fun
Overview:
Let your child learn their ABC's and 123's while having fun watching things come to life on the screen, with the clouds bringing rain, flowers attracting butterflies and the sun, the airplane and the windmill in motion. Finish off each session with fireworks.

Catchy background music and some random sounds should keep your kid entertained for a long time.

Learning something was never so much fun!

Name: Learn math and sciences
Overview: This game teaches you Math and Science.

Name: Learn the Controller
Overview:
Teach your children, significant other, or grandparents how to use the Xbox controller with this fun game for learning the buttons!

Make art and music in freestyle mode, test out those budding skills by showing the space hamster how fast you are getting, or test your memory by copying robot dance moves!

Learn the Controller features unique levels, different audio styles, and plenty of fun.

Name: LED Display
Overview: Transform your TV into a LED Display!

Name: League of Planets
Overview: The Emperor Wharg III has invaded the galaxy. Survivors of all the resistances of all planets are joined under the command of the great commander, Lucente. Lucente has created a rebellion force named the league of planets, an army to fight and take back all the planets of the Galaxy.

Name: Learn Basic Italian
Overview: Learn Basic Italian is a simple tool to learn Italian. This app have different categories like Basic Phrases, Vocabulary and Grammar.

Name: Learn Indo European Language
Overview: Free Language Tutorials: Basic Phrases, Vocabulary and Grammar in 4 Languages.

Name: The Legend of Aylesbury
Overview:
The Legend of Aylesbury is a 2 player co-operative platformer where a couple must rescue their pet duck using their unique abilities.

One player can turn into a bird, the other can use their grapple hook and together they can perform co-operative actions to span the landscape.

Name: Learn Basic French
Overview: Learn Basic French is a simple tool to learn French. This app have different categories like Basic Phrases, Vocabulary and Grammar.

Name: Learn the U.S Presidents
Overview: This game has teaches you the presidents of United States, learn the first lady, 50 States and etc.

Name: Learn To Eat
Overview: All you have to do is get the food in your mouth. Simple.

Name: Leave Home
Overview: Abstract shooter with dynamic difficulty and metaphorical explosions. Fixed length game session. Score points. Increase difficulty. Split shots. Leave Home...

Name: Legend of Max
Overview:
Legend of Max is an arcade adventure game. Help Max (little DOG) to find his master.

In this game, you must find key, make puzzles, combinations to advance..

Name: Legend of the Rune Lords: The Quest for Runic Magia
Overview: Long ago, in the Age of Runic Magia... Fantastic creatures roamed the land and Runes, the source of all magic, were available to all. That was until the Rune Lords came to hoard all of the precious Runes. Particularly the ancient and powerful Runic Magia. Legend of the Rune Lords: The Quest for Runic Magia is a short-form RPG featuring classic console RPG gameplay.

Name: Lemmy Lizard vs. The Mecha-Eggs
Overview: An epic old school platform adventure in which Lemmy battles the Mecha-Eggs with his toxic spit, ninja kick and inventory full of consumable treats. Under the guidance of his Uncle Lenny he must venture across grassy plains and explore underground caverns to grab the buglets and save the egglets on his way to his ultimate challenge: the Citadel!

Name: Legioner
Overview:
Cool shooter. Fight, collect money, upgrade weapons. Unleash hell on enemies...

Enjoy.

Name: Let's Learn Japanese: Beginner
Overview: Let's Learn Japanese: Beginner is a language learning game that helps to teach the Japanese written language. Learn Hiragana, Katakana, Kanji, and common words using Flashcard, Quiz, and Review mode.

Name: Lemonade Ltd.
Overview: In a world that gives you lemons, make lemonade... and SELL IT! Aided by break-even analysis and weather forecasts, determine the most profitable strategy by deciding stock levels, price, and marketing. Monitor sales throughout the day and track growth with daily graphs and reports. Simple to learn but difficult to master, you must compete for top place in the company league table!

Name: Let's Learn Japanese: Deluxe
Overview:
Have you ever wanted to learn Japanese? Are you studying Japanese and want to improve your skills? Then Let's Learn Japanese: Deluxe is for you! Designed for beginners and those learning Japanese, you will learn about the language basics, the 3 character sets, common words, and pronunciation.

Learn Hiragana and Katakana, Kanji, and 1700+ common words using Quiz, Flashcard, and Review mode. It also includes spoken pronunciation and stroke order!

Name: Let's Get Fiscal
Overview: A young accountant is on his way to meet with a client, when something unexpected happens causing maximum surprise.

Name: Lethal Judgment Origins
Overview: Welcome back into the battle of Proetynia! This new episode of Lethal Judgment will let you fight against aliens all along the original levels of previous games. Play 5 furious stages with HD graphics and win 15 challenges to unlock all the included awards.

Name: Leucistic Wyvern
Overview:
LEUCISTIC WYVERN is a deep-scrolling shooter. Control your character, the Wyvern, and shoot down waves of approaching enemies!

There are nine stages in total. Stages 3 and 6 are bonus stages.

Name: Level Zero
Overview:
You never thought going into space was a good idea... Turns out you were right.

See how long you can survive in this simple and fun-to-play shooter.

Name: Leximo
Overview:
Can you beat the clock? Can you beat the challenges?! Are you 1337 enough to SPELL?!

I don't think you are. Move along...

Name: Lexiv
Overview:
Build a city using just your words in this innovative puzzle-strategy game where each part of speech has a different effect!

Citizens will flock to your city, but can you keep them happy and safe from harm?

Test your skill through 4 varied worlds in a challenging 10+ hour campaign.

Name: Lethal Judgment
Overview: Play the popular series of PC Shoot them up on your Xbox 360 with a specially updated HD version of the game. Fight along 5 infested levels of Aliens and try to survive.

Name: Let's Draw & Share!
Overview: Draw pictures and send them to friends and family over Xbox LIVE.

Name: Licky Licky Lizards
Overview: Frantic fun for the whole family as you try to eat as many bugs as you can with your lizard using child friendly controls, but beware of the bees!

Name: Lifeguard
Overview:
Rescue drowning victims from the beach, and stuff. 21 levels, half of them runner, the other half a mix of CPR, driving, swimming, and flying.
