Does anyone ever read these descriptions? I doubt it... If you're one of the 0.001% of people still reading, send me a tweet on twitter saying you read til the end and I'll send you a free download code (if I still have any).

Name: Letter Munch
Overview: Munch. Spell. Score. How large is your vocabulary? Capture the falling letters to create words. Use double and triple-score tiles and chain multiple bonuses to keep time from expiring and get the high score.

Name: Light Bikes 360
Overview: Take on your friends in this 1 - 4 player fight to the death! Combining elements of many of your old, favourite classics into a single, modern, SUPERGAME OF TOTAL CHAOS AND DESTRUCTION!!

Name: Light Catcher
Overview: Catch the lights falling from the sky to light up your lamp! Get special color combos to get more points and go for the high score. Play cooperatively with a friend or duke it out to get the most points.

Name: Lewjmele
Overview: Shooting game with an artillery barrage. Modern people came to be able to use necromancy by the power of OOPARTS "Lewjmele" that ancient civilization invented. However, evils that conspire to dominate the world begin to abuse the power as it happened in remote ages, which involves destiny of three nations and three heroes.

Name: Life in the Dorms
Overview: Crafted in the spirit of classic adventure games, Life in the Dorms also brings some modernity to the genre by introducing a new, social media-inspired feature. After Dack collects the smart phone item, he'll be able to "Flitter" to his followers about his environment, the people around him, and even things in his inventoryâ€”in fact, he'll have to, in order to solve many of the game's challenging puzzles.

Name: Let's Draw A Picture Together!
Overview: Draw pictures on your own or together with friends over Xbox LIVE. The pencil, brush, bucket and many colors to choose from helps you create the picture you want.

Name: Lifeless
Overview:
Lifeless, an experimental and personal interpretation about loneliness.

Decipher its mysteries and discover its 4 possible endings.

Name: Light Fighters
Overview:
Join the elite combat team known as the Light Fighters in a variety of battle modes.

Compete Head-To-Head in Multiplayer or try to save the Colony from impending doom. Prove your skills and valor by entering the Galactic Tournament where you will face the toughest foes in the Galaxy.

Utilize special abilities to gain the upper hand in battle or relax to the interstellar tunes of the Galaxy Radio.

Name: Light's End
Overview: Where does one man end and another begin? Become any character you meet in this unique story-driven game! Unforgettable characters, engrossing story, and 20 original songs make Light's End a must-play experience.

Name: A Light Start
Overview:
In "A Light Start" you take control of your own crawler and must collect energy for your queen crawler, so that she can remove the darkness and light the world.

Dig your way through the world and avoid the dangers of the dark. "A Light Start" features procedurally generated levels and a level editor to allow you to create and play your own levels.

Name: LightFish
Overview: LightFish is a highly addictive arcade game, where the user controls a small fish who lives in the abyssal deeps of the ocean... surrounded by deadly creatures. His objective is to destroy all the monsters who inhabit those dangerous zones by drawing lines onto unexplored territory. However, any enemy who manages to touch the Lightfish will kill him instantly!

Name: Lodestar 1000
Overview: Lodestar, the robot that will steal your heart and crush your mind makes his debut in Lodestar 1000. The challenge starts off with classic Simon gameplay, but takes a detour across the DPad and Thumbsticks. Can you handle it? If not, bring your friends because this Simon game has CO-OP! Made awesome by 8-bit graphics, C64 sound FX and an original chiptune soundtrack that builds dynamically!

Name: Little Ninjas
Overview:
In a world populated by ninjas, you must slice your way through waves of invading ninja puppets.

Team up with your friends or ninjas controlled by artificial intelligence and let the battle begin!

Name: Little Racers
Overview: Milkstone Studios presents the ultimate 2D arcade racing game, now with online multiplayer! Master your driving skills and defeat your opponents with style on one of the more than 20 tracks available. With new improvements based on user feedback, and much easier handling, the game includes quick race, custom race and championship mode, and also the new online mode for up to 12 players.

Name: Lights Off
Overview: Solve over 750 levels across three difficulties in this mind bending puzzle game. Try the new Time Attack mode to see how many puzzles you can solve before time runs out.

Name: Like, Favorite, Shoot!
Overview:
Featuring all of your favourite Youtube stars, this is the first and only game that lets you truly Like, Favourite or Shoot them!

With global leaderboards and HD graphics, this is your chance to gun with the stars!

Name: Livelayer Prototype
Overview: Can you run through the maze of the light and shadow, and can you reach the exit safely? Easy, simple action maze game.

Name: Lil' Demons: Splatter
Overview: Kill the demons, absorb their blood for powerups! Lil' Demons: Splatter includes Wave Survival and King of the Hill game modes, piles of weapons, and supports multiple 3D rendering modes including anaglyph glasses. All for just 80 points!

Name: Lingolu
Overview:
Dive into a spectacular stereoscopic gaming experience.

Steer you spaceship in full 6 degrees of freedom through 30 stunning levels. Complete a level by eliminating the floating rings, pierce through their middle to make them disappear. But beware! Time is limited and numerous obstacles and monster try to hinder or even destroy you.
br This game supports side by side and anaglyph stereo video modes.

Name: Link Attack
Overview: Staged in a classical puzzle style, link attack infuses an original puzzle concept with impactful imagery influenced by former Soviet Union communist propaganda. Original audio arranged and recorded in-house provides an invigorating background to the constant action. As a puzzle game, Link Attack contains 6 different game modes that task the player with unique and individual challenges. This constant excitement is further elaborated through interaction with the players Xbox avatar which is present and very much active throughout gameplay. A competitive two player mode finishes off the roster with a fast paced and invigorating mode and full high score tables round off the competitive spirit of the game.

Name: Little Green Men
Overview:
Zap through moon rock with the Z-50 laser canon and blast through steel floors with the X-3 space drill!

Cross vast distances using alien transporters and bridge gaps with the power of thought!!

Just some of the tools required to guide the Little Green Men (LGM) to safety over Martian landscapes and extra-terrestrial obstacles.br
Make life and death decisions sacrificing a few to save the many.

Name: Living Dead
Overview:
If you love to slaughter endless waves of zombies, then this is the game for you!

It includes 2 game modes, unlock-able weapons, high scores, and more!

Name: Little Flappers
Overview:
How long can you last flapping your wings while avoiding the spinning blades of death.

Scoreboards and local multiplayer keeps you coming back for just one more go.

Name: Little Kingdom
Overview: Little Kingdom is a simulation game. You're the leader of a small kingdom aiming to conquer the world. In this peaceful world without war or battle. Strengthen your economy and dominate the world with your influence. Choose your map, choose your teammate, and choose the AI levels! Little Kingdom is playable up to 4 players on the same screen. (without splitscreen)

Name: Little Kingdom Advanced
Overview:
You’re the leader of a small kingdom aiming to conquer the world. In this peaceful world without war or battle. Strengthen your economy and dominate the world with your influence.

Contains a map generator.

It's the enhanced version, more buildings, more resources, new graphism, a new HUD, new gameplay options, more enemies , bigger map...

Name: Little Racers STREET
Overview:
Milkstone Studios presents the next installment in the indie racing series, now with online for 12 players! Drive the 30+ high speed cars on a 3D,weather-changing city! Career mode provides hours of fun, challenging races. You need to tune your car and earn money to get the most wanted cars.Pursuit the top ranks and become the best in the world! Underground racing has never been so fun!

Little Racers STREET is a much needed refresh to the top-down racing genre! Offering a whole 3D city with lots of different tracks and enviromental effects, the game's key point is its career mode.

You'll have to start from scratch, with a low class car. Win races and complete challenges to earn credits, and spend them upgrading your car or purchasing new ones. Featuring 30 different cars, challenging opponents and varied race conditions, this game offers hours of fun and enjoyment!

Name: Little Rocket Girl
Overview:
In a far off, dystopian world, there are two kinds of humans: the Unlimited who possess free will and the limited who do not.

KANA is a young, limited girl who one day has broken away from her servitude programming and has stolen a rocket pack. She sets off to kill the Empress.

Name: Little Acorns Deluxe
Overview: Guide Mr. Nibbles the acorn hoarding squirrel through a variety of levels in this charming platforming adventure. Collect the acorns scattered around each zone to stock up for winter. Featuring super simple controls, a variety of game mechanics with a cute and lovable look, Little Acorns is an adventure that is completely at home on iOS.• LITTLE ACORNS...BIG GAMELittle Acorns features 60 cleverly designed levels to explore! Spread out over 4 seasons and 3 years, you'll be hunting nuts for hours on end!• SEASONED GAMEPLAYFluid, simple platforming controls that mean players of all skills can enjoy this captivating adventure. With classic platformer gameplay, mixed with a modern visual style, you'd be nuts not to love it.• SQUIRREL POWER!Collect power-ups to save time and grab high scores including a time stopping clock and an invulnerability crash helmet. Dodge or defeat a variety of enemies including dopey caterpillars and hanging spiders on your way to collecting all the acorns and fruit in the game!

Name: Little Monsters
Overview: Little Monsters have started appearing everywhere, and now they're starting to run riot. You must carefully place your bombs to blast them! This Physics puzzler will provide you with a fun challenge. 6 different types of Monster, ranging from the cute little Fuzzle, to the obnoxious Bloater. A range of other obstacles such as exploding barrels and melting ice will certainly to keep you busy.

Name: Lights Out
Overview:
Study the level. Turn off the light. Walk to the goal.

LightsOut is a unique game where you must solve each level using sound, timing and memory. You have 99 seconds to pass the level which is ideal if you have a few minutes before dinner, or even "just one more level" before you go to bed.

There are 10 exciting ways to play. 
Can you pass all 100 levels?

Name: Little Strategy
Overview: Play as Lady Strategy, a young lady heir of a dying country. A 4x for everybody: Explore the world, expand your empire, extract the resources and exterminate the enemies. Contain : a campaign, a map generator, a map editor, real time and turn base, 4 players.

Name: LOL Runner
Overview: Race against ninjas, pirates, robots and zombies! Unlock more than 10 different runners and 5 different tracks in campaign mode. Race against or with your friends in relays, three-Legged races and more!

Name: Loot or Die
Overview: Let's be honest, RPG's are more fun with machine guns. Experience fast paced action supported by loot collection and item optimization. Drop in multiplayer means you never have to wait in lobbies. Plunder the universe with friends to take on tougher foes; then PvP to see who has the best gear!

Name: Loot Grinder
Overview:
Loot Grinder is an RPG inspired by the 16-bit era classics. It is all about doing battle and unlocking new classes and abilities.

Customize your team at anytime by assigning job classes that you have unlocked. These jobs give new abilities as you level up.

Travel to a destination long enough to unlock special Boss battles. If your heroes are strong enough to win, they will be rewarded.

Name: Lootfest
Overview: The game has a creative area with powerful voxel editor tools. You can join friends online and build together.

Name: Logan's Treasure
Overview:
Logan's Treasure is an arcade platform game.

Guide Logan to collect all 40 Keys on each levels, and go to open the treasure Chest.

Name: LOL LOL Kitty Commando
Overview: In 1993 a group of Satanic Estate Agents bought up property in key areas of the world to act as a demonic staging area and gateway to the depths of hell, summoning forth unspeakable evil. LOL LOL Kitty, a weaponized house cat and government black project is deployed by the US Military in order to take out the trash.

Name: Lolita of Labyrinth
Overview:
This is a side-scrolling action game. This game has 12 Levels. You must find the key which can open the door to exit.

You can stamp monsters, get your coins. If 100 coin is collected, it is exchangeable for a treasure box.

If it clears once, difficult stage composition can be played.

Name: Loot or Die 2
Overview:
Plunder the universe in a never ending quest for better loot and harder challenges. Engage entire worlds with up to four other players.

Prestige mode lets you play forever as your enemies scale with your progress.

Name: Loot, Steal 'n Destroy
Overview: This frantic party game pits 2-4 pirates against eachother in a mad race for gold! Use all your cunning and prowess to become top dog!

Name: Lootfest 360
Overview: Jump in to a party-style adventure game, bash down monsters within a minute, grab some loot and save the day! Lootfest is an action adventure game, in 3rd or 1st person view. Random generated voxel world with a fantasy setting. Up to four players, drop in, split screen co-op.

Name: Lotus: Stellar Conflict
Overview: A top-down view space shooter that is easy to pick up and play, yet rewards mastery of subtle tactics. Detailed 3D graphics and fast-paced combat are combined with a ten mission story-driven campaign. Online co-op and skirmish modes add great replay value.

Name: Lootfest: Live Design
Overview: Enjoy a block building fest with your friends. Make stunning structures in no time with the game's easy to use creation tools. Fight off zombie hordes with your trusty sword. Race your friends using the RC cars. You can do anything you want, as long as it's blocky! (Update1: RC Helicopter, air plane and pirate ship. Blocks with letters. File backup and restore. Animated block creations tool) (Update2: Create animated objects, make your own pets and doors. Tools to quickly build geometric shapes)

Name: Lunacy
Overview: A game of skill, accuracy and guts! Pilot your ship from moon to moon while avoiding the asteroids. Score points by landing on moons and clearing the limitless levels. Your only offense is your deft maneuvering, while your defense is the shields you earn by scoring points.

Name: Lootfest2
Overview: Lootfest is back for everyone who loves classic adventure games. With more monsters, weapons, missions and of course - more loot! Explore a large world with your friends, using an easy drop-in multiplayer. Any combination of split screen and online gameplay is supported.

Name: Lucky Game
Overview:
This is a game you can enjoy golf and gambling machine with. Decide an angle and power to put a ball in a cup. Winnings increase as you place the right bets. Maybe the farther the cup, the better the chance.

1 player: Increase your winnings. kinds of the gambling machines be increased when you increase maximum winnings.

2-4 players: Compete with other player in scores.

Name: Lord Ownage and the Thoroughly UnBritish Invasion
Overview: Save Great Britain from the biggest threat it has faced since the Beatles broke up! Fight aliens alone or cooperatively in this very British puzzle shooter. Kill lots of aliens to unlock power ups and extra play modes, including a jolly good fun level editor. Also includes realistic British weather, with a 1 in 4 chance that it will be raining whenever you play!

Name: A Lot of Balls
Overview: Do you feel lucky? Try your luck and beat your friends. Up to four players can fill out tickets and then feel the electrifying suspense of the drawing.

Name: Lots of Guns
Overview:
Are you hardcore enough? Climb your way as high as you can in this platforming shooter complete with an insane collection of guns and explosives.

Lots of Guns will have you fighting zombies under an evil moon, out of control robots in a factory, medieval knights, and monster slime creatures on your journey.

Voxel styled pixel art gives this game a distinct but retro feel.

Name: Love Hurts
Overview: Love Hurts is a side scrolling beat em up about mans redundant need to save princesses and the fact that cliches are cliches because they work.

Name: M.A.C.E.
Overview:
Founded after the first alien invasion on earth in the year 2054. M.A.C.E. is the epitome of the new cohesion of all peoples of the earth to fight against the aliens to serve life on earth in a military path.

While heavy fights rages on earth against incoming alien ships and the M.A.C.E. units are to prevent the construction of additional land bases for the alien ships, a group of specially trained fight pilots with space warships try to prevent the arrival of more aliens and destroy the alien mother ships and troops of aliens.

Fight in an exceptional space mission by foreign galaxies to prevent the arrival of more alien swarms on the earth. Your spaceship is one of the first one which is built by people using alien technology including engines, weapons and shields to survive against the aliens.

MACE is a classic space shoot 'em up, inspired by the legendary Amiga games of this genre. Handdrawn 2D graphics in HD resolutions, parallax scrolling, explosion effects and optimized games mechanics, combined with the proven gameplay are transporting the "Spirit of Amiga" in today's Age.

Name: Lunar Panda Deluxe
Overview:
The year is 3016 and Pandas are now the dominant species of planet Earth. Amongst this God-like species exists one Panda in particular, known simply as Mr Panda, who left his home planet in search of adventure.

In this revolutionary new video game you take full control of Mr Panda as he negotiates gravity, uneven surfaces and a finite amount of jetpack fuel!

Name: Madam Zhen's Tent of MYSTERY!
Overview: Full featured tarot reader with over 150 unique card descriptions and 5 distinct reading types for all occasions.

Name: Magic Thighs & Slightly Phil
Overview:
A fast moving, classic, arcade style, platform game - Jump and glide over 60 action packed levels.

Discover all 'Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji' as either 'Magic Thighs' or 'Slightly Phil' (One or two player - co-op) and save Japan from the nefarious Zodiac gang.

Name: Magicians & Looters
Overview:
High above the lame Mortal Realm rests the cloud-wreathed towers of the Wizard Keep. It is a place where robes never go out of style, and beards are totally awesome.

But then the badguys attack, and Versimos is kidnapped!

Luckily for Versimos, he has three students who will stop at nothing to get a passing grade, and if that means rescuing their teacher from the treacherous Morg Mountains, then so be it.

Guide three sociopathic apprentices through an open world filled with caves, castles and underground cities as you search for your kidnapped teacher. Discover countless secrets, loot hidden treasure troves, and decapitate your enemies. Or immolate them. Or smack them in the face with fruit.

Name: M2AF: Message 2 All Friends
Overview: Send a message to all of your friends or a group with only one press on a button! Communicate faster with your clan or closer friends. Use the banlist to exclude the not-so-friendly friends from receiving your message.

Name: The Maid-san's Caving Adventure
Overview: A maid wandered into a cave where the Benars live. Can she escape the cave safely by using her specialty "trembling" to get away from them?

Name: Magic Racing Rally
Overview:
A new Top-Down racing game is here!

Enjoy the rally with 18 unique racing circuits and different game modes:

- Time Trial
- Fastest Laps with online Leaderboard
- Time Attack
- Head to Head
- Battle Mode
- Quick Race Race locally against other friends/CPU drivers, or play Online.

Name: Magnetic By Nature: Awakening
Overview:
Wield the power of magnetism on a journey through a forgotten utopia in this captivating puzzle-platformer.

Utilizing magnets, attract, repel, and launch yourself through 36 levels while avoiding dangerous, robot-crunching obstacles.

Name: Make It Rain
Overview: Have you ever wanted to be like your favorite musical artist or favorite athlete and show up to the club and just make it rain money in there? Well here is a game that will bring you as close to that feeling as you can get, without actually spending $10,000 in one night!

Name: MADRISM
Overview:
Create a floor plan and erase rooms! A new housing action puzzle game, "MADRISM."

Connect the falling rooms with doors, place a toilet and kitchen, and [complete] it. Be careful, as it's game over if the rooms collide!

Name: Magnetic Wars
Overview:
Use your ship's magnetic powers to beat 20 varying levels filled with enemies and power-ups!

Play by yourself or with a friend in this challenging space shoot-em-up!

Name: Mahjong Moves Mini
Overview:
We took Mahjong Moves and improved it. Better Visibility! Over 50 Tile Sets! Advanced Editor!

Now with 3-D, zooming tiles and a larger playfield, you can see the tiles much more clearly. You can also design layouts that zoom the tiles even more!

Play on smaller screens or from further away than was ever possible with the original game.

Name: Maids with Balloons
Overview: Help these maids gather balloons and use them to fend off seagulls in a set of fun minigames.

Name: A Madman's Guide to Happiness
Overview: A horror/mystery game where you examine the PC of a suicide victim. It is filled with mad rantings and cryptic files. It also claims that whoever unlocks the files will be rewarded with the secret of happiness.... Why did he kill himself? What is the secret of happiness? Who is 'Princess'? Explore the twisted computer of a madman to find out.

Name: Mage Cage
Overview:
Get ready for some MAGICAL MAYHEM with MAGE CAGE! Grab your friends and play as one of four students of sorcery, each with unique abilities, and demonstrate your magical prowess in this hectic platform fighter. Conjure your way through various levels as your spells bounce and burst in an attempt to become the most powerful wizard in the academy.
Mage Cage couples the competitive yet beginner friendly multiplayer of Super Smash Brothers with the fast-paced chaos of Multiplayer Pong. A cast of hilariously eccentric magic students fight to prove whose spells, and perhaps personality, is the best. Featuring 4 player local multiplayer, 5 maps with different tactical qualities, polished 3D art, 3 game modes, and AI for practicing your skills, this game gives you the chance to zap, burn, and freeze your enemies (or best friends)!

Name: Mama & Son: Clean House
Overview:
Really Shooter and his mother Poor Mama are running a cleaning service business, with Really taking commando jobs on the side.

One day, aliens invade (!) and Really doesn’t hesitate for one second, he heads over to their mother ship and begins to mow down the invading forces with his trusty machine-gun. And of course, as usual it is up to Mama to clean up the mess after him.

Name: MagicalCube
Overview: Magical Cube is a mission-clear style puzzle game. The object of this game is to defeat monsters in battle by using Marie's magic. When 3 Cube is aligned (only same color), Marie's magic is invoked. Marie can deliver a damaging blow to the monster with magic, and when monster's life gone run out, you win! Collect coin, and purchase accessories to make Marie more powerful!

Name: Magnet Man
Overview:
Use your trusty Magnet Cannon and Obnoxiously Big Legs to solve countless puzzles. Push, pull, lift, and leap your way to victory.

Dozens of secret rooms filled with prizes await your discovery. What are you still reading for!?

Name: Machiavelli's Ascent
Overview: Machiavelli's Ascent is a vertical platformer taking place in the deepest depths of the ocean. Guide Machiavelli the jellyfish on an ascending journey by consuming nutrient bubbles, chaining them together to create melodious combinations. Progress upwards with the catapulting assistance of jumpers and score enhancing starfish. Pursue and hunt elusives as you guide Machiavelli all the while earning achievements as you play and competing locally or globally for highscores. See you underwater...

Name: Mad Blocker Arcade
Overview: Developed using the XNA framework, Mad Blocker Live is an expansion of the original flash game featuring new Modes exclusive to this version of the game such as a unique 2 player battle mode and some extra special block types. Mad Blocker Live is a fresh new version of the game. See how many Fluzzel's you can free!

Name: Magic Racing GP 2
Overview: Magic Studio presents: A new Top-Down racing game is here! 4 classes: Open Wheel, Kart (85cc, 150cc, 250cc) Race over 34 circuits with different game modes: - Practice - Quick Race - Complete Weekend Race - Season Race against to 19 CPU drivers or play Online. The internal editor for full personalization of drivers and teams!

Name: Magic Soccer
Overview:
It's a Soccer Game! 117 different teams, from 6 nations (USA, England, France, Italy, Germany and Spain).

Friendly match, Penalty Kicks, Tournaments.

Name: Maison Kanraku
Overview:
Tokyo, 2015 A.D. The First Climax is released.

We are the Alpha and the Omega. The world will never be the same...

Maison Kanraku is a NEC PC-Engine style panty-throwing simulator. Experience the high resolution of thrown-away pixelated panties as they distract an army of conservative landladies and janitors.

Name: Mambow
Overview:
Help Mambow and Piou to conquer their independence in an incredible 3D platform game.

Collect 50 medals distributed in savanna, jungle, mountain and temple. 10 levels to go for maximum challenge!

Name: Magnetic Defender
Overview: Intense top-down shooter with a magnetic twist! Defend four missiles as they head towards their intended target. Use a magnetic field to keep enemy projectiles away from the missiles. Also includes a 2-player mode. Created by a UNM Advanced Graphics Lab student.

Name: Mahjong Moves
Overview: 18 tile sets, 100 challenging layouts and a layout editor to create your own layouts.

Name: MAKIVA
Overview: A simulation game of harvesting and shipping crops. Aim: 10,000 pieces of coins!

Name: Main Sequence
Overview:
Main Sequence: A Game of Beautiful Disasters.

You're just a little rock with dreams of becoming a big star. Absorb smaller masses, avoid larger ones, ride the gravity waves, and try not to destroy the solar system.

Name: Mancala
Overview: A classic board game, Mancala is an easy game to learn but challenging to master. Challenge a friend locally or online or play against the AI opponent. Configurable with up to 8 seeds in each pit and 10 AI levels of difficulty. Uses the ELO rating system and shares high scores online.

Name: Manic Miner 360
Overview: MANIC MINER 360 is the near-100% original ZX Spectrum game, as written by Matthew Smith in 1983 and is being brought to Xbox Live Indy Games as an officially licenced product.

Name: Man, I Hate That Indie Game!
Overview: Some cute girls who are interested in indie games are in need of your help! Do you love indie games enough to be useful? Choose your route carefully, and you may end up a winner!

Name: The MANLY Game for MANLY Men
Marathon Monk
Overview: Marathon Monk is a classic running platformer - run for your health, run for fun, run because THEY ARE AFTER YOU!

Name: Massage Me
Overview: Massage yourself or make a massage party stimulating each other. Easy create and save your own customized massage! Play it automatically. Manually change intensity, speed and playtime in desired moment. Available 23 hot & nice massages to please you. It will change your pad into unlimited vibrating toy!

Name: Marauder Madness!
Overview: Marauder Madness is an arcade style shooter featuring pirate ships created by students at the University of New Mexico. Destroy the merchant ships to plunder their gold, but be careful, too much looting and the destroyers will be hunting for you. Play alone in 21 campaign levels or against up to 3 players in a local match.

Name: Marble Masters: The Pit
Overview:
Do you have what it takes to become a Marble Master?

Destroy the enemy marbles through 50 levels in this challenging physics based action puzzler.

Avoid falling into the deep dark pit while bumping the enemy marbles down the depths to their doom.

Knock your opponents into the deadly spikes shattering them to pieces.
br Use blocks as shields from the relentless marble onslaught.

Complete all levels to become a Marble Master!

Name: Marble Puzzle
Overview: A classic IQ game dating back to the 17th century, Marble Puzzle challenges players to remove as many marbles as possible on a triangular board. Difficulty increases with each level as each new board setup offers fewer ways to win and it ramps up even more across three challenge modes. Few will find all the possible solutions in challenge mode.

Name: March to the Moon
Overview:
March to the Moon is a shoot-em-up game where you learn abilities from 12 different skillsets.

Turn your enemies into skeletons and vampires as the necromancer, poison them and burn them as the alchemist, shoot and turn them into meat as the hunter. Yes, even the robots turn into meat.

Don't stop there! Learn a second skillset to get the dual-class paladin-necromancer you've always wanted.

Name: Mark The Mechanic
Overview:
This is a 2D Run-and-Jump Platformer. There are 8 levels in different locations ranging from the Antarctic to Volcanos. The player earns score for collecting nuts during the game and any time left over will be added to the score.

The game has different enemies for each level. Touching the enemy will damage the player.

There are some tricky jumps so try not to fall.

Name: Marksman: Long Range
Overview: Use realistic rifle controls to master the art of long-range shooting. Complete time trials, eliminate incoming zombie hordes, and play "rifle golf" to put your skills to the test.

Name: Mars Revenge
Overview: You pilot a flying saucer on a mission to defend the Earth from the invading Martian forces. Your ship is the latest in space technology, outfitted with advanced evasive maneuver capabilities as well as upgradable weapons and armor. Watch out for the Martians with their space ships and thier grim space creatures! If you like old school space shooters, then you need to play Mars Revenge! Out now on XBox Live Indie Games.

Name: Marshmallow Duel
Overview:
Marshmallow Duel is like a simplified version of Super Smash Bros. You play against another person, moving from platform to platform and collecting items. Some items help you, some items hurt them, and some items are just plain destructive.

Throw it all above a massive vat of marshmallow and you have Marshmallow Duel!

Name: Marvelous Galaxy
Overview: "Marvelous Galaxy" is a turn-based strategic game. There are available three game modes: Single player, Multiplayer and Fight Now. The objective of Single and Multiplayer(up to four players) is conquer all enemy planets and destroy his robots. At 'Fight Now' mode, player must choose five robots or outer-space creatures to win an immediate battle.

Name: Mashapocolypse
Overview:
Mash those buttons in the race to the finish.

Compete against your friends in local multiplayer and play along to either the in game loops or your own music library.

Name: Massteroid
Overview: Tilt, tap or drag your way through space, collecting as much space junk as possible as you hurtle towards planet Earth. Become as huge as you can to inflict maximum damage!

Name: MatchingPair
Overview: Memory card game. Features 2 unique art styles and 50 unique cards to unlock. Full gallery of unlocked cards. Play solo or with a friend. The size of the card grids increase as you progress making for a good challenge. Four play modes including speed rounds that test you memory to the max.

Name: Match-A-Monster
Overview:
Puzzle game combining the sliding mechanic of games like Three's and 2048 with the more traditional 3 in a row matching game play.

Includes 100 level challenge mode and global scoreboards.

Name: Math Cruncher
Overview:
Math Cruncher has the player race around a grid trying to complete math problems without being eaten by the monsters and not making more than three mistakes.

There are five modes: Multiples, Factors, Primes, Equality, and Inequality. The player tries to complete five stages and can post local high scores.

Name: Math Gardener
Overview: Help the flowers grow as you practice answering math problems. Learning math can be fun. As math problems are shown at the top of the screen, position the rain cloud over the flower pot with the correct answer. It may seem simple, but it is still way better than flash cards.

Name: Math Sniper 3D
Overview: Practice math times tables and have fun at the same time. Game play focuses on solving the math problems while also providing a targeting challenge. The user plays the roll of a sniper taking out spies who know the answer to the math problem. Be careful not to hit the normal workers who don't know the right answer.

Name: Mayan Countdown
Overview:
Let the countdown begin!

A Mayan countdown to December 21st 2012! Is there more to this then just a screensaver? Can you unlock the 4 secret messages, that provide you with insights into the Mayan Spaceship image?

Includes a countdown timer and the current Long Count date.

Name: Max Fun Times
Overview:
Max Fun Times is a customizable drinking application that enhances the enjoyment of frosty cold beverages with friends.

Spin the wheel and receive a command or customize your own wheel to create your own random fun generator!

Name: Master of the Seven Teas
Overview:
Epic, Maritime Skirmishes on a Teeny, Tiny, Teacup Scale!

In Master of the Seven Teas, you Captain a Pirate Ship inside of one of seven varied cups of tea, each presenting unique hazards. Make use of the crazy power ups, including Octopus, Ninja and Seagulls, to shoot, smash and sink your opponents.

Simple controls make Seven Teas incredibly easy to pick-up, so you can quickly take on the AI Armada solo and co-op, or enjoy the various versus options with up to 4-Players!

Name: Matchem
Overview: A fun game of Memory for the whole family. Up to 4 players take turns flipping cards to find their matches. This Xbox version saves you the trouble of laying out all those rows & rows of cards on the carpet. Small grid and rumble turn indicator make it child friendly or try larger grid for more challenge. We wrote this to play with our 4 kids and hope you will enjoy it as much as we do :)

Name: Max the Frog
Overview: Quick reactions, aiming skills and an overall strategy will be needed to make Max the Frog catch all those colored flies circling his beautiful pond. The game is a completely new variation of the popular match three concept. The beautiful graphic effects and intuitive gameplay make it appealing to any age. So go ahead an find out if your tongue is quicker then the flies!

Name: Masters of Influence
Overview:
Challenge up to 3 other players, including stunning AI, for total domination of the board.

Collect resources, assault other towers, and use the terrain to eliminate the opponents!

Name: Massive Cleavage vs Zombies
Overview:
Your mission is to find BBQ sauce for your people and bring it back to them. Fighting off thousands of zombies with only your massive cleaver and equally massive cleavage.

The game is played with simple arcade mechanics (move left, move right, high attack, low attack), and it starts you off with an easy amount of zombies to re-kill. But each level adds more and more zombies, and eventually dogs that will chew your face off in a couple seconds

Name: Math Fighter
Overview:
Battle your way to the top using various taunts, special attacks and more!

Choose from 13 grades of customizable math challenges ranging from basic math to calculus! Challenge players over Xbox live with the advanced auto match making system that will pull you out of a one-player game and match you up with another opponent!

Leaderboards, Badges, Unlockables, and much more!

Name: Math Aerobat
Overview: Take off into the wild blue yonder as the pilot of your very own Bi-Plane. Math problems will determine where you fly in the sky as you try to plow into the cloud that has the correct answer on it. Math Aerobat continues the fun that Math Sniper 3D started with a simple, but fun math problem solving game.

Name: Masters of Belial
Overview: Masters of Belial is an arena type action rpg game that takes place in the ancient fantasy land of Azgoth.

Name: Maya Challenge
Overview: Maya Challenge is a puzzle game that will test your brains keeping you relaxed at the same time.

Name: MathFlash
Overview: A math flash card game for addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. Three difficulty settings and Local High Scores. A good way for Dad to justify the XBox as an "Educational Tool".

Name: Match Frenzy
Overview: Match shapes to get a high score in this addicting puzzle type game.

Name: Mayfly's Castle
Overview: Your mission is to defeat the lord on the top floor(Floor10) of the castle. Using skills of the ninja, Attack the enemy. Or, do not to be found by the enemy.

Name: Maze of Apes
Overview: Maze of Apes is probably one of the most addictive brain teasing games. It will blow your mind how tricky yet so simple a puzzle can turn out to be.

Name: Maze Haze
Overview: Guide the ball through tricky mazes and race with your friends to see who is the fastest while everyone tries to stop the others.

Name: Mech Gladiator
Overview: This is a 3D robot action game.

Name: Mechanician Alex 2
Overview:
Mechanician Alex 2 is an arcade platform game.

When Alex has finished repairing his car, a terrible monster dropped a bomb on his house. Help Alex to defeat the monster by traveling to different levels.

Name: Mechanician Alex
Overview: Mechanician is an arcade platform game. Guide Alex to collect all the tools on each level to repair his car.

Name: Mechanoid Army
Overview: Mechanoid Army is a very entertaining platform based video game, which action takes place inside of a mysterious spaceship, the Nexus-9. This frenetic video game will challenge the good reflexes and ingenious of the player since the very beginning.

Name: MechFish
Overview: The plans for the MechFish, a remote mechanical recon device, have been stolen and used to create an evil counterpart: the DeathFish! Armed with reflexes, a high powered vertical propulsion system, and an unlimited supply of explosive bombs and missiles, you must control your MechFish through 14 sidescrolling levels of dangerous enemy waters - dodging mines and destroying DeathFish along the way!

Name: Medieval Zombies
Overview:
This isn't a present day apocalypse. No guns or machetes to help you here.

Loot buildings to survive and try to kill the thousands of zombies on the huge map before they eat you!

Supports over 1,000,000 zombies in a single level.

Name: meds
Overview: Meds: Recommended Dosage 100mg 3 times daily. Classic retro-style gameplay with the only enemy being your mind. 50 levels of madness, each with randomly generated withdrawal symptoms. Caution: you may never have the same experience twice. Taking pills may help, but beware of unexpected side effects. Taking meds with a friend may result in versus mode, so be sure to divide up your dosage evenly.

Name: Meet Ur Match
Overview: Meet Ur Match is a memory/strategy party game! Dust off those 'Scene It' controllers.....M-U-M is compatible and this allows one hand free for eating/drinking while you play.....great for parties or corporate functions. Powerups and penalties can be found amonst the images so beware! Anybody can play M-U-M so why not challenge Grandma and see if she kicks your butt.

Name: Meep
Overview:
Meep - The strive for height is an addictive nobrainer classic game. With simple controls and cute graphics, you control Meep - the ever jumping - from ledge to ledge in the strive for height.

Get as high up in the air as possible to make it onto the HighScore table and beat your friends!

Name: Meep 2: Jumping Evolved
Overview:
Meep 2 - Jumping Evolved offers different gameplay from what you've seen before in platform jumpers.

Beat the clock in time trial in 20 different levels! Help yourself to be the best by viewing the ghostplayer from the best times for each level!

You can also enjoy some splitscreen multiplayer action against a buddy in tournaments!

Name: MeetURMatch: Avatar Edition
Overview: Highly rated - Now UPDATED! With Avatars - High Scores & Saving Settings - New Gameplay and screens - New Analog control system plus all the cool features and strategy twists that made it so versatile in the first place! Good clean fun for the whole family (even the very little ones)....

Name: Mega Shooter 11
Overview:
Mega Shooter 11 is an extremely authentic, retro side-scrolling space-shooter, ala the best 8 and 16-bit space shooters. It features topnotch old-school graphics, a heart-thumping soundtrack, and intelligent game play.

Spread over four huge bases with branching pathways, the game features tons of upgrades, hidden levels, enemies, and excessive amounts of replay value.

Name: MegaCity
Overview: MegaCity is a highly original and fun 'one-more-go' style puzzle game. Easy to learn, hard to master gameplay which requires thinking, logic and luck.Place requested buildings in the queue to earn points, but watch out: Nobody wants to live next to a landfill site or industrial estate! Everybody wants a nice park or shcool nearby, but the city's budget is limited. This is where you come in. Megacity is a game of planning and thinking ahead to squeeze the most points of out your citizens by clever town planning. And if it all goes wrong, it's their fault for electing you mayor, right?Megacity is a real thinking person's game, which appeals to and is suitable for all ages.

Name: Mega Monster Mania
Overview: With arcade style gameplay, Mega Monster Mania lets you explore and conquer a nearly infinite number of randomly generated dungeons. Fight dangerous beasts and reap the rewards! Hunt for treasure and upgrade your equipment with friends to see who can collect the most!

Name: Megalopolis
Overview: Get the highest score by managing an island for 10 virtual years in 10 minutes. To provide efficient living conditions for the human inhabitants keep a good balance between quick expansion, income and environmental sustainability.

Name: Meltdown Moon
Overview: Action! Puzzles! Moons! Jetpacks! Explosions! Avatars! Save the world from all of the above. Crazy high score grabbing action. Meltdown Many Moons today!

Name: MegaUP: Upload If You Can!
Overview: In 2012 four men owners of a known uploader web were sent to prison by the government of freedom for a crime they didn't commit. These men promptly escaped from prison. Today, still wanted by the government of freedom, they survive as uploaders of fortune. If you have a problem, if no one else can help, and if you can find them, maybe you can hire them.

Name: Melon Madness
Overview:
A small 2D stadium with a quick gravitational hiccup to get things moving in a new way, a few over eager players to kick a ball about and you are playing 'Melon Madness'.

In 'Tournament' mode, take on the rookies and work your way to the pros for a challenge that only fools and heroes would rise to.

In 'Exhibition' mode, invite a friend for co-op or VS gameplay with up to 4 players (2 Vs 2).

Name: Memorania
Overview: Exercise your brain with a game of Memory! Choose from three different game modes: Classic, Speed game, and No Mistakes. Perfect when you only have a few minutes to spare.

Name: Melvin's Meltdown
Overview: There's a radiation problem in the lab and you need to clean it up with Melvin's machine! Play in one or two player modes on multiple difficulties in this fast paced match 3 game.

Name: Memory Freak
Overview: Memory problems? Three fun games to help expand your memory.

Name: MemoStomp
Overview: Fun party game based on the classic card game. Great for a dance pad, but fun to play on a standard controller too!

Name: Merball Tournament
Overview:
Enter a contest in which two teams of mermaids compete to find a randomly placed coral ball and carry it all the way to the opposing team’s court, within a sunken ship that makes the game a true 3D maze.

Can you swim fast enough to win this tournament?

Name: Merger
Overview:
Merger is an unique and addictive puzzle game for all ages. The game comes packed with 60 pre-made levels in increasing difficulty to prepare you for Endless Mode where the real challenge is.

In Endless Mode you will be faced with random generated levels that you need to finish before the timer runs out.

Name: Merry Inc.
Overview: A potpourri 3D board game with strategic challenge and fun-learning of general knowledge. Compete against the representative of McFishy Corp who wants to take over Merry, Inc. Earn enough gold coins to buy the Xmas tree branches and build the Xmas Tree. Invest and own major stake in Merry, Inc.

Name: Merry Match3 Christmas
Overview:
Get into Christmas mood and check out this Match 3 game.

Beautiful backgrounds, Christmas trees, jingle bells and twenty challenging levels - it's all there.

Name: MetaElectric Guitar
Overview: Play the electric guitar with your Xbox 360. 168 total sound samples harnessed through simple, easy controls. Powerchords, Open and Drop-D chords, Single Strings, Palmmutes all played through 4 amplification effects. Change pitch, volume and picking speed in real-time for a HUGE variety of sound.

Name: Metronome HD
Overview: Are you a musician seeking to improve your chops or a beginner wanting to learn? Yaystuff brings you an accurate rhythm keeping device with an HD finish! You might already own a metronome, but imagine the accuracy if it harnessed the processing power of the Xbox 360! And if you're like us then you always misplace your pocket sized metronome, but that probably won't be a problem with Metronome HD!

Name: Micro Invasion
Overview: Micro Invasion is a shooter type game where you struggle to fend off waves of microscopic robot spiders injected into your brain to erase your memories and human instincts in order to turn humans into robotic slaves.1 player game with 10 player online score exchange.

Name: Miasma
Overview: Miasma is a turn-based strategy game set in a dystopian future; where the mega-corporation Vilhelm Industries rules the world and everyone blindly and inexplicably follows their regime. Join a small band of rebels, specialise and develop their skills, and lead them in an attempt to restore everyone's individuality.

Name: Miasma 2
Overview:
ESP Games present Miasma 2, the sequel to 2010's turn-based strategy hit.

Take control of Paul or Lina once more, and command your elite squad of freedom fighters in battle against the oppressive Vilhelm Industries. With an all-new turn-based tactics/real-time battle system, the action runs fast and thick, and with new units to command - and a whole new graphics engine - this is one adventure not to be missed.

Miasma 2 gives turn-based strategy an unexpected twist as you must plan your entire team's orders at the start of the turn, then hit commit and see how it plays out. Will your courageous flanking manoeuvre pay off or will you be caught out of cover?

Name: Sega Rally Championship
Overview:
An easy way to play one of Sega's most influential racers on modern hardware with quality-of-life improvements such as:

* HD and UHD scaling
* True 16:9 or 4:3 toggle
* CRT filters
* Controller and wheel support
* Force feedback support
* System Link and online play support up to 4 players
* Cross-play
* Custom soundtrack support

Name: Miner of Duty
Overview:
Miner of Duty is a block-building FPS. The game includes 5 multiplayer game modes: Team Deathmatch, FFA, Fort Wars, Search & Mine, and Custom Maps. Also, Swarm Mode, a zombie-survival game mode, is playable as an offline game mode.

Custom Map mode allows you to design a map and play it with others.

You are able to customize your character's looks and your weapon classes with an array of weapons.

Name: Microbial
Overview:
A puzzle / action game - you're a white blood cell and your host has a tumor. Navigate through increasingly treacherous areas of the body to find and wipe it out.

Evade enemy viruses, trap them in the scenery, or exploit them to solve puzzles - use protein powerups to dissolve cell walls and alter your environment - conquer 40 levels in all.

Name: Minions!
Overview: Minions! is a mission-based shooter that can be played from both top-down and third-person perspectives. You create a hero, accompanied by a wide range of different minions to help you complete each mission. As the challenges get tougher, your hero will unlock points to spend on upgrades and customized minions.

Name: Mind Warp
Overview: Prepare to have to your mind blown!

Name: Mister Jump
Overview: Mister Jump is a classical retro jump'n'run where you have to help "Mister Jump" to complete all the levels!It features:? Nice retro-Gfx (thanks to flying yogi!)? 10 levels!? Universal-app with full iPad and iPhone-support!? steady framerates with 60 FPS on most devices? Full "Game Center"-supportYou can control "Mister Jump" via on-screen-buttons. Defeat enemies by jumping on them (don´t try that with the fish!). If you collect 100 rubies you´ll get an extra-life.

Name: Mithra: Episode 1: The Calling, Chapter 1
Overview: Join Tag in a mysterious adventure set in the bizarre world of planet Gi! Mithra is an action-adventure game full of fun puzzles to solve, new places to explore, an interesting story to uncover, and lots of characters to meet. Mithra is being developed and released in an episodic fashion, and this is the first chapter of Episode 1 of the series.

Name: Miner4Ever
Overview: Welcome miner, start building your empire! Mine resources in a limitless world, dig and build structure to increase you production. Miner4Ever will update your resources production even when you're offline! Miner4Ever is a minecraft inspired game where the classic mining game meets the strategy and all the appeal of the most popular browser games. Dig your mine miner, build your empire miner! M4E

Name: Midnight Bite
Overview:
Help the little vampire quench his thirst!

Little Draku's parents have gone on vacation, and they forgot to stock the pantry! It's time to go to town in search of fresh blood...

Stay unnoticed, and use your vampiric powers to confuse your enemies, but be wary of the dangerous vampire hunters that watch over the city!

Name: Missile Escape
Overview: Missile Escape is simple : go flying, evade many missiles and unlock new fighters along the way ! Warning : Fighter pilot spirit required.

Name: Military Sniper-Sim 3.18
Overview: If you are considering a career as a marine or army sniper, this is where you begin. The creator of MILITARY SNIPER-SIM, Matthew Reedake, is an ex-soldier of the Australian Army and has studied advanced physics at Sydney University. Designed to allow the practice of all key skills used by snipers and marksmen, it includes environment effects, moving targets, ballistics replay and much more.

Name: Micromazes
Overview:
Micromazes is an 8-bit retro style puzzle game which can be played single player or two-player co-op (challenge mode), or two-, three- or four-player versus (race mode). Levels are randomly generated so no two games are ever the same.

To complete the 50 challenge levels you'll have to make use of keys, doors, blocks, targets, teleports, switches and lots lots more!

Name: MiG Madness
Overview:
Outnumbered, but not outgunned!

Destroy the relentless waves of enemy MiG-15 jet aircraft, and be the Top Gun. Your weapon is the legendary North American F-86 Sabre jet. Play solo or with 1-4 player coop in this fast paced, Korean war era shooter.

Mere survival is not enough - you'll need a severe case of "MiG Madness", and hunger for crazy Power-ups to truly be the best!

Name: Millennium Man
Overview:
This 2D puzzle platformer invites you to travel vast expanses of time to explore a unique world.

Witness walls crumble before you and erode away as you project yourself into a distant future; see structures rebuild themselves as you travel to a distant past. Use your time travel powers to discover the secrets of your mysterious environment.

Name: Minigolf Mania
Overview: Minigolf Mania is a 3D game with over 60 holes on 4 different courses. It comes with four different games modes like Safari and Race mode, and many fun things including Booster Beams, Super Powers, Bouncy Surfaces, Lava, and more!

Name: Modern Pirate Hunter Episode 1: Nash's Revenge
Overview: Modern Pirate Hunter: Ep 1 (Nash's Revenge) is a fast-paced sea combat game with a unique style of action and depth featuring intense dog-fights, a rich 3D world to explore, a multitude of weapons and upgrades, and a thrilling campaign.

Name: Mobius
Overview:
Test your reflexes in this fast-paced, one-button classic. Race through procedurally generated levels, dodging obstacles in your path.

Can you complete the twisted loop that is Mobius?

Name: Miner Style
Overview:
Build Miner Sandbox style worlds, then traverse them in interesting and fun ways. Fly, Drive, Walk or use Spider powers to cling to walls, then spider shot to another.

Explore computer generated worlds to find hidden blocks, some hidden blocks have special properties. Some of these properties include starting or stopping a timer, another lets you bounce up and down, what will the others do?

Name: Mind's Eye of Jupiter: 01
Overview: A woman searches the ruins of a Roman Temple for the legend of the Mind's Eye of Jupiter, a hidden portal to another time. Download episode one of this 3D sci-fi adventure game.

Name: Minesweeper Mayhem
Overview: Experience the puzzling Minesweeper game with a new modern look. Up to 4 players competitive or CO-OP. Highly customizable games complete with highscores and user statistics.

Name: Mini Golf 360
Overview: Now you can enjoy the great American pass-time from the comfort of your couch. Play with up to 3 of your friends and family.

Name: Minigame Marathon
Overview:
Prepare yourself to get seriously retro with 26 challenging minigames that make up the Minigame Marathon.

Choose one of four difficulty levels and try to pass the minigames in the fewest attempts and quickest time possible, using the highly-effective but highly-dangerous "fast forward" mode if required.

Playable by one to four players, and includes online score sharing.

Name: Minotaur
Overview:
Play as the Minotaur... Wandering the world with your axe, destroying everything that tries to harm you. Chop, smash, combo, block and counter your way through entire armies!

Play co-op with 3 friends locally, or up to 7 friends over Xbox Live.

Unravel the mystery of the mysterious falling rocks from the sky! Paint the ground with the blood of your fallen enemies!

Name: Misfit Battles
Overview: Inspired by Shigeru Miyamoto’s Mario Bros title, Misfit Battles improves upon its spiritual predecessor by adding increased multi-player functionality, levels, monsters, and artwork culminating in the ultimate platform battle based game!

Name: Modern Hunt
Overview: In Memory of the Old Times.....shoot at the birds! And you can also challenge your friends in the Multiplayer mode!

Name: Missing Reel
Overview: Missing Reel is a co-operative arcade shooter with a "B-Movie" theme. Players must defend themselves against hordes of enemies and survive to the end of the level, when the players must defeat a boss enemy. The game includes three different game modes. There are 5 levels to play through each with their own unique character, enemy and boss.

Name: Mind's Eye of Jupiter: 03
Overview: Alice returns to her own time to confront Tribune and make the choice that will affect the distant future. Download the final episode of this 3D sci-fi adventure game.

Name: Mind's Eye of Jupiter: 02
Overview: Alice is told to journey into the caves under the Roman Temple. Somewhere in the caverns the Dream Guide waits to answer the questions she searches for.

Name: Mini Wizards
Overview:
Miniaturize your Xbox Live Avatar and battle against other Mini Wizards in this spell casting action game.

Includes LIVE multiplayer and single player survival mode with global scoreboard.

Name: Milie & Telly
Overview:
After an emergency landing, Telly's spaceship has been stolen by a strange and dark professor. As Milie, a young mechanic girl, help him to find it back.

Ride your motorbike, fight against a whole army of robots and defeat the professor in this scrolling shooter.

Name: Moe Mekuri 2.5
Overview: A new Moe Mekuri is here! Just like the previous game, the goal is simply to flip over all the panels face up. Can you complete all the stages and add the cute girls' pictures to the gallery? The higher the difficulty level, the less clothing the girl in the picture will wear! It's a Moe-moe puzzle game that perfectly reflects on the developer's interests!

Name: The Money Game
Overview:
How much money can you rack up?

Get a job, make investments, and put some savings aside as your money grows to the top!

Name: Moe Mekuri
Overview: This game is as simple as just flipping all the panels to face up. Can you pass all the stages and add the girls' illustrations to the gallery? With the upgrade version, after beating all the stages including the SPECIAL, you can move the breasts of the images for the HARD level in the GALLERY.

Name: Moe Mekuri 3
Overview:
1 year after Moe Mekuri 2, new Moe Mekuri 3 is here with all new cute girls! The game system is the same puzzle game as the previous version.

Can you pass all the stages and get all the illustrations of those girls in your gallery?

Enjoy this moe-moe puzzle game that once you start, you can't stop.

Name: MoleGame
Overview: The mole appears one after another. Strike it with the hammer quickly.

Name: Molly the Were-Zompire
Overview: Finding a magical portal to another world? Cool! Being killed soon upon arrival? Not cool. Turning into a Were-Zompire (Werewolf + Zombie + Vampire) and gaining amazing power? Very cool! Embarking on an interactive story with many different paths & endings? Totally awesome!

Name: Monaco 360
Overview: "Monaco 360"is a classic 2d retro by design top down racer inspired by many retro racing games on the Commodore 64 and Arcade formats.

Name: The Monastery
Overview:
Lost at night in a monastery in ruins, unarmed and hunted by demons...

A first-person horror experience that is best played with the lights off.

Name: Monkey Madness
Overview:
Do you have spatial awareness and fast reactions?

Plan forward and help your monkey to pass dangerous obstacles. Collect useful bonus items, jump and run and find the way through different landscapes. But be aware of evil monsters chasing you.

Receive awards and work on your highscore list.

Name: Monkey Nuts
Overview:
Monkey has lost his nuts!

Help monkey get his nuts back - dodge hazards, defeat enemies and beat the clock through 100 levels.

Name: Monster Talk
Overview: Choose your favorite monster and give them a voice. Each monster has its own unique style for the ultimate voice changer.

Name: THE MONKEY WANTS BANANAS
Overview:
Help the monkey to get many bananas in this funny puzzle game.

4 levels with a different amount and kinds of coins will keep you and your friends satisfied. And in the future there`s more to come!

Name: Monster Wisp
Overview: Monster Wisp, a puzzle game in which you must find and rescue stranded wisps throughout the woods. While you avoid the dangers that are trying to steal the wisps you are trying to rescue. The game features twenty five levels, some that will test your wits, some that will require quick timing and others that will test your search and rescue skills.

Name: MonkeyAirBoard
Overview: Ever wondered what monkeys play for fun in the jungle? They play the ultimate air board game. Come and join them!

Name: Monster Katz
Overview:
Monster Katz are on the attack and your best defense is... water?! Good thing Monster Katz hate water, but you better make it last!

Use dozens of water-powered defenses to fend off the monster hoard in 39 exciting levels across 3 unique maps.

Play along to your own tunes or jam with our Monster mix!

Name: Monkey Poo Flinger
Overview:
Maxwell T. Monkey is fed up of life in the zoo and desperately wants something fun to do. Going against the wishes of his good conscience Maxwell, egged on by his bad conscience, takes up the sport of poo flinging.

Join Maxwell the schizophrenic monkey and his friends in over 30 levels of poo flinging madness... just don't smell his finger.

Now includes local two player co-op!

Name: Monster Escape
Overview: Monster Escape is an action-puzzle hybrid where players navigate their monsters safely through levels. Along the way they must make a pathway with puzzle pieces to connect the landscape and avoid a variety of enemies. Each level requires a new approach while still allowing multiple solutions.

Name: Monsters Shoot 'n Monsters
Overview:
In this twin stick shooter you must shoot and destroy your foe while playing through 32 different challenges . Also use your grapple to swing and hurl monsters into one another.

Upgrade your gun and grapple for more destruction.

Name: Monsters Elect
Overview: Monsters Elect is a 2D fantasy action game. Fight your way through a never ending stream of monsters and lead your allies in battle as you take down four mean bosses.

Name: Monsters in Neon Space
Overview: In this space shooter you will destroy hordes of space monsters using your choice of three different upgradable guns and bombs along with other upgradable abilities. These abilities will give you the edge to survive through the monsters' space and their planet. If you think you're up for it play through the game on hard difficulty using the powerful but dangerous gravity bomb.

Name: Moon Cheese
Overview: Battle your way up to the moon, to get some delicious moon cheese, that not only tastes magnificent it also comes with some bonus effects, and then enjoy as the points just keep coming.

Name: Moon Miner
Overview: Moon Mining & Drilling Co has hired you to mine valuable resources from deep beneath the moon's surface.

Name: Moon Taxi: Seven Short Stories
Overview: Pilot your way through this unique collection of performed short stories. You drive a Moon Taxi and every passenger has a story to tell. Collect dust and words to unlock the next fare and the next tale.

Name: MoonShine
Overview: Immerse yourself in the underworld of the 1920s era prohibition period. 6 Unique game modes, a custom game mode editor, upgradable GUI, unlockable Milestones, and many other features will test your trading skills for a long time to come.

Name: Monsters (Probably) Stole My Princess
Overview: Take control of the massively awesome and super sexy aristocratic demon known only as "The Duke" in an upwards-scrolling platformer where chasing down giant fleeing monsters is the business at hand. Build combos to unleash increasingly magnificent finishing moves on the (most likely) guilty monsters - and impress your adoring fans.

Name: Monsters Swimming
Overview: In this twin stick action game you will need to avoid monsters and then smash them to bits with your axe so you can eat them. Monsters Swimming has 25 levels that become more and more challenging and 5 challenge levels that will test your avoiding, smashing and eating skills. So prepare to hack and devour.

Name: More Fun With Twins
Overview: Find and match the illusive twin cards to learn Iliana's deepest secrets!

Name: Mortal Legacies
Overview: Mortal Legacies is a 2D Japanese Role Playing Game. Explore the world of Elisia in search of the lost crown while fighting powerful foes and finding friends to help you on your quest.

Name: The Most Addicting Sheep Game
Overview: Run, jump and roll to the beat in the easy-to-learn, tricky-to-master most addicting sheep game.Simple side-scrollers with catchy music and cutesy graphics are awesome. And rhythm games rock. In fact, we like them both so much we decided to make them into one. The result? The Most Addicting Sheep Game. It’s an engagingly simple rhythm platformer where jumps and rolls must be perfectly timed to the music to complete the increasingly complex levels with maximum score. Oh, and it has a cute sheep.We loved making TMASG. We love playing TMASG. And we’d love to know if you do too!

Name: MothBallz
Overview: MothBallz gives you 14 balls to unlock, each with unique dynamics; 45 testing levels, including Time Trials and KillAll frenzies; a game progression designed to maximize replay value; and that satisfied feeling you can only get from crushing a ton of bugs.

Name: MOTOJUMP
Overview: How big can you go?

Name: Motorbike Stunt Agent Julie
Overview:
MSA Julie features a novel combination of two-stick-shooter and motorbike racing game. While helping the French agent Julie Cevoir on her hunt for super villain Dr. Kreutzer you have to master bike physics while clearing the way off enemies.

In twenty increasingly challenging missions preceded by an extensive tutorial the story is told in professionally recorded dialogs and comic stills.

Name: MotorHEAT
Overview: You've got the ultimate racing car, and an unlimited road to drive on. What else do we need to say? It's all about driving. Fast. No brakes, no limits.

Name: Mouse Maze
Overview: Designed to help you improve your joystick control ability, help the mouse safely find his way to the end of the maze. Pick up cheese wedges along the way to satisfy his appetite and increase your score. Keep your mouse away from the edges though; they will zap him!

Name: Movipas
Overview:
"Animation movie puzzle + puzzle with a falling object feel."

Swap the pieces to complete the movie, and all the pieces in that movie will disappear! Clear the pieces quickly, making sure they don't cross the red line.

Pieces on the stage rise one row at a time, giving it a falling object feel.

Name: Mower
Overview:
Hate having to go outside to mow the lawn? Now you can do it while still indoors!

Armed with a lawn mower and a weed eater, you have the mission of mowing a virtual lawn as fast as you can.

Try not to mow any cats...

Name: Mr BeatLoop
Overview:
Create music quickly on your Xbox 360. Best viewed as a fun music/sketch toy, Mr BeatLoop lets you create loops using 3 different drum kits and 8 different instruments.

Edit the loops in real time, change the speed, save and load your best ideas!

Designed with absolute ease of use and fun in mind - Mr BeatLoop is great for sketching up quick musical ideas, or just experimenting!

Name: Mr. Gravity
Overview: Shift gravity to navigate Mr. Gravity through a series of challenging (and most times perilous) puzzles to find Mrs. Gravity! While moving through these puzzles be sure to collect the gems along the way, but be careful.

Name: MULLETMAN
Overview: Mulletman is a moral man, principled, disciplined, a man of roids and wisdom. Trapped between two worlds, between the eighties and the nineties, he walks the line between the past and the future, between good and gilded robot.

Name: Multitasking
Overview:
Play up to 4 continuously shuffling minigames at once, using the entire Xbox 360 Controller.

Last as long as possible, attempt 30 increasingly-difficult Challenges, or try the full-featured Practice Mode.

Great for parties!

Name: Mummies vs GunnS
Overview: Follow The Adventure of the explorer, Gunnthar Svensen, in discovering the treacherous tombs of Egypt!

Name: Murder Miners
Overview:
The #1 rated Xbox Live Indie Game. Halo-inspired. Destructible/constructible environments. Vehicles. Zombie survival. Hookshots.

Infection mode: Be the zombie & eat the dead to level up your zombie abilities.

Name: Murder On Snake Road
Overview: There's a battleaxe stuck in the back of Patrick's head!

Name: MPL Slots #1
Overview:
Favorite slots games from LiveGLBT.com are now available to everyone. Each with its own mini-game.

Cocktail slots has exciting three real slot action like in a casino. Bright colorful graphics, high quality sound!

Take a trip under the sea in Fish Slots.

Ride'm Cowboys and Cowgals! Mosey on over to Rodeo Slots and take a spin. A great western themed game with a cattle roping mini-game.

Name: Muffy Boy
Overview:
Muffy boy is an arcade platform game. Style of the best retro game Jetset Willy.

Roby kid has lost all Marbles, you must collect all 80 Marbles, and Roby leave your computer.

Name: Mummies Rising
Overview: After the disappearance of an archaeological expedition in an Egyptian tomb, a soldier was sent to find them. His worst nightmare was about to begin...

Name: Murder for Dinner
Overview:
You have been invited to a dinner party at Miss Havisham's, a notorious old gossip. But upon arrival, your host is missing and the rest of the guests are exceptionally uncomfortable and oddly behaved.

You determine to get to the root of all their behaviour and to explain the mystery you encounter.

Name: Murky Horizon
Overview: Murky Horizon takes traditional elements like power-ups and upgradeable turrets, and introduces features rarely seen in either genre like four-player coop and pitch-black nightfall. In Murky Horizon players defend a bunker from waves of flesh-eating lizards. As day turns to night, the game grows more challenging and players must use flashlights and flares to spot incoming enemies.

Name: Murderous Market
Overview:
Murderous Market is a party game of stealth and assassination. Each of up to four players must first find themselves in a town filled with NPCs, then they must find and kill their targets quietly.

Murderous Market has four game modes that use stealth in unique ways. There are outbreaks of plague, werewolves, character specific powers, and customizable settings that make every play different.

Name: Murphid
Overview: In Murphid players must use their puzzle solving skills and fast reaction to withstand attack of gorgeous marble hordes and bring those beasts under control. Deep, yet simple core game mechanics coupled with astonishing graphics, immersive sound effects and adaptive gameplay result in intense climatic moments that modern gamers have come to expect. We hope you dig it!

Name: Music Roll
Overview: Simple music sequencer in piano roll style. Enjoy editing and playing as you like.

Name: Musickness
Overview:
The world of Music and Purpleness has been invaded by the Musickness, turning healthy notes Pink and Green!

Do what you can to save as many of them as possible!

Name: Music Box
Overview: Music Box is a new type of music app, focusing on user experience and ease of use.

Name: Music Island
Overview: Music Island is a rhythm game where you make your own music as you play. Take the role of a man trapped on an island and use the beat to defeat waves of incoming sea creatures. Features a full story mode and an infinite mode with global leaderboards.

Name: Musical Advent Calendar
Overview: Brighten up your T.V. this Christmas with our musical advent calendar, featuring 3 advent calendars, puppies, kittens and cartoon pictures all whilst listening to some all time favourite Christmas songs

Name: MusicNow!
Overview:
MusicNow! is a music jukebox and the fastest way to access your music library on your XBOX.

Utilizing the new SEMpick UI you can find a specific Artist, Album, or Song with fewer keystrokes than any other product available.

Name: Musicus
Overview: This sound action puzzle is put some pieces of panel together to play the music. Connecting four colors of panels on the screen and make it rectangle, and attach to the place called scorezone where the music will be playing. put the panel together well, and let's enjoy music.

Name: Musicus2
Overview: This is the Second edition of Musicus. All songs are new one. and can confront in XBOXLive game. This sound action puzzle is put some pieces of panel together to play the music. Connecting four colors of panels on the screen and make it rectangle, and attach to the place called scorezone where the music will be playing. put the panel together well, and let's enjoy music.

Name: MXHD
Overview:
Motocross High Definition. Race your dirtbike against 3 computer controlled bikes on 5 different racetracks.

The bike handling is amazing with the bike power-sliding in turns and the suspensions absorbing every bump on the track. Many stunts allowed including back flip, front flip and many more.

Impressive crashes. Controllable camera. Original Soundtrack.

Name: Mute Crimson
Overview: PLATFORMING NINJA ACTION ** Many levels of platforming action! ** Climb walls and slash enemies! ** Get collectibles and go for fast times!

Name: Pinball FX 2
Overview: Pinball FX is back, and it is better than ever! Pinball FX2 offers brand new tables and a host of new features and improvements, including a new state-of-the-art physics model that surpasses anything available so far.

Name: Muvizzle
Overview:
Simple to pick up but difficult to master, Muvizzle uses one of the simplest of concepts in number puzzling, but one that offers endless possibilities for strategy and replay.

Tired of in game muzak? Muvizzle bundles an interface to YOUR music collections and a background visualisation to gee you along. Put on the music that YOU want to listen to, relax and perfect your scores in Muvizzle.

Name: Mutant Zombie Onslaught
Overview:
The year is 2012 and the world as we know it has ended. A virus sent from the depths of Hell has decimated humanity. Genetic mutations caused by the virus have turned many of those remaining into mindless zombies with dangerous mutant powers.

Can you survive the zombie onslaught and save humanity from Armageddon?

Name: MyBand
Overview: My Band is a musical game offering to the player the ability to create a band and compose their own music with a Pad or any instruments compatible with the XBox 360.

Name: My Cat vs. Zombies Ep I
Overview:
The zombie hordes of living dead monsters are hungry, and cat is on the menu. Rascal the cat must use all her nine lives to survive this nightmare.

Kill zombies, build alliances, loot stashes and level up as you fight for survival in a world where cats have inherited human civilization.

Name: My Chabudai
Overview: 2D Shooter role playing game.

Name: myFishtank
Overview: Design your ultimate fish tank. Customize wallpapers, rock features, plants, gravels, and pretty much everything. Add more than 18 fish types to your aquarium. Why not create your very own species in the paint fish area? Unlock able rewards to add extra tank features that make this one of the most exciting XNA community products launched to date.

Name: myChristmas
Overview: Featuring 10 Christmas carols and our next gen 3d engine. Decorate and light your Christmas tree, stretch out in front of a Yule log fire or get a group of friends together and go Christmas caroling over Xbox Live with your avatars. Experience first hand the awesome magic of Santa arriving, it just wouldn't be myChristmas without him.

Name: Mystic Cards
Overview: Use your wits to defeat your opponents by getting rid of all your cards first. With local and online play, you can share your scores and take on up to 3 opponents via system link, or through xbox live!

Name: Natural Selection
Overview: It's a fish eat fish world out there. Only the biggest survive!

Name: Your Neighborhood is Gang Infested
Overview: Choose one of five gangs and take to the streets to fight for city-wide domination! Out-think and out-manoeuvre the rival gangs to take control of their suburbs in this risk-like turn based strategy game.

Name: Nene minigames
Overview:
Join Nene and his friends the week before his birthday. Each day you will have to face new challenges and activities.

Unlock all the minigames, play against your friends and show them you are the best.

Name: Nebulon
Overview: Old School Arcade Action for the 21st Century! Featuring adaptive gameplay, a host of awesome weaponry, stunning effects and a thumping soundtrack to match. Get those trigger fingers ready - this is Retro as it was meant to be played...

Name: Mystic Forest
Overview: Experience a sexy and mysterious adventure in the Mystic Forest!

Name: Nandeyanen!?: The 1st Sutra
Overview:
Nandeyanen!? – The 1st Sutra is a horizontal 2D shoot’em up that introduces gameplay mechanics such as bullet counter and blast pods: the first allows the player to survive waves of attacks by returning them to their sender and the second is a tool meant to valorize the player’s learning curve by letting him spread his attacks on the whole screen.

In a narrative thought as a homage to Japanese imaginary worlds and creative game design, the player takes the role of Tenguman, a long-nosed goblin who wakes up after a thousand year sleep to see the world overrun by an army of mythical pranksters. The game structure seeks to emulate both the tenacity and the virtuosity required by the genre. Thus, while meant to be easy on the eyes the game is not targeted at beginners.

Name: NanoSquad
Overview: Join the squad as they try to save the world from the Wolf Pack. A multiplayer sidescrolling shooter game which uses RPG battle elements and teamwork in its mechanics. Use the aircrafts' different jobs and abilities to help the squad complete their missions.

Name: Naoki Tales
Overview:
Naoki Tales is an arcade adventure game.

When Naoki came back at holidays, his wife is captured by an Evil. Help him to save his wife on each level.

Name: Mythos Castle
Overview:
Dare you brave the walls of Mythos Castle?

Choose to be the Wizard, Knight or Fairy in this epic platform action adventure.

Name: Nano Doc
Overview:
The sickness comes without warning. The last hope for humanity is a nanoscale robot, small enough to swim through the bloodstream and destroy the infection head-on.

Use four different weapons to blast through 20 levels of intense bullet-hell action. The nanobot also is equipped with a claw to grab any cell for upgrades and chargeable bombs.

Name: Neo Terra
Overview: Conquer planets in this frantic race to dominate, conquer and subjugate neutral planets as well as your enemy planets. Use cunning, deceit, and strategy to further your own goal of conquering the galaxy. Offers 8 player games (4 humans and 4 AI), and a bevy of different map customizations.

Name: Mystic Mayhem
Overview:
Max crash landed onto a mysterious island. After meeting the king of the island, Max accidentally unleashes the evil sorcerer Malwarp who has kidnapped the princess and took over the kingdom.
