The Staff of Wisdom has chosen Max and has granted him the power to fight back against Malwarp's army of minions.

Help Max find keys and doorways on the journey to reach the top of the mountain and save the princess!

Name: New Year Countdown
Overview: This app uses the date/time set on your Xbox to show you the exact days/ h/min/sec left to New Year! When only 9 sec left the countdown will turn red and start beeping, wanting you to join in. When the countdown reaches 0 there will be colorful fireworks and atmospheric sound effects. Theres also a Simulate New Year button for the once whod like to celebrate New Year at another time! Enjoy!

Name: The Never Ending Game 2
Overview:
The sequel to the Never Ending Game. The Never Ending Game 2 is a ball drop game with power ups, high scores, and more.

Try out the all new customization menu. Customize your wheel which affects different aspects of your ball.

Name: Neon Prime
Overview: Neon Prime is a retro style vertical space shooter with the player fighting their way through waves of enemies and bosses, over five stages to defeat the Neon Prime. As well as the story mode players can play through the 5 story level and 5 extra levels. A Neon Prime has entered our solar system. We sent our main fleet to engage it but contact has been lost. Now you are our only hope.

Name: Neutrino Wars
Overview: Battle your enemies throughout the galaxy with Neutrino Wars, the ultimate low-gravity space duel! With 8 levels, two weapons and a choice of ship colour, the retro gameplay will have you and your friends hooked! Who will be the champion?

Name: The Never Ending Game
Overview:
Play this addicting and never ending game!

Good luck with this crazy challenging game!

Name: Neon Paddles
Overview: This is the definitive remake of the "paddles game." All of the playability of the original, but with added special movements and several configurations, as well as a dazzling audio-visual update.

Name: Nessie
Overview:
The elusive Loch Ness monster - a creature surrounded by the unknown. Keep it that way!

Help her avoid the prying eyes of those pesky humans, or she will no longer be mysterious! No one can spot her when underwater, but be careful - even Nessie needs to come up for air.

Name: NewsCopter
Overview: Collect News Photos from cities around the World.

Name: Newton vs. The Horde: An Old Spice Creation Myth
Overview: Physics Vs Stinky Zombies. Awesome!. Build traps out of random objects, rope and elastic. Use whatever you have. A Bomb, a spear, a fish. Stop the Stinkies from taking freshness from the world. And remember, Old Spice enhances manliness and awesomeness. Apply it to the dude, apply it to the computer, apply it to a bear or just throw it at a monster and laugh when he cant handle the freshness.

Name: Newton's New Tones
Overview:
Harness the power of Newton's cradle to create mesmerizing music. Featuring varied click sounds and a system that will help you turn your unsynchronised cradles into an astonishing orchestra.

Experiment. Experience. Newton’s NEW Tones.

Name: Ninja Stole My Bike
Overview: Ninjas keep stealing your bike. Do you have what it takes to get it back? Find out in this fast paced reflex game. Full version includes all levels and global scoreboards.

Name: Ninja 360
Overview: Long ago, The 84-year-old ninja stealth "Gigi" is a friend of the people as ordered by the generals, Broke into the house and fraud Akudaikan took the gold coin acquired by evil, Sprinkle rose went to the task of the masses. Well, that'll do! Listen, the trap-loaded mechanism. Gigi will be able to do the missions? Now, go!

Name: Ninja Crash
Overview:
Take to the sky and become the ultimate aerial ninja! Strap on your magic lanterns... It's CRASH time!

Strike your opponents down across 9 beautiful levels in full 1080p, destroying their lanterns to send them falling to their doom. Gain the advantage with game-changing powerups such as the kite-chute and kunai!

Get ready to CRASH! The more players, the more craziness and laughter!

Name: NextWar: The Quest for Earth
Overview: Fight across the galaxy in an exciting 2D tower defence game. Build towers, research upgrades, and obliterate the enemy in 10 campaign missions and skirmish mode. The war needs you! For Earth! And all her colonies!

Name: Nice Try
Overview: In this fast paced game you guide a worm in his eternal journey full of hazards through various stages of his life. Use the solo, co-op or the versus-mode to accomplish this. Eat digestible goodies to grow as you go. Avoid the once that might harm or kill you. If you consume enough Cola you can burp away annoying obstacles. This is great fun when played with your partner!

Name: Night of Doom 2
Overview: Face off against a horde of undead either alone or with up to three of your friends. Can you survive the Night of Doom?

Name: Ninja Exorcist Episode 1
Overview: Ninja Exorcist is the passion project of Nebula Game Studios. Featuring gorgeous full 1080p HD hand-painted and hand-animated 2D visuals, a beautiful score, and deep, polished gameplay, Ninja Exorcist sets out to combine action, stealth, exploration and a plethora of gameplay-altering upgrades into an engrossing and methodical experience that will sink its claws into your gaming senses.

Name: Ninja Sneaking
Overview:
Get to the top floor through the traps and enemies sight! Get the fastest clear time!

You can practice floors you've reached in "Floor training" mode.

Name: Ninja Sneaking 2
Overview:
Sneak into Karakuri residence to get back her big sister!

A lot of Karakuris hinder her! Clear all the difficult stages without being found!

3 stages + 1 extra "Chaos" stage included. You can retry from the stage that you'd been found (with penalties).

Name: Night Of Doom
Overview: Many fools have tried to survive the "Night Of Doom", only adding to our numbers. Have you got what it takes? 3d First person shooter, 3 Levels with different enemies all aiming for one thing... Your head!

Name: Niji
Overview: Do you like swimming against the stream? Play Niji, a multiplayer tower swim experience that puts you into the role of Niji the Rainbow Fish. Scale waterfalls, jump from one into the other and perform flips to build up huge combos. Play alone to save your love Masu from the evil thundercloud Arashi and try to set new highscores or compete with up to three friends in three local multiplayer modes.

Name: Ninja Chop!!
Overview: "Ninja Chop" is a Ninja Training to chop off milk bottles. During training, you will sometime get a new costume as a reward. So try it out when you get it. Keep chop!

Name: Ninja Escape
Overview: Ninja, fall, next, Ninja, fall,next...10 stages!

Name: Ninja Guardian
Overview: As the Ninja Guardian of Earth it is your duty to protect the planet from "Evil Samurai Warlord", an evil samurai warlord bent on destroying the Earth's natural beauty. Ninja must jump on platforms and attack his enemies to propel himself upward and confront his nemesis.

Name: Ninja Recapture
Overview:
Beat enemies with Shuriken and Katana. Get back the book of secrets stolen from castle!

Buy equipments or get higher levels to power-up. You can play games at the Gambling Hall or rebattle with bosses at the Arena in the latter part of the game.

Name: Ninja STG
Overview: NINJA 2D shooting game.

Name: No Air Out Here
Overview:
Greetings! You are a solitary space adventurer on the mission of all missions! Unfortunately, your super awesome spacecraft has suffered near fatal damage and you must make an emergency landing for parts.

Luckily for you, you have landed on a planet full of spare parts and scrap metal! The down side? They fight back!

Prepare yourself for battle and remember your space cadet training!

Name: Ninja Train
Overview: Wao! That's NINJA!

Name: Ninjah
Overview:
Ninjah is a fast paced puzzle platformer.

Get from A to B as quickly as possible with the help of your ninja rope and ninja jetpack. However, there is a snag. You may only come in to contact with blocks the same colour as Ninjah, else it's POP and you have to start again. To help combat this, you can change colour by bumping in to the corresponding checkered blocks.

Good luck!

Name: Nuclear Wasteland
Overview:
Take on wave after wave of Mutants!

By 2030 nuclear waste has mutated many locals, who have taken over a military base; and its your job to clean them up! Unlock Assault Rifles, a Submachine Gun, a Shotgun, Health depot's and Ammunition bunkers to help get the job done!

Name: Nuke Your Neighbor
Overview: Nuke Your Neighbor puts both your strategic skills and reflexes to the test like no other card game out there. Compete against three other players to see who can get rid of all their cards first! Earn all 15 Awards and build your player record for endless hours of exciting gameplay.

Name: Notebook Adventures
Overview: Follow Cecil Jenkins on his first Notebook Adventure. The journey will be very tough but doable. Embark crossed over 40 pen and paper levels, avoid the spikes, climb the ropes, and DON'T FORGET THE KEY. Collect money to unlock the most challenging adventure yet. Warning this adventure can be very addicting.

Name: Nova Remnant
Overview:
Fast paced strategic game where timing is imperative for a big score but being swift will increase the challenge.

Prove your worth by establishing a large score in survival mode if you can last the onslaught long enough.

Name: norT:Tron 84
Overview:
Help Magic Thighs & Slightly Phil escape Eugene’s Lair in this INTENSE TWIN-STICK SHOOTER.

Battle alone, or co-op with a friend; fighting over 42 action-packed levels. Compare you best scores against the world with an on-line (P2P) hi-score table.

Name: No Frills: Cross Sums
Overview: Challenge yourself with a game of Cross Sums, a logic-based number placement game. Thousands of unique puzzles are at your fingertips. If you like crossword puzzles or sudoku, you'll love Cross Sums!

Name: No Pain No Brain
Overview:
A new awesome ZOMBIE Game! A real one! Try this new masterpiece from Monkeyware Studios!

- Full 16bit Retro-Enhanced Graphics
- Levels with Humor
- Unique Boss Fight!
- Tons of ZOMBIE!

Name: Ninja War Stolen Scrolls
Overview:
Speedy action ninja game of fire and water and wind and lightning!

Up to four people can play together!

Name: NLL Lacrosse 2010
Overview: NLL Lacrosse 2010 features all eleven National Lacrosse League teams and their 250 players, custom jerseys, season mode, dive shots and all the fast paced, hard hitting professional indoor lacrosse you can handle for just 400 MSP!

Name: No-Fly Zone
Overview: Shoot down aircraft in the No-fly Zone! Upgrade your turret to stop them all!

Name: The Ninjabread Men
Overview:
Help the ninjabread men save as many civilians as they can. The longer they make their stand against the endless demon hoard the more time they buy for the civilians to escape harm.

How long can you last and how many civilians can you save?

Name: No Luca No
Overview: Breakfast with Luca.

Name: Nomis: Legacy Islands
Overview: Defeat the robot general before he can resurrect a weapon hidden long ago. Play through 20 levels and engage in boss battles, local co-op, and upgrade your character and weapons.

Name: NomNoms
Overview:
In the beginning, the semi-intelligent creatures known as Noms were the favorite food source of many creatures. After discovering that this was because the Noms have a flavor, they decided to free themselves from the oppressive feasting of the other beasts under the epic leadership of Lord Noms and RamboNom.

Gather Loot, build up your forces, and defend your Nomlets, all in the name of the LOL!

Name: The No Button Game
Overview: The No Button Game is a fast paced button-free platform game that does not require the use of buttons or sticks to be played. Place your wireless controller on a box then tap with your fingers and it is done! Don't you have a wireless controller or a box handy? No worries, there's the one button mode.

Name: No Frills: Sudoku
Overview: Challenge yourself with a classic game of Sudoku, a logic-based number placement game. Thousands of unique puzzles are at your fingertips.

Name: Ninja VS. Zombie
Overview: This game is an action game with the puzzle element. The player operates a ninja and defeats a zombie and avoid a trap and advance. The trial version is 6 stages. The product version is 25 stages.

Name: NoEnd
Overview:
Try to leave Hell avoiding the traps which are bound to make you lose lives!

Playing with another gamer in co-op mode, you will be able to win lives, which will make your task easier... But will you succeed?

More than 30 levels, 2 multiplayer modes and 2 single modes!

Name: Ninjas and Priestess
Overview: Experience a sexy and mysterious adventure in Ninjas and Priestess!

Name: NLL 11
Overview: NLL 11 features the National Lacrosse Leagues ten teams, 230 players, a new game engine, new artificial intelligence, franchise mode, league statistics, manual substitutions, fighting, and much more for only 400 MSP!

Name: Null Divide
Overview: Find upgrades to aid in exploration and combat, fight bosses, and find a way out. *Features retro graphics and nonlinear levels to explore. Includes medals to unlock and drop-in drop-out coop!*

Name: Nostalgya
Overview:
Travel through four levels of constant action in this space shooter, an homage to the 2D shoot-'em-ups from the 80's.

Choose one from SIX different pilots, each with its own profile and collect up to EIGHT different weapons, including missiles, defense shields and the ultimate weapon - the pulverizer.

Play solo or with a friend: you will have a blast in this sci-fi adventure from the past!

Name: Nucleon
Overview: You are the Electron, guardian of the atomic nucleus. Destroy incoming radiation particles before they hit the Proton at the center of the atom. Use your Electron powers to transform into an electric bolt, arcing to nearby radiation. The Neutrons will shield the all-important Proton too, but once they are destroyed, you're the only defense. Destroy the radiation. Defend Nucleon!

Name: Nuke War '84
Overview:
Two tribes go to war in this strategy game that recreates the tension and paranoia of the cold war era.

Build bases and spy on your enemy, each side waiting for the best moment to push the button first. Once war is on, gauge the benefits of offense versus defense as you activate your bases.

Can you outwit the computer and win a nuclear war?

Name: Notebook Shooter
Overview:
This stick shooter pins you against endless waves of increasingly difficult evil robots that must be destroyed! Fast paced fun for 1-4 people cooperatively.

With 4 unique guns and 6 upgrades for each, you can choose your own path to survival.

Name: Nova Lancer
Overview: Get behind the throttle of a fast paced space fighter as a gun for hire at Lancer Corp. Unlock missions and buy ships with newly acquired credits as you find out more and more how the universe isn't so friendly.

Name: Noyd
Overview:
Noyd is a new artificially intelligent game playing prodigy. Every artificial neuron in Noyd's artificial brain is designed to crush you. Noyd doesn't think you'll be able to beat Noyd in one game, let alone the 15 Noyd is capable of playing.

Warning: Noyd has been known to have a few tricks up Noyd's sleeves.

Name: Nuage
Overview:
Enter a state of calm relaxation with Nuage, a no stress game where you collect clouds and rain drops to rain on the environment and bring it to life, all while listening to the well known unsigned relaxation musician, Paul Collier.

Play with headphones for an even better experience.

Name: Null Battles
Overview: Null Battles features online multiplayer with up to 16 players on 2 to 4 teams, zero gravity combat, procedurally generated levels, and retro style art and sound.

Name: Nyan Cat Adventure
Overview: In the year 20XX NYAN CAT GOES ADVENTURE! Single-button arcade action meets the Internets greatest Cat Meme, Nyan Cat! Super simple to pick up and play, starring all your favorite Nyan characters. 5 game modes jam packed with all the insanity youd expect from the developers behind Techno Kitten Adventure! Nyanyanyanyanyanyanya :)

Name: North Pole Zombie Massacre
Overview:
You are Santa Clause. Zombies have invaded the North Pole. The kids are counting on you to gather all of the presents that the zombies have scattered all over the North Pole, and return them to the sleigh. Only then can you deliver them and save the holidays!

Enjoy endless random levels of holiday cheer.

Name: Obesity Epidemic
Overview: A new additive called extract-11 has made food irresistible and mutated people into overweight raging hordes! All of the junk food across the nation is quickly consumed until only 4 pieces remain Play as one of these 4 survivors armed with machine guns, flamethrowers, rocket launchers and more as they use overwhelming firepower to escape the grocery store in this epic twin stick shooter!

Name: Ocean Drive Challenge
Overview:
Classic arcade racing game in a flashy 80's look. The race course combines the most stunning landscapes of the world and gives you some marvelous views.

Choose all characters and see how their personal stories unwind and intertwine. Listen to great music and enjoy the ride!

Name: O.C.D.
Overview: Tired of RPG's with convoluted plot lines and hour long cutscenes? Sick of cutting-edge graphics that just make your eyes bleed? With the Optimal Character Development system, you can focus on what's important: grinding your characters.

Name: Obsessive Collecting Disorder
Overview:
Ever wanted to know just how obsessed with collecting you are? Obsessive Collecting Disorder is a platformer designed to test you to your collecting limits.

70 levels of hardcore collecting action await... get rated today!

Name: Ocean Scenes
Overview: Ready for a tropical escape but can't get away? Let Ocean Scenes transform your TV into a window looking in on a virtual vacation.. in the comfort of your own living room! Choose from 18 combinations of scenery. Feel the movement of the waves and listen to the soothing sounds of the ocean. Relax in an ocean view beach house, or out on your own private stateroom balcony on a luxury cruise ship.

Name: Octogenarian VIP
Overview: Escort the ever elusive Octogenarian VIP through multiple levels and defend her from waves of ninja monkey assassins and hungry, hungry, gators.

Name: Octagon
Overview: Set in a trance-like alternate gameworld, Octagon combines frantic shootem' up tactics with devilish puzzles to produce a unique hybrid experience. Each of the four gem buttons correspond to 4 different enemy colors. Only the correct colored shot will destroy your enemy.

Name: Octave Bar Clock
Overview: Unique time telling method combines sophistication and class with utility. Each bar graph is assigned its own piano octave and therefore visually and audibly represents time changes. The Octave Bar Clock also serves as a fully functional alarm clock.

Name: Odyssey 3011
Overview: 3D, 1st person space-sim, combat, trading. Dog-fight and trade your way through hundreds of star systems. Earn galactic credits to upgrade your ship. Complete missions, discover the alien artefacts.

Name: Octopede
Overview:
Octopede is a fast-paced 2D survival shooter. The player takes control of a computer worm inside a hostile mainframe. Gather as much data as possible before the host’s defences get the better of you!

Manic gameplay, shiny neon graphics and 8-bit style music and SFX make Octopede a truly intense experience.

Name: Oh Snap!
Overview: Oh Snap! All you gotta do is match the same color blocks. Get rectangles of the same color and they disappear (OH SNAP!). Get 1,000,000 points and level up! Go for the High Score... Oh Snap!

Name: Oft Horizon: Seascape
Overview:
Use Oft Horizon's procedural technology to generate your unique island, control time, and alter the weather.

Chat with others online, fade into the sounds of the ocean, and reflect on your own romantic portrait of the seaside.

Name: Oh Noes!!2
Overview:
For too long they have mocked you. For too long have you been the accompaniment of some luke-warm fries and an obligatory soft-drink. Now it is time to make the human race pay for it's indiscretions against your meaty goodness.

Sucks when you get vaporised by the lazer eyes of a psychopathic fast-food product from space... oh wellz....

Name: Office Affairs
Overview: Life is short.

Name: Office DisOrders
Overview: Finally, you can live out your dream of rising to the top of the corporate ladder! Office Politics is a satirical simulation game spanning 5 working days. You play an aspiring intern named Jennifer who has just received a lucrative internship position at Incomputech. To succeed, you must complete office tasks, maintain a good work/life balance, and even go to Washington D.C. for a bailout.

Name: Ogre's Phantasm Sword Quest
Overview: 3D Action RPG. Attack large ogres with your sword! Break the helmets! This game contains 9 stages and 5 swords!

Name: Oh Noes!!1
Overview:
Oh Noes!!1 a giant chicken with laser eyes is stomping down upon helpless humanity. Who will save them... certainly not you, you control the chicken.

Play this Ultra-Realistic-Laser-Eyed-Chicken Simulation now and stomp down upon humanity like it so richly deserves.

Please note, this game is EXCESSIVELY VIOLENT and EXCESSIVELY GORY... Oh Wellz...

Name: Oicho-Kabu Online
Overview: Oichokabu is a Japanese traditional card game like baccarat. If the last digit of your cards total is larger than the dealer's then you win double your wager. The winner is the one with the most money. Oichokabu is fully playable over Xbox Live.

Name: Old School Adventure
Overview:
Old school 2D adventure game.

Take to the air on powerful wind currents. Discover cool power-ups such as flying boots, fire armor and more.

Name: Of Steel and Sorcery
Overview: The fantasy world of Adoria is under siege. Follow the story of three unique characters using all of their skills, strength and magic in a turn-based game with RPG influences.

Name: Off Balance
Overview:
Can you overcome being stranded on a desert island and find the girl of your dreams?

Stack the objects to find the items necessary to make your dreams of salvation come true. Includes 20 amazingly addictive levels that will challenge your gaming skills to the max.

Name: Oft Horizon: Precursor
Overview:
Oft Horizon: Precursor recreates the longing solitude and serenity of an uncharted voyage into the unknown.

Navigate through placid blue waters and violent storms within a small systems run universe. Encounter other player ships online, while sailing, exploring, battling, bartering, and researching, to cultivate your crew and ships to a seaworthy corps.

Name: Oil Magnate
Overview: Do you have what it takes to be an Oil Magnate? Buy and drill wells, extinguish burning oilfields, assist pipeline workers, engage terrorists and manage your contracts. Do whatever necessary to keep the oil flow running.

Name: Old School Destruction
Overview: Get ready for the ultimate co-op adventure!!! In OSD you will battle through rich 3D environments destroying everything old school style!. New technology meets the classic destroy first, ask questions later gameplay to give you the HD experience of a lifetime. Beautiful graphics employing advanced techniques like soft shadows and real time lightning deliver crisp visuals through the whole game!

Name: Old School Racer
Overview: Old School Racer is a fun, fast paced motorbike game that will have you coming back for more! Upgrade your bike to set even faster times on the global scoreboard! With over 20 crazy levels and 13 dirt bikes to choose from, prepare to loose sleep!

Name: Operation Old Spice
Overview:
Have you got what it takes to defend the Old Spice?

Prevent the old spice from being carried away by nemesis and battle your way to fame through 16 different levels of difficulty, covering the heights of Matterhorn and the wind swept beaches of Fiji.

By scoping your enemies and preventing them from leaving with the valuable Old Spice, you can save the day, while smelling good.

Name: Oozi: Earth Adventure Episode 3
Overview: Oozi: Earth Adventure is where classic platforming fun meets modern visuals and hand-drawn art. Lots of special abilities, dozens of enemies, extra difficult challenge mode and time limited arcade mode specially for hardcore gamers.

Name: Orbit Craze
Overview: Orbit Craze is an out of this universe, color coding brain warp. Race opponents and the clock to align your planets first. Play at any level and increase your speed. Be ready to get sucked into another dimension.

Name: The Omniscient Orb
Overview: Have questions that need answers? Try The Omniscient Orb! Our magical crystal ball will answer all of your life’s questions without hesitation or bias.

Name: Oozi: Earth Adventure Episode 1
Overview: Oozi: Earth Adventure is where classic platformer gameplay meets modern visuals and hand-drawn art. 5 story mode levels, 7 extra challenge levels for hardcore gamers, time limited arcade mode and dozens of enemies.

Name: Old Spice Racers
Overview: Old Spice Racers brings the return of exciting 2D side scrolling games coupled with local and online multi-player game play. Up to 8 players may compete, via Xbox Live, through 45 stages for racing supremacy. Old Spice Superpowers provide that extra competitive edge. Ranking boards are shared between network players to create and maintain a thriving online community.

Name: Orbit Crash
Overview:
You're a small comet hurtling through space. Destroy smaller objects to increase your size.

Can you survive to become an unstoppable mass?

Name: One Night You're Crazy
Overview:
Welcome to my strange and bizarre home. I've dismantled my blood soaked teddy bear and scattered his parts in the various closets, shelves and corners of this eerie place. In order for you to escape, you will need to find all these parts and then assemble the cuddly teddy bear in the basement. Did I mention that there was a wolf occasionally wandering the halls that you'll also have to watch out for?

You only have 5 minutes to find all the teddy bear parts and escape. Take too long and you'll wish the wolf had eaten you!

It's like playing tag. Where you collect bloody teddy bear parts. While avoiding a flesh eating wolf.

Name: oOberidiot
Overview: Huh? is what you usually say to people. Thats OK because where you come from everyone does. Aah, home, oOberland! A land of the finest idiocy, the smelliest cheese, the most evil oOberidiot... Well, he may not be evil but thats not the point. The point is youve made up your mind to kick him out and become the new oOberidiot. Go now! Run up that tower! If you can

Name: On a Roll 3D
Overview:
Roll your way through 24 huge levels across six different themes in this fast, colourful 3D platform game.

Be prepared to take on spikes, mines, dynamite, conveyor belts, springs, switches, doors, bumpers, lasers, saws, fire, ice, water, electricity, trapdoors and much much more. Each level has three areas you must navigate your way through, battling a host of enemies along the way, then a fourth and final area where you must take on one of the six end-of-level bosses!

Grab the protective stars as you go and keep an eye out for the many hidden bonuses to help you on your way.

Name: One Finger Death Punch
Overview:
Experience cinematic kung-fu battles in the fastest, most intense brawler the indie world has ever seen! With the unique 1:1 response system of One Finger Death Punch, players will feel the immediate feedback of every bone-crunching hit.

Pay tribute to the masters using five classic kung-fu styles mixed with additional weapons. Combine face-to-face combat with throwing weapons to recreate complex fight choreographies or just send bad guys flying through glass windows. Explore a world map with over 250 stages, 13 modes, and 3 difficulty levels. Unlock 21 different skills that can be combined in thousands of ways to assist you in your journey. Put your kung-fu to the ultimate test in the survival mode.

Name: Ophidian Wars: Opac's Journey
Overview: As Opac, you will will climb, blast, glide, and dash through an ancient network of caves. Search for six hidden relics that unlock new abilities, and collect roots to upgrade them. Think you can platform? See if you can reach the surface to fulfill Opac's Journey!

Name: Opposites
Overview: A competitive/cooperative falling blocks game!

Name: The Oracle
Overview: Ask the Oracle your yes or no questions and prepare for a truth-splosion.

Name: Oozi: Earth Adventure Episode 2
Overview: Oozi: Earth Adventure is where classic platforming fun meets modern visuals and hand-drawn art. Lots of special abilities, dozens of enemies, extra difficult challenge mode and time limited arcade mode specially for hardcore gamers.

Name: One Man Army
Overview:
Built in an underground lab by a team of scientists from steel alloy and raw rage. Raised by a pride of lions until you killed them for food at age six. Trained to withstand face-melting heat, eyeball-freezing cold, and mind-numbing fear.

You are Army, the world's preeminent badass. And you must stand alone

Name: Oozi: Earth Adventure Episode 4
Overview: The fourth episode is set up in on an alien planet. Oozi will use all his skills to get past all dangerous obstacles he's going to encounter in this place. However, no alien lifeform will stop him from getting his spaceship back!

Name: Old Spice: Fresh Card Game
Overview: Set sail aboard the legendary Old Spice clipper ship to the 4 FRESHEST destinations on earth! From coolest to warmest you will sail by Matterhorn, Denali, Fiji and Cyprus. A Fresh, Fast Paced Card Game where the object is to be the last player still holding an Old Spice Fresh Destination Deodorant, making you the FRESHERSHIST!

Name: On a Roll
Overview: On A Roll is a platform game in which you control a multi-coloured spotted ball with eyes (don't ask) that has to travel across 16 levels of increasing difficulty over four unique graphical themes. Collect the protective stars and power-ups as you go - you'll need them if you're to contend with pits of spikes, enemy striped balls, four end-of-theme bosses, and lots more nasties!

Name: One Million Taps
Overview:
Ever since the ancient Greeks developed the first version of natural philosophy, it has been hypothesized that tapping the A button on one's Xbox 360 controller 1,000,000 times would make that person very cool.

Featuring captivating 4-player cooperative play and a never-before-seen "Fast Tap Challenge," One Million Taps may be the best game known to man.

Can you do one million taps?

Name: One Night Two Crazies
Overview:
Perhaps you were just bored or even lonely. Whatever the reason, you foolishly agreed to test out a friend's custom security system. Things start off smoothy, as you monitor your friends wandering throughout the house and occasionally slam your magnetically sealed door in their faces. Then cameras start to break. Your sanity wanes and you start to see impossible visions. A strange spider-like creature joins the creeping entities outside your room. It might all be in your head, but this is becoming a lot more than what you signed up for!

Enjoy a simple, fun, and occasionally frightening simulation. Fun for all ages provided you can handle the scares. No gore, no violence. Just girlish yells followed immediately by nervous laughter.

Name: Orbit One
Overview: Orbit One is an action packed, hyper-competitive multiplayer game played with just one button. Fly around a circular arena collecting orbs while avoiding enemies. Smash through your opponents for extra points!

Name: omg cats game@#$
Overview: An amusing game where a little dot can move around following the track. Using your skills, you just might be able to maneuver the tracks and avoid touching the cats to win. The full version of this game contains a shocking and surprising twist.

Name: Orb Tower Defense
Overview:
Orb Tower Defense is an elemental-based tower defense game featuring an online game mode with up to six players and three different singleplayer game modes.

The towers and creeps can be one of the following elements: fire, water, plant, electric. Each element has strengths and weaknesses to each other. Every type of tower has a total of six possible upgrades.

Name: Orbital Arena
Overview: A 2D Space Shooter that focuses on hardcore multiplayer action! Play the 8 original game types including the fast paced Survivor and the mind provoking Numb3rs! Find different Weapons and Power-Ups to gain advantages over your opponents. Enjoy different visual effects in game including the HIGHLY appealing Retro Mode!

Name: Onager!
Overview: Lead your catapult to destroy blue monsters and their lairs using as little shots as possible.

Name: Old Space
Overview: The goal of Old Space is simple: Take your Faction Leader into the center of Makeout Nebula. Choose a starting faction, perform missions for the Faction Leader and advance in rank and skill. Choose which Skill you want to increase from the SMART Stats so that you are better able to Attack and Out maneuver the Enemy faction ships.

Name: Orbitron: Revolution
Overview:
Launch into a relentless battle against a robotic horde bent on the destruction of an Orbital Power Station. Blast your way through three intense game modes with one of two selectable space fighters.

Beautiful 3D graphics and a soundtrack by Audio Antics await you in Orbitron: Revolution!

Name: Organon
Overview: Organon is a 3D flight and shooting game.

Name: Osr unhinged
Overview: Prepare for some really wacky racing! Negotiate gravity fields, race along moving platforms, hop over boiling lava, collect tokens and attempt to become number one in the hall of fame.

Name: Ostracized
Overview:
Play as fifty foot Annunaki Princess who got attacked by the crazy citizens. Use various weapons and survive forty levels of onslaught.

Can you teach these silly citizens a lesson?

Name: Orbyx: Mystic Orbs of Chaos
Overview: Orbyx is an amazingly addictive pachinko-style game. The goal is to collect all of the golden orbs in the 32 ingenious levels by blasting them with flaming-metal cannonballs. However, you must also summon incredible magic spells and make massive combos in order to get to the top of the scoreboard. It may be easy to start playing but it's impossible to stop!

Name: Origin X
Overview: Create a galaxy, colonize it's planets, and unleash the forces of gravity and fire in order to protect your civilization from extra-terrestrial attack! With 10 campaign levels, and literally hundreds of unique possible scenarios in sandbox mode - see how much space-strategy-awesomeness you can handle!

Name: Outbreak on Uranus
Overview: Just when mankind thought they escaped the zombie threat...

Name: The Outer Rim
Overview:
Control your Sentinel Mark 2 defence droid and protect the colony; upgrade your weapons and shoot super hot plasma at the enemy tanks.

Campaign mode, with protect the convoy, destroy the fuel dumps, wave of attacks, and more!

Mayhem madness with Arcade modes to test your shooting skills for immediate destruction!

Name: Outpost Defender 1.0
Overview: Take role as defender of human outpost. Use Straight Fire or Guided Missiles to Destroy Enemy Combata.

Name: Outpost Defender Online
Overview:
Play as 1 of 4 online players with or against your friends in several game modes: Cooperative, Free For All, Team Death Match.

Select 1 of 6 Experience Levels, in which you can fight with or against your friends to defeat the alien menace.

Name: Ovary Overload
Overview:
In this exciting new game, you take the role of a mere egg cell fighting off legions of sperm who dream of inseminating you. Fortunately, you have been equipped with the most powerful birth control known to man.

Help the egg stop the waves of sperm, and make sure the pill works!

Name: Overdriven
Overview:
Take the Overdriven ship and save the galaxy from an unknown enemy.

1 to 4 Players (Local Co-op), 7 Stages, 7 Secret Items, 7 Challenges, 6 Bosses, 3 Difficulties, 35 Alien Artefacts to find, 20 Awards, Local Highscores, 9 Ship's Levels with Upgrades and Weapons!

Original Gameplay elements (Dynamic Occluders, QTE, Puzzle), Instrumental Soundtrack available from the game Menu.

Name: Overscan Sniper HD
Overview: Do you love your HD TV? Of course you do, but your TV might not be displaying the entire input! Yaystuff gives you the weapons to calibrate your TV and reveal overscan problems. Getting informed is as easy as peering through your sniper scope of overscan doom! If you don't like what you see, you can always just pull the trigger.

Name: Oxadania: An E-book
Overview:
Set in the fictional fantasy world of Glomundia.

Contains a garden pot movement game. (In garden pot movement game move the pot around using the D-Pad and press A up to 2 times to change the scene).

Name: Paddle Wars
Overview:
Conquer the galaxy by brick breaking through dozens of exciting and fun levels.

Upgrade your ship as you advance. Tons of power-ups to collect.

Name: Painting Beats
Overview: In rhythm action game "Painting Beats", it is a purpose to do the paint to the music and to update a high score. Let's select the difficulty that exists in your ability because it is prepared from an easy stage to a difficult stage.

Name: P3
Overview: P3 is an intense twin-stick shooter where you pilot your nano-ship inside a petri dish to protect the nucleus at the center from hordes of invading bacteria. Collect energy from dead bacteria to keep the nucleus powered up, and use power ups, mines, and extra lives to blast your way through 14 tough waves.

Name: Pablo's Fruit
Overview:
Pablo's Fruit is a simple arcade adventure game with more than 20 levels, great graphics, chip music and more.

On each levels, take all fruit and go to exit. There are some monsters who prevent to collect fruit.

Name: Pacific Wings
Overview: The mobile hit game "Pacific Wings" (over 2 million installs already) is finally on the App Store, better than ever!Pacific Wings is a vertical scrolling shoot-em-up and it features retro-style-graphics.The story plays during the "Battle of Midway" in 1942 where you have to fly an American P-38-airplane against all kinds of japanese airplanes.You can control your warbird with the touchscreen. The plane shoots automatically.Features:- Retro-style graphics!- 3 different weaponupgrades on your plane!- different enemies!- Full "Game Center"-integrationIf you find bugs or have any suggestions to make "Pacific Wings" even better please tell us!

Name: Packito lost in space
Overview:
Help packito to clean the galaxy! Picking all the garbage without forgetting to use the right color.

Beware of evil dust throughout the 15 levels of play!

Name: Paddle Baddle
Overview: What is Paddle Baddle you ask? It may look like a simple paddle game but this ain't your grandmas paddle game. This is a Paddle Game on Steroids! (it's ok games can use steroids we checked) Paddle Baddle offers 1 - 4 players 3 Fast paced game modes Obstacles and Power Ups 50+ Lvls All wrapped up in a fast paced game where you can try dominate your friends to earn bragging rights.

Name: Paint Wars
Overview:
A twin stick shooter you can play against the friends you hate most.

3 extras, 5 stages, one of them pink.

A friend of mine got sweaty palms so the game must have some qualities. Get it now so that I can buy a nice present for my mom.

Name: Painting Party
Overview: Draw pictures on your own or with friends over Xbox LIVE. The pencil, brush, bucket and thousands of colors to choose from helps you create the picture you want.

Name: Paipa
Overview: It is the year 1866. The Queen has sent the interplanetary steamer HMS Victoria to claim Mars in the name of the British Empire. You are an engineer responsible for the pressure release valves on deck 43. To release water pressure you have to connect the valves on both sides of the console by rotating pipes and working with tools.

Name: Pajamorama
Overview:
Pajamorama is a fighting game featuring up to 4 player multiplayer either local or over XBox Live, and gameplay so crunchy you could pour milk over it and eat it for breakfast.

Dominatrix librarian pillow fighting in outer space! Bath time soap bubble fights with all your girlfriends! A combo engine so minty fresh, you'll want to brush your teeth with it.

It's PAJAMORAMA, baby!

Name: Pallet Loader
Overview: Use your forklift to get the crates to the correct shelf in time. Earn money to upgrade your forklift or give it a new paint job.

Name: Pan-Global Racing Syndicate
Overview: Whenever anyone has invented anything, people have gathered to see who's the fastest at it. Up to 4 player split-screen allows sweet old racing for modern gamers. Perfectly complimented by peppy piano music making this a fun pastime from past times.

Name: Paint Ball: Splashes of Fun
Overview: Shoot paint balls at your opponent and make a splash. Take fun to the next level across roads, parks, rail roads and so on. Stealth, blobs, turrets, teleport and cars make this a fun splashing adventure. May the best player win!

Name: Paintball War
Overview:
Join the paintball battle with your friends in Avatar Town. Features weapon upgrades, perks, kill streaks, taunts, and lots of paint!

Play offline against bots or online with up to 15 other players.

Name: Paintball Wars 2
Overview:
Join the paintball battle with your friends in this sequel to Paintball War. Features weapon upgrades, perks, kill streaks, taunts, and lots of paint!

Play offline against bots or online with up to 15 other players.

Name: Panic Attack-Devil's Favorite
Overview: The Devils favorite game, Panic Attack, will make you swear, sweat and sing strange melodies of insanity. Speed trough 56 deranging maps on your way to the ultimate challenge: The Lands of Pain! Maps that only a few, hardcore gamers have ever been able to complete. Panic Attack is featuring music from 8 Bit Weapon and ComputeHer.

Name: Partyboat
Overview: Partyboat is... a party on a boat! In what the developers describe as "Love Boat meets Family Guy meets Sim Tower," the player takes on the persona of The Skipper, a retired womanizer who must sail, manage, design, gamble, hire, fire, and event coordinate his way from a sailboat to a cruise ship. Partyboat is a comedy-bound sandbox simulator, loaded with a crazy cast of characters, retro atmosphere, original gameplay, and of course - casinos, showtunes, and sloppy-drunk passengers. It's presented as a unique blend of 2D animation, 3D renders, and live action. With lots of hilarious dialogue and over 80 minutes of music, the game is a big product in a tiny package;

Name: Paper Sky
Overview: Paper Sky is an action packed 2D paper styled scrolling shooter, with unique challenges and Co-Op play.

Name: Parrot Paradise: Lorikeets
Overview:
Parrot Paradise: Lorikeets is the perfect game for parrot lovers everywhere.

Whether it's brushing up on your knowledge of the many types of Lorikeets in the Parrot Guide or just sitting back and admiring them in the Parrot Gallery, if you have even the slightest passion for parrots then Parrot Paradise: Lorikeets is the game for you.

Name: PaperCraft
Overview: It's like if Rambo got all of James Bonds tech into Maverick's fighter jet that was made out of paper. The thinking mans 4 player co-op twin-stick action shooter. As deep or as shallow as you like. Get your meta-game on with strategic resource and upgrade management, open world mission selection, and on-the-fly tactical adjustments. Or just shoot, dodge, power-up and get the high score.

Name: Papercraft Monsters
Overview:
Papercraft Monsters is a first-person-shooter for 1 to 4 players to play either against each other or co-operatively against hordes of cartoon monsters.

The single-player and co-operative modes see players use a selection of weapons to face off against waves of fiendish ghouls attacking from all directions.

Name: Paradox
Overview:
Paradox - A game that pits your wits against the cosmos.

Match blocks together as they funnel into a time-space rip to get a higher score. The higher your score gets the harder the game becomes.

Play across three different modes of play, and hone your skills to become a true Paradox Champion.

Name: Parasitus: Ninja Zero
Overview: Battle an onslaught of monsters in action packed stages, as you travel through time, learn new skills and even team up with a partner to save the future from an interstellar menace.

Name: Parkza
Overview:
Can you rescue your love from the evil sun?

Shoot the sun and avoid getting hit to win.

Inspired by Cannon Ball, Ooops up and Pang.

Name: Paper RPG
Overview: Explore the comical hand drawn world of Paper RPG!

Name: PebbleDash
Overview: Explore deep mines and search for rare jewels. Watch out for falling rocks though!

Name: Path of King Arthur
Overview:
Build up your army and guide King Arthur through Camelot!

A mix of Tower Defense, Action and Strategy, Path of King Arthur contains all of your favorite Camelotia characters, and some of your least favorite, too!

Name: Patterns of Light
Overview: Play through 100 levels of strange and subtle pattern matching, ranging from comfortingly slow and simple to surprisingly quick and challenging. As you progress, you'll uncover an abstract retelling of a vaguely familiar storyline, and, if you're careful and attentive, you might discover you have more control over the plot than you expected.

Name: Pastry Wars
Overview: A lonely baker tries to bake himself friends and before he knows it his kitchen is being taken over by evil pastries.Now your goal is to defend your kitchen and drive out the pastries.

Name: Pedro
Overview:
Pedro is a trick taking card game that is played around the world with various rules. The game is played by two teams of two players. The object of the game is to win a predetermined number of points through a series of hands.

Incorporating elements of other team games like Bridge and Spades, Pedro is a fun, fast-paced game everyone can enjoy.

Name: Peg Solitaire
Overview:
Peg solitaire is a board game for one player involving movement of pegs on a board with holes. Some sets use marbles in a board with indentations.

The game is known simply as Solitaire in the United Kingdom where the card games are called Patience. It is also referred to as Brainvita (especially in India).

Name: Pegzo
Overview: Strategically jump your Pegzos around the board in this 3D adaptation of the classic board game, Peg Solitaire. Sixty-four infuriatingly charming levels across eight themed worlds. Can you leave one Pegzo behind?

Name: Pelleteuse
Overview:
Pelleteuse is a arcade game. Your task is to collect Emeralds, try to stay alive from falling bags and avoid monsters.

You are placed in an underground maze, and can dig horizontal and vertical tunnels through it.

Name: Pellets QuadraStack
Overview: Put your stacking abilities to the test with Pellets QuadraStack. Stack as many pellets as you can without stacking yourself into a hole. Then, compare your score to other players.

Name: Pellmell
Overview: An Original Shootemup. Run Pellmell down the training corridors shooting and avoiding the Training Droids. Packed full of features. More than 100 levels. Awards, Highscores, Story, Cooperative play. Lots of Aliens and Unique playfield control. How High can you score and how many levels can you fight your way through?

Name: Pendoku
Overview: Check out sudoku with a puzzling twist! Fit the pieces into the grid, line up the numbers to solve the sudoku. Millions of puzzle combinations and multiple difficulty levels make this game fun for everyone.

Name: Pendulous
Overview:
Welcome to Pendulous, Operator. Your help is requested to guide a displaced gear through the moving parts of this great machine.

Swing from anchor to anchor, using shifting pipes and steam jets to hurry you along. But avoid the electrical arcs and twisting components that can send you tumbling into the deadly red mist below.

Name: Penny Arcade Adventures: Episode Four
Overview: Penny Arcades On the Rain-Slick Precipice of Darkness 4 concludes the saga of Tycho Brahe, Scion of The Long Project, and his almost certainly human partner Jonathan Gabriel. The world has been destroyed, but existence extends beyond this mortal plane in the gruesome Underhell! The new game expands considerably on its predecessor in size, scope and gameplay. Create the ultimate fighting force by recruiting bizarre, occasionally disgusting monsters and teaming them up with the best trainer for the job!

Name: The Perfect Match
Overview: Take on the role of MatchMaker, where you ask the Contestant and twenty Candidates questions about themselves and each other - all in hopes of finding the Contestant's "Perfect Match". With 3 different Match Levels to choose from, decide how inclusive you want to go in your efforts of finding the Perfect Match!

Name: PentomiGo
Overview: Spread your influence on the board and surround territory, while keeping your opponent at bay. Play against 3 computer opponents, or against your friends in local multiplayer.

Name: Pentominon
Overview: Block meets Sound. Each block on the matrix makes sound like a music sequencer. This game looks like a classic falling block style game, its different and special feature is "make a gap". If you make flowing block, you will get more score.

Name: Perdition
Overview:
Imprisoned for life... Sentenced to death... One chance of escape...

Perdition is a dark fantasy hack-and-slash adventure by Amalgamation Softworks. Carve a bloody path across the dungeon as you evade traps, fight monsters, and search for items. Reach the surface and you will know freedom. Linger in the dark places and only death will find you.

Can you survive?

Name: The Perfect Pickup Line
Overview: Use the power of Old Spice to create perfect pickup lines and win over the ladies. Select one of four Old Spice scents to take with you into battle. Use the word spinner to fill in the blanks for each pickup line. The ladies will respond to your success or failure. Correct words will boost your Old Spice power. When your power is full you may unleash the full potential of Old Spice.

Name: Penkin Ball Dodge
Overview: Join Penkin in an amazing ball dodging adventure. Includes multiple gameplay modes, an original soundtrack, and jaw-dropping artwork. Players will enjoy countless hours of entertainment and excitement. Includes original Ball Dodge and special Defense mode.

Name: Penny Arcade Adventures: Episode Three
Overview: The Startling Developments Detective Agency springs into action as On the Rain-Slick Precipice of Darkness 3 begins, set in motion by a call from a mysterious source. The ever escalating perils on the Rain-Slick Precipice of Darkness will season our tender heroes to their very core! Expect cunning evil doctors, a series of unexplainable thefts, a mysterious book of power, enigmatic supernatural forces, hoboids, roboids, time travelling dinosaurs, and more!

Name: A Perfect Massage
Overview: Relax enjoying different automatic massage sessions using your pad vibrations. Or make your own massage session with the manual mode. Take control on all other pads if you wish! The best XBOX 360 massager ever!

Name: Penga's Peril
Overview: The popular Freaky Creatures pet 'Penga' makes an appearance in his very own mini game, Penga's Peril. Guide Penga through 50 mind twisting levels filled with challenges, teleports and Puff Puff!

Name: Pig & Bullet
Overview:
Someone really wants to shoot you, pig...But at least you have a one second head start and a pair of skis!!!!

Get ready for some bullet hell training...

Name: The Periodic Table
Overview: If you don't know your Elements off by heart then this is your one-stop-shop for all the information you you'll need!

Name: Pigs Can't Fly
Overview:
Pigs can't fly - except in their dreams!

Wallowing in mud is great and all, but sometimes you just want to soar under the stars. Feel the wind on your wings...well, strapped on wings anyway, and just let out a loud SQUEEEEEE as you zoom across the hills below, racing against the moon's descent.

Name: Lumi
Overview: Lumi, the 2010 DreamBuildPlay winner is an action/puzzle/platform game, in a marvelous 2D universe. You control Lumi, a small creature with powers based on magnetism and light, and with the goal to save the universe sunk into darkness.

Name: Pew Pew Pod
Overview: Pew Pew Pod is a frantic arcade shooter with strategic influences. Four unique weapons offer endless avenues of assault against the merciless enemy forces. There are six unrelenting game modes that can each be played with up to four players. Be the best with our global highscore boards divided amongst the game types. Features pick up and play controls and enough depth for hours of gameplay!

Name: PewPewPewPewPewPewPewPewPew
Overview: Two people use two microphones to control one jet-pack equipped, shape shooting space-man. Requires two microphones or headsets.

Name: Pilot Test
Overview: This game is based on information about secret military pilot test. Most information about this test has been collected from uncovered documents and heared from pilots. Our intention is to provide you possibility to check your perception, memory, reflex and challenge you and your skills to compete with real pilots. Can you pass the test and be a military jet pilot ? Good Luck !

Name: Picture Slider
Overview: Unscramble beautiful & interesting photographs while listening to peaceful music from Kevin MacLeod. 40+ pictures of various types taken by the creators themselves and family. No stock photos used! Choose between 5 levels of difficulty. Try to solve the puzzles in the least moves and time.

Name: Petank Party!
Overview: Join the fun in this crazy 3D sport simulation where the goal is to throw metal balls as close as possible to a little wooden ball called the Jack. Compete with up to 6 other players on a local xbox or xbox live and use magic balls to turn the game to your advantage. Customize your alien, giant cat or one of the 6 cool characters. Grab some friends and have fun with Petank Party!

Name: Phibian
Overview: Phibian is a high score based top down scroller. The game features 3D graphics with three outdoor settings and various creatures to ride and defeat. Pick up as many multipliers as possible while preventing creatures from escaping to maximize your score.

Name: Perkunas' Dragon: Episode One
Overview: Perkunas' Dragon combines gamer's three most exciting styles - Shooter, RPG and Puzzle. Forget the old "shoot them up" games, this game rocks with new twists and turns at every level. In Perkunas' Dragon everything is different! If you want to survive you must discover, try and combine magic spells, upgrade your dragon abilities and change the world to solve puzzles. Every level is different and every level brings new challenges. Discover a magical world of Slavonic creatures! Are you ready for a big journey?

Name: Picture Puzzle
Overview: A fun and relaxing sliding picture puzzle game.

Name: Physics Sandbox
Overview:
Create your own physics scenes. Create tanks, catapults, spring guns, rope, ragdolls, cars, and whatever you can think of.

Add custom objects, springs, joints, and hinges and edit their properties.

Includes six examples which demonstrates just a few of the game's possibilities.

Name: Phase Runner
Overview: Use your avatar to explore a unique world where the terrain dynamically reacts to your movement.

Name: Phat Fly!
Overview:
You are Phat Fly, the meanest fly in town.

Customize yourself with hats, hair, and other accessories with money you find in-game.

Upgrade your character with G.U.B.E.R. items such as booger bazookas, bombs, and sheilds.

Battle and avoid tons of different enemies such as bats, toads and even a giant monkey!

Name: Physics Sandbox 2
Overview:
Solve physics based puzzles and create your own physics scenes.

Includes Puzzle Mode and Sandbox Mode.

Name: Picbox
Overview:
Create pixelated pictures from the number clues in this addictive puzzle game!

Featuring 100 puzzles, 28 awardments, a tutorial video to get you started, and many hours of puzzling fun!

Name: Crystal Defender
Overview:
A top down 360 shooter the uses all the power of the 360 modern controller.

How high can you get?

Name: PigMan
Overview:
Your aim is to collect precious gold and emeralds buried deep in subterranean levels of an old abandoned mine.

With your Pigman running, you tunnel out new shafts, scoop up emeralds and race ahead while dodging falling bags of gold and avoiding wide-eyed Trolls hot on your trail.

Name: Pew Pew Pew
Overview: You can not run, you can not hide....all you can do is... PEW PEW PEW! Will you survive...?

Name: Pick
Overview: With Pick, the guitar music rhythm game from Ionic Games, play any song from your Xbox Hard drive or your PC music library! Keep track of your high scores and never be limited to a set playlist of songs again! You Pick It, You Play It! Pick supports most standard guitar controllers.

Name: Pie Collect
Overview:
You are the Pie Sweeper. Your objective is to collect as many Pies as possible. But be wary - a new Orb enemy appears every time you collect a Pie! If you hit even one Orb, you lose!

The full game of Pie Collect features Local Multiplayer, Unlockable Characters, Customizable Options, Single Player Statistics, an original soundtrack and a seriously addictive game at that!

Name: Petunk
Overview: Petunk is a fun putt-putt style puzzle game. Bounce off of walls and obstacles to win. This game is made entirely out of construction paper.

Name: Physics Lab
Overview: Physics Lab is an intuitive yet powerfully complex 2D physics game. Build anything you can imagine using shapes, joints, springs, motors, particles, gravity, emitters, textures and more. Then strap custom controls onto your creation! Includes 12 video tutorials.

Name: PerlMania
Overview: You take one idea and build upon it, that's how great games are made; coincidentally that's what Jey and Oli have done with Perlmania. A game that was just scribbled on a napkin now contains 50 levels and a wonderful, colourful design. We want to share our vision with you. An original puzzler, 50 levels, ether use your brain or just have fun!

Name: Philip Muwanga Presents: Hexy Trench
Overview: 'Hexy Trench' is a fast paced, multiplayer focused game for 1-4 human or AI players. Players will start with a single HQ tile and vie for control of a hexagonal based grid by placing randomly allocated trench tiles to form a trench system.

Name: A Pimp RPG
Overview: Help the city of Oakland by being the cool guy on the street to remove the evil Mayor from office and get Oakland back to normal. This is a fun and funny standard RPG.

Name: Ping Time
Overview: A non-interactive clock program where two computer AI opponents play to keep track of the time.

Name: Pingvinas
Overview: You are near the South Pole. Your penguins jump across ice floes, trying to block your opponent and hunt as much fish as possible. The player with the most fish wins. Play against computer opponents, multiplayer on one machine or online using XBox LIVE.

Name: piniq
Overview:
A modern take on an ancient classic with sweet original music, friggin awesome backgrounds in space, and an extremely fun new mode that will put your reflexes to the test.

Grab a friend and crush'em mercilessly in super piniq turbo.

Name: Pinky vs Blocks
Overview: A game that mixes platforms, cleverness and a retro style. Guide Pinky along more than a fifty different levels where he will need to use his skills and mental controlling on the blocks falling down on him in order to scape the prison of blocks where he's at. If you think of yourself as a master of blocks games, platform games and puzzles, you have to give Pinky vs Blocks a try!

Name: Pioneer
Overview: On a barely inhabited world, some villages have just been founded, seeding civilization. You are one of the villages' hero. Can you ensure your people's survival? Will you lead them to world domination? Pioneer is part role playing game, part strategy game.

Name: Pirates! Quest for Booty
Overview:
It’s the 17th century, the golden age of piracy in the caribbean.

Though not so golden for you, as you languish in jail at Port Crown, your meeting with the hangman’s noose only hours away. However with death staring you in the face, and the hour of reckoning upon you, an unexpected visitor appears at your cell door. It’s the governess of the island, and she makes you an offer that may save your wretched pirate neck. If you can retrieve a magical artifact for her then you will be given enough gold to while away your days in rum, revelry and “womanly relations”.

All you have to worry about in the meantime is cannibals, rival pirates, zombies and man-thirsty amazon warriors. It will draw on all your villainous skills to complete the challenge before you.

Name: Pixel Man
Overview: An experiment in minimalist/retro game design, Pixel Man challenges you to complete 30 platforming levels without save points or fancy graphics.

Name: Pirate Texas Holdem Defense
Overview:
Texas Hold'em Poker anyone? Winning lots of money gets you powerful towers. You better hope that you have the towers you need placed in strategic locations. The waves of Pirates have no mercy!

And just when you think you are good, the boss will show up to challenge you your dominion.

This game is non-stop fun.

Name: Pirates Attack
Overview:
You now have the ultimate defense on your Xbox!

Pirates Attack features a cannon store to purchase powerful cannons to arm you on the forts throughout each of the Antilles. You will encounter battles with Lieutenants, light house, small town, port and forts. There is also a bonus level to help you build up your aim and defend and defeat the Pirate Attacks!

Name: Pixel Animator 3D
Overview:
Let the creativity flow! Pixel Animator 3D is a modelling and animation suite for your XBox360!

Use boxes to build your props and actors, and make whatever scene or story you want. The easy to use model editor lets you quickly make models, or use premade models and avatars to build your scenes.

Name: Pixel Blocked!
Overview:
Put your mind to the test with over 180 creative puzzles, all designed to challenge your spatial logic.

The object of this simple yet challenging puzzle game is to fill in the missing blocks in the outlined image. Shoot blocks against an initial foundation to start and advance through increasingly difficult levels.

Make sure to plan ahead and watch out for those tricky Magnetic and Crumble Blocks!

Name: Pixel Boarder
Overview: Stunt snowboarding in a pixel diorama. 100% analog physics-based control. State of the art retro graphics.

Name: A Pixel Escape
Overview: Play the role of Pixel in this innovative First Person Puzzle-Platform game. As a little pixel your life has always been confined inside a small monitor... but now you have a dream: Escape!! Destroy existing pixels, create new ones and use your special abilities to find the exit. Either if you love mind-teasing puzzles or fast paced action, this game is what you are looking for!

Name: Pirate Cubes
Overview: Welcome to world of Pirate Cubes. Choose from 10 different characters each with their own unique special move. Simple for all levels of skill yet extremely fun to play, especially against your friends or family. You will love the charm of Pirate Cubes.

Name: Pixel Mix
Overview: Pixel Mix is a complex grid based puzzle game. Players must combine color tiles of different colors to create color cubes that will accomplish various tasks. Pixel Mix boasts 4 modes with distinct strategy and game play that contain many levels.

Name: Pioneerz
Overview: A pioneer's life : protect your town, gather food, explore the wilderness, fight hostiles animals, conquer enemies town... The road is harsh to make a peaceful kingdom. Pioneerz is the sequel of pioneer. It revisit and improve all of pioneer aspect (battle, world generation, city building...)

Name: Pixelbit Helicopter Challenge
Overview: Test your piloting skills in 30 challenges over 5 levels. Collect stars, fly through hoops, shoot targets, navigate touch pads and hover pads to gain awards to unlock more challenges and faster helicopters.

Name: Pixelbit Snooker & Pool
Overview: Play Snooker, UK 8-ball, US 8-ball and 9-ball in single player, competition and multiplayer modes. With a fully 3D viewpoint, realistic physics, realtime ball reflections, aim assist, autosave and highscores.

Name: Pixel Whirled
Overview: A retro arcade shooter.. with a twist! Pirate and Ninja must combine forces to save Pixel World! Modeled after the games of yesteryear, this is the first entry in the Holmade Games 8-Bit Series.

Name: Plasma Spheres 2
Overview: Plasma Spheres 2 is a retro arcade game where players navigate a bouncing sphere through a bizarre world. In the campaign, players must collect items and experience to survive waves of diverse enemies including Zombies, Pirates, and Ninjas. In battle mode, a myriad of weapons, items, and objectives make for a wide array of multiplayer fun. A full physics engine makes every match unpredictable.

Name: Planet Pinball
Overview: Rack up the millions with meteors, rockets, orbits, black holes and airlocks as you go in search of the jackpot in this fast-paced, space-themed pinball game. Timing is everything as you use the flippers (and the occasional "tilt") to guide the ball towards the cosmic prizes on offer. With tons of features and secrets, Planet Pinball is light years better than any pinball game you've ever played!

Name: Plasma TV Break In
Overview:
A precision break in program for Plasma TVs. For those who think break in is a good thing.

Colors cycle through full RGB range (0-255), with the values changing by one every 34 milliseconds.

Name: Pixelpix
Overview: Use logic to uncover the hidden pictures against the clock. 80 puzzles to solve in 4 different sizes.

Name: Piz-ong
Overview:
With three stages of pure ball and paddle action, along with a bumping soundtrack by DJ Cutman, you'll be glued to your seat for hours!

A graphical face lift and beautiful particle effects breathe new life into the genre that started it all!

Name: Place the Arrows on the Floor
Overview:
An incredibly fast paced fun family strategy game, Place The Arrows allows up to 8 players to play simultaneously in the same room, and multiple players on only one pad!

Guide people to your castle and monsters to your opponents, but beware- your opponents will be doing the same.

Use your cunning and bonus powers to rescue the most people, and win the game.

Name: Plague
Overview: Plague is an Action game, developed and published by Contagious Games, which was released in 2011.

Name: Planet Crashmania 9,000,000
Overview: Your planet's orbit is decaying and it's about to meet its demise! Build rockets to pilot your people to the safety of nearby planets. Beware of asteroids and alien invaders who want to destroy your planet! Build nukes to eliminate the aliens and clear asteroids from your path. But be careful not to nuke the planets! Watch for power-ups and use nukes to shoot them down and reap the benefits!

Name: Planet Delta
Overview: The journey of your life will bring you to the core of planet Delta. Enjoy this addictive and original 3-match game and choose your own path to the core. With an amazing control system the game offers a travel through mountains, jungles, caves and more, exploring the inside of the far-off planet Delta.

Name: Plasmania
Overview:
Plasmania is a fast paced collection game where you attempt to collect as many blue plasma balls as you can while avoiding the red.

The bigger you are the more points per ball, but the harder it is to maneuver around the red.

See how high you can score!

Name: Pixelosity
Overview:
A new 8-bit styled horizontal shooter! Up to 8 stages of pure shooting action.

Of course playing all alone is no fun when you have friends over, so your friend can join too!

After a run, submit your score to the online and local highscores so you can compete with the world! Try beating the highest score, or even finishing all 8 stages!

Name: Plane Traffic
Overview: Try to navigate each plane to its designated runway. Avoid plane crashes! Sounds simple? It's not!

Name: Planet Wars
Overview: Planet Wars is a top-down alien shooter with unique hand-drawn graphics, exciting action & strategy gameplay and completely customisable weapons!Simple customisable controls make the game easy to pick up and play.Play through the 10 mission campaign, with beautifully illustrated graphic novel style story panels. Missions range from offence to defence missions- upon which you can build a base to stop the alien horde.There is also a survival mode with 6 maps, where you destroy wave after wave of incoming aliens. Compete with local and global (gamecenter) high scores.Earn in-game money with every battle you fight, or even achievement you earn. You can spend on upgrading your weapons by buying different components. There are 7 different upgradable parts, this means you can completely customise your gun and armour to suit your style of play.There are over 70 different items and components in the game with which to do this; including 17 core weapons which range from standard rifles to flame-throwers and rocket launchers: Make a fast firing sniper rifle with exploding rounds, or a deadly powerful shotgun with a bayonet for close encounters!Features:-Main 10 mission story-driven campaign, narrated by graphic novel style illustrations.-Over 70 items/components with which to customise your armoury.-6 Different survival maps with GameCenter high scores.-27 GameCenter achievements which earn you in-game money.-A mixture of action and tower defence style gameplay.

Name: Planetary Shield
Overview:
Planetary Shield is a game of skill in which you have to destroy all the meteorites before they impact on Earth, and yet manage to cover and drive rescue ships fleeing from Earth.

Your armament is a ball of energy generated between two satellites. You can also get items that give you the advantages needed for the most difficult moments.

Name: Plasma Spheres
Overview: Plasma Spheres v1.1 is a retro arcade game where players navigate a bouncing sphere through a bizarre world. In the campaign, players carefully navigate dangerous obstacles in each level to rescue the helpless pulselings. In battle mode, a myriad of weapons, items, and objectives make for a wide array of multiplayer fun. A full physics engine makes every match unpredictable.

Name: Plasma Spheres 3
Overview: Plasma Spheres returns with a whole new campaign featuring 24 levels! Full Xbox LIVE support is back for crazy online multiplayer matches! Dozens of power-ups, a full physics engine, and over a dozen battle levels make every match unique!

Name: Planet Popper
Overview:
Enjoy this extraterrestrial experience matching planets in groups of 3 or more.

Crisp colourful graphics, and relaxing music.

Pop your troubles away!

Name: Perfect Shooting Training Camp
Overview: This game will test your aiming skills.

Name: PerturBirds
Overview: PerturBirds - These Birds aren't just Angry. They are Perturbed.

Name: Pester
Overview:
"Prepare to be Pestered, in a good way!"

Pester is a vertical shoot em' up which blends the old school with the new creating a frantic and fun shooter experience. With over 100 combinations of play, a thumping techno soundtrack, 6 trophies to unlock and a unique old school-new school graphic style Pester is a game for both shooter enthusiasts and anyone up for a good challenge.

Name: The Plat Master
Overview:
The Plat Master is a platformer in which you, the player, create your own platforms to complete the level.

There are 50 challenging floors for you to climb.

Name: Platform Hack
Overview:
Platform Hack is mashup of a hack and slash RPG with a platform jumper.

Explore massive maze-like worlds to slay enemies, find keys and unlock doors, all while jumping, dodge and swinging over chasms and past traps.

Name: Platformance: Castle Pain
Overview:
Old-school platformer ! -more- The Classic Xbox 360 Indie platformer lands on Windows Phone 7. PLATFORMANCE: Castle Pain is a challenging platformer which puts tons of inventive hazards between your heroic knight and the obligatory princess.
If you manage to get to the end, youll keep coming back to beat your fastest time.
Terrific old-school fun!

Name: Platformance: Temple Death
Overview:
While filming her latest movie, famous starlet Grace Belly gets abducted by a sect of evil savages.

You decide to go and rescue her down the 'Temple Death'- a place filled with evil traps where only the fools can survive.

Just like its predecessor "PLATFORMANCE: Castle Pain" (already available on WP7),

"PLATFORMANCE: Temple Death" is a challenging platformer that takes place in a giant single level filled with deadly traps and puzzles.

Name: Perplaxis
Overview: Perplaxis is an intense action puzzle game where you rotate pieces around a board matching based on color, constantly battling against time to keep your board clear. The pieces that show up are based on the seasons of the year: more reds and yellows in summer, blues and purples in winter for example. There are plenty of power ups to help and even a monster named Chompo who scarfs down pieces!

Name: Platypus
Overview: Platypus puts you right in the middle of the action in this ground-breaking side-scrolling shooter game. Guide your ship, Platypus, through 30 challenging and action-packed levels, destroying everything in your path.

Name: Plucky's 3D Adventure
Overview: 3D graphics! Arcade platforming! Lovable characters! Woooo!

Name: Platformer From Hell
Overview: Platformer from Hell combines gravity, switches, and platforming to create an experience unlike any other. Thrilling jumps, mind boggling gravity puzzles, and a pastrami sandwich in distress awaits Tie Guy in the abyss of PFH. Fulfill your primal greed by destroying Tie Guy repeatedly in his tragic quest for the root of all evil. Take control of Tie Guy on his journey to save his sandwich and traverse the depths in this passion inducing platformer.

Name: Playing in Traffic
Overview: Stevie the Safety Pig has some (not so) helpful safety tips for crossing the street. Includes practice!

Name: Playing With Humans
Overview: What would an alien race do upon arriving on our planet? Hold sporting events involving death and destruction of course! Up to four can compete in a one-button contest to wreak the most havoc in three different events: Beating up an unwilling human participant, tossing the most cars on a desert highway, and collecting earthling meat from spaceships above farms.

Name: Plows in Hell
Overview: Plows are trapped in Hell battling for their souls. Try to survive as long as possible on a melting ice sheet surrounded by the fires of Hell.

Name: Plugemons: Part 1
Overview:
Jump, run, DIE, kill, save Plugemons, DIE AGAIN, plug yourself, solve puzzles, evade magma and enormous bosses in an epic adventure with an epic race enslaved by evil machines where dying is a matter of time.

CONSIDER YOURSELF WARNED!

Name: Play As You Go
Overview:
This is a mini arcade setup. It has three games.

Beyond Space is a space shooter. Color Mimic is a memory game. H1N1 a.k.a. Swine Flu is a brick breaker.

Name: Play x Play! Guitar
Overview: This is the application to play the guitar to use Xbox360 controller. The guitar tone can be switched. 864 kinds of guitar chords can be used. Pentatonic scale display. Irregular tuning is possible. The display with the TAB score and the piano roll is possible. 35 quick codes can register. Save/loading is possible.

Name: Plunder Party
Overview: Bring your friends over and conquer the world from your couch! A party style strategy game that mixes turned based and realtime mechanics, which I call semi-RTS. Co-optional 2-4p local multiplayer. There is an endless amount of random generated worlds to bring down. A small light wargame is included, in both single player and local versus.

Name: Pocoro
Overview: Here is Pocoro ! The simple and addictive brain teaser is finally available on iPhone ! Over 70 puzzles to solve in a unique atmosphere... An unforgettable experience !

Name: PointMass
Overview: Use gravitational forces as your weapon and defense in this insanely action packed physics based two stick shooter. Battle varied enemy types and upgrade your ship's abilities to cause more carnage.

Name: Poker Blinds
Overview:
Poker Blinds is a Poker Tournament Management Application. Enter your tournament’s details and let Poker Blinds handle the rest!

Features: Customisable Blinds, Times, Antes, Chips, Stakes, Stats and Prizes.

Name: PowerSpinners
Overview: PowerSpinners is a really fast paced classic-style sports game. Test your skills against the AI (100 difficulty levels) or random opponents from around the world!

Name: Prairie Dog Massacre
Overview:
Are you ready to slaughter some prairie dogs? It's going to be a massacre. Be careful though, some of them can shoot back.

Shoot the prairie dogs with the guns to get more ammo. If you run out of ammo or get shot five times it's game over for you.

Name: Prank Call 2
Overview: It's time to trick the world again in the ultimate Prank Call Game. You have to think fast and talk faster as you try and trick other xbox live players .

Name: Powa Volley
Overview:
Powa volley is a 2D volley game with eight original characters, each having a unique ability that can give the player an advantage in a point.
You can play on four different fields, each having special gameplay elements.
And you can choose to play in different game modes, such as, quick play, classic mode, story mode and you can improve your skills with five challenging mini games.

Name: Poker Date
Overview:
One day, a demon, offers to Adam the chance to conquer the girl of his dreams simply playing a head-to-head Poker with her... Will be able to obtain the heart of the girl?

A beautiful and lovely manga-style game for all Poker fans.

Name: Poker Stacker
Overview: Drop cards to create the best poker hand you can in each row. Earn more points for better poker hands. Don't let the board fill up!

Name: Poker Stacker 2
Overview: Strategize and position falling cards to create the best 5-card poker hand you can in each row. Make a valid poker hand and the row clears, scoring points.

Name: Power Hour
Overview:
Can you make it 60 minutes in this old school drinking game?

Play your music while playing with your friends!

Name: Power-Up
Overview:
The Earth is doomed! As you pilot the prototype fighter, Weapon-F through the debris of your vanquished escape shuttle you come to realise that you are the last human alive. You alone must take on the army of reptilian monsters responsible for the destruction of humankind. You alone must carry out your final mission... Revenge!

POWER-UP is the modern-retro styled Shoot-Em-Up from one-man game studio, Psychotic Psoftware.

Spanning vibrant locations to a monster soundtrack, Power-Up thrusts you into battle with a diverse range of fighters, freighters and titanic level guardians. If you loved retro SHMUP classics like R-Type, Hellfire or Project-X, you'll get a kick out of Power-Up's slick, detailed visuals, challenging gameplay and impressive arsenal of weapons.

Name: Pop Quiz
Overview: Pop Quiz hotshot!!! Do you think you are some hotshot know it all? Prove it. We have the ultimate Pop Quiz covering Anime, Manga, Movies, Television, Music, and Video Games. Think you know more than your friends challenge them to one of our 4 game modes. Take the Pop Quiz and show your right!!

Name: Prank Call
Overview: It's time to trick the world in the ultimate Prank Call Game. You have to think fast as you try and out smart other xbox live players to complete your mission first.

Name: Polar Escape
Overview: Judgment Day has arrived... Global Warming is mounting a full scale invasion to finish off the Polar Bears once and for all. Move the Polar Bears north and help them stave off the uncomfortable feeling of Anti-Life. Nut Bear?

Name: Poker Squares
Overview: Place 25 cards in a 5 by 5 grid to make the 10 best poker hands. The better the poker hands the bigger score. Three modes of play: Solo, against the A.I. and against another Local Player. Each of these can also be played as a Speed Game. A number of top 10 high score tables are kept. Both USA and UK scoring systems are supported. Watch out! The A.I. is very hard to beat!

Name: PolyWobble
Overview: Explore the strange 3D worlds of PolyWobble as you pursue wandering polyhedra, but beware the threats theyll knock you for a loop.

Name: Poopocalypse
Overview:
Poopocalypse is the second installment in a series of deviant indie game concepts, following Quizocalypse which featured Zombies who compete for brains in this multiplayer trivia game catering to nerds and geeks.

Go on a pooping spree as a vengeful, fat pigeon! This twin-stick poop'em up comes with a big load of famous pristine landmarks, a hot pile of squishy trophies and an online top droppers highscore list! You are the messenger of the Poopocalypse!

Name: Powa Volley Classic
Overview: Powa Volley Classic is a 2D volley game. It features two different fields with special gameplay elements. Train alone against the computer or with the training mini game, and prepare to face up to four players on local or online matches.
